  /* V35: connected walking corridors, referenced by both vegetation clearance and NPC routing. */
  const WV_NAVIGATION_GRAPH=Object.freeze({
    routes:Object.freeze([
      [[1,51],[10,51],[17,50],[23,49],[28,51],[30,45],[29,39],[29,35],[27,31],[24,28],[19,26],[15,22],[15,19],[17,17]],
      [[19,31],[24,30],[27,29],[30,30],[34,28],[39,23]],
      [[51,23],[56,23],[61,24],[68,25],[71,28],[72,32],[72,37],[72,42],[72,47],[76,50],[82,51],[86,51]],
      [[51,45],[57,45],[62,45],[67,44],[72,43],[77,43],[82,43]],
      [[7,45],[12,43],[17,40],[21,37],[23,33]],
      [[13,16],[19,18],[25,20],[32,21],[39,22]],
      [[58,18],[62,16],[68,15],[74,16],[79,18]],
      [[60,33],[64,36],[67,40],[68,45],[67,50]],
      [[34,50],[38,48],[42,46],[48,45],[53,45]],
      [[62,26],[64,25],[67,24],[69,27],[73,27],[76,30]]
    ]),
    distance(x,y){
      let closest=1000;
      for(const nodes of this.routes)for(let i=1;i<nodes.length;i++){
        const [ax,ay]=nodes[i-1],[bx,by]=nodes[i],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay;
        const q=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
        closest=Math.min(closest,Math.hypot(x-ax-dx*q,y-ay-dy*q));
      }
      return closest;
    },
    cost(x,y){
      if(WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.hasDeck(x,y))return 1;
      const dist=this.distance(x+.5,y+.5);
      if(dist<.85)return 1;
      if(dist<1.7)return 1.15;
      if(dist<3)return 1.35;
      return 1.7;
    }
  });
  function wvForest(g,a,R,width,height){
    // Flora groups have ecological placement rather than fully random scattering.
    const zones=[

      {name:'Vaela Ancient Woods',x:7,y:37,rx:8,ry:8,pool:[0,2,7,8,17],target:18},
      {name:'West Rainforest',x:6,y:54,rx:8,ry:6,pool:[4,5,12,13,18],target:16},
      {name:'Falls Cloudforest',x:32,y:5,rx:7,ry:5,pool:[0,1,15,16,18],target:15},
      {name:'Aylara Ridge',x:57,y:7,rx:8,ry:6,pool:[3,6,9,11,19],target:16},
      {name:'Talori High Canopy',x:80,y:17,rx:7,ry:10,pool:[0,2,7,15,17],target:17},
      {name:'Orchid Cliffs',x:83,y:40,rx:6,ry:7,pool:[5,8,14,15,16],target:15},
      {name:'Navae Southern Wetland',x:80,y:55,rx:7,ry:5,pool:[4,10,12,13,18],target:15},
      {name:'Elarin Woodland',x:58,y:53,rx:8,ry:5,pool:[8,9,11,14,16],target:16}
    ];
    // The same route graph protects path visibility and guides Maorai NPCs.
    const pathDistance=(x,y)=>WV_NAVIGATION_GRAPH.distance(x,y);
    const placed=[];
    let planted=0;
    zones.forEach((zone,zi)=>{
      let zonePlaced=0;
      for(let j=0;j<zone.target*4 && zonePlaced<zone.target;j++){
        const theta=R()*Math.PI*2,radius=Math.sqrt(R());
        const x=zone.x+Math.cos(theta)*radius*zone.rx,y=zone.y+Math.sin(theta)*radius*zone.ry;
        if(x<1.9||x>a.w-1.8||y<2||y>a.h-2.0)continue;
        if(Math.abs(x-wvRiverX(y))<9.2)continue;
        if(pathDistance(x,y)<3.75)continue;
        if(a.buildings.some(b=>x>b.x-4.7&&x<b.x+b.w+4.7&&y>b.y-4.5&&y<b.y+b.h+5.3))continue;
        if([[63,17],[74,20],[63,30],[76,30],[29,54],[36,55]].some(([sx,sy])=>Math.hypot(x-sx,y-sy)<4.7))continue;
        if(Math.hypot(x-WV_SPIRIT.x,y-WV_SPIRIT.y)<7.6)continue;
        if(placed.some(p=>Math.hypot(x-p.x,y-p.y)<3.35))continue;
        const id=zone.pool[(j*3+zi+Math.floor(R()*5))%zone.pool.length],scale=.64+R()*.50;
        const px=x*T,py=y*T;
        // Gradated forest floor, leaf litter and lichen tied to each individual trunk.
        ellipse(g,zi%3===0?0x1f4838:zi%3===1?0x295a3c:0x365d48,px,py+8,58*scale,22*scale,.28);
        for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
          const lx=px+Math.sin(j*1.7+k*1.9)*22*scale,ly=py+11+Math.cos(j+k)*6*scale;
          ellipse(g,k%2?0x497c4b:0x6e8e5a,lx,ly,11*scale,6*scale,.48);
        }
        wvTree(g,px,py,id,scale,zi*401+j);
        placed.push({x,y});
        zonePlaced++; planted++;
      }
    });
    return planted;
  }

  /* V35: a shared geometric model for rendering, water collision and bridge decks.
     Crossing is possible only on the one tile-wide visible bridge platform. */
  const WV_BRIDGES=[23,45,51];
  const wvRiverX=y=>44+Math.round(3*Math.sin(y*.15)+2*Math.sin(y*.34));
  const WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY=Object.freeze({
    width:88,height:60,tile:T,
    bridgeRows:Object.freeze([23,45,51]),
    moonveil:Object.freeze({x:79,y:55.6,rx:2.55,ry:1.72}),
    river(y){
      const x=wvRiverX(y)*T+16;
      const half=(y<14?8:y<23?6:4)*T+((y>7&&y<16)?(15-y)*20:0);
      return {x,half};
    },
    isPond(x,y){
      const p=this.moonveil;
      return ((x+.5-p.x)/p.rx)**2+((y+.5-p.y)/p.ry)**2<.84;
    },
    creekY(x){return 56.4+.47*Math.sin((x-50)*.18);},
    isCreek(x,y){
      const start=this.river(56).x/T+3;
      return x+.5>=start&&x+.5<=this.moonveil.x&&
        Math.abs(y+.5-this.creekY(x+.5))<.76;
    },
    isRiverTile(x,y){
      const s=this.river(y+.5);
      return Math.abs((x+.5)*T-s.x)<=s.half-T*.09;
    },
    hasDeck(x,y){return this.bridgeRows.includes(y)&&this.isRiverTile(x,y);},
    isWaterBlocked(x,y){
      return (this.isRiverTile(x,y)&&!this.hasDeck(x,y))||this.isPond(x,y)||this.isCreek(x,y);
    },
    bridgeEndpoints(row){
      const s=this.river(row+.5);
      return {left:s.x-s.half-20,right:s.x+s.half+20,y:(row+.5)*T};
    }
  });
  function wvRiverHalfPx(y){return WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.river(y).half;}
  function wvRiverSurface(y){return WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.river(y);}
  function wishBarriers(){
    const barriers=[];
    for(let y=0;y<WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.height;y++){
      let begin=-1;
      for(let x=0;x<=WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.width;x++){
        const blocked=x<WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.width&&WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isWaterBlocked(x,y);
        if(blocked&&begin<0)begin=x;
        if(!blocked&&begin>=0){
          barriers.push({kind:WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isPond(begin,y)?'moonveil-water':'river',x:begin,y,w:x-begin,h:1});
          begin=-1;
        }
      }
    }
    return barriers;
  }

  function wvTerrainQuilt(g,a,R,width,height){
    const bands=[0x345d44,0x3e6d4b,0x4f7652,0x476d50,0x57754d,0x315d49];

        const jitterX=(R()-.5)*13,jitterY=(R()-.5)*11;
        const x=(ix+.45)*T+jitterX,y=(iy+.45)*T+jitterY;
        const tX=x/T,tY=y/T;

        if(tX<27)z=(z+1)%4;

        ellipse(g,c,x,y,35+R()*49,12+R()*18,.13+R()*.13);

    const glades=[[9,22,250,105,0x789263],[22,48,220,88,0x69875b],

      ellipse(g,0x213f36,tx*T,ty*T+10,ww+33,hh+18,.12);

    ];
    function fromRoad(x,y){let d=1000;
      for(const line of routes)for(let i=1;i<line.length;i++){
        const [ax,ay]=line[i-1],[bx,by]=line[i],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay;
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
        d=Math.min(d,Math.hypot(x-ax-t*dx,y-ay-t*dy));
      }return d;
    }
    for(let i=0;i<defs.length;i++){
      const [tx,ty,type,scale]=defs[i];
      if(Math.abs(tx-wvRiverX(ty))<7.2 || Math.hypot(tx-WV_SPIRIT.x,ty-WV_SPIRIT.y)<7.8)continue;
      if(a.buildings.some(b=>tx>b.x-2.2&&tx<b.x+b.w+2.2&&ty>b.y-3&&ty<b.y+b.h+2.1))continue;
      if(fromRoad(tx,ty)<1.95)continue;
      const x=tx*T,y=ty*T,s=scale;
      ellipse(g,0x162d2a,x+8,y+12,126*s,30*s,.28);
      if(type==='outcrop'||type==='cliff'){
        const high=type==='cliff'?105*s:66*s;
        wvPoly(g,0x273e39,[[x-57*s,y+16],[x-37*s,y-high*.67],[x-8*s,y-high],[x+24*s,y-high*.79],[x+47*s,y-12],[x+58*s,y+24],[x+8*s,y+31],[x-38*s,y+27]],.95);

        for(let k=0;k<7;k++)ellipse(g,0x4d8655,x+(k-3)*15*s,y+10-(k%3)*15*s,15*s,7*s,.52);
        if(type==='cliff')for(let k=0;k<3;k++)wvPath(g,0x416f51,3,[[x+24*s,y-65*s],[x+(29+k*5)*s,y-25*s],[x+(31+k*3)*s,y+9]],.66);
      }else if(type==='root'){

      }else if(type==='ruin'){

        wvPath(g,0xc6aa7a,3,[[x-19*s,y-39*s],[x+27*s,y-32*s]],.6);

          const ang=j*2.39,rx=x+Math.cos(ang)*44*s,ry=y+Math.sin(ang)*17*s;

  function wishGround(g,a){

  function ground(g,a){
    if(a.id==='vocalt-greedy-land'){vocaltGround(g,a);return;}
    if(a.id==='old-oriaris'){royalGround(g,a);return;}
    if(a.id==='tech-co'){techGround(g,a);return;}
    if(a.id==='wish-valley'){wishGround(g,a);return;}
    const id=a.id,p=palette(id),R=rnd(4003+ORDER.indexOf(id)*511);
    col(g,p.ground,0,0,W*T,H*T);
    for(let i=0;i<2400;i++){

      col(g,i%3===0?p.grass:p.dot,x,y,1+R()*4,1+R()*3,i%3===0?.16:.18);
    }
    // Perimeter garden belts and sculpted landscape pockets.
    for(let x=2;x<W-2;x+=3)for(const y of [1,H-2]){
      const bx=x*T+R()*12,by=y*T;
      ellipse(g,p.grass,bx,by,37,19,.92);ellipse(g,0xe1e9b8,bx-6,by-4,12,5,.4);
    }
    for(let y=2;y<H-2;y+=3)for(const x of [1,W-2]){
      ellipse(g,p.grass,x*T,y*T,25,34,.88);
    }
    const hy=16*T,vx=26*T;

    if(id==='old-oriaris'){

    }else if(id==='wish-valley'){
      ellipse(g,0x78bfc3,27*T,28*T,265,103,.9);
      ellipse(g,0xb4e8e7,27*T-25,28*T-14,125,28,.6);
      for(let k=0;k<100;k++){

        if((x<5*T||x>51*T||y<3*T||y>32*T)&&R()>.1) continue;

      }
    }else if(id==='vocalt-greedy-land'){

    a.buildings.forEach((b,i)=>building(g,b,p,id,i));

      col(g,0x4b879b,cx-32,cy-75,64,104);col(g,0x294e72,cx-24,cy-66,48,95);

      for(let k=0;k<7;k++)ellipse(g,0xf1dca9,cx-45+k*16,cy-100+(k%3)*19,5,5,.9);

      ellipse(g,0x412b40,cx,cy+13,145,26,.3);
      col(g,0xa5793b,cx-27,cy-69,54,90);
      col(g,0xf0cb66,cx-19,cy-74,38,68);

  function royalBuildingFootprint(b){
    // V52.1: use exactly the painted footprint for every royal building.
    // Palace, opera, academy and estates are solid. The ceremonial gate and
    // garden pathways are independent world obstacles and remain unchanged.
    return [{x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h}];
  }

    function area(id){
    const s=SPECS[id],idx=ORDER.indexOf(id),royal=id==='old-oriaris';
    const wish=id==='wish-valley';
    const vocalt=id==='vocalt-greedy-land';
    const w=royal?88:(wish?88:vocalt?80:W),h=royal?60:(wish?60:vocalt?48:H);
    const prev=idx===0?'english-town-past':ORDER[idx-1],next=ORDER[idx+1];
    const sideY=royal?29:(wish?49:vocalt?23:16), sideH=royal?5:(wish?4:vocalt?5:3);
    // Destinations are tailored to the TARGET map, never to the source dimensions.
    const prevSpawn=idx===0?{x:61,y:11}:idx===3?{x:85,y:51}:{x:W-3,y:17};
    const warps=[{x:0,y:sideY,w:1,h:sideH,label:idx===0?'← Oriaris Village':`← ${SPECS[prev].title}`,to:prev,spawn:prevSpawn}];
    if(next){
      warps.push({x:w-1,y:sideY,w:1,h:sideH,label:`${SPECS[next].title} → · OPEN`,to:next,spawn:{x:2,y:17}});
    }else warps.push({x:w-1,y:sideY,w:1,h:sideH,label:'Train → English Town',to:'english-town',spawn:{x:19,y:12}});
    // Arrival into Old Oriaris always begins at the ceremonial southern gate.
    if(id==='tech-co')warps[1].spawn={x:44,y:54};
    if(id==='old-oriaris')warps[1].spawn={x:29,y:51};
    if(id==='wish-valley'){warps[0].spawn={x:83,y:31};warps[1].spawn={x:2,y:24};}
    const waterBarriers=()=>[
      {kind:'river',x:0,y:0,w:88,h:4},
      {kind:'river',x:0,y:56,w:40,h:4},{kind:'river',x:49,y:56,w:39,h:4},
      {kind:'river',x:0,y:4,w:4,h:25},{kind:'river',x:0,y:34,w:4,h:22},
      {kind:'river',x:84,y:4,w:4,h:25},{kind:'river',x:84,y:34,w:4,h:22},
      // The gate towers are solid; the five-tile central arch remains walkable.
      {kind:'gate-tower',x:37,y:50,w:3,h:6},{kind:'gate-tower',x:49,y:50,w:3,h:6},
      {kind:'gate-pillar',x:41,y:53,w:1,h:3},{kind:'gate-pillar',x:47,y:53,w:1,h:3},
      // Interior of the sculpted garden beds: collision matches the planted
      // zone; no giant rectangular invisible boundary around the gardens.
      {kind:'parterre',x:8,y:20,w:15,h:3},{kind:'parterre',x:65,y:20,w:15,h:3},
      {kind:'parterre',x:8,y:38,w:14,h:3},{kind:'parterre',x:66,y:38,w:14,h:3},
      {kind:'parterre',x:29,y:26,w:8,h:2},{kind:'parterre',x:51,y:26,w:8,h:2},
      {kind:'fountain',x:42,y:30,w:5,h:1},
      {kind:'fountain',x:41,y:31,w:7,h:2},
      {kind:'fountain',x:42,y:33,w:5,h:1},
      {kind:'fountain',x:43,y:34,w:3,h:1}
    ];
    return {id,name:s.name,w,h,theme:'town',seed:6200+idx,spawn:{...s.start},buildings:s.buildings.map(b=>({...b,color:COLORS[id].roof,wall:COLORS[id].wall,chimney:false,...(royal?{collisionRects:royalBuildingFootprint(b)}:wish?{collisionRects:wvBuildingFootprint(b)}:{})})),places:{},
      roadsH:royal?[{y:29,h:5},{y:39,h:2,x0:17,x1:71}]:wish?[{y:49,h:4,x0:0,x1:37},{y:49,h:4,x0:51,x1:88}]:vocalt?[{y:12,h:4},{y:23,h:5},{y:36,h:5}]:[{y:16,h:4}],
      roadsV:royal?[{x:41,w:7,y0:18,y1:60},{x:15,w:2,y0:17,y1:25},{x:70,w:2,y0:17,y1:25}]:wish?[{x:29,w:3,y0:43,y1:51},{x:71,w:3,y0:40,y1:51}]:vocalt?[{x:17,w:3},{x:37,w:7},{x:62,w:3}]:[{x:26,w:4}],
      npcs:[],warps,portals:{},makeObstacles:royal?waterBarriers:wish?wishBarriers:()=>[]};
  }

  const areas=ORDER.map(area);
  // This public array is the only source imported by the pre-existing Phaser area's registry.

      reply={priya:'I organise meetings and help the team agree on a suitable time.',jonah:'I investigate login problems and explain the steps clearly.',erin:'I manage projects and send concise updates to the team.'}[t.id] || `I work as ${t.role}.`;
    }else if(/\b(help|hint|example|how|task|mission)\b/i.test(msg))reply=`Your mission: ${t.prompt} Hint: ${t.hint}`;
    else if(/\b(thanks|thank you)\b/i.test(msg))reply='You are welcome! Keep practising English at your own pace.';

    r.className='result';r.textContent=`${t.name}: ${reply}`;

  function techReview(t,answer){
    const v=answer.trim();
    const checks={
      priya:[
        [/\b(meet|meeting|schedule|call|appointment|available|free)\b/i,'Suggest a meeting.'],
        [/\b(at\s*(\d{1,2}(:\d\d)?\s*(am|pm)?|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|noon)|tomorrow|on\s+(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday))\b/i,'Specify a meeting time.'],
        [/\b(login|log in|sign.?in|page|button|form|password|screen)\b/i,'Describe the login-page problem.'],
        [/\b(because|since|as\s+the|reason|due to)\b/i,'Explain the reason using because or since.']
      ],
      jonah:[
        [/\b(first|firstly|to begin)\b/i,'Begin with First.'],
        [/\b(then|next|after that|second)\b/i,'Explain the next step.'],
        [/\b(should|please|could|recommend|suggest|would)\b/i,'Make a polite recommendation.']
      ],
      erin:[
        [/\b(please|could you|can you|would you|need you|request)\b/i,'Make a request.'],
        [/\b(by\s+(friday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|saturday|sunday|\d|tomorrow|noon|end)|before|deadline|tomorrow|today|next week)\b/i,'Give a deadline.'],
        [/\?|\b(could you|would you|can you|when can|what time)\b/i,'Include a question.']
      ]
    };
    const missing=(checks[t.id]||t.checks).filter(([re])=>!re.test(v)).map(x=>x[1]);
    if(v.split(/\s+/).length<6)missing.push('Write a complete response with at least six words.');
    return missing;
  }
  function check(){
    const t=activeTask,sc=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();if(!t||!sc)return;
    const v=elem('lq-career-answer')?.value||'',r=elem('lq-career-result');
    const missing=sc.area.id==='tech-co'?techReview(t,v):t.checks.filter(([re])=>!re.test(v)).map(x=>x[1]);
    if(missing.length){r.className='result bad';r.textContent=`Try again: ${missing.join(' ')} (Offline checks evaluate task goals, not every grammar rule.)`;return;}
    const id=sc.area.id,key=`${id}:${t.id}`,isFirst=!state()[key];
    state()[key]=true;
    try{sc.store.save();}catch(e){console.warn('career save',e);}
    const done=count(id);
    r.className='result';r.textContent=isFirst?`✓ Task goals met! ${done}/3. Every map is already accessible. Tip: review punctuation and grammar before using your sentence at work.`:'✓ Task goals met. Mission already completed.';
    refreshHud(sc);
    if(isFirst)sc.quests?.toast?.([`✅ ${t.name} — completed`,`Progress: ${done}/3 tasks · All maps available`]);
  }

  const techPos=(x,y)=>({x:(x+.5)*T,y:(y+.5)*T});
  const inBounds=(area,x,y)=>!area.isTileBlocked(x,y) && x>0 && x<area.w-1 && y>0 && y<area.h-1;
  function actorPath(sc,actor,tx,ty){
    const area=sc.area,sx=Math.floor(actor.x/T),sy=Math.floor(actor.y/T);
    // Existing findPath() returns the blocked destination on failure, hence
    // Tech-Co uses its own 4-neighbour bounded BFS with explicit no-path result.
    if(!inBounds(area,tx,ty)||!inBounds(area,sx,sy))return [];
    const key=(x,y)=>y*area.w+x,from=new Int32Array(area.w*area.h).fill(-2);
    const q=[[sx,sy]];from[key(sx,sy)]=-1;
    let found=false;
    for(let h=0;h<q.length;h++){
      const [x,y]=q[h];if(x===tx&&y===ty){found=true;break;}
      for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){
        const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(!inBounds(area,nx,ny)||from[key(nx,ny)]!==-2)continue;
        from[key(nx,ny)]=key(x,y);q.push([nx,ny]);
      }
    }
    if(!found)return [];
    const path=[];let cur=key(tx,ty),start=key(sx,sy);
    while(cur!==start&&cur>=0){path.push(techPos(cur%area.w,Math.floor(cur/area.w)));cur=from[cur];}
    return path.reverse();
  }
  // One image per frame, built once into Phaser's texture cache. 32 x 48
  // pixels at native resolution, not scaled rectangles or remote assets.
  function techTexture(sc,t,dir,frame){
    const key=`lq19_${t.id}_${dir}_${frame}`;
    if(sc.textures.exists(key))return key;
    const g=sc.add.graphics();
    const rect=(c,x,y,w,h)=>g.fillStyle(c,1).fillRect(x,y,w,h);
    const skin=t.id==='jonah'?0xc99476:t.id==='erin'?0xe0ad88:0xefba90;
    const hair=t.id==='priya'?0x372947:t.id==='jonah'?0x2b3546:0x7b4a43;
    const coat=t.id==='priya'?0x4c7d9d:t.id==='jonah'?0x386c74:0x9475a4;
    const dark=t.id==='priya'?0x254b6d:t.id==='jonah'?0x254950:0x634877;
    const darkHair=0x252b42,shoe=0x283d51;
    const moving=frame>0,step=frame===1?2:frame===2?-2:0;
    const side=(dir==='left'||dir==='right');
    // Contact shadow & shoes: anchored to the scene tile center.
    rect(0x375e62,6,44,20,2);rect(0x456970,9,46,14,1);
    rect(shoe,9+(side?step:0),39+(moving?Math.max(0,step):0),6,5);
    rect(shoe,18-(side?step:0),39+(moving?Math.max(0,-step):0),6,5);
    rect(dark,10,29,5,11);rect(dark,18,29,5,11);
    // Coat, cuffs, collar and job-specific accessories.
    rect(dark,8,20,17,12);rect(coat,9,19,15,11);
    rect(coat,5,22+(step>0?1:0),4,11);rect(coat,24,22+(step<0?1:0),4,11);
    rect(skin,6,31,3,3);rect(skin,25,31,3,3);
    if(t.id==='priya'){
      rect(0xe3d8bb,15,21,3,10);rect(0xe9c36e,16,24,2,6);

      rect(0xe5f1e7,9,27,5,3);
    }
    rect(skin,11,9,12,12);
    if(dir==='up'){
      rect(hair,9,7,16,12);rect(darkHair,10,7,13,4);

      rect(skin,dir==='left'?11:20,14,3,4);
      rect(darkHair,dir==='left'?11:21,13,2,2);

      rect(hair,9,6,16,7);rect(hair,9,12,3,7);rect(hair,22,12,3,7);
      rect(darkHair,10,6,14,3);
      // A 2-pixel blink in the idle frames makes sprites feel alive.
      const blink=frame===3;

    if(t.id==='erin'){rect(0xcf9f6f,10,7,4,2);rect(0xcf9f6f,20,7,4,2);}
    g.generateTexture(key,32,48);g.destroy();

  function techActor(sc,t){
    const p=techPos(t.x,t.y);
    const image=sc.add.image(p.x,p.y,techTexture(sc,t,'down',0)).setOrigin(.5,.93).setDepth(10);
    const label=sc.add.text(p.x,p.y-51,`${t.name}  ✦`,{
      fontFamily:'system-ui,Arial',fontSize:'12px',fontStyle:'bold',color:'#ffe5ad',
      backgroundColor:'#142e40ee',padding:{x:6,y:3}
    }).setOrigin(.5,1).setDepth(12);
    const zone=sc.add.zone(p.x,p.y-15,40,54).setDepth(11).setInteractive({cursor:'pointer'});
    const actor={t,x:p.x,y:p.y,image,label,zone,face:'down',phase:0,path:[],mode:'IDLE',site:'',lastSchedule:-1,
      lastWander:0,seenAt:0,indoors:false};
    zone.on('pointerdown',()=>{
      if(!canTalk(sc,t))sc.quests?.toast?.([`Walk closer to ${t.name} to talk.`]);
      else open(t);
    });
    sc.areaObjs.push(image,label,zone);
    return actor;
  }
  function getAgents(sc){return sc&&techActors.get(sc)||null;}
  function samePlane(sc,a){
    if(!sc?.inside)return !a.indoors;
    return !!a.indoors&&a.indoors===sc.inside.b.name;
  }
  function canTalk(sc,t){
    if(!sc||!t||sc.switching||sc.sleeping)return false;
    if(sc.area?.id==='old-oriaris'){
      const a=getRoyalAgents(sc)?.get(t.id);
      return !sc.inside&&!!a&&Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y)<76;
    }
    if(sc.area?.id!=='tech-co')return !sc.inside&&Math.hypot(sc.player.x-(t.x+.5)*T,sc.player.y-(t.y+.5)*T)<72;
    const a=getAgents(sc)?.get(t.id);
    return !!a&&samePlane(sc,a)&&Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y)<76;
  }
  function closestCareer(sc){
    if(!sc||!isNew(sc.area?.id))return null;
    let best=76,found=null;
    for(const t of ASSIGNMENTS[sc.area.id]){
      if(!canTalk(sc,t))continue;
      const a=sc.area.id==='old-oriaris'?getRoyalAgents(sc)?.get(t.id):getAgents(sc)?.get(t.id);
      const d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-(a?.x??(t.x+.5)*T),sc.player.y-(a?.y??(t.y+.5)*T));
      if(d<best){best=d;found=t;}
    }
    return found;
  }
  function getSlot(t,minutes){return TECH_JOBS[t.id].find(s=>minutes<s.until)||TECH_JOBS[t.id].at(-1);}
  function syncTechIndoor(sc){
    const agents=getAgents(sc);if(!agents)return;
    const b=sc.inside?.b?.name||null;
    const unit=32*(sc.inside?.k||1);
    const spots={priya:[8,6],jonah:[6,6],erin:[9,6]};
    for(const a of agents.values()){
      const room=TECH_ROOMS[a.site],active=!!b&&b===room;
      if(active && !a.indoors){
        a.outPos={x:a.x,y:a.y};a.path=[];
        a.indoors=b;a.x=20000+(spots[a.t.id][0]+.5)*unit;
        a.y=20000+(spots[a.t.id][1]+.5)*unit;
        a.image.setScale(sc.inside.k);
      }else if(!active&&a.indoors){
        a.indoors=false;a.image.setScale(1);
        a.x=a.outPos?.x??(a.t.x+.5)*T;
        a.y=a.outPos?.y??(a.t.y+.5)*T;
        a.outPos=null;
      }
      const show=!b||active;
      a.image.setVisible(show);a.label.setVisible(show);a.zone.setActive(show).setVisible(show);
      a.image.setPosition(a.x,a.y);
      a.label.setPosition(a.x,a.y-50*(sc.inside?.k||1));
      a.zone.setPosition(a.x,a.y-15*(sc.inside?.k||1));
    }
    for(const x of (sc.__techOutdoorLabels||[]))if(x?.active)x.setVisible(!b);
  }
  function updateTechAgents(sc,time){
    const agents=getAgents(sc);if(!agents||sc.switching)return;
    const dt=Math.min(80,Math.max(0,time-(sc.__careerAgentTime??time)));
    sc.__careerAgentTime=time;
    const minutes=Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes??480);
    if(sc.inside){syncTechIndoor(sc);return;}
    for(const a of agents.values()){
      if(a.indoors){a.indoors=false;a.image.setScale(1);a.x=a.outPos?.x??a.x;a.y=a.outPos?.y??a.y;}
      const slot=getSlot(a.t,minutes);
      if(a.site!==slot.site||a.lastSchedule!==slot.until){
        a.site=slot.site;a.lastSchedule=slot.until;a.path=actorPath(sc,a,...slot.tile);
      }
      const chatting=isDialogOpen()&&activeTask?.id===a.t.id;
      if(chatting){a.mode='TALK';}
      else if(a.path.length){
        a.mode='WALK';
        const goal=a.path[0],dx=goal.x-a.x,dy=goal.y-a.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy),step=46*dt/1000;
        if(dist<step+.5){a.x=goal.x;a.y=goal.y;a.path.shift();}
        else {a.x+=dx/dist*step;a.y+=dy/dist*step;}
        a.face=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?dx>0?'right':'left':dy>0?'down':'up';
      }else{
        a.mode=slot.activity;
        // Idle shifts are occasional and bounded to a clear walkable tile.
        if(time-a.lastWander>11500){
          a.lastWander=time+(['priya','jonah','erin'].indexOf(a.t.id)*1700);
          const x=Math.floor(a.x/T),y=Math.floor(a.y/T);
          const near=[[x,y],[x+1,y],[x-1,y],[x,y+1],[x,y-1]];
          const [tx,ty]=near[(Math.floor(time/12000)+a.t.id.length)%near.length];
          if(inBounds(sc.area,tx,ty))a.path=actorPath(sc,a,tx,ty);
        }
      }
      if(a.mode==='WALK')a.phase+=dt/190;
      const frame=a.mode==='WALK'?1+(Math.floor(a.phase)%2):(Math.floor(time/2800+a.t.id.length)%9===0?3:0);
      const key=techTexture(sc,a.t,a.face,frame);
      if(a.image.texture.key!==key)a.image.setTexture(key);
      a.image.setPosition(a.x,a.y);
      a.label.setPosition(a.x,a.y-48);
      const caption=`${a.t.name} ${state()[`tech-co:${a.t.id}`]?'✓':'✦'}`;
      if(a.label.text!==caption)a.label.setText(caption);
      a.zone.setPosition(a.x,a.y-15);
    }
  }
  /* V35: unobtrusive Maorai interior dressing; uses existing interior geometry,
     game collision and lifecycle, with no extra save data or scene transition. */
  function wvInteriorArt(sc){
    const room=sc.inside;if(!room?.objs?.length)return;
    const name=room.b?.name||'',origin=room.objs[0],unit=32*(room.k||1);
    const x=origin.x,y=origin.y,w=room.spec.w*unit,h=room.spec.h*unit;
    if(!Number.isFinite(x+y+w+h))return;
    const g=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.25);
    room.objs.push(g);
    // Woven wall bands, in keeping with the organic wood-and-bamboo exterior.
    col(g,0x735c40,x+unit*.9,y+unit*1.35,w-unit*1.8,unit*.17,.58);
    for(let k=0;k<7;k++){
      const px=x+(1.3+k*(room.spec.w-2.6)/6)*unit;
      wvPath(g,k%2?0xcab484:0x718362,1.5,[[px-8,y+unit*1.31],[px,y+unit*1.18],[px+8,y+unit*1.31]],.62);
    }
    const shelf=(px,py)=>{
      col(g,0x665039,px-22,py,44,5,.88);
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++)col(g,i%2?0xbda16e:0x87a47b,px-17+i*9,py-10,7,11,.9);
    };
    if(name.includes('ELDER')){
      ellipse(g,0x7b6651,x+w*.48,y+h*.48,unit*2.5,unit*1.2,.21);
      ellipse(g,0xb1a178,x+w*.48,y+h*.48,unit*2.1,unit*.8,.29);
      shelf(x+unit*1.5,y+unit*2.4);shelf(x+w-unit*1.5,y+unit*2.4);
      wvPath(g,0xd5c08b,3,[[x+w*.45,y+unit*1.35],[x+w*.5,y+unit*.9],[x+w*.55,y+unit*1.35]],.65);
    }else if(name.includes('COUNCIL')){
      ellipse(g,0x5f4b36,x+w*.5,y+h*.45,unit*2.2,unit*.82,.35);
      ellipse(g,0xc0a477,x+w*.5,y+h*.43,unit*1.8,unit*.63,.35);
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++)col(g,i%2?0xc5c6a1:0x9b9c7a,x+w*.5-unit*.64+i*unit*.39,y+h*.4,unit*.28,unit*.08,.76);
      shelf(x+unit*1.6,y+unit*2.25);
    }else if(name.includes('VAELA')){
      for(let k=0;k<3;k++)wvBasket(g,x+unit*(1.65+k*.55),y+h-unit*2.25,0xd1b472);
      wvPlanter(g,x+w-unit*1.85,y+unit*2.22,unit*.9);
      ellipse(g,0x986f43,x+unit*1.8,y+unit*2.8,unit*.75,unit*.35,.55);
    }else if(name.includes('EXPLORER')){
      col(g,0x927656,x+unit*1.2,y+unit*2.1,unit*2,unit*.75,.56);
      col(g,0xd9c69c,x+unit*1.32,y+unit*2.17,unit*1.7,unit*.54,.8);
      for(let j=0;j<5;j++)wvPath(g,0x749586,1.5,[[x+unit*1.42,y+unit*(2.27+j*.08)],[x+unit*2.7,y+unit*(2.26+j*.08)]],.54);
      shelf(x+w-unit*1.7,y+unit*2.25);
    }
  }

  function onInteriorEnter(sc){
    if(sc?.area?.id==='vocalt-greedy-land'){v481InteriorArt(sc);return;}
    if(sc?.area?.id==='wish-valley'){wvInteriorArt(sc);return;}
    if(sc?.area?.id==='old-oriaris'){syncRoyalIndoor(sc);if(sc.__careerFx?.active)sc.__careerFx.clear();return;}
    if(sc?.area?.id!=='tech-co')return;
    syncTechIndoor(sc);
    if(sc.__careerFx?.active)sc.__careerFx.clear();
  }
  function onInteriorLeave(sc){if(sc?.area?.id==='tech-co')syncTechIndoor(sc);else if(sc?.area?.id==='old-oriaris')syncRoyalIndoor(sc);}

  function vOutfitPixel(sym,kind){
    const p=V_OUTFITS[kind%V_OUTFITS.length];
    if('13467OGMPQRU'.includes(sym)){
      if('347O'.includes(sym))return sym==='7'?p[1]:sym==='4'?p[2]:p[0];
      if('6GMPQU'.includes(sym))return p[2];
      if(sym==='R')return p[1];
      return p[0];
    }
    return V_PIXEL_PALETTE[V_PIXEL_ALPHABET.indexOf(sym)];
  }

  /* V47: Original-blue-template dimensions 29x42. Artwork from the 50 approved
     portraits, normalized to a single pixel grid and loaded from a local embedded
     PNG atlas. No external requests, no per-frame image loading or sprite distortion. */
  function vTexture(sc,kind,dir='down',frame=0,variant=0,lookId=-1){
    if(lookId<0||lookId>=50)return v46LegacyTexture(sc,kind,dir,frame,variant,lookId);
    const key=`lqV47_${lookId}_${dir}_${frame}`;
    if(sc.textures.exists(key))return key;
    const atlas=document.getElementById('lq-v47-npc-atlas');
    if(!atlas||!atlas.complete||atlas.naturalWidth!==290)return v46LegacyTexture(sc,kind,dir,frame,variant,lookId);
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=29;canvas.height=42;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:false});ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    const sx=(lookId%10)*29,sy=Math.floor(lookId/10)*42;
    if(dir==='left'){
      ctx.translate(29,0);ctx.scale(-1,1);
    }
    ctx.drawImage(atlas,sx,sy,29,42,0,0,29,42);
    // Walk frames: minimal boot-shift only, maintaining the compact original base form.
    if(frame===1||frame===2){
      ctx.clearRect(3,35,23,7);
      const left=frame===1?-1:1,right=-left;
      ctx.drawImage(atlas,sx+3,sy+35,11,7,3,35+left,11,7);
      ctx.drawImage(atlas,sx+15,sy+35,11,7,15,35+right,11,7);
    }
    // Same front-facing pixel anatomy across directions; a light back-of-head layer
    // hides facial landmarks when facing away, without changing the character size.
    if(dir==='up'){
      const head=ctx.getImageData(8,5,14,7);const pix=head.data;
      let rr=66,gg=47,bb=48,nn=0;
      for(let i=0;i<pix.length;i+=4)if(pix[i+3]>100&&pix[i]<140){rr+=pix[i];gg+=pix[i+1];bb+=pix[i+2];nn++;}
      rr=Math.round(rr/(nn+1));gg=Math.round(gg/(nn+1));bb=Math.round(bb/(nn+1));
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgb(${rr},${gg},${bb})`;ctx.fillRect(11,15,8,5);
    }
    try{
      sc.textures.addCanvas(key,canvas);
      sc.textures.get(key).setFilter(Phaser.Textures.FilterMode.NEAREST);
      return key;
    }catch(e){return v46LegacyTexture(sc,kind,dir,frame,variant,lookId);}
  }
  window.LQV47ArtworkReady=()=>{
    const atlas=document.getElementById('lq-v47-npc-atlas');
    return !!(atlas&&atlas.complete&&atlas.naturalWidth===290);
  };

  window.LQV46TextureForLook=(lookId,dir='down',frame=0)=>{
    const sc=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();
    if(!sc)return null;
    const p=V46_LOOKS[lookId];if(!p)return null;
    return vTexture(sc,p.kind,dir,frame,p.variant,lookId);
  };

  function vNearest(sc){
    if(sc?.area?.id!=='vocalt-greedy-land'||sc.inside)return null;
    let nearest=null,best=82;
    for(const a of (vActors.get(sc)||[])){
      if(a.quest)continue;
      const d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y);
      if(d<best){best=d;nearest=a;}
    }
    return nearest;
  }

  function vUpdate(sc,time){
    const actors=vActors.get(sc);if(!actors||sc.switching)return;
    const dt=Math.min(80,Math.max(0,time-(sc.__vLast||time)));sc.__vLast=time;
    const indoor=!!sc.inside;
    if(indoor&&sc.__vLifeFx?.active)sc.__vLifeFx.clear();
    for(const a of actors){
      a.img.setVisible(!indoor).setActive(!indoor);
      a.label.setVisible(!indoor&&Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y)<77);
      if(indoor)continue;
      const isStatic=a.quest||a.type==='lord'||a.type==='vendor'||a.type==='stallVendor';
      if(!isStatic){
        if(a.path.length===0&&time>=a.hold){
          const target=a.route[a.target%a.route.length];a.target=(a.target+1)%a.route.length;
          a.path=actorPath(sc,a,target[0],target[1]);
          a.hold=time+a.pause+(a.n%5)*170;
        }
        if(a.path.length){
          const p=a.path[0],dx=p.x-a.x,dy=p.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
          if(d<1.6){a.x=p.x;a.y=p.y;a.path.shift();}
          else{
            const speed=a.type==='courier'?52:a.type==='manager'?36:a.type==='vendor'?13:a.type==='resident'?30:34;
            const step=Math.min(d,speed*dt/1000),nx=a.x+dx/d*step,ny=a.y+dy/d*step;
            if(!sc.area.isTileBlocked(Math.floor(nx/T),Math.floor(ny/T)) && !sc.blocked(nx,ny)){
              a.x=nx;a.y=ny;a.face=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?dx>0?'right':'left':dy>0?'down':'up';
              a.phase+=dt/195;a.stuck=0;
            }else{a.stuck+=dt;if(a.stuck>620){a.path=[];a.stuck=0;a.hold=time+1200;}}
            if(step>=d)a.path.shift();
          }
          a.mode='WALK';
        }else{
          const cycle=Math.floor((time+a.n*639)/(a.type==='vendor'?1700:2600))%4;
          a.mode=a.type==='vendor'?['SERVE','DISPLAY','COUNT','IDLE'][cycle]:
              a.type==='customer'?['BROWSE','BUY','CHAT','IDLE'][cycle]:
              a.type==='courier'?['DELIVER','CARRY','REST','IDLE'][cycle]:
              a.type==='manager'?['INSPECT','WRITE','WAIT','IDLE'][cycle]:
              a.type==='tourist'?['LOOK','MAP','POINT','IDLE'][cycle]:
              ['TALK','REST','LOOK','IDLE'][cycle];
          if(a.partner&&Math.hypot(a.x-a.partner.x,a.y-a.partner.y)<92){
            a.mode='BUY';a.face=a.partner.x<a.x?'left':'right';
            a.partner.face=a.x>a.partner.x?'right':'left';
          }
        }
      }else a.mode=a.type==='lord'?'INSPECT':(a.type==='vendor'||a.type==='stallVendor')?['DISPLAY','SERVE','INVITE','COUNT'][Math.floor((time+a.n*517)/2100)%4]:'IDLE';
      const frame=a.mode==='WALK'?1+Math.floor(a.phase)%2:(Math.floor(time/2450+a.n)%17===0?3:0);
      const tex=vTexture(sc,a.kind,a.face,frame,a.variant,a.lookId);
      if(a.img.texture.key!==tex)a.img.setTexture(tex);
      a.img.setPosition(Math.round(a.x),Math.round(a.y));a.img.setDepth(8+a.y/10000);
      a.label.setPosition(a.x,a.y-50);
    }
    if(sc.__vInfo?.active){
      const near=vNearest(sc);
      if(near&&!indoor){sc.__vInfo.setVisible(true).setPosition(near.x,near.y-52);
        sc.__vInfo.setText(`✦ ${near.person?.job||near.role} · E to talk`);
      }else sc.__vInfo.setVisible(false);
    }
    // Real trade encounters: visibly pass a package/coin between shopper and staffed counter.
    if(!indoor&&time-(sc.__vLastFx||0)>130&&sc.__vLifeFx?.active){
      sc.__vLastFx=time;
      const g=sc.__vLifeFx;g.clear();
      const cam=sc.cameras?.main;
      let count=0;
      for(const a of actors){
        if(a.type!=='customer'||!a.partner)continue;
        const v=a.partner,d=Math.hypot(a.x-v.x,a.y-v.y);
        if(d>91||count>=18||a.mode!=='BUY')continue;
        if(cam){const view=cam.worldView;if(a.x<view.x-70||a.x>view.right+70||a.y<view.y-70||a.y>view.bottom+70)continue;}
        const f=(Math.sin(time*.005+a.n*2)+1)/2;
        const px=a.x+(v.x-a.x)*f,py=a.y-16+(v.y-a.y)*f;
        g.fillStyle(0x33313a,.65).fillRect(px-4,py-4,9,9);
        g.fillStyle(a.n%2?0xf2d087:0xb5dca5,.98).fillRect(px-2,py-3,6,6);
        g.fillStyle(0xffffff,.7).fillRect(px-1,py-3,2,2);
        count++;
      }
      // Periodic small stock-handling motion at the vendor's hand, plus glitter for luxury shops.
      for(const a of actors){
        if(a.type!=='vendor'||cam&&Math.abs(a.x-sc.player.x)>750)continue;
        const shift=Math.round(Math.sin(time*.004+a.n)*2),x=a.x+14,y=a.y-19;
        g.fillStyle(a.kind<2?0xe2ca87:0xb99a6e,.85).fillRect(x,y+shift,7,4);
        g.fillStyle(0x766049,.9).fillRect(x,y+shift+4,7,2);
      }
      if(count>0&&Math.floor(time/1800)!==Math.floor((time-130)/1800))sc.__vTradeCount+=count;
    }
  }
  function sprite(sc,t){
    if(sc.area.id==='vocalt-greedy-land')return; // V41 vAttach() spawns both C1 mentors and a living crowd.
    if(sc.area.id==='old-oriaris'){
      if(!getRoyalAgents(sc))royalActors.set(sc,new Map());
      getRoyalAgents(sc).set(t.id,royalActor(sc,t));return;
    }
    if(sc.area.id!=='tech-co'){legacySprite(sc,t);return;}
    if(!getAgents(sc))techActors.set(sc,new Map());
    getAgents(sc).set(t.id,techActor(sc,t));
  }
  function legacySprite(sc,t){
    const x=(t.x+.5)*T,y=(t.y+.5)*T;
    const g=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(10);

  function techPulse(g,time){

      const yy=4*T+40+i*21;
      col(g,0xc2ffff,6*T+15+((time*.013+i*53)%(15*T-60)),yy,8,2,.16);
    }
    // Exactly three light cells for Priya, Jonah, and Erin achievements.
    for(const [i,id] of ['priya','jonah','erin'].entries()){

    }

      for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
        const yy=y-12-k*24;
        col(g,0xa3ebcf,x-23,yy,46,3,.12+(Math.sin(phase*2+k)+1)*.08);
      }
    }
    // Co-Work Garden fountain: limited animated ripples and tiny floating lights.
    const fx=27.5*T,fy=27.7*T;
    for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
      const rr=10+(phase*8+k*18)%54;
      g.lineStyle(2,0xb6e8e3,.07+(1-rr/72)*.20);
      g.strokeEllipse(fx,fy,rr*2,rr*.54);
    }

      ellipse(g,0xc7f4de,fx+dx,fy-dy,4,4,.24);
    }
    techFuturePulse(g,time);
  }

  function wvCivGridSafe(a,x,y){
    const tx=Math.floor(x),ty=Math.floor(y);
    if(!a||tx<2||ty<2||tx>=a.w-2||ty>=a.h-2)return false;
    if(a.isTileBlocked(tx,ty)||a.warpAt?.(tx,ty))return false;
    // The decorative 1-tile-wide banks cannot be crossed outside the real deck.
    if(WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isWaterBlocked(tx,ty))return false;
    return true;
  }
  function wvCivNearestSafe(a,point){
    if(!point||point.length<2)return null;
    if(wvCivGridSafe(a,point[0],point[1]))return [Math.floor(point[0]),Math.floor(point[1])];
    for(let r=1;r<Math.max(a.w,a.h);r++){
      let best=null,bestDist=Infinity;
      for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++){
        if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))!==r)continue;
        const x=Math.floor(point[0])+dx,y=Math.floor(point[1])+dy;
        if(!wvCivGridSafe(a,x,y))continue;
        const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(d<bestDist){best=[x,y];bestDist=d;}
      }
      if(best)return best;
    }
    return null; // Never substitute an unverified spawn or teleport through water.
  }
  // Cached terrain movement costs: computed once for the immutable Wish Valley map.
  let WV_NAV_COST_CACHE=null;
  function wvNavCostGrid(a){
    if(!WV_NAV_COST_CACHE||WV_NAV_COST_CACHE.length!==a.w*a.h){
      const cost=new Float32Array(a.w*a.h);
      for(let y=0;y<a.h;y++)for(let x=0;x<a.w;x++)cost[x+y*a.w]=WV_NAVIGATION_GRAPH.cost(x,y);
      WV_NAV_COST_CACHE=cost;
    }
    return WV_NAV_COST_CACHE;
  }
  // Weighted 4-way A* with deterministic ties, road priority and safe directional waypoint merging.
  function wvCivRoute(a,start,target){
    if(!a||!target)return [];
    const sx=Math.floor(start.x/T),sy=Math.floor(start.y/T);
    const dst=wvCivNearestSafe(a,target);
    if(!dst||!wvCivGridSafe(a,sx,sy))return [];
    const [tx,ty]=dst,w=a.w,h=a.h;
    const n=w*h,from=sy*w+sx,to=ty*w+tx;
    const movementCosts=wvNavCostGrid(a);
    if(from===to)return [];
    const cost=new Float64Array(n).fill(Infinity),previous=new Int32Array(n).fill(-1),closed=new Uint8Array(n);
    const heap=[];
    function push(node,score){
      const item={node,score};heap.push(item);
      for(let i=heap.length-1;i>0;){const p=(i-1)>>1;if(heap[p].score<=item.score)break;heap[i]=heap[p];i=p;heap[i]=item;}
    }
    function pop(){
      const out=heap[0],last=heap.pop();if(heap.length){let i=0;
        while(i*2+1<heap.length){let child=i*2+1;if(child+1<heap.length&&heap[child+1].score<heap[child].score)child++;
          if(heap[child].score>=last.score)break;heap[i]=heap[child];i=child;}
        heap[i]=last;
      }return out;
    }
    const heuristic=(x,y)=>(Math.abs(x-tx)+Math.abs(y-ty));
    cost[from]=0;push(from,heuristic(sx,sy));
    let steps=0;
    while(heap.length&&steps++<n*7){
      const {node}=pop();if(closed[node])continue;closed[node]=1;
      if(node===to)break;
      const x=node%w,y=Math.floor(node/w);
      for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0],[0,-1]]){
        const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(!wvCivGridSafe(a,nx,ny))continue;
        const next=ny*w+nx;if(closed[next])continue;
        const price=cost[node]+movementCosts[next];
        if(price+1e-6<cost[next]){cost[next]=price;previous[next]=node;push(next,price+heuristic(nx,ny));}
      }
    }
    if(previous[to]===-1)return [];
    const raw=[];for(let at=to;at!==from;at=previous[at]){
      if(at<0||raw.length>n)return [];
      raw.push({x:(at%w+.5)*T,y:(Math.floor(at/w)+.5)*T});
    }
    raw.reverse();
    // Compress straight segments only; never smooth across diagonal wall corners.
    const route=[];
    for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){
      const before=i===0?{x:(sx+.5)*T,y:(sy+.5)*T}:raw[i-1];
      const after=raw[i+1];
      if(!after||Math.sign(raw[i].x-before.x)!==Math.sign(after.x-raw[i].x)||
        Math.sign(raw[i].y-before.y)!==Math.sign(after.y-raw[i].y))route.push(raw[i]);
    }
    return route;
  }

      if(!home||!work||!social){console.warn('WV V35: no safe target for',def.id);return null;}

      const zone=sc.add.zone(x,y-12,30,46).setInteractive({cursor:'pointer'}).setDepth(9.9);
      sc.areaObjs.push(zone);
      const altar=wvCivNearestSafe(sc.area,[63+(i%4)*2,25+(i%3)*2]);
      const graphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(9.8);
      sc.areaObjs.push(graphics);
      const npc={...def,index:i,home,work,social,altar,x,y,zone,graphics,route:[],goal:'',facing:'down',mode:'IDLE',stride:0,activityPhase:i*1.43,stuckFor:0};
      zone.on('pointerdown',()=>{
        if(Math.hypot(sc.player.x-npc.x,sc.player.y-npc.y)<92)wvLivingOpen(npc);
        else sc.quests?.toast?.([`Walk closer to ${npc.name} to talk.`]);
      });
      return npc;
    }).filter(Boolean);
    const creatures=WV_WILDLIFE.map(([type,tx,ty],i)=>{
      const aquatic=['otter','fish','waterbird'].includes(type);
      const lagoon=aquatic&&tx>=72;
      const px=lagoon?(tx+.5)*T:aquatic?wvRiverSurface(ty+.5).x+((i%3)-1)*24:(tx+.5)*T;
      const py=(ty+.5)*T;
      const graphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(9.78);
      sc.areaObjs.push(graphics);
      return {type,index:i,x:px,y:py,baseX:px,baseY:py,visualX:px,visualY:py,fromX:px,fromY:py,dir:1,graphics,phase:i*2.37,state:'IDLE'};
    });
    sc.__wvLiving={civilians,creatures,npcGraphics,npcFront,animalGraphics,animalFront,atmosphere,lastFrame:0,lastUpdate:0,lastGoalCheck:-1,areaId:sc.area.id,dialogNpc:null,routeFailures:0};
  }

  const WV_MAORAI_CEREMONIES=Object.freeze([

  const WV_SOCIAL_AI=Object.freeze({
    isGathering(n,hour){return hour>=11&&hour<13||hour>=18&&hour<21;},
    isPeerNear(a,b){return a!==b&&Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<45;},
    face(n,other){const dx=other.x-n.x,dy=other.y-n.y;
      n.facing=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?'right':'left'):(dy>0?'down':'up');
    }
  });
  function wvLivingGoal(n,hour){
    if(hour<6||hour>=21)return ['RETURN_HOME','home'];
    for(const event of WV_MAORAI_CEREMONIES){
      if(hour>=event.from&&hour<event.to&&event.participants.includes(n.id)&&n.altar)return ['CEREMONY','altar'];
    }
    if(hour>=11&&hour<13)return ['SOCIAL','social'];
    if(hour>=18)return ['SOCIAL','social'];
    if(hour>=13&&hour<14)return ['IDLE','home'];
    return ['WORK','work'];
  }
  function wvDiscoveryNearest(sc){
    if(sc?.area?.id!=='wish-valley'||sc.inside)return null;
    let best=null,d=80;
    for(const spot of WV_DISCOVERY){
      const x=(spot.at[0]+.5)*T,y=(spot.at[1]+.5)*T;
      const distance=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-x,sc.player.y-y);
      if(distance<d){best=spot;d=distance;}
    }
    return best;
  }
  function wvDiscoveryOpen(spot){
    const sc=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();
    if(!spot||sc?.area?.id!=='wish-valley'||sc.inside||isDialogOpen())return;
    const distance=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-(spot.at[0]+.5)*T,sc.player.y-(spot.at[1]+.5)*T);
    if(distance>95)return;
    const key='wish-valley:discovery:'+spot.id,first=!state()[key];
    if(first){
      state()[key]={name:spot.name,day:Number(sc.store?.game?.day||1),time:Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes||0)};
      try{sc.store?.save?.();}catch(e){console.warn('WV Discovery journal save',e);}
    }

  function wvLivingNearest(sc){
    if(sc?.area?.id!=='wish-valley'||sc.inside||!sc.__wvLiving)return null;
    let best=null,distance=80;
    for(const npc of sc.__wvLiving.civilians){
      const d=Math.hypot(npc.x-sc.player.x,npc.y-sc.player.y);
      if(d<distance){best=npc;distance=d;}
    }
    return best;
  }
  function wvLivingOpen(npc){

  /* V35: four facing directions, role accessories and work/social gestures.
     Feet are the stable depth origin; idle animation does not slide on terrain. */
  function wvDrawCitizen(g,n,t){
    const x=Math.round(n.x),y=Math.round(n.y),walking=n.mode==='MOVE';
    const facing=n.facing||'down',up=facing==='up',side=facing==='left'||facing==='right';
    const dir=facing==='left'?-1:1,step=walking?Math.sin(n.stride)*3:0;
    const gesture=!walking&&n.mode==='WORK'?Math.sin(t*.005+n.activityPhase)*4:0;
    const skin=[0xc69b70,0xb58761,0xd8ad7c,0xa47759][n.index%4];
    const tunic=n.cloth,base=side?x-7:x-9;
    g.fillStyle(0x102923,.3).fillEllipse(x,y+8,27,9);
    // A flared woven tunic, bound sash and alternating walking feet.
    g.fillStyle(0x40382e,1).fillRect(x-7,y+1+step,5,9);
    g.fillStyle(0x40382e,1).fillRect(x+2,y+1-step,5,9);
    g.fillStyle(0x524839,1).fillTriangle(x-11,y-20,x+11,y-20,x+11,y+3);
    g.fillStyle(tunic,1).fillRect(base,y-20,side?15:18,23);
    g.fillStyle(0xcfb47d,.94).fillRect(x-8,y-3,16,3);
    g.fillStyle(n.index%2?0x56795f:0x7b6d4a,.84).fillRect(x-3,y-17,5,13);
    // Work animation and restrained arm movement.
    g.fillStyle(skin,1).fillRect(x-14,y-17+gesture,5,12);
    g.fillStyle(skin,1).fillRect(x+9,y-17-gesture,5,12);
    g.fillStyle(skin,1).fillRect(x-7+(side?dir*2:0),y-34,14,15);
    const hairShapes=n.index%4;
    g.fillStyle(n.hair,1).fillRect(x-8,y-36,16,8);
    if(hairShapes===0)g.fillRect(x-10,y-31,4,9);
    if(hairShapes===1)g.fillRect(x+6,y-32,4,10);
    if(hairShapes===2)g.fillEllipse(x+7,y-37,11,8);
    if(hairShapes===3)g.fillRect(x-9,y-35,3,14);
    if(!up){
      g.fillStyle(0x2b302a,.9);
      if(side)g.fillRect(x+dir*4,y-27,2,2);
      else g.fillRect(x-4,y-27,2,2).fillRect(x+3,y-27,2,2);
      g.fillStyle(0xe5bd84,.68).fillRect(x+dir*2,y-22,3,2);
    }else{
      g.fillStyle(n.hair,.95).fillRect(x-6,y-31,12,9);
      g.fillStyle(0x856b4b,.7).fillRect(x-5,y-22,10,2);
    }
    // Individual garment markers and insignia, not mere palette swaps.
    const marker=[0xe1c785,0x9bc5a2,0x87aaa5,0xd5b887][n.index%4];
    if(n.index%3===0){g.fillStyle(marker,.9).fillRect(x-1,y-15,3,10);}
    else if(n.index%3===1){g.lineStyle(2,marker,.85).lineBetween(x-7,y-14,x+7,y-7);}
    else {g.fillStyle(marker,.85).fillTriangle(x-4,y-13,x+4,y-13,x,y-5);}
    if(n.accessory==='basket'){
      g.fillStyle(0x745633,1).fillEllipse(x+13,y+gesture*.22,16,9);
      g.fillStyle(0xe1ba69,.98).fillEllipse(x+13,y-4+gesture*.22,12,6);
    }else if(n.accessory==='scroll'||n.accessory==='ledger'){
      g.fillStyle(0xe1cc98,1).fillRect(x+10,y-13+gesture*.2,9,12);
      g.lineStyle(1,0x7b6446,.8).lineBetween(x+12,y-8,x+17,y-8);
    }else if(n.accessory==='staff'){
      g.lineStyle(4,0x765b38,1).lineBetween(x+15,y-23,x+15,y+9);
      g.fillStyle(0xb6ca86,1).fillEllipse(x+15,y-25,8,6);
    }else if(n.accessory==='tool'){
      g.fillStyle(0xb4b7a2,1).fillRect(x+13,y-17-gesture,5,9);
      g.fillStyle(0x66533b,1).fillRect(x+15,y-9-gesture,3,12);
    }else if(n.accessory==='leaf'){
      g.fillStyle(0x70b079,1).fillTriangle(x+8,y-18,x+21,y-22,x+15,y-10);
    }else if(n.accessory==='satchel'){
      g.fillStyle(0x72523c,1).fillRect(x+8,y-10,9,14);
      g.lineStyle(2,0xd6b789,.7).lineBetween(x-5,y-19,x+12,y-8);
    }
    if(n.talking||n.socializing){
      const bob=Math.sin(t*.004+n.index)*2;
      g.fillStyle(0xf2e0ae,.66).fillEllipse(x+13,y-46+bob,11,7);
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++)g.fillStyle(0x56735b,.72).fillRect(x+9+i*3,y-47+bob,2,2);
    }
    if(n.mode==='CEREMONY'){
      g.fillStyle(0xe1cba0,.75).fillEllipse(x,y-43,6,9);
    }
  }
  /* V38: articulated wildlife. Render at 30Hz; movement decisions stay at ~10Hz.
     All geometry uses bounded local coordinates and mirrored positive-width rectangles. */
  function wvDrawAnimal(g,a,time,night){
    const x=Math.round(a.visualX??a.x),y=Math.round(a.visualY??a.y);
    const dir=a.dir===-1?-1:1,t=a.type,q=a.state||'IDLE';
    const phase=(a.phase||0),seconds=time*.001;
    const stride=Math.sin(seconds*(q==='TROT'?17:q==='HOP'?15:12)+phase);
    const breathing=Math.sin(seconds*2.6+phase)*.75;
    const moving=['WALK','FOLLOW','TROT','PROWL','HOP','SWIM','PADDLE','FLY','DART','FLUTTER'].includes(q);
    const gait=moving?stride*2.6:0;

    const P=(c,coords,alpha=1)=>{g.fillStyle(c,alpha);g.fillPoints(coords.map(([dx,dy])=>({x:px(dx),y:y+dy})),true);};

    const sh=(w=28,h=9,alpha=.16,dy=10)=>E(0x112720,0,dy,w,h,alpha);

    }
    if(t==='fish'){
      const swish=Math.sin(seconds*(q==='DART'?23:13)+phase)*4;
      E(0xc9f3e4,-2,4,26,9,.10);

  function wvAnimalAmbient(g,a,time,night){
    const x=a.visualX??a.x,y=a.visualY??a.y,t=a.type,ph=time*.003+a.phase;
    if(t==='fish' || t==='otter' || t==='waterbird'){
      const ripple=t==='fish'?1:(t==='otter'?2:3);
      for(let i=0;i<ripple;i++){
        const r=10+i*5+Math.sin(ph+i)*2;
        g.lineStyle(1,t==='waterbird'?0xdbe7cf:0x9fd9d3,.16-.025*i).strokeEllipse(x,y+6,r,r*.45);
      }
      if(t==='otter'&&a.state==='FLOAT')g.fillStyle(0xe9fff7,.18).fillEllipse(x-5,y-6,10,4);
      return;
    }
    if(t==='butterfly'){
      g.fillStyle(0xf5e0ab,.20).fillEllipse(x+Math.sin(ph*2)*5,y-8+Math.cos(ph*1.7)*3,3,3);
      return;
    }
    if(t==='firefly'&&night){
      g.fillStyle(0xf4efa1,.09).fillEllipse(x,y,26+Math.sin(ph*2)*6,18+Math.cos(ph*2)*3);
      return;
    }
    if(t==='aru'&&a.state==='FLY'){
      g.fillStyle(0x142722,.10).fillEllipse(x,y+13,16,5);
      return;
    }
    if((t==='varek'&&(a.state==='TROT'||a.state==='FOLLOW')) || (t==='deer'&&a.state==='WALK') || (t==='squirrel'&&a.state==='HOP')){
      const dust=t==='squirrel'?1:2;
      for(let i=0;i<dust;i++)g.fillStyle(i?0x86a06b:0xa8bb80,.18).fillEllipse(x-7+i*9,y+10-i,7-i,4-i*.5);
    }
  }
  const WV_HABITAT_SYSTEM=Object.freeze({
    aquatic:Object.freeze(['otter','fish','waterbird']),
    land:Object.freeze(['varek','lunari','squirrel','deer']),
    aerial:Object.freeze(['aru','butterfly','firefly']),
    maxWaterDrift:28,
    followOwner:'varel',
    inWater(x,y){
      return WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isRiverTile(Math.floor(x/T),Math.floor(y/T))||
        WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isPond(Math.floor(x/T),Math.floor(y/T))||
        WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.isCreek(Math.floor(x/T),Math.floor(y/T));
    }
  });
  /* Species-specific schedules: decisions only every 100ms; no positional motion while sleeping / grazing. */
  function wvAnimalStep(sc,animal,time,dt,night){
    const k=animal.index,t=animal.type,sec=time*.001,ph=sec*.7+animal.phase;
    const ox=animal.x,oy=animal.y;
    let nx=ox,ny=oy,state='IDLE';
    const steer=(gx,gy,speed)=>{
      const dx=gx-ox,dy=gy-oy,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      if(d>.8){const reach=Math.min(d,speed*dt);nx=ox+dx/d*reach;ny=oy+dy/d*reach;}
      return d;
    };
    if(t==='fish'){
      const dart=Math.sin(ph*2.1+k)>.88;
      const targetY=animal.baseY+Math.sin(ph*.77)*25;
      const targetX=animal.baseX>72*T?animal.baseX+Math.cos(ph*1.2)*17:wvRiverSurface(targetY/T).x+Math.sin(ph*1.8+k)*18;
      steer(targetX,targetY,dart?65:23);state=dart?'DART':'SWIM';
    }else if(t==='otter'){
      const floating=Math.sin(ph*.91+k)>.65;
      const targetY=animal.baseY+Math.sin(ph*.51+k)*22;
      const targetX=animal.baseX>72*T?animal.baseX+Math.cos(ph*1.05)*16:wvRiverSurface(targetY/T).x+Math.cos(ph*1.35+k)*28;
      if(!floating)steer(targetX,targetY,17);
      state=floating?'FLOAT':'SWIM';
    }else if(t==='waterbird'){
      const grooming=Math.sin(ph*.6+k)>.63;
      const targetY=animal.baseY+Math.sin(ph*.45+k)*20;
      const targetX=(animal.baseX>72*T?animal.baseX:wvRiverSurface(targetY/T).x)+Math.sin(ph*.8+k)*28;
      if(!grooming)steer(targetX,targetY,10);
      state=grooming?'PREEN':'PADDLE';
    }else if(t==='aru'){
      const fly=Math.sin(ph*.85+k)>.16;
      const gx=animal.baseX+Math.sin(ph*.69+k)*29,gy=animal.baseY+Math.cos(ph*.57+k)*31;
      if(fly)steer(gx,gy,29);
      state=fly?'FLY':'PERCH';
    }else if(t==='butterfly'){
      const rest=Math.sin(ph*.64+k)<-.80;
      if(!rest)steer(animal.baseX+Math.sin(ph*1.2+k)*34+Math.sin(ph*2.7)*10,
                     animal.baseY+Math.cos(ph*1.9+k)*15,24);
      state=rest?'HOVER':'FLUTTER';
    }else if(t==='firefly'){
      if(night)steer(animal.baseX+Math.sin(ph*.57+k)*23,animal.baseY+Math.cos(ph*.61+k)*15,9);
      state=night?'GLOW':'REST';
    }else if(t==='varek'){
      const caretaker=sc.__wvLiving?.civilians.find(n=>n.id==='varel');
      if(caretaker){
        const goalX=caretaker.x+(k%3-1)*32+Math.sin(ph*.6+k)*10;
        const goalY=caretaker.y+21+(k%2)*12;
        const d=Math.hypot(goalX-ox,goalY-oy);
        if(d>22){steer(goalX,goalY,d>75?48:31);state=d>75?'TROT':'FOLLOW';}
        else state=Math.sin(ph*.85+k)>.15?'SIT':'IDLE';
      }
    }else if(t==='deer'){
      const grazing=Math.sin(ph*.48+k)>.08;
      const herd=sc.__wvLiving?.creatures.filter(o=>o!==animal&&o.type==='deer'&&Math.hypot(o.baseX-animal.baseX,o.baseY-animal.baseY)<90)||[];
      if(!grazing){
        const hx=herd.length?herd.reduce((sum,o)=>sum+o.baseX,0)/herd.length:animal.baseX;
        const hy=herd.length?herd.reduce((sum,o)=>sum+o.baseY,0)/herd.length:animal.baseY;
        const aim=sec*.17+animal.phase;
        steer(animal.baseX+Math.sin(aim)*24+(hx-animal.baseX)*.1,
              animal.baseY+Math.cos(aim)*15+(hy-animal.baseY)*.1,11);
      }
      state=grazing?'GRAZE':(Math.sin(ph*1.3+k)>.76?'LOOK':'WALK');
    }else if(t==='lunari'){
      const sleep=Math.sin(ph*.31+k)>.25;
      const stretch=!sleep&&Math.sin(ph*1.16+k)>.62;
      if(!sleep&&!stretch)steer(animal.baseX+Math.sin(sec*.23+animal.phase)*15,
                                animal.baseY+Math.cos(sec*.19+animal.phase)*10,8);
      state=sleep?'SLEEP':stretch?'STRETCH':'PROWL';
    }else if(t==='squirrel'){
      const hopping=Math.sin(ph*1.4+k)>.27;
      if(hopping)steer(animal.baseX+Math.sin(sec*.7+animal.phase)*18,
                       animal.baseY+Math.cos(sec*.64+animal.phase)*14,24);
      state=hopping?'HOP':'FORAGE';
    }
    if(WV_HABITAT_SYSTEM.aquatic.includes(t)){
      if(WV_HABITAT_SYSTEM.inWater(nx,ny)){animal.x=nx;animal.y=ny;}
    }else if(WV_HABITAT_SYSTEM.land.includes(t)){
      if(wvCivGridSafe(sc.area,nx/T,ny/T)){animal.x=nx;animal.y=ny;}
      else state='REST';
    }else{
      animal.x=Math.min((sc.area.w-2)*T,Math.max(2*T,nx));
      animal.y=Math.min((sc.area.h-2)*T,Math.max(2*T,ny));
    }
    const dx=animal.x-ox,dy=animal.y-oy;
    if(Math.abs(dx)>.08)animal.dir=dx>0?1:-1;
    animal.state=state;
  }
  function wvLivingUpdate(sc,time){
    const sim=sc.__wvLiving;
    if(!sim||sim.areaId!==sc.area.id||sc.inside){
      if(sim&&!sim.inactive){
        sim.npcGraphics.clear();sim.npcFront.clear();sim.animalGraphics.clear();sim.animalFront.clear();sim.atmosphere.clear();
        sim.civilians.forEach(n=>{n.graphics.clear();n.graphics.setVisible(false);});
        sim.creatures.forEach(a=>{a.graphics.clear();a.graphics.setVisible(false);});
        sim.inactive=true;
      }
      return;
    }
    if(sim.inactive){sim.inactive=false;sim.lastFrame=0;sim.lastUpdate=0;}
    if(time-sim.lastFrame<32)return; // wildlife animation ~30Hz, AI decisions ~10Hz.
    sim.lastFrame=time;
    const behaviorTick=!sim.lastUpdate||time-sim.lastUpdate>=100;
    const dt=behaviorTick?Math.min(.22,Math.max(.016,(time-(sim.lastUpdate||time-110))/1000)):0;
    if(behaviorTick)sim.lastUpdate=time;
    const minutes=((Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes??480)%1440)+1440)%1440,hour=minutes/60,night=hour<6||hour>=19;
    const view=sc.cameras?.main?.worldView;
    const visible=(x,y)=>!view||x>view.x-96&&x<view.right+96&&y>view.y-110&&y<view.bottom+110;
    if(behaviorTick){
    const personG=sim.npcGraphics;personG.clear();sim.npcFront.clear();
    const occupied=[];
    if(sim.dialogNpc&&modal.hidden)sim.dialogNpc=null;
    for(const n of sim.civilians){
      const [mode,where]=wvLivingGoal(n,hour);
      if(n.goal!==where){
        n.goal=where;n.mode='MOVE';
        const dest=n[where];n.route=wvCivRoute(sc.area,{x:n.x,y:n.y},dest);
        if(!n.route.length)n.mode=mode;
      }
      const talking=sim.dialogNpc===n&&!modal.hidden;
      n.talking=talking;n.socializing=false;
      if(talking){WV_SOCIAL_AI.face(n,sc.player);n.mode='SOCIAL';}
      else if(n.route.length){
        const next=n.route[0],dx=next.x-n.x,dy=next.y-n.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(d<3){n.x=next.x;n.y=next.y;n.route.shift();}
        else{
          const v=Math.min(d,(n.id==='saelun'?18:27)*dt);
          const nx=n.x+dx/d*v,ny=n.y+dy/d*v;
          const overlap=occupied.some(other=>Math.hypot(other.x-nx,other.y-ny)<17);
          if(!overlap&&wvCivGridSafe(sc.area,nx/T,ny/T)){
            n.x=nx;n.y=ny;n.facing=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?'right':'left'):(dy>0?'down':'up');n.stride+=dt*8;n.stuckFor=0;
          }else{
            n.stuckFor+=dt;
            if(n.stuckFor>2.4){
              n.route=wvCivRoute(sc.area,{x:n.x,y:n.y},n[where]);n.stuckFor=0;
              if(!n.route.length){n.mode='IDLE';sim.routeFailures++;}
            }
          }
        }
        n.mode=n.route.length?'MOVE':mode;
      }else if(!talking){n.mode=mode;n.stride+=dt*.5;}
      if(!talking&&WV_SOCIAL_AI.isGathering(n,hour)&&!n.route.length){
        const peer=occupied.find(o=>WV_SOCIAL_AI.isPeerNear(n,o));
        if(peer){n.socializing=true;WV_SOCIAL_AI.face(n,peer);}
      }
      occupied.push(n);
      n.zone.setPosition(n.x,n.y-12);
      n.graphics.clear();
      n.graphics.setVisible(visible(n.x,n.y));
      if(n.graphics.visible){
        n.graphics.setDepth(n.y>sc.player.y+5?10.05+n.y*.00001:9.73+n.y*.00001);
        wvDrawCitizen(n.graphics,n,time);
      }
    }
    } // NPC schedules, AI and pathfinding remain on their original slower update.
    const animalG=sim.animalGraphics;animalG.clear();sim.animalFront.clear();
    const g=sim.atmosphere;g.clear();
    for(const animal of sim.creatures){
      if(behaviorTick){
        animal.fromX=animal.visualX??animal.x;animal.fromY=animal.visualY??animal.y;
        wvAnimalStep(sc,animal,time,dt,night);
        animal.motionStart=time;
      }
      const alpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(time-(animal.motionStart||time))/105));
      const eased=alpha*alpha*(3-2*alpha); // prevents jumps between AI decisions.
      animal.visualX=(animal.fromX??animal.x)+((animal.x)-(animal.fromX??animal.x))*eased;
      animal.visualY=(animal.fromY??animal.y)+((animal.y)-(animal.fromY??animal.y))*eased;
      animal.graphics.clear();
      const onScreen=visible(animal.visualX,animal.visualY);
      animal.graphics.setVisible(onScreen&&(!night?animal.type!=='firefly':true));
      if(animal.graphics.visible){
        wvAnimalAmbient(g,animal,time,night);
        animal.graphics.setDepth(animal.visualY>sc.player.y+6?10.04+animal.visualY*.00001:9.70+animal.visualY*.00001);
        wvDrawAnimal(animal.graphics,animal,time,night);
      }
    }
    // Lightweight, phase-offset foliage and shrine lights. No offscreen redraw cost.
    const motes=[[10,28],[20,26],[34,42],[59,29],[67,21],[73,31],[79,42],[32,14],[12,48]];
    for(let i=0;i<motes.length;i++){
      const [tx,ty]=motes[i],cx=tx*T,cy=ty*T;
      if(!visible(cx,cy))continue;
      for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
        const x=cx+(j-1)*28+Math.sin(time*.0018+i+j*3)*11,y=cy+Math.cos(time*.002+i*2+j)*8+j*5;
        g.fillStyle(i%2?0xaec58f:0x88bc8b,.20).fillEllipse(x,y,8+j*2,4+j%2);
      }
    }
    if(night){
      for(const [x,y] of [[17,19],[29,30],[16,41],[72,34],[69,26]]){
        if(!visible(x*T,y*T))continue;
        g.fillStyle(0xffdf9e,.12).fillEllipse(x*T,y*T,34,24);
        g.fillStyle(0xffe4aa,.56).fillEllipse(x*T,y*T,6,6);
      }
    }
  }

  function attach(sc){
    if(!isNew(sc?.area?.id))return;
    ui();const id=sc.area.id;
    ASSIGNMENTS[id].forEach(t=>sprite(sc,t));
    const names=SPECS[id].landmarks;
    if(id==='old-oriaris')sc.__v26RoyalSigns=[];
    for(const [x,y,name] of names){
      const royal=id==='old-oriaris';
      const label=sc.add.text((x+.5)*T,(y+1.3)*T,name,{
        fontFamily:royal?'Georgia,serif':'system-ui, Arial',
        fontSize:royal?'11px':'13px',fontStyle:'bold',
        color:royal?'#f5e7c8':SPECS[id].accent,
        backgroundColor:royal?'#3e3546d9':'#0d1d2cdb',
        padding:{x:royal?7:8,y:4}
      }).setOrigin(.5,.5).setDepth(12);
      if(royal){label.setVisible(false);sc.__v26RoyalSigns.push(label);}
      sc.areaObjs.push(label);
    }
    const fx=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1);
    sc.areaObjs.push(fx);sc.__careerFx=fx;sc.__careerFxArea=id;
    if(id==='wish-valley')wvLivingAttach(sc);
    if(id==='vocalt-greedy-land')vAttach(sc);
    if(id==='old-oriaris'){ v26AttachTownspeople(sc); showRoyalIntro(sc); }
    if(id==='tech-co'){createTechOverlay(sc);sc.__techOutdoorLabels=sc.areaObjs.filter(x=>x.type==='Text');syncTechIndoor(sc);}
    else sc.__techCoLabels=null;
    refreshHud(sc);
  }
  function refreshHud(sc){
    ui();const id=sc?.area?.id;if(!isNew(id)){hud.hidden=true;talkButton.hidden=true;return;}
    const s=SPECS[id],n=count(id),next=ORDER[ORDER.indexOf(id)+1];
    const staff=id==='tech-co'?`<small style="margin-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #6d9aab88;padding-top:6px">${[...(getAgents(sc)?.values()||[])].map(a=>`${esc(a.t.name)} · ${esc(a.site ? (TECH_ROOMS[a.site]||a.site) : 'campus')} · ${esc(a.mode.toLowerCase())}`).join('<br>')}</small>`:'';
    hud.hidden=false;hud.innerHTML=`<b>${esc(s.title)} · ${esc(s.level)}</b><div>${n}/3 English missions completed</div><small>${next?'✓ Next map open: '+SPECS[next].title:'All worlds open · The east train returns to English Town'}</small>${staff}`;
    if(id==='tech-co')updateTechLabels(sc);
  }
  function update(sc,time){
    if(!sc||!sc.player)return;
    const id=sc.area?.id;
    if(id!==lastSeenArea){lastSeenArea=id;nearest=null;if(!isNew(id))close();refreshHud(sc);}
    if(!isNew(id)){sc.__wvAtSpirit=false;if(talkButton)talkButton.hidden=true;return;}
    if(id==='tech-co'){updateTechAgents(sc,time);if(time-(sc.__careerHudUpdated||0)>2500){sc.__careerHudUpdated=time;refreshHud(sc);}}
    if(id==='wish-valley')wvLivingUpdate(sc,time);
    if(id==='vocalt-greedy-land')vUpdate(sc,time);
    if(id==='old-oriaris'){
      updateRoyalAgents(sc,time);v26UpdateTownspeople(sc,time);
      for(const sign of (sc.__v26RoyalSigns||[])){
        sign.setVisible(!sc.inside && Math.hypot(sc.player.x-sign.x,sc.player.y-sign.y)<210);
      }
    }
    nearest=closestCareer(sc);
    const livingNear=id==='wish-valley'?wvLivingNearest(sc):null;
    const exploreNear=id==='wish-valley'?wvDiscoveryNearest(sc):null;
    sc.__wvLivingNear=livingNear;
    sc.__wvExploreNear=exploreNear;
    sc.__wvAtSpirit=id==='wish-valley'&&!sc.inside&&
      Math.hypot(sc.player.x-(WV_SPIRIT.x*T),sc.player.y-(WV_SPIRIT.y*T))<119;
    ui();const vocaltNear=id==='vocalt-greedy-land'?vNearest(sc):null;
    talkButton.hidden=(!nearest&&!sc.__wvAtSpirit&&!livingNear&&!exploreNear&&!vocaltNear)||!modal.hidden;
    if(sc.__wvAtSpirit)talkButton.textContent='🌿 Trung tâm Tinh thần · E';
    else if(nearest)talkButton.textContent=`💬 Talk to ${nearest.name} · E`;
    else if(vocaltNear)talkButton.textContent=`💬 ${vocaltNear.name} · E`;
    else if(livingNear)talkButton.textContent=`💬 ${livingNear.name} · E`;
    else if(exploreNear)talkButton.textContent=`🌿 Explore ${exploreNear.name} · E`;
    if(sc.__careerFx?.active&&sc.__careerFxArea===id && (!sc.inside||(id!=='tech-co'&&id!=='old-oriaris')) && Math.floor(time/66)!==Math.floor((time-16)/66)){
      const g=sc.__careerFx;g.clear();const ph=time*.002;
      const spot=(x,y,c)=>{ellipse(g,c,(x+.5)*T,(y+.5)*T,80+Math.sin(ph)*12,37,.05);ellipse(g,c,(x+.5)*T,(y+.5)*T,25,8,.22);};
      if(id==='tech-co')techPulse(g,time);
      else if(id==='old-oriaris')v26Pulse(g,time,sc.area);
      else{
        spot(id==='wish-valley'?44:27,id==='wish-valley'?9:8,id==='vocalt-greedy-land'?0xffde8b:id==='wish-valley'?0xb5f5e5:0xffdc9a);
        if(id==='wish-valley'){
          // Living river highlights and moving ripples.
          for(let i=0;i<118;i++){
            const flow=i/117,yy=(15+flow*42)*T,curve=wvRiverX(yy/T),drift=Math.sin(ph*2.2+i*.71)*1.4;
            const xx=(curve+((i%7)-3)*.82+drift)*T;
            ellipse(g,i%4===0?0xcffcf3:0xdffdf5,xx,yy+Math.sin(ph*2.4+i*.55)*7,7+(i%3)*4,2,.24+(i%5)*.015);
            if(i%6===0)ellipse(g,0xa4efe2,xx-8,yy+3,12,3,.16);
          }
          // Animated Aylara waterfall: several moving curtains, spray and basin foam.
          const fallX=44*T;
          for(let colIdx=0;colIdx<7;colIdx++){
            const offset=(-3+colIdx)*34;
            for(let seg=0;seg<14;seg++){
              const prog=(seg/14),yy=(1.8+prog*13.6)*T + ((ph*90+colIdx*27+seg*12)%26);
              const swing=Math.sin(ph*3+seg*.6+colIdx)*5;
              ellipse(g,colIdx%2?0x9ceee7:0xdffef7,fallX+offset+swing,yy,10+(seg%3)*3,18,.16+.03*(seg%4));
              ellipse(g,0xbff8ef,fallX+offset*0.92+swing*.6,yy-10,5,10,.12);
            }
          }
          for(let m=0;m<24;m++){
            const mx=fallX-190+(m*17)%380 + Math.sin(ph*2+m)*10;
            const my=14.9*T + Math.sin(ph*2.8+m*.8)*12 + (m%4)*2;
            ellipse(g,m%3?0xeafff8:0xcff8ef,mx,my,10+(m%5)*4,4+(m%3),.22);
          }
          for(let c=0;c<8;c++){
            const mx=fallX-100+Math.sin(ph*1.7+c)*85,my=(12.8+c*.45+Math.sin(ph+c)*.18)*T;
            ellipse(g,0xe9fff5,mx,my,44+(c%3)*14,18+(c%2)*8,.05);
          }
          // V35: foam ribbons descend at different rates across four cascades.
          const view=sc.cameras?.main?.worldView;
          const near=(x,y,pad=180)=>!view||x>view.x-pad&&x<view.right+pad&&y>view.y-pad&&y<view.bottom+pad;
          if(near(fallX,8*T,550)){
            for(let tier=0;tier<4;tier++){
              const fy=(1.5+tier*3.5)*T;
              for(let j=0;j<12;j++){
                const flow=(time*(.048+tier*.009)+j*39+tier*83)%86;
                const px=fallX+(j-5.5)*(23-tier*2)+Math.sin(ph*1.7+j)*3;
                ellipse(g,j%3?0xd0f6ed:0x8ddbcf,px,fy+flow,7+(j%3)*3,12+(tier%2)*4,.13+(j%4)*.035);
              }
              for(let j=0;j<8;j++){
                const px=fallX+(j-3.5)*(26-tier*2);
                ellipse(g,0xe4fff4,px,fy+92+Math.sin(ph*2+j)*4,14+(j%3)*7,4+(j%2)*3,.21);
              }
            }
          }
          // Moonveil reflections and aquatic leaves (world-space, camera-culled).
          const lx=WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.moonveil.x*T,ly=WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.moonveil.y*T;
          if(near(lx,ly,140)){
            for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
              const px=lx-46+(i%4)*31,py=ly-17+Math.floor(i/4)*27;
              const ripple=9+((time*.013+i*18)%32);
              g.lineStyle(1.2,0xb6e5d5,(1-ripple/45)*.28);
              g.strokeEllipse(px,py,ripple*1.6,ripple*.42);
            }
          }
          for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
            const py=(22*T+(time*.021+i*73)%(36*T));
            const {x,half}=WV_WORLD_GEOMETRY.river(py/T);
            const px=x+Math.sin(i*2.4+ph*.8)*Math.min(half*.52,55);
            if(!near(px,py,35))continue;
            g.fillStyle(i%3?0x769e60:0xb8b782,.52);

  function hash(a, b, seed) {
    let n = (Math.imul(a + 21, 1597334677) ^ Math.imul(b + 13, 3812015801) ^ seed) | 0;
    n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 15), 2246822519); n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 13), 3266489917);
    return ((n ^ (n >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }
  function seedFor(s) { return Array.from(s).reduce((n, c) => Math.imul(n ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619), 2166136261) | 0; }
  function fill(g, c, x, y, w, h, alpha = 1) { g.fillStyle(c, alpha).fillRect(x, y, w, h); }
  function dot(g, c, x, y, r = 2, alpha = 1) { g.fillStyle(c, alpha).fillCircle(x, y, r); }
  function oval(g, c, x, y, w, h, alpha = 1) { g.fillStyle(c, alpha).fillEllipse(x, y, w, h); }
  function stroke(g, c, x, y, x2, y2, width = 1, alpha = 1) { g.lineStyle(width, c, alpha).lineBetween(x, y, x2, y2); }
  function walkable(a, x, y) {
    x = Math.floor(x); y = Math.floor(y);
    return x > 0 && y > 0 && x < a.w - 1 && y < a.h - 1 && !a.isTileBlocked(x, y) && !(a.warpAt && a.warpAt(x, y));
  }
  function ground(g, a) {
    const p = PLAN[a.id]; if (!p) return;
    const seed = seedFor(a.id);
    // Hundreds of tailored accents. All are only a few pixels high, so walking remains unobstructed.
    const palette = p.tone === 'creative' ? [0xffcd58, 0xe774b4, 0x53d9cd, 0x9673e6] :
      p.tone === 'ore' ? [0x7ea397, 0x5d7d86, 0xc9ba92, 0x61847a] :
      p.tone === 'scarred' ? [0x917d58, 0x6a694d, 0xb2a37d, 0x81916d] :
      [0xffffff, 0xffffff];
    const step = p.tone === 'creative' ? 2 : 3;
    for (let y = 1; y < a.h - 1; y += step) for (let x = 1; x < a.w - 1; x += step) {
      const h = hash(x, y, seed);
      if (h > p.density || !walkable(a, x, y)) continue;
      const cx = x * T + 4 + hash(x, y, seed ^ 19) * 23;
      const cy = y * T + 5 + hash(x, y, seed ^ 51) * 20;
      if (p.tone === 'creative') {
        const c = palette[Math.floor(h * 139) % palette.length];
        fill(g, c, cx, cy, 5, 2, 0.52); fill(g, c, cx + 4, cy - 2, 2, 6, 0.32);
        if (h < .13) dot(g, 0xffffff, cx + 9, cy + 6, 1.8, .45);
      } else if (p.tone === 'ore') {
        stroke(g, palette[Math.floor(h * 35) % 4], cx, cy, cx + 9, cy - 3, 1.4, .46);
        dot(g, 0x9fedd3, cx + 5, cy - 2, 1.3, .44);
      } else if (p.tone === 'garden') {
        stroke(g, 0x3b754a, cx, cy + 3, cx + 1, cy - 5, 1.2, .6);
        dot(g, [0xffd69d, 0xf6b6c4, 0xdceec4][Math.floor(h * 83) % 3], cx + 1, cy - 5, 1.9, .83);
      } else if (p.tone === 'camp' || p.tone === 'scarred') {
        oval(g, 0x584936, cx, cy + 1, 6, 2.8, .28);
        stroke(g, 0xb3a681, cx + 2, cy - 1, cx + 6, cy - 3, 1, .4);
      } else {
        stroke(g, 0x57653c, cx, cy + 4, cx - 2, cy - 3, 1.25, .6);
        stroke(g, 0x788a51, cx, cy + 4, cx + 3, cy - 2, 1.3, .6);
      }
    }
  }
  function vignette(g, k, x, y, r, tone, seed) {
    const R = (n) => hash(n + Math.floor(x / 7), Math.floor(y / 7), seed);
    const col = (color, px, py, rw, rh, alpha) => oval(g, color, px, py, rw, rh, alpha);
    if (k === 'crater') {
      col(0x4a4034, x, y + 7, r * 2.02, r * 1.22, .34);
      col(0x79674f, x - 1, y - 1, r * 1.94, r * 1.12, .94);
      col(0xaf9872, x - 4, y - 7, r * 1.46, r * .73, .82);
      col(0x3f3932, x + 1, y + 3, r * 1.34, r * .82, .94);
      col(0x5f584d, x - 2, y + 1, r * .96, r * .58, .61);
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
        const a = i * 2.399, rad = r * (.68 + .22 * R(i));
        dot(g, i % 3 === 0 ? 0xc3b28a : i % 3 === 1 ? 0x6f6352 : 0x879667, x + Math.cos(a) * rad, y + Math.sin(a) * rad * .57, 1.5 + R(i + 17) * 2.2, .78);
      }
    } else if (k === 'stream') {
      for (let i = -11; i <= 11; i++) {
        const py = y + i * 7;
        const cur = x + Math.sin(i * .39) * 13;
        col(0x375d57, cur, py, 40, 11, .77);
        col(0x749d86, cur - 4, py - 2, 27, 4, .56);
        if (i % 3 === 0) stroke(g, 0xcce2c2, cur - 4, py - 1, cur + 8, py - 1, 1, .65);
      }
      for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
        const yy = y + i * 10;
        fill(g, 0x56432e, x - 36, yy, 72, 7, 1);
        fill(g, 0xb59b6e, x - 34, yy, 68, 4, 1);
        fill(g, 0xe0c897, x - 28, yy + 1, 24, 1, .45);
      }
      fill(g, 0x433d2c, x - 38, y - 45, 4, 90, .88);
      fill(g, 0x433d2c, x + 34, y - 45, 4, 90, .88);
    } else if (k === 'plaza' || k === 'mosaic') {
      col(0x223142, x, y + 5, r * 2, r * 1.17, .32);
      col(k === 'plaza' ? 0xdfd1ae : 0x292c47, x, y, r * 2, r * 1.08, .91);
      col(k === 'plaza' ? 0xf7e8c4 : 0x48506e, x, y - 2, r * 1.74, r * .91, .87);
      for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) for (let j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
        const cx = x + i * r / 5, cy = y + j * r / 5;
        if (((cx - x) / (r * .88)) ** 2 + ((cy - y) / (r * .5)) ** 2 > 1) continue;
        const c = k === 'plaza' ? [0xe3bc78, 0xf3e1b9, 0xa7bbab, 0xe6ceb2][(i + j + 20) % 4] :
          [0xffbc53, 0x65d9cc, 0xed7eb1, 0x9579e7][(i + j + 20) % 4];
        fill(g, c, cx - 2, cy - 2, 6, 4, k === 'plaza' ? .7 : .9);

function originSeen(scene,id){return scene?.store?.game?.originStoriesSeen?.[id]===true;}
function commitOrigin(scene,id){if(!scene?.store?.game)return;const g=scene.store.game;if(!g.originStoriesSeen||typeof g.originStoriesSeen!=='object'||Array.isArray(g.originStoriesSeen))g.originStoriesSeen={};g.originStoriesSeen[id]=true;scene.store.save();}
function originRestore(scene,active,mark){
 if(!active||active.closed)return;
 active.closed=true;
 clearTimeout(active.wake);clearTimeout(active.deadline);
 try{scene.events.off('update',active.onFrame);}catch(e){}
 try{active.art?.destroy();}catch(e){}
 // Camera return started at 6700ms. Snap on completion/Skip; never add a timer past 7500ms.
 try{scene.cameras.main.setZoom(active.zoom0);scene.cameras.main.centerOn(scene.player.x,scene.player.y);}catch(e){}
 try{scene.cameras.main.startFollow(scene.player,true,.12,.12);}catch(e){}
 if(active.keyboard)active.keyboard.enabled=active.keyboardWasOn;
 if(scene.__lqAreaCine===active)scene.__lqAreaCine=null;
 if(__originActive===active)__originActive=null;
 if(__originUi)__originUi.classList.remove('play');
 if(active.keyHandler)window.removeEventListener('keydown',active.keyHandler,true);
 if(active.skipBtn)active.skipBtn.removeEventListener('click',active.finish);
 if(mark && !active.replay && scene.area?.id===active.id)commitOrigin(scene,active.id);
}
function drawOriginFrame(scene,active,elapsed){
 if(active.closed||!scene.sys?.isActive?.())return;
 const t=Math.min(7500,elapsed),d=ORIGIN_STORIES[active.id],ui=__originUi;
 let beat=t<1400?0:t<3600?1:2;
 if(active.beat!==beat){active.beat=beat;ui.querySelector('.origin-beat').textContent=[d.before,d.foundation,d.reveal][beat].toUpperCase();ui.querySelector('.origin-line').textContent=d.narration[beat];}
 if(t>=5600){ui.querySelector('.origin-map').hidden=false;ui.querySelector('.origin-map').textContent=d.title;ui.querySelector('.origin-tag').hidden=false;ui.querySelector('.origin-tag').textContent=d.tagline;ui.querySelector('.origin-beat').textContent='ORIGIN REVEALED';}
 ui.querySelector('.origin-fill').style.width=(t/75).toFixed(1)+'%';
 if(t>=3600&&!active.panned&&scene.area?.id===active.id){
   active.panned=true;
   const spot=PLAN[active.id]?.marks?.[0],cam=scene.cameras.main;
   if(spot){const x=Math.max(0,Math.min(scene.area.w*32,(spot[1]+.5)*32));const y=Math.max(0,Math.min(scene.area.h*32,(spot[2]+.5)*32));try{cam.pan(x,y,1050,'Sine.easeInOut',true);cam.zoomTo(active.zoom0*1.06,1050,'Sine.easeInOut',true);}catch(e){}}
 }
 if(t>=6700&&!active.returning){
   active.returning=true;
   try{scene.cameras.main.pan(scene.player.x,scene.player.y,760,'Sine.easeInOut',true);scene.cameras.main.zoomTo(active.zoom0,760,'Sine.easeInOut',true);}catch(e){}
 }
 const art=active.art;
 if(!art)return;
 const reduced=active.reduced;
 // The illustrated before/foundation layers fade away to reveal the ACTUAL landmark on the current map.
 const archiveReplay=active.replay&&scene.area?.id!==active.id;
 const opacity=archiveReplay?(t<6700?1:Math.max(0,1-(t-6700)/800)):(t<=3600?1:Math.max(0,1-(t-3600)/1750));
 art.setAlpha(opacity);
 if(!opacity)return;
 if(t-active.frameAt< (reduced?160:64))return;
 active.frameAt=t;
 art.clear();
 ORIGIN_PIXELS.paint(art,d,t,reduced);
}
function startOrigin(scene,id,replay=false){
 // Never play or replay an origin intro outside English Town.
 if(!INTRO_ENABLED_MAPS.has(id))return false;
 const d=ORIGIN_STORIES[id];if(!scene||!d||__originActive||!scene.player?.active)return false;
 if(!replay && scene.area?.id!==id)return false;
 const cam=scene.cameras.main,keyboard=scene.input?.keyboard;
 const reduced=!!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 if(scene.__lqAreaCine)stopAreaCinematic(scene);
 const ui=getOriginUi();ui.style.setProperty('--oc',d.accent);
 ui.querySelector('.origin-film').textContent=d.film;
 ui.querySelector('.origin-map').hidden=true;ui.querySelector('.origin-tag').hidden=true;
 ui.classList.add('play');
 const g=scene.add.graphics().setDepth(9000).setScrollFactor(0);
 const w=scene.scale?.width||window.innerWidth||900,h=scene.scale?.height||window.innerHeight||580;
 const scale=Math.max(w/640,h/360);
 g.setPosition((w-640*scale)/2,(h-360*scale)/2).setScale(scale);
 const active={id,replay,art:g,closed:false,zoom0:cam.zoom||1,keyboard,keyboardWasOn:keyboard?.enabled??true,
   start:performance.now(),frameAt:-1000,beat:-1,reduced,panned:false,returning:false,onFrame:null,finish:null,wake:0,deadline:0};
 __originActive=active;scene.__lqAreaCine=active;
 if(keyboard){keyboard.enabled=false;try{keyboard.resetKeys();}catch(e){}}
 try{cam.stopFollow();}catch(e){}
 active.finish=()=>originRestore(scene,active,true);
 active.keyHandler=e=>{if(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey||e.key==='Tab')return; e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();if(['Escape','Enter',' '].includes(e.key))active.finish();};
 window.addEventListener('keydown',active.keyHandler,true);
 const btn=ui.querySelector('.origin-skip');btn.addEventListener('click',active.finish);active.skipBtn=btn;
 ui.querySelector('.origin-kicker').textContent=replay?'WORLD ORIGINS · ARCHIVE REPLAY':'WORLD ORIGINS · FIRST DISCOVERY';
 // For cross-map Journal replays, camera remains on the actual current area; the illustration is still replayable.
 if(replay&&scene.area?.id!==id)active.panned=true;
 active.onFrame=()=>{
   if(active.closed)return;
   if(!scene.sys?.isActive?.()||scene.switching||scene.inside){originRestore(scene,active,false);return;}
   if(!active.replay && (window.LQArtDistrict?.isFilming?.() || window.LQPast?.isFilming?.() || window.LQIntro?.isPlaying?.())){
     originRestore(scene,active,false);queueAreaCinematic(scene,PLAN[active.id]);return;
   }
   const elapsed=performance.now()-active.start;
   drawOriginFrame(scene,active,elapsed);
   if(elapsed>=7500)active.finish();
 };
 scene.events.on('update',active.onFrame);
 drawOriginFrame(scene,active,0);
 active.deadline=setTimeout(()=>{if(!active.closed){drawOriginFrame(scene,active,7500);active.finish();}},7500);
 return true;
}
function renderOriginJournal(root,store){

 const wrapper=document.createElement('section');wrapper.className='lq-origin-journal';

 const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='lq-origin-grid';
 for(const [id,d] of Object.entries(ORIGIN_STORIES).filter(([id])=>INTRO_ENABLED_MAPS.has(id))){

  const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='lq-origin-card'+(opened?'':' locked');

  if(opened){

   const teaser=document.createElement('p');teaser.textContent=d.tagline;card.appendChild(teaser);
   const read=document.createElement('button');read.type='button';read.textContent='Read Story';
   read.addEventListener('click',()=>{const prev=card.querySelector('.lq-origin-history');if(prev){prev.remove();read.textContent='Read Story';return;}const p=document.createElement('p');p.className='lq-origin-history';p.textContent=d.history;card.appendChild(p);read.textContent='Close Story';});
   const replay=document.createElement('button');replay.type='button';replay.textContent='Replay Cinematic';
   replay.addEventListener('click',()=>{
     const sc=window.LQOrigins?.currentScene?.();

  }

 }
 wrapper.appendChild(grid);root.appendChild(wrapper);
