  function showIntro(areaId, meta, holdMs = 2850) {
    if (!INTRO_ENABLED_MAPS.has(areaId) || !meta) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (introLast.id === areaId && now - introLast.at < 1200) return;
    introLast = { id: areaId, at: now };
    const root = ensureIntroUi();
    root.querySelector('.icon').textContent = meta.icon || '🗺️';
    root.querySelector('.eyebrow').textContent = meta.eyebrow || 'WORLD';
    root.querySelector('.title').textContent = meta.title || areaId;
    root.querySelector('.subtitle').textContent = (CINEMA_V15[areaId]?.text || meta.subtitle || '');
    root.querySelector('.chapter').textContent = CINEMA_V15[areaId]?.name || '';
    root.querySelector('.shot').textContent = CINEMA_V15[areaId]?.shots?.[0] || '';
    root.querySelector('.progress span').style.width = '0%';
    root.style.setProperty('--v15-accent', CINEMA_V15[areaId]?.accent || '#f6cd86');
    root.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(introHideTimer);
    introHideTimer = setTimeout(() => root.classList.remove('show'), holdMs);
  }

  const cinematicSeen = new Map();
  function canPlayCinematic(scene, areaId) {
    if (!scene || scene.area?.id !== areaId || scene.switching || scene.inside || scene.sleeping) return false;
    if (!scene.player?.active || !scene.cameras?.main || !scene.sys?.isActive?.()) return false;
    if (scene.chat?.isOpen || scene.briefing?.isOpen || scene.settings?.isOpen || scene.quests?.isOpen) return false;
    // Story films, boot tutorial and the title screen own the camera whenever present.
    for(const id of ['lq-art','lq-past','lq-intro','lq-shrine']){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el&&!el.hidden&&getComputedStyle(el).display!=='none'&&getComputedStyle(el).visibility!=='hidden'&&getComputedStyle(el).opacity!=='0')return false;}
    if(window.LQArtDistrict?.isFilming?.() || window.LQPast?.isFilming?.() || window.LQIntro?.isPlaying?.()) return false;
    const lobby=document.getElementById('lq-title');
    if(lobby && !lobby.hidden && getComputedStyle(lobby).display!=='none' && getComputedStyle(lobby).visibility!=='hidden') return false;
    return true;
  }
  function stopAreaCinematic(scene) {
    if(!scene)return;
    const active=scene.__lqAreaCine;
    if(!active)return;
    if(active===__originActive){originRestore(scene,active,false);return;}
    active.closed=true;
    clearTimeout(active.timer);
    if(active.keyHandler)window.removeEventListener('keydown',active.keyHandler,true);
    if(active.skipBtn)active.skipBtn.remove();
    scene.__lqAreaCine=null;
    try{scene.cameras.main.pan(scene.player.x,scene.player.y,150,'Sine.easeOut',true);
      scene.cameras.main.zoomTo(active.zoom0,150,'Sine.easeOut',true);
      scene.cameras.main.startFollow(scene.player,true,.12,.12);}catch(e){}
    if(active.keyboard)active.keyboard.enabled=active.keyboardWasOn;
    if(introRoot)introRoot.classList.remove('show');
  }
  function queueAreaCinematic(scene,p){
    if(!scene||!p)return;
    clearTimeout(scene.__lqAreaCinePending);
    // Seven non-ET maps enter gameplay immediately; no origin film and no V15 intro card.
    if(!INTRO_ENABLED_MAPS.has(scene.area?.id))return;
    const id=scene.area.id;
    let checked=false;
    const attempt=()=>{
      if(scene.area?.id!==id || scene.__lqWorldFx?.id!==id || !scene.sys?.isActive?.())return;
      if(scene.__lqAreaCine || !canPlayCinematic(scene,id)){
        // Don't consume first-discovery state during a story film, title screen, or modal.
        scene.__lqAreaCinePending=setTimeout(attempt,650);
        return;
      }
      if(originSeen(scene,id)){
        // Revisit: a short non-blocking location card; no long camera tour.
        showIntro(id,p.intro,900);
        ensureIntroUi().classList.add('revisit');
        return;
      }
      startOrigin(scene,id,false);
    };
    scene.__lqAreaCinePending=setTimeout(attempt,600);
  }
  function attach(scene) {
    const p = PLAN[scene.area?.id]; if (!p) return;
    const cache = scene.__lqWorldFx;
    if (cache) detach(scene);
    const layer = scene.add.graphics().setDepth(7);
    const nodes = [layer];
    const labels = [];
    p.marks.forEach(([kind, x, y, r, name, description], i) => {
      // Labels are intentionally small and below NPC/player depth; click for a short world-building fact.
      if (i > 5 || !name) return;
      const discoveryId = scene.area.id + ':' + i;
      const discovered = (scene.store?.game?.worldDiscoveries || []).includes(discoveryId);
      const label = scene.add.text((x + .5) * T, (y - .8) * T, (discovered ? '✦ ' : '◇ ') + name, {
        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '10px', color: discovered ? '#ffda81' : (p.tone === 'creative' ? '#ffe3a1' : '#fff0cf'),
        backgroundColor: '#13212ad9', padding: { x: 5, y: 3 },
      }).setOrigin(.5, .5).setDepth(8).setInteractive({ useHandCursor: true });
      label.on('pointerdown', () => {
        if (scene.inside || scene.switching) return;
        const save = scene.store?.game;
        let found = false;
        if (save) {
          if (!Array.isArray(save.worldDiscoveries)) save.worldDiscoveries = [];
          if (!save.worldDiscoveries.includes(discoveryId)) {
            save.worldDiscoveries.push(discoveryId); found = true;
            scene.store.save();
            label.setText('✦ ' + name).setColor('#ffda81');
          }
        }
        scene.quests?.toast?.([`${found ? '✦ Location discovered' : '🧭 Landmark'} · ${name}`, description]);
      });
      labels.push(label); nodes.push(label);
    });
    const seed = seedFor(scene.area.id);
    const motes = [];
    const lowMotion = (window.innerWidth || 1280) <= 600 || !!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const count = lowMotion ? (scene.area.theme === 'past' ? 9 : 7) : (scene.area.theme === 'past' ? 18 : 14);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const x = 20 + hash(i * 9, 31, seed) * (scene.area.w * T - 40);
      const y = 20 + hash(i * 7, 47, seed) * (scene.area.h * T - 40);
      if (!walkable(scene.area, x / T, y / T)) continue;
      motes.push({ x, y, p: hash(i, 23, seed) * TAU, vx: .3 + hash(i, 48, seed), type: p.particle });
    }
    scene.__lqWorldFx = { id: scene.area.id, layer, nodes, labels, motes, time: 0, frame: 0, effects: p.effects, lowMotion, reducedMotion: !!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches };
    queueAreaCinematic(scene, p);
    // Since these items are in areaObjs they are destroyed by the existing area cleanup.
    scene.areaObjs?.push(...nodes);
  }
  function detach(scene) {
    if(!scene)return;
    clearTimeout(scene.__lqAreaCinePending);
    stopAreaCinematic(scene);
    if(scene.__lqWorldFx) scene.__lqWorldFx=null;
  }
  function update(scene, ms) {
    const fx = scene?.__lqWorldFx;
    if (!fx || fx.id !== scene.area.id) return;
    if (scene.inside || scene.switching) { fx.layer.setVisible(false); fx.labels.forEach(n => n.setVisible(false)); return; }
    fx.layer.setVisible(true);
    fx.labels.forEach(n => n.setVisible(true));
    const dt = Math.min(100, ms || 16);
    fx.time += dt / 1000; fx.frame += dt;
    if (fx.frame < (fx.lowMotion ? 110 : 55)) return;
    fx.frame = 0;
    const g = fx.layer; g.clear();
    if (fx.reducedMotion) return;
    const left = scene.cameras.main.scrollX - 100, top = scene.cameras.main.scrollY - 100;
    const right = left + scene.cameras.main.width + 200, bottom = top + scene.cameras.main.height + 200;
    const visible = (x,y) => x > left && x < right && y > top && y < bottom;
    const t = fx.time;
    function animate(type, x, y, phase, amp = 1) {
      if (!visible(x,y)) return;
      const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.3 + phase);
      if (type === 'clockhands') {
        // The civic clock hand advances gently; a restrained warm light marks its face.
        const cy=y-48, ang=t*.07+phase;
        oval(g,0xffecb7,x,cy,24,24,.055);
        stroke(g,0xfff1cf,x,cy,x+Math.sin(ang)*9,cy-Math.cos(ang)*9,1.8,.73);
        stroke(g,0xfff1cf,x,cy,x+Math.sin(ang*.25)*6,cy-Math.cos(ang*.25)*6,1.6,.62);
      } else if(type === 'crystalpulse') {
        const beat=.35+.28*(1+Math.sin(t*1.7+phase))*.5;
        for(let j=0;j<5;j++) {
          const xx=x+(j-2)*15,yy=y-42-Math.abs(j-2)*6;
          dot(g,0xa3fff5,xx,yy,1.7+j%2,beat);
          stroke(g,0xf8ffff,xx-2,yy+3,xx+1,yy-4,1,beat*.58);
        }
      } else if(type === 'prismsweep') {
        const sway=Math.sin(t*1.3+phase)*4;
        for(let j=0;j<4;j++) {
          const xx=x-33+j*22;
          stroke(g,[0xffd37c,0x81efdc,0xf4a1cb,0xac9bff][j],xx,y-26+sway,
            xx+4*Math.sin(t*1.4+j),y-8+sway,2.2,.65);
        }
      } else if(type === 'bannerflutter') {
        const p=Math.sin(t*1.15+phase)*3;
        fill(g,0x8a3f3c,x+10,y-65,20+p,10,.67);
        stroke(g,0xe9ce9a,x+13,y-60,x+26+p,y-60,1,.58);
      } else if(type === 'springmist') {
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++) {
          const tt=(t*.12+j/3)%1;
          oval(g,0xd4f7e5,x-35+tt*70,y-8+j*6,22,5,(1-tt)*.21);
          stroke(g,0xb7fff6,x-21+j*14,y+10+Math.sin(t+j)*2,x-4+j*14,y+10+Math.sin(t+j)*2,1,.3);
        }
      } else if(type === 'seedwind') {
        for(let j=0;j<4;j++) {
          const xx=x-25+Math.sin(t*.7+j*1.3)*32;
          const yy=y-15+j*10+Math.sin(t*.95+j)*7;
          oval(g,j%2?0xb6c48a:0xe8d8aa,xx,yy,4,2,.27);
        }
      } else if(type === 'forestmoon') {
        for(let j=0;j<4;j++) {
          const xx=x-34+j*24+Math.sin(t*.6+j)*6;
          const yy=y-22+(j%3)*17+Math.cos(t*.8+j)*8;
          dot(g,0xedf4bd,xx,yy,1.2,.18+.18*(1+Math.sin(t*2+j)));
        }
      } else if(type === 'canvasflutter') {
        const sway=Math.sin(t*1.1+phase)*4;
        stroke(g,0xdcc79e,x-38,y-30+sway,x+32,y-30-sway,1.8,.5);
        for(let j=0;j<2;j++)dot(g,0xffd88c,x+(j?23:-23),y-22+Math.sin(t*1.6+j)*2,2,.46);
      } else if (type === 'fire') {
        oval(g, 0xf7a744, x, y + 1, 20 + bob * 3, 9, .31);
        g.fillStyle(0xdc5c2b, .94).fillTriangle(x - 6, y + 6, x + 6, y + 6, x + bob * 4, y - 17 - bob * 3);
        g.fillStyle(0xffd57e, .9).fillTriangle(x - 2, y + 5, x + 3, y + 5, x - 1 - bob * 2, y - 10);
      } else if (type === 'smoke') {
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const cycle = (t * .35 + i / 4 + phase / TAU) % 1;
          oval(g, 0xa8aba6, x + Math.sin(t + i * 2) * (8 + cycle * 8), y - 13 - cycle * 42,
            (8 + cycle * 11) * amp, (5 + cycle * 8) * amp, (.19 * (1 - cycle)));
        }
      } else if (type === 'water') {
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          let cycle = (t * .38 + i / 3 + phase / TAU) % 1;
          g.lineStyle(1.4, 0xd7f8f0, .4 * (1 - cycle)).strokeEllipse(x, y + i * 4, 13 + cycle * 31, 4 + cycle * 12);
        }
      } else if (type === 'ore' || type === 'sparkle') {
        const gl = (.5 + .5 * Math.sin(t * 3.9 + phase));
        dot(g, type === 'ore' ? 0xb2fff1 : 0xffe0ad, x, y + bob * 3, 1.4 + 1.8 * gl, .3 + gl * .7);
        stroke(g, 0xffffff, x - 4 * gl, y, x + 4 * gl, y, 1, .42 * gl);
      } else if (type === 'lantern') {
        const sway = Math.sin(t * 1.3 + phase) * 3;
        oval(g, 0xffd899, x + sway, y, 24 + bob * 3, 19, .15);
        dot(g, 0xffe6a0, x + sway, y, 3.4, .7);
      } else if (type === 'ember') {
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          let cy = (t * (.31 + i * .05) + i * .17) % 1;
          dot(g, i % 2 ? 0xffc26a : 0xff8753, x - 8 + Math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 3) * 12,
            y - cy * 44, 1.3 + (1 - cy), (1 - cy) * .65);
        }
      } else if (type === 'butterfly') {
        let xx = x + Math.sin(t * 1.5 + phase) * 15, yy = y + Math.cos(t * 1.4 + phase) * 10;
        oval(g, 0xffd8a8, xx - 2, yy, 3 + Math.abs(bob) * 5, 4, .79);
        oval(g, 0xf6b8b9, xx + 3, yy, 3 + Math.abs(bob) * 5, 4, .8);
      } else if (type === 'confetti') {
        const xx = x + Math.sin(t * .9 + phase) * 13, yy = y + Math.cos(t * 1.2 + phase) * 8;
        fill(g, [0xf6bb68, 0x69d5cb, 0xf48cc4][Math.floor(phase * 4) % 3], xx, yy, 3, 3, .83);
      } else if (type === 'dust' || type === 'leaves' || type === 'firefly') {
        const xx = x + Math.sin(t * .77 + phase) * 16;
        const yy = y + Math.sin(t * 1.14 + phase) * 9;
        if (type === 'leaves') oval(g, 0xb5be77, xx, yy, 5 + Math.abs(bob) * 2, 2.5, .53);
        else dot(g, type === 'firefly' ? 0xffeda7 : 0xb9ab86, xx, yy, type === 'firefly' ? 1.7 : 1.2,
          type === 'firefly' ? .25 + Math.max(0, bob) * .75 : .36);
      }
    }
    fx.effects.forEach(([kind, tx, ty], i) => animate(kind, (tx + .5) * T, (ty + .5) * T, i * 2.03));
    fx.motes.forEach((m, i) => animate(m.type, m.x, m.y, m.p, .65));
  }
  function diagnostics(a) {
    const p = PLAN[a.id];
    if (!p) return [];
    return p.marks.map(([kind,x,y,r,name]) => ({ kind, x,y, name, inBounds:x>=0 && y>=0 && x<a.w && y<a.h }));
  }
  window.LQWorldUpgrade = Object.freeze({ ground, details, attach, detach, update, diagnostics, catalog: () => Object.keys(PLAN), information: (id) => PLAN[id] ? { density: PLAN[id].density, landmarks: PLAN[id].marks.map(a=>a[4]), particle: PLAN[id].particle } : null });
})();

</script>
<script>
/* LIFEQUEST AI V17 — Career Worlds
 * Extra deterministic, non-solid painted details. Never edits the area's geometry,
 * interactive objects, spawn locations, quests, saves or character animation.
 */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const T=32, TAU=Math.PI*2;
  const CONFIG=Object.freeze({
    'english-town':    {mode:'city',     colors:[0xf7e4ae,0xe6b7b9,0xaed3bf], target:[30,5]},
    'mining-town':     {mode:'mineral',  colors:[0x91c8ba,0xc0a57d,0x5c8790], target:[50,13]},
    'art-district':    {mode:'art',      colors:[0xf9bb64,0xe68bbf,0x69d8c7], target:[36,18]},
    'english-town-past': {mode:'village', colors:[0xc9b27a,0x90a36d,0x9c6c52], target:[30,5]},
    'oriaris-trail-1': {mode:'stream',   colors:[0x96b585,0xd2dba0,0xa8dbd0], target:[20,8]},
    'oriaris-trail-2': {mode:'renewal',  colors:[0x9d9473,0x80966f,0xc5bb90], target:[26,19]},
    'oriaris-trail-3': {mode:'forest',   colors:[0x789b73,0x486d55,0xafd7ad], target:[22,10]},
    'oriaris-camp':    {mode:'camp',     colors:[0xe1bd7d,0x8c9474,0xd49a77], target:[24,15]},
  });
  function hash(a,b,seed){let v=(Math.imul(a+37,0x45d9f3b)^Math.imul(b+47,0x27d4eb2d)^seed)|0;v=Math.imul(v^(v>>>16),0x7feb352d);v=Math.imul(v^(v>>>15),0x846ca68b);return ((v^(v>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296;}
  function seedOf(str){return [...str].reduce((s,ch)=>Math.imul((s^ch.charCodeAt(0))|0,16777619),2166136261)|0;}
  function rect(g,x,y,w,h,c,a=1){g.fillStyle(c,a).fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.max(1,Math.round(w)),Math.max(1,Math.round(h)));}
  function dot(g,x,y,r,c,a=1){g.fillStyle(c,a).fillCircle(x,y,r);}
  function line(g,x,y,x2,y2,c,a=1,w=1){g.lineStyle(w,c,a).lineBetween(x,y,x2,y2);}
  function oval(g,x,y,w,h,c,a=1){g.fillStyle(c,a).fillEllipse(x,y,w,h);}
  function walkable(a,x,y){return x>1&&y>1&&x<a.w-2&&y<a.h-2&&!a.isTileBlocked(x,y)&&!(a.warpAt&&a.warpAt(x,y));}
  const within=(a,x,y)=>x>=1&&y>=1&&x<a.w-1&&y<a.h-1;
  function ground(g,a){
    const p=CONFIG[a?.id]; if(!p)return;
    const seed=seedOf(a.id), mode=p.mode, col=p.colors;
    // Tiny fragments read as ground texture, not as new path-blocking objects.
    for(let ty=2;ty<a.h-2;ty+=2){for(let tx=2;tx<a.w-2;tx+=2){
      if(!walkable(a,tx,ty))continue;
      const rnd=hash(tx,ty,seed);if(rnd>.54)continue;
      const x=tx*T+5+Math.floor(hash(tx,ty,seed^125)*18);
      const y=ty*T+8+Math.floor(hash(tx,ty,seed^217)*15);
      const c=col[(rnd*37|0)%3];
      if(mode==='city'){
        rect(g,x,y,8,2,0xfff3d9,.13);rect(g,x+3,y+4,5,1,0x5d8491,.17);
        if(rnd<.15){dot(g,x+11,y-4,2,c,.68);dot(g,x+13,y-5,1,0xfff8e3,.7);}
      }else if(mode==='mineral'){
        line(g,x-4,y+3,x+7,y,c,.35,2);line(g,x+2,y-3,x+9,y-5,0xcce9dc,.22,1);
        if(rnd<.14){g.fillStyle(c,.64).fillTriangle(x,y-6,x+6,y+2,x-3,y+2);line(g,x,y-4,x,y+1,0xedfff8,.34);}
      }else if(mode==='art'){
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++)rect(g,x+j*5,y+(j%2)*3,5,2,col[(j+tx)%3],.44);
        if(rnd<.22){rect(g,x+7,y-4,3,3,0xfff0ce,.7);rect(g,x-3,y+4,2,2,col[1],.68);}
      }else if(mode==='village'){
        rect(g,x,y+3,8,2,0x9d8463,.27);line(g,x,y-2,x+1,y-6,0x557248,.54);dot(g,x+2,y-6,1.5,0xc2b780,.65);
      }else if(mode==='stream'){
        line(g,x,y+4,x-2,y-3,0x4b875b,.5);line(g,x,y+4,x+4,y-4,0x92a970,.53);
        if(rnd<.15){dot(g,x+5,y-4,2.1,c,.8);dot(g,x+2,y-6,1.3,0xffe5ba,.8);}
      }else if(mode==='renewal'){
        rect(g,x,y,7,2,0x4a4b42,.32);rect(g,x+2,y-1,3,1,0xb5a990,.32);
        if(rnd<.28){line(g,x+10,y+3,x+10,y-5,0x577d4d,.65);dot(g,x+10,y-5,1.8,c,.76);}
      }else if(mode==='forest'){
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++){line(g,x+j*3,y+6,x+j*4-4,y-5,0x38644e,.48);dot(g,x+j*4-4,y-5,1.5,col[j],.6);}
        if(rnd<.2)oval(g,x+8,y+2,7,3,0x415a4b,.44);
      }else if(mode==='camp'){
        rect(g,x,y+4,8,2,0x4b4236,.26);line(g,x+2,y,x+6,y-4,0xc3aa84,.48);
        if(rnd<.14){dot(g,x+11,y-2,1.8,0xf8d4a1,.6);}
      }
    }}
    // Soft authored wayfinding motifs around each region's principal destination.
    const [tx,ty]=p.target;
    if(within(a,tx,ty)){
      const x=(tx+.5)*T,y=(ty+.5)*T;
      for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
        const theta=i*TAU/22,rad=65+(i%4)*10;
        const xx=x+Math.cos(theta)*rad, yy=y+Math.sin(theta)*rad*.52;
        const cx=Math.floor(xx/T),cy=Math.floor(yy/T);
        if(!walkable(a,cx,cy))continue;
        if(mode==='city'||mode==='art')rect(g,xx,yy,7,3,col[i%3],.29);
        else if(mode==='mineral')rect(g,xx,yy,5,3,col[i%3],.39);
        else if(mode==='stream'||mode==='forest'||mode==='renewal'){
          line(g,xx,yy+3,xx+1,yy-4,0x406d4d,.7);dot(g,xx+1,yy-5,1.7,col[i%3],.8);
        }else if(mode==='camp')rect(g,xx,yy,9,2,col[i%3],.21);
        else rect(g,xx,yy,7,2,col[i%3],.3);
      }
    }
  }
  function landmark(g,a){
    const p=CONFIG[a?.id];if(!p)return;
    const [tx,ty]=p.target;if(!within(a,tx,ty))return;
    const x=(tx+.5)*T,y=(ty+.5)*T,c=p.colors,m=p.mode;
    // Architecture detailing stays attached to an existing painted monument, with NO new collision.
    if(m==='city'){
      for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++){
        const px=x+j*13;
        rect(g,px-4,y-16,8,2,0xffe9bb,.67);
        rect(g,px-3,y+14,6,3,0x354f69,.42);
      }
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
        const angle=i*TAU/12;dot(g,x+Math.cos(angle)*13,y-49+Math.sin(angle)*13,1.3,0xffe4a8,.85);
      }
      rect(g,x-29,y+33,58,2,0xffdfaa,.56);
    }else if(m==='mineral'){
      for(let j=-3;j<=3;j++){
        const px=x+j*15,py=y+13-Math.abs(j%3)*7;
        g.fillStyle(0x6fc4ba,.42).fillTriangle(px-4,py+6,px+2,py-10,px+7,py+7);
        line(g,px+2,py-7,px+2,py+1,0xe0fff3,.6);
      }
    }else if(m==='art'){
      for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
        const xx=x-54+j*27,yy=y-45+(j%2)*6;
        rect(g,xx,yy,19,5,[0xffd879,0x80e1d9,0xfaa1c8,0xbca0ff,0xffd879][j],.65);
        dot(g,xx+10,yy+3,1,0xffffff,.8);
      }
      for(let i=0;i<11;i++)rect(g,x-52+i*10,y+22+(i%3)*3,7,2,c[i%3],.59);
    }else if(m==='village'){
      for(let j=-3;j<=3;j++){
        rect(g,x+j*11-3,y+19,7,3,0xd5c39b,.46);
        line(g,x+j*11,y-58,x+j*11+4,y-65,0x825f47,.55);
      }
      rect(g,x-31,y+29,62,3,0x513e32,.5);
    }else if(m==='stream'){
      for(let j=-3;j<=3;j++){
        rect(g,x-31,y+j*9-2,62,2,0xe9d4a6,.45);
        line(g,x-29,y+j*9+1,x+28,y+j*9+1,0x473c2b,.32);
      }
      for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
        const xx=x-40+j*13;line(g,xx,y+52,xx+6,y+52,0xc8ece7,.36);
      }

      for(let j=0;j<27;j++){

        dot(g,xx+2,yy-6,1.5,c[j%3],.73);
      }

      for(let j=-6;j<=6;j++){
        let xx=x+j*8;

  function facade(g,b,a){
    if(!b || !b.w || !b.h)return;
    const mode=CONFIG[a?.id]?.mode||'city';
    const x=b.x*T,y=b.y*T,w=b.w*T,h=b.h*T;
    if(w<80||h<64)return;
    const roof=Math.round(h*((b.floors??1)===2?.4:.55));
    const name=(b.name||'').toLowerCase();
    const texture=mode==='mineral'?[0x94aaa7,0x667d85]:mode==='art'?[0xffd6d1,0xd6b3e7]:[0xffe7bd,0x827a72];
    // Roof-edge craftsmanship is drawn inside the existing building bounds.
    for(let j=13;j<w-12;j+=19){
      rect(g,x+j,y+Math.max(7,roof-10),11,2,texture[0],.28);
      rect(g,x+j+3,y+Math.max(11,roof-6),5,1,texture[1],.19);
    }
    const mid=x+w*.5,wallY=y+roof;
    const display=(rgb)=>{
      rect(g,mid-17,wallY+12,34,17,0x2b4352,.72);
      rect(g,mid-14,wallY+14,28,11,rgb,.41);
      rect(g,mid-17,wallY+12,34,2,0xeef4e9,.54);
    };
    if(/library/.test(name)){
      for(let j=-1;j<=1;j++){rect(g,mid+j*9-4,wallY+17,7,10,[0xf7c279,0xa4c9c2,0xc78e9d][j+1],.83);rect(g,mid+j*9-4,wallY+23,7,1,0xffffff,.4);}
      rect(g,mid-24,wallY+29,48,3,0x5a4f48,.7);
    }else if(/cinema/.test(name)){
      for(let j=0;j<9;j++)dot(g,mid-44+j*11,wallY+3,2.3,j%2?0xffdd76:0xf8af88,.76);
    }else if(/town hall|school|bank/.test(name)){
      rect(g,x+17,wallY+6,w-34,3,0xffebcc,.3);
      for(let j=0;j<4;j++)rect(g,x+22+j*(w-44)/4,wallY+10,3,17,0xf1e2c5,.23);
    }else if(/hospital|clinic/.test(name)){
      rect(g,mid-4,wallY+11,8,24,0xe9f1f1,.31);rect(g,mid-11,wallY+19,22,8,0xe9f1f1,.31);
    }else if(/great mine|smithy|forge/.test(name)){
      for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++){
        line(g,mid+j*17,wallY+5,mid+j*17+10,wallY+23,0x7c8f9b,.52,2);
      }
      rect(g,mid-23,wallY+23,46,4,0x293744,.45);
    }else if(/rail station/.test(name)){
      display(0x9cdad3);
      for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++)rect(g,mid+j*12-3,wallY+30,7,2,0xf6d2a4,.47);
    }else if(/gallery|studio|workshop/.test(name) && mode==='art'){
      for(let j=0;j<5;j++)rect(g,x+15+j*Math.max(9,(w-36)/5),wallY+12,7,12,[0xead16e,0xf397bc,0x7fd7cb,0xa99cea,0xe8d08b][j],.53);
    }else if(/house|home/.test(name)){
      const seed=seedOf(name), variant=(seed>>>4)%4;
      const c=[0x92b3a2,0xa9bad0,0xd0aaa2,0xccbc8f][variant];
      for(const side of [-1,1]){
        const wx=mid+side*w*.28;
        rect(g,wx-10,wallY+10,20,3,c,.42);
        rect(g,wx-9,wallY+14,18,12,0x2e4d57,.4);
        rect(g,wx,wallY+14,2,12,0xf3e6bf,.56);
        rect(g,wx-7,wallY+24,15,2,0xfff0ce,.32);
      }
    }else if(/cafe|restaurant|shop|market/.test(name)){
      for(let j=0;j<5;j++)rect(g,mid-35+j*14,wallY+7,10,3,[0xffdb9b,0xe3a49c,0x9bcac2,0xffdb9b,0xe3a49c][j],.46);
    }
  }
  function interior(g,s){
    if(!s||!s.w||!s.h)return;
    const W=s.w*T,items=s.items||[];
    const types=new Set(items.map(i=>i.k));
    const color=types.has('crystal')||types.has('forge')?0x9be5dd:types.has('bookshelf')||types.has('shelf')?0xc3d2af:0xf5d1a0;
    for(let j=35;j<W-35;j+=88){
      // Art on the back wall: purely ornamental; no interactive hitbox.
      rect(g,j-15,12,30,27,0x5e493a,.73);
      rect(g,j-12,15,24,21,0xe1cba2,.54);
      rect(g,j-9,18,18,15,0x5f7984,.55);
      g.fillStyle(color,.48).fillTriangle(j-8,32,j,21,j+9,32);
      rect(g,j-10,35,20,2,0xfff1d4,.4);
      dot(g,j,9,1.3,0xffe9af,.7);
    }
    // Wall-only details leave every existing furniture and passage tile untouched.
    rect(g,9,61,W-18,2,color,.24);
  }
  window.LQWorldV15=Object.freeze({ground,landmark,facade,interior,
    diagnostics:(area)=>({known:!!CONFIG[area?.id],bounds:!!CONFIG[area?.id]&&within(area,...CONFIG[area.id].target)}),
    maps:()=>Object.keys(CONFIG),version:'15.0-world-reborn'});
})();

  // who: '' = narrator. cam: tile to look at (null = the player). acc: caption colour. act: what happens at this line.
  const FILM = [

    { cam: [35, 47], zoom: 1.45, en: 'Then you saw them on the wall: a star, an eye and a wave. The three marks!', vi: 'Rồi bạn nhìn thấy chúng trên tường: một ngôi sao, một con mắt và một con sóng. Ba dấu hiệu!', act: 'marks', acc: '#ffd447' },
    { cam: [35, 40], zoom: 1.15, en: 'At the end of the tunnel, there was light… and colour everywhere.', vi: 'Ở cuối đường hầm có ánh sáng… và màu sắc ở khắp mọi nơi.', act: 'light' },
    { cam: [36, 14], zoom: 0.82, en: 'Beyond the tunnel rises Dream Gate: a new home for painters, makers and performers.', vi: 'Qua đường hầm là Dream Gate: ngôi nhà mới của họa sĩ, nghệ nhân và nghệ sĩ biểu diễn.', act: 'paint' },

    { cam: [83, 32], zoom: 1.0, en: 'Galleries and studios now share an artists’ avenue, while stages and dance venues have their own quarter.', vi: 'Phòng tranh và xưởng sáng tác nằm trên tuyến phố nghệ sĩ; sân khấu và sàn nhảy có khu riêng.', act: 'paint', acc: '#42dce7' },
    { cam: [10, 46], zoom: 1.3, who: 'Ivo · Street Musician', en: 'And every street can become a stage. Can you hear the rhythm?', vi: 'Và mỗi con phố đều có thể trở thành sân khấu. Bạn có nghe thấy nhịp điệu không?', act: 'music', acc: '#42dce7' },

    { cam: [62, 47], zoom: 1.3, who: 'Sol · Art Critic', en: "Don't just say it is beautiful. Tell us why it matters.", vi: 'Đừng chỉ nói nó đẹp. Hãy cho chúng tôi biết vì sao nó có ý nghĩa.', act: 'sol', acc: '#c39cff' },
    { cam: null, zoom: 1, en: 'Explore the painters’ quarter, complete three creative activities, then leave your mark.', vi: 'Hãy khám phá khu hội họa, hoàn thành ba hoạt động sáng tạo rồi để lại dấu ấn của bạn.', act: 'end' },

  // ---- drawing helpers (into the film's own Graphics, redrawn every frame) -------------------------------------------
  function star(g, cx, cy, r, color, alpha) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI) / 5;
      const rr = i % 2 ? r * 0.45 : r;
      pts.push({ x: cx + Math.cos(a) * rr, y: cy + Math.sin(a) * rr });
    }
    g.fillStyle(color, alpha).fillPoints(pts, true);
  }
  function eye(g, cx, cy, r, color, alpha) {
    g.lineStyle(3, color, alpha);
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(cx, cy + r * 0.9, r * 1.25, Math.PI * 1.22, Math.PI * 1.78, false);
    g.strokePath();
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(cx, cy - r * 0.9, r * 1.25, Math.PI * 0.22, Math.PI * 0.78, false);
    g.strokePath();
    g.fillStyle(color, alpha).fillCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.32);
  }
  function wave(g, cx, cy, r, color, alpha) {
    g.lineStyle(3, color, alpha);
    g.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
      const x = cx - r + (i / 20) * r * 2;
      const y = cy + Math.sin((i / 20) * Math.PI * 2) * r * 0.35;
      if (i) g.lineTo(x, y);
      else g.moveTo(x, y);
    }
    g.strokePath();
  }
  function glow(g, x, y, r, color, a) {
    for (let k = 3; k >= 1; k--) g.fillStyle(color, a * 0.12 * k).fillCircle(x, y, r * (1 + (3 - k) * 0.6));
  }
  // Seeded random so the splashes are always in the same place.
  function rnd(seed) {
    let s = seed >>> 0;
    return () => ((s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296);
  }

  // ---- film player -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let filming = false;
  function ensureCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('lq-art-css')) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'lq-art-css';
    st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  function setupScene(sc, actors) {
    const W = sc.area.w * 32,
      H = sc.area.h * 32;
    const R = rnd(77);
    const splashes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++)
      splashes.push({
        x: (12 + R() * 48) * 32,
        y: (14 + R() * 32) * 32,
        r: 5 + R() * 12,
        c: PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length],
        d: R() * 1.6,
      });
    const notes = [];
    const marks = [
      { k: 'star', x: 31.7 * 32, y: 48.4 * 32, c: 0xff4f87 },
      { k: 'eye', x: 38.6 * 32, y: 46.6 * 32, c: 0x35c8d0 },
      { k: 'wave', x: 31.9 * 32, y: 45.2 * 32, c: 0x9470e8 },
    ];
    const st = { dark: 0, darkTo: 0, darkFrom: 0, darkT0: 0, marks: 0, marksT0: 0, paint: 0, paintT0: 0, music: 0, focus: null, focusT0: 0 };
    const fade = (to, ms) => {
      st.darkFrom = st.dark;
      st.darkTo = to;
      st.darkT0 = performance.now();
      st.darkMs = ms;
    };
    const npcAt = (id) => {
      const n = sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((n) => n.def && n.def.id === id && n.sprite && n.sprite.visible);
      return n ? { x: n.sprite.x, y: n.sprite.y } : null;
    };
    return {
      tick(time) {
        const now = performance.now();
        if (st.darkT0) {
          const p = Math.min(1, (now - st.darkT0) / st.darkMs);
          st.dark = st.darkFrom + (st.darkTo - st.darkFrom) * p;
        }
        // Paint splashes "land" one after another once the light comes in.
        if (st.paint) {
          const t = (now - st.paintT0) / 1000;
          for (const s of splashes) {
            const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - s.d) / 0.35));
            if (!p) continue;
            actors.fillStyle(s.c, 0.55 * p).fillEllipse(s.x, s.y, s.r * 2 * p, s.r * 1.3 * p);
            actors.fillStyle(s.c, 0.5 * p).fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y + s.r * 0.5, 2, s.r * 0.9 * p);
          }
        }
        // Darkness over the whole map (the tunnel at the start).
        if (st.dark > 0.01) actors.fillStyle(0x05070c, st.dark).fillRect(-64, -64, W + 128, H + 128);
        // The three marks glow on the tunnel wall, one after another.
        if (st.marks) {
          const t = (now - st.marksT0) / 1000;
          marks.forEach((m, i) => {
            const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - i * 0.7) / 0.6));
            if (!a) return;
            const pulse = 0.75 + Math.sin(time * 0.005 + i) * 0.25;
            glow(actors, m.x, m.y, 16, m.c, a * pulse);
            if (m.k === 'star') star(actors, m.x, m.y, 11, m.c, a);
            if (m.k === 'eye') eye(actors, m.x, m.y, 10, m.c, a);
            if (m.k === 'wave') wave(actors, m.x, m.y, 12, m.c, a);
          });
        }
        // Music notes rise from the warehouse stage.
        if (st.music) {
          const base = npcAt('ivo') || { x: 9 * 32 + 16, y: 47 * 32 };
          if (notes.length < 14 && Math.random() < 0.08)
            notes.push({ x: base.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70, y: base.y - 10, t0: now, c: PALETTE[(Math.random() * PALETTE.length) | 0] });
          for (let i = notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const n = notes[i];
            const t = (now - n.t0) / 1000;
            if (t > 2.4) {
              notes.splice(i, 1);
              continue;
            }
            const a = 1 - t / 2.4;
            const x = n.x + Math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 8,
              y = n.y - t * 42;
            actors.fillStyle(n.c, a).fillEllipse(x, y, 8, 6);
            actors.fillStyle(n.c, a).fillRect(x + 3, y - 14, 2, 14);
          }
        }
        // A soft ring under the artist who is speaking.
        if (st.focus) {
          const p = npcAt(st.focus.id);
          if (p) {
            const r = 20 + Math.sin(time * 0.006) * 3;
            actors.lineStyle(3, st.focus.c, 0.85).strokeEllipse(p.x, p.y + 14, r * 2, r * 0.8);
          }
        }
      },
      act(a, skipping) {
        if (a === 'dark') {
          st.dark = 0.8;
          st.darkTo = 0.8;
          st.darkT0 = 0;
        }
        if (a === 'marks') {
          st.marks = 1;
          st.marksT0 = performance.now();
          if (!skipping) toast('✨ The three marks', 'Star · Eye · Wave', 'Ngôi sao · Con mắt · Con sóng');
        }
        if (a === 'light') fade(0, 2200);
        if (a === 'paint') {
          st.paint = 1;
          st.paintT0 = performance.now();
        }
        if (a === 'noor') st.focus = { id: 'noor', c: 0xff5d9b };
        if (a === 'music') {
          st.music = 1;
          st.focus = { id: 'ivo', c: 0x42dce7 };
        }
        if (a === 'kai') {
          st.music = 0;
          st.focus = { id: 'kai', c: 0xff8b54 };
        }
        if (a === 'sol') st.focus = { id: 'sol', c: 0xc39cff };
        if (a === 'end') {
          st.focus = null;
          st.music = 0;
          st.marks = 0;
          st.dark = 0;
          st.darkT0 = 0;
        }
      },
    };
  }

  function play() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !here(sc) || filming || sc.inside || !sc.player) return Promise.resolve(false);
    // Never on top of the Chapter 2 film.
    if (document.body.classList.contains('lq-filming')) return Promise.resolve(false);
    filming = true;
    ensureCss();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const cam = sc.cameras.main;
      const zoom0 = cam.zoom;
      const kb = sc.input && sc.input.keyboard;
      if (kb) {
        kb.enabled = false;
        try {
          kb.resetKeys();
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      cam.stopFollow();
      const actors = sc.add.graphics().setDepth(9.6);
      const scene = setupScene(sc, actors);
      const tick = (time) => {
        actors.clear();
        scene.tick(time);
      };
      sc.events.on('update', tick);
      const root = document.createElement('div');
      root.id = 'lq-art';
      root.innerHTML =
        '<div class="lb t"></div><div class="lb b"></div>' +
        '<div class="card"><small>New area unlocked</small><b>ART DISTRICT</b><span>Concrete Dreams · Khu Nghệ thuật</span></div>' +
        '<div class="cap"><div class="who"></div><p class="en"></p><p class="vi"></p><div class="hint">Click / Space ▶</div></div>' +
        '<button class="skip" type="button">Skip ⏭</button>';
      document.body.appendChild(root);
      if (sc.game && sc.game.canvas) sc.game.canvas.classList.add('lq-main');
      document.body.classList.add('lq-artfilm');
      const card = root.querySelector('.card');
      const cap = root.querySelector('.cap');
      const who = root.querySelector('.who');
      const en = root.querySelector('.en');
      const vi = root.querySelector('.vi');
      let i = -1,
        typing = 0,
        full = '',
        ended = false;
      const look = (shot, ms) => {
        if (shot.cam) cam.pan(shot.cam[0] * 32 + 16, shot.cam[1] * 32 + 16, ms, 'Sine.easeInOut', true);
        else cam.pan(sc.player.x, sc.player.y, ms, 'Sine.easeInOut', true);
        cam.zoomTo(zoom0 * (shot.zoom || 1), ms, 'Sine.easeInOut', true);
      };
      const show = () => {
        const s = FILM[i];
        look(s, i === 0 ? 1 : 1500);
        if (s.act) scene.act(s.act);
        root.style.setProperty('--acc', s.acc || '#d9d9d9');
        who.textContent = s.who || '';
        who.style.display = s.who ? '' : 'none';
        vi.textContent = s.vi;
        full = s.en;
        en.textContent = '';
        clearInterval(typing);
        let n = 0;
        typing = setInterval(() => {
          n += 1;
          en.textContent = full.slice(0, n);
          if (n >= full.length) clearInterval(typing);
        }, 28);
      };
      const next = () => {
        if (ended) return;
        if (i >= 0 && en.textContent.length < full.length) {
          clearInterval(typing);
          en.textContent = full;
          return;
        }
        i += 1;
        if (i >= FILM.length) return finish();
        show();
      };
      const finish = () => {
        if (ended) return;
        ended = true;
        clearInterval(typing);
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        const g = game();
        if (g) {
          g.artIntroSeen = g.artIntroSeen || Date.now();
          g.v72ArtIntroSeen = g.v72ArtIntroSeen || Date.now();
          save();
        }
        root.classList.add('out');
        document.body.classList.remove('lq-artfilm');
        cap.classList.remove('show');
        card.classList.remove('show');
        sc.events.off('update', tick);
        actors.destroy();
        cam.zoomTo(zoom0, 600, 'Sine.easeInOut', true);
        cam.startFollow(sc.player, true, 0.1, 0.1);
        if (kb) kb.enabled = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
          root.remove();
          filming = false;
          toast('🎨 Art District', 'Meet the seven artists', 'Gặp gỡ bảy nghệ sĩ: Noor, Ivo, Ada, Kai, Mira, Ren, Sol.');
          resolve(true);
        }, 850);
      };
      const onKey = (e) => {
        if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          next();
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          e.preventDefault();
          finish();
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
      cap.addEventListener('click', next);
      root.querySelector('.skip').addEventListener('click', finish);
      cam.centerOn(FILM[0].cam[0] * 32 + 16, FILM[0].cam[1] * 32 + 16);
      cam.setZoom(zoom0 * FILM[0].zoom);
      scene.act(FILM[0].act);
      card.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (ended) return;
        card.classList.remove('show');
        cap.classList.add('show');
        next();
      }, 2800);
    });
  }

  // Go to the Art District (testing, or later from the story).
  function enter(opts) {
    const o = Object.assign({ film: true }, opts || {});
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.switchArea) return false;
    if (o.film) pending = true;
    if (here(sc)) return true;
    sc.switchArea(ID, SPAWN, 'Art District – Concrete Dreams');
    return true;
  }

  // First arrival → the film (checked a few times a second, like past.js).
  let pending = false;
  let waiting = false;
  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.area || !sc.player || filming || waiting) return;
    if (!here(sc) || sc.inside || sc.switching) return;
    const g = game();
    if (!g) return;
    if (!pending && g.artIntroSeen && g.v72ArtIntroSeen) return;
    waiting = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      waiting = false;
      const s = getScene();
      if (!here(s) || s.inside || s.switching || filming) return;
      pending = false;
      play();
    }, 800);
  }, 400);

  const m = /[?&]artfilm=1\b/.exec(location.search);
  if (m) {
    const wait = setInterval(() => {
      const sc = getScene();
      if (sc && sc.player && sc.switchArea) {
        clearInterval(wait);
        setTimeout(() => enter({ film: true }), 900);
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  window.LQArtDistrict = {
    id: ID,
    play,
    enter,
    isFilming: () => filming,
    // Testing: see the film again on the next arrival.
    reset() {
      const g = game();
      if (g) {
        delete g.artIntroSeen;
        delete g.v72ArtIntroSeen;
        save();
      }
    },
  };
})();

    <!-- Art District: floor mural of the three marks, paint, neon string lights, drifting light. -->
    <script>
/*
 * Art District · street-art light and colour (layered on top of the game's own drawing of the area).
 *  - Floor (one texture, depth 0.5, under the characters): paint splatters and drips under the facades, rainbow
 *    crosswalks, little cyan stars leading from the tunnel to the plaza, and a big floor mural of the three marks
 *    (a gold star, an eye and a blue wave) in the middle of the plaza.
 *  - Lights (redrawn every frame, additive): neon string lights hanging over the streets, the mural glowing softly,
 *    and specks of coloured light drifting up into the night.
 * Testing: index.html?preview=art-district
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const ID = 'art-district';
  const T = 32;
  const PAL = [0xff4f87, 0x35c8d0, 0xffd447, 0x9470e8, 0x83c96b, 0xff893d];
  // On the square in front of the tunnel: the first thing the player sees (the middle is the fenced building site).
  const MURAL = { x: 36 * T, y: 40 * T, s: 1.1 }; // centred between the lower street (ends y 36) and the tunnel (y 44)
  // The fenced site in the middle of the district, kept free for a future landmark (obstacles in game/03).
  const SITE = { x0: 23, y0: 2, x1: 48, y1: 31 }; // the whole back middle, centred on x 36
  // The drifting specks of colour: the artists' creativity, everywhere in the district.
  const MOTE_PAL = [0xffb6d5, 0x1f4fd8, 0x8fd3ff, 0x6f5cff, 0xfff04a, 0xf5b21b];
  const ADD = 1; // Phaser.BlendModes.ADD
  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);

  function rnd(seed) {
    let s = seed | 0;
    return () => {
      s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  const onBuilding = (a, x, y, m) => a.buildings.some((b) => x >= b.x - m && x < b.x + b.w + m && y >= b.y - m && y < b.y + b.h + m);

  // ---- the floor ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function star(g, cx, cy, n, ro, ri, rot) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
      const a = rot + (i * Math.PI) / n;
      const r = i % 2 ? ri : ro;
      pts.push({ x: cx + Math.cos(a) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(a) * r });
    }
    g.fillPoints(pts, true);
  }
  function sparkle(g, cx, cy, r, c, a) {
    g.fillStyle(c, a);
    g.fillTriangle(cx - r * 0.25, cy, cx + r * 0.25, cy, cx, cy - r);
    g.fillTriangle(cx - r * 0.25, cy, cx + r * 0.25, cy, cx, cy + r);
    g.fillTriangle(cx, cy - r * 0.25, cx, cy + r * 0.25, cx - r, cy);
    g.fillTriangle(cx, cy - r * 0.25, cx, cy + r * 0.25, cx + r, cy);
  }
  // The three marks, like the poster: a gold eight-point star, an eye in its heart, a blue wave curling below.
  function mural(g, cx, cy) {
    g.fillStyle(0x15122a, 1).fillCircle(cx, cy, 110);
    g.lineStyle(3, 0x9470e8, 0.8).strokeCircle(cx, cy, 110);
    // splashes of paint around the disc
    const R = rnd(77);
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const a = R() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = 110 + R() * 22;
      g.fillStyle(i % 2 ? 0x9470e8 : 0x35c8d0, 0.55).fillCircle(cx + Math.cos(a) * d, cy + Math.sin(a) * d, 2 + R() * 5);
    }
    // the star: dark outline, orange shade, gold face
    g.fillStyle(0x1b1206, 1);
    star(g, cx, cy, 8, 100, 46, -Math.PI / 2);
    g.fillStyle(0xe08a1e, 1);
    star(g, cx + 2, cy + 3, 8, 92, 40, -Math.PI / 2);
    g.fillStyle(0xffc93c, 1);
    star(g, cx, cy, 8, 88, 38, -Math.PI / 2);
    g.fillStyle(0xffe58a, 1);
    star(g, cx - 3, cy - 4, 4, 70, 22, -Math.PI / 2);
    // the eye
    g.fillStyle(0x1b1206, 1).fillEllipse(cx, cy, 78, 40);
    g.fillStyle(0xf4ead2, 1).fillEllipse(cx, cy, 70, 32);
    g.fillStyle(0x2a6fd6, 1).fillCircle(cx, cy, 14);
    g.fillStyle(0x4cc3ff, 1).fillCircle(cx, cy, 10);
    g.fillStyle(0x0b0b14, 1).fillCircle(cx, cy, 6);
    g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 1).fillCircle(cx - 4, cy - 5, 3);
    // the wave curling under the eye
    // (each arc stays under a full turn: from the left, over the top, curling down on the right, like a breaking wave)
    const wx = cx + 22;
    const wy = cy + 62;
    const arcs = [
      [0x1d4fbf, 11, 30, 0, 0],
      [0x2f86e8, 8, 21, 3, -2],
      [0x35c8d0, 6, 13, 5, -3],
      [0xd9f6ff, 3, 6, 6, -4],
    ];
    g.lineStyle(12, 0x1d4fbf, 1);
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(cx - 80, wy + 26);
    g.lineTo(wx - 4, wy + 26);
    g.strokePath();
    for (const [c, w, r, ox, oy] of arcs) {
      g.lineStyle(w, c, 1);
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(wx + ox, wy + oy, r, Math.PI * 0.55, Math.PI * 2.2, false);
      g.strokePath();
    }
    g.lineStyle(4, 0xd9f6ff, 0.9);
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(cx - 70, wy + 20);
    g.lineTo(wx - 22, wy + 20);
    g.strokePath();
    // little stars all around
    [[-80, -70], [80, -66], [-92, 20], [96, 30], [0, -102], [-40, 96], [60, 92]].forEach(([dx, dy], i) => sparkle(g, cx + dx, cy + dy, 7 + (i % 3) * 2, 0xffd447, 0.95));
  }
  // ---- graffiti on the buildings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // A tiny 5×5 block font for the big "bubble letter" words.
  const FONT = {
    A: ['01110', '10001', '11111', '10001', '10001'], B: ['11110', '10001', '11110', '10001', '11110'],
    C: ['01111', '10000', '10000', '10000', '01111'], D: ['11110', '10001', '10001', '10001', '11110'],
    E: ['11111', '10000', '11110', '10000', '11111'], I: ['11111', '00100', '00100', '00100', '11111'],
    L: ['10000', '10000', '10000', '10000', '11111'], N: ['10001', '11001', '10101', '10011', '10001'],
    O: ['01110', '10001', '10001', '10001', '01110'], P: ['11110', '10001', '11110', '10000', '10000'],
    R: ['11110', '10001', '11110', '10010', '10001'], S: ['01111', '10000', '01110', '00001', '11110'],
    M: ['10001', '11011', '10101', '10001', '10001'], G: ['01111', '10000', '10011', '10001', '01110'],
    T: ['11111', '00100', '00100', '00100', '00100'], Y: ['10001', '01010', '00100', '00100', '00100'],
  };
  // Bubble letters: dark outline, colour fill (top lighter than bottom), a white shine.
  function word(g, text, x, y, k, c1, c2) {
    const each = (fn) =>
      [...text].forEach((ch, i) => (FONT[ch] || []).forEach((row, ry) => [...row].forEach((v, rx) => v === '1' && fn(x + (i * 6 + rx) * k, y + ry * k, ry))));
    each((px, py) => g.fillStyle(0x0d0b14, 1).fillRect(px - k * 0.45, py - k * 0.45, k * 1.9, k * 1.9));
    each((px, py, ry) => g.fillStyle(ry < 2 ? c1 : c2, 1).fillRect(px, py, k, k));
    each((px, py, ry) => ry === 0 && g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.75).fillRect(px + k * 0.15, py + k * 0.15, k * 0.35, k * 0.3));
  }
  function note(g, x, y, c) {
    g.fillStyle(c, 1).fillEllipse(x, y, 9, 7).fillRect(x + 3, y - 16, 2, 16).fillTriangle(x + 5, y - 16, x + 11, y - 12, x + 5, y - 9);
  }
  const ICONS = {
    // Color Gallery: a colour wheel and a brush
    color(g, x, y, s) {
      [0xff4f87, 0xff893d, 0xffd447, 0x83c96b, 0x35c8d0, 0x9470e8].forEach((c, i) => g.fillStyle(c, 1).slice(x, y, s, (i * Math.PI) / 3, ((i + 1) * Math.PI) / 3).fillPath());
      g.fillStyle(0xf4ead2, 1).fillCircle(x, y, s * 0.3);
      g.lineStyle(5, 0x8a5a3b, 1).lineBetween(x + s * 0.4, y + s * 0.9, x + s * 1.2, y - s * 0.4);
      g.fillStyle(0xff4f87, 1).fillCircle(x + s * 0.4, y + s * 0.9, 4);
    },
    // Backbeat Warehouse: a speaker, sound waves and notes
    beat(g, x, y, s) {
      g.fillStyle(0x1a1a22, 1).fillRect(x - s * 0.5, y - s * 0.8, s, s * 1.6);
      g.fillStyle(0x35c8d0, 1).fillCircle(x, y - s * 0.35, s * 0.28).fillCircle(x, y + s * 0.35, s * 0.36);
      g.fillStyle(0x0d0b14, 1).fillCircle(x, y - s * 0.35, s * 0.12).fillCircle(x, y + s * 0.35, s * 0.16);

      note(g, x + s * 1.5, y - s * 0.4, 0xffd447);

    },
    // Open Canvas Gallery: three framed abstract pictures
    open(g, x, y, s) {
      [[-1.1, 0xff4f87], [0, 0x35c8d0], [1.1, 0xffd447]].forEach(([dx, c], i) => {
        const fx = x + dx * s - s * 0.45;

      });
    },
    // Mural Workshop: a spray can spraying a colourful cloud
    spray(g, x, y, s) {

      g.fillStyle(0xc0c4cc, 1).fillRect(x - s * 0.12, y - s * 0.78, s * 0.24, s * 0.2);

    // Photo Lab: a camera with a flash, and a film strip
    snap(g, x, y, s) {

      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

        g.fillTriangle(x + s * 0.5, y - s * 0.7, x + s * 0.5 + Math.cos(a) * s * 0.7, y - s * 0.7 + Math.sin(a) * s * 0.7, x + s * 0.5 + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * s * 0.7, y - s * 0.7 + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * s * 0.7);
      }
      g.fillStyle(0x0d0b14, 1).fillRect(x - s * 0.8, y - s * 0.45, s * 1.6, s * 1.05);
      g.fillStyle(0x6b7280, 1).fillRect(x - s * 0.72, y - s * 0.37, s * 1.44, s * 0.89);

      g.fillStyle(0x35c8d0, 1).fillCircle(x, y + s * 0.08, s * 0.27);
      g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.8).fillCircle(x - s * 0.08, y - s * 0.02, s * 0.08);
