      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) g.fillStyle(0xf4ead2, 1).fillRect(x - s * 1.5 + i * s * 0.36, y + s * 0.74, s * 0.14, s * 0.08);
    },
    // Independent Studio: a crown and a big star
    indie(g, x, y, s) {
      g.fillStyle(0x0d0b14, 1);
      star(g, x, y, 5, s * 0.95, s * 0.42, -Math.PI / 2);
      g.fillStyle(0x83c96b, 1);
      star(g, x, y, 5, s * 0.82, s * 0.34, -Math.PI / 2);
      g.fillStyle(0xffd447, 1).fillPoints(
        [[-0.6, -0.9], [-0.35, -1.35], [-0.15, -1.0], [0, -1.45], [0.15, -1.0], [0.35, -1.35], [0.6, -0.9]].map(([dx, dy]) => ({ x: x + dx * s, y: y + dy * s })),
        true,
      );
    },
  };
  const GRAFFITI = {
    'Color Gallery': { word: 'COLOR', icon: 'color', c1: 0xffd447, c2: 0xff893d },
    'Backbeat Warehouse': { word: 'BEAT', icon: 'beat', c1: 0x4cc3ff, c2: 0x9470e8 },
    'Open Canvas Gallery': { word: 'OPEN', icon: 'open', c1: 0xff9ac1, c2: 0xff4f87 },
    'Mural Workshop': { word: 'SPRAY', icon: 'spray', c1: 0x9be37a, c2: 0x35c8d0 },
    'Photo Lab': { word: 'SNAP', icon: 'snap', c1: 0xfff1a8, c2: 0xffd447 },
    'Independent Studio': { word: 'INDIE', icon: 'indie', c1: 0xc39cff, c2: 0xff4f87 },
  };
  // Painted over the facade panel that 07a draws on every building (same geometry as __lqStreetArtBuilding).
  function graffiti(g, b, R) {
    const art = GRAFFITI[b.name];
    if (!art) return;
    const x = b.x * T;
    const y = b.y * T;
    const w = b.w * T;
    const h = b.h * T;
    const frontY = y + Math.round(h * 0.48);
    const wallH = h - Math.round(h * 0.48);
    const px = x + 8;
    const py = frontY + 7;
    const pw = w - 16;
    const ph = wallH - 12;
    // brick wall
    g.fillStyle(0x2a2833, 1).fillRect(px, py, pw, ph);
    for (let yy = 0; yy < ph; yy += 8)
      for (let xx = (yy / 8) % 2 ? -8 : 0; xx < pw; xx += 16) g.fillStyle(0x34323f, 1).fillRect(px + Math.max(0, xx) + 1, py + yy + 1, Math.min(14, pw - Math.max(0, xx) - 2), 6);
    // overspray in the background
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) g.fillStyle(PAL[i % PAL.length], 0.35).fillCircle(px + R() * pw, py + R() * ph, 3 + R() * 9);
    // the word on the left, the picture on the right
    const k = Math.max(3, Math.min(ph * 0.12, (pw * 0.58) / (art.word.length * 6)));
    word(g, art.word, px + 10, py + ph * 0.5 - k * 2.5, k, art.c1, art.c2);
    const iconX = px + 10 + art.word.length * 6 * k + (pw - (20 + art.word.length * 6 * k)) / 2;
    ICONS[art.icon](g, Math.min(iconX, px + pw - ph * 0.45), py + ph * 0.52, Math.min(ph * 0.36, 30));
    // drips from the letters
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const dx = px + 12 + R() * art.word.length * 6 * k;
      const len = 6 + R() * 16;
      g.fillStyle(art.c2, 0.9).fillRect(dx, py + ph * 0.5 + k * 2.4, 2, len);
      g.fillCircle(dx + 1, py + ph * 0.5 + k * 2.4 + len, 2);
    }
  }
  // The building site: gravel ground, a construction fence with posts and warning stripes, a "COMING SOON" board.
  function site(g, R) {
    if (window.LQArtV67?.paintPlaza) { window.LQArtV67.paintPlaza(g, SITE); return; }
    const x0 = SITE.x0 * T;
    const y0 = SITE.y0 * T;
    const w = (SITE.x1 - SITE.x0 + 1) * T;
    const h = (SITE.y1 - SITE.y0 + 1) * T;
    g.fillStyle(0x6b6258, 1).fillRect(x0, y0, w, h);
    for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) g.fillStyle([0x7d746a, 0x5a524a, 0x8a8178][i % 3], 0.8).fillRect(x0 + R() * w, y0 + R() * h, 2 + R() * 2, 2);
    // survey pegs and chalk lines for the future landmark
    g.lineStyle(2, 0xf4ead2, 0.5).strokeRect(x0 + 3 * T, y0 + 3 * T, w - 6 * T, h - 6 * T);
    g.lineStyle(2, 0xf4ead2, 0.35).strokeCircle(x0 + w / 2, y0 + h / 2, 4 * T);
    for (const [px, py] of [[3, 3], [w / T - 3, 3], [3, h / T - 3], [w / T - 3, h / T - 3]]) g.fillStyle(0xff893d, 1).fillRect(x0 + px * T - 2, y0 + py * T - 6, 4, 10);
    // the fence: one tile thick, posts every tile, two rails and yellow-black warning stripes
    const rail = (ax, ay, bx, by) => {
      g.fillStyle(0x3b3f46, 1).fillRect(Math.min(ax, bx), Math.min(ay, by), Math.abs(bx - ax) || 4, Math.abs(by - ay) || 4);
    };
    for (const [ax, ay, bx, by] of [[x0, y0 + 16, x0 + w, y0 + 16], [x0, y0 + h - 16, x0 + w, y0 + h - 16]]) {
      g.fillStyle(0x1a1a20, 0.25).fillRect(ax, ay + 10, bx - ax, 6);
      rail(ax, ay - 8, bx, ay - 8);
      rail(ax, ay + 2, bx, ay + 2);
      for (let x = ax; x < bx; x += 16) g.fillStyle((x / 16) % 2 ? 0x15151a : 0xffd447, 1).fillRect(x, ay - 3, 16, 4);
    }
    for (const [ax, ay, bx, by] of [[x0 + 16, y0 + 16, x0 + 16, y0 + h - 16], [x0 + w - 16, y0 + 16, x0 + w - 16, y0 + h - 16]]) {
      rail(ax - 8, ay, ax - 8, by);
      rail(ax + 2, ay, ax + 2, by);
      for (let y = ay; y < by; y += 16) g.fillStyle((y / 16) % 2 ? 0x15151a : 0xffd447, 1).fillRect(ax - 3, y, 4, 16);
    }
    for (let x = x0 + 16; x <= x0 + w - 16; x += T) for (const y of [y0 + 16, y0 + h - 16]) g.fillStyle(0x8a9097, 1).fillRect(x - 2, y - 14, 4, 20);
    for (let y = y0 + 16; y <= y0 + h - 16; y += T) for (const x of [x0 + 16, x0 + w - 16]) g.fillStyle(0x8a9097, 1).fillRect(x - 2, y - 14, 4, 20);
    // the board on the south fence, facing the street: COMING SOON
    const bw = 300;
    const bx = x0 + w / 2 - bw / 2;
    const by = y0 + h - 16 - 64;
    g.fillStyle(0x0d0b14, 1).fillRect(bx - 4, by - 4, bw + 8, 58);
    g.fillStyle(0x23202e, 1).fillRect(bx, by, bw, 50);
    g.fillStyle(0x8a9097, 1).fillRect(bx + 20, by + 50, 5, 14).fillRect(bx + bw - 25, by + 50, 5, 14);
    word(g, 'COMING SOON', bx + 18, by + 13, 4.4, 0xfff04a, 0xf5b21b);
  }
  function paintFloor(sc, a) {
    const key = 'lq_art_floor67';
    if (sc.textures.exists(key)) return key;
    const R = rnd(4242);
    const g = sc.make.graphics({ x: 0, y: 0, add: false });
    const pick = () => PAL[Math.floor(R() * PAL.length)];
    // 1. paint splatters on streets and squares (not on the buildings)
    for (let i = 0; i < 320; i++) {
      const x = R() * a.w;
      const y = R() * a.h;
      if (onBuilding(a, x, y, 0.4)) continue;
      const c = pick();
      const r = 3 + R() * 9;
      g.fillStyle(c, 0.18 + R() * 0.22).fillCircle(x * T, y * T, r);
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) g.fillCircle(x * T + (R() - 0.5) * r * 4, y * T + (R() - 0.5) * r * 4, 1 + R() * 2.5);
    }
    // 2. paint dripping down from the bottom of every facade
    for (const b of a.buildings) {
      const by = (b.y + b.h) * T;
      for (let x = b.x * T + 6; x < (b.x + b.w) * T - 6; x += 7 + R() * 16) {
        const c = pick();
        const len = 6 + R() * 26;
        g.fillStyle(c, 0.75).fillRect(x, by - 2, 3, len);
        g.fillCircle(x + 1.5, by - 2 + len, 2.6);
      }
    }
    // 3. rainbow crosswalks where the streets cross
    for (const v of a.roadsV)
      for (const h of a.roadsH) {
        if (h.y < (v.y0 ?? 0) || h.y > (v.y1 ?? a.h)) continue;
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          g.fillStyle(PAL[i], 0.55).fillRect(v.x * T + 4, (h.y - 1) * T + 4 + i * 5, v.w * T - 8, 3);
          g.fillRect((v.x - 1) * T + 4 + i * 5, h.y * T + 4, 3, h.h * T - 8);
        }
      }
    // 4. little cyan stars leading from the tunnel up to the plaza
    for (let y = 47; y > 44; y -= 2) sparkle(g, 35.5 * T + (y % 4 ? 10 : -10), y * T, 6, 0x35c8d0, 0.85);
    // 5. the big floor mural of the three marks (scaled up around its centre)
    g.save();
    g.translateCanvas(MURAL.x, MURAL.y);
    g.scaleCanvas(MURAL.s, MURAL.s);
    mural(g, 0, 0);
    g.restore();
    // 6. V67 art sidewalks and planters; don't overpaint dedicated new facades.
    if (window.LQArtV67?.paintStreetDetails) window.LQArtV67.paintStreetDetails(g, a);
    else for (const b of a.buildings) graffiti(g, b, R);
    window.LQArtV69?.paintStreets?.(g,a);
    // 7. Fully accessible Living Canvas and the new walk-through Dream Gate.
    site(g, R);
    g.generateTexture(key, a.w * T, a.h * T);
    g.destroy();
    return key;
  }

  // ---- lights -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // String lights hang over the streets, from post to post (every 6 tiles), with a little sag.
  function strings(a) {
    const out = [];
    const span = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => out.push([x1 * T, y1 * T, x2 * T, y2 * T]);
    for (const h of a.roadsH) for (let x = (h.x0 ?? 0) + 1; x <= (h.x1 ?? a.w) - 7; x += 6) span(x, h.y + 0.2, x + 6, h.y + 0.2);
    for (const v of a.roadsV) for (let y = (v.y0 ?? 0) + 3; y < (v.y1 ?? a.h) - 6; y += 6) span(v.x - 0.2, y, v.x - 0.2, y + 6);
    return out;
  }
  function makeLights(sc, a) {
    const st = {
      floor: sc.add.image(0, 0, paintFloor(sc, a)).setOrigin(0).setDepth(0.5),
      wires: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(12),
      bulbs: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(12.1).setBlendMode(ADD),
      glow: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(0.6).setBlendMode(ADD),
      motes: [],
      spans: strings(a),
      area: a,
    };
    const R = rnd(9);
    // the wires never change: draw them once
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of st.spans) {
      st.wires.lineStyle(1, 0x101018, 0.9);
      st.wires.beginPath();
      for (let k = 0; k <= 12; k++) {
        const t = k / 12;
        const sag = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 10;
        const x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t + (x1 === x2 ? sag : 0);
        const y = y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + (y1 === y2 ? sag : 0);
        if (k) st.wires.lineTo(x, y);
        else st.wires.moveTo(x, y);
      }
      st.wires.strokePath();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 126; i++) st.motes.push({ x: R() * a.w * T, y: R() * a.h * T, v: 10 + R() * 22, c: MOTE_PAL[i % MOTE_PAL.length], p: R() * 6, r: 1.6 + R() * 1.9 });
    return st;
  }
  function drawLights(st, time, dt, cam) {
    const b = st.bulbs;
    b.clear();
    const view = cam.worldView;
    st.spans.forEach(([x1, y1, x2, y2], si) => {
      if (Math.max(x1, x2) < view.x - 40 || Math.min(x1, x2) > view.right + 40 || Math.max(y1, y2) < view.y - 40 || Math.min(y1, y2) > view.bottom + 40) return;
      for (let k = 1; k < 8; k++) {
        const t = k / 8;
        const sag = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 10;
        const x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t + (x1 === x2 ? sag : 0);
        const y = y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + (y1 === y2 ? sag : 0) + 3;
        const c = PAL[(si + k) % PAL.length];
        const tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(time * 0.004 + si * 1.7 + k * 0.9);
        b.fillStyle(c, 0.12 * tw).fillCircle(x, y, 11);
        b.fillStyle(c, 0.5 + 0.5 * tw).fillCircle(x, y, 2.6);
      }
    });
    // specks of light drifting up, then starting again at the bottom
    for (const m of st.motes) {
      m.y -= m.v * dt;
      m.p += dt;
      if (m.y < 0) m.y = st.area.h * T;
      const x = m.x + Math.sin(m.p * 0.8) * 10;
      if (x < view.x || x > view.right || m.y < view.y || m.y > view.bottom) continue;
      const tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(m.p * 2.3);
      b.fillStyle(m.c, 0.14 * tw).fillCircle(x, m.y, 4 + m.r * 3);
      b.fillStyle(m.c, 0.45 + 0.5 * tw).fillCircle(x, m.y, m.r);
    }
    // the mural breathes softly
    const gl = st.glow;
    gl.clear();
    const p = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.0022);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) gl.fillStyle(i % 2 ? 0x35c8d0 : 0xffd447, 0.035 + p * 0.03).fillCircle(MURAL.x, MURAL.y, 205 - i * 34);
  }

  // ---- per-frame hook ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function update(sc, time, delta) {
    let st = sc.__lqArtGlow;
    const here = !!(sc.area && sc.area.id === ID) && !sc.switching;
    if (st && (!here || st.area !== sc.area)) {
      ['floor', 'wires', 'bulbs', 'glow'].forEach((k) => st[k].destroy());
      sc.__lqArtGlow = st = null;
    }
    if (!here || !sc.cameras || !sc.cameras.main) return;
    if (!st) st = sc.__lqArtGlow = makeLights(sc, sc.area);
    const show = !sc.inside;
    ['floor', 'wires', 'bulbs', 'glow'].forEach((k) => st[k].setVisible(show));
    if (show) drawLights(st, time, Math.min(0.05, (delta || 16) / 1000), sc.cameras.main);
  }
  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.events || sc.__lqArtGlowHook) return;
    sc.__lqArtGlowHook = true;
    sc.events.on('update', (time, delta) => {
      try {
        update(sc, time, delta);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('LQArtGlow', e);
      }
    });
  }, 400);
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * "Infinity" aura: a hazy blue mist with soft wisps rising and dissolving behind the player (no hard outline), shown
 * while the player's look has aura === 'infinity' (Gojo). It hooks into the scene's update loop once per scene.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);

  function draw(sc, time) {
    const st = sc.__lqAura;
    if (!st) return;
    const g = st.g;
    g.clear();
    const look = sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg && sc.store.game.rpg.look;
    const p = sc.player;
    if (!look || look.aura !== 'infinity' || !p || !p.visible) return;
    const s = p.scaleX || 1;
    // Slow hover: nudge the sprite's origin up and down (applyRankLook resets it, which we detect below).
    if (st.lastOrigin === undefined || Math.abs(p.originY - st.lastOrigin) > 1e-6) st.baseOrigin = p.originY;
    const bob = Math.sin(time * 0.0016) * 1.5;
    st.lastOrigin = st.baseOrigin + bob / (p.height || 50);
    p.setOrigin(0.5, st.lastOrigin);
    const cx = p.x;
    const cy = p.y - 17 * s;
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.0025);
    // Hazy mist with no visible edge: many very faint ellipses stacked from the body outwards, so the alpha
    // builds up towards the centre and fades smoothly to nothing at the rim.
    const layers = 18;
    const breathe = 0.85 + 0.15 * pulse;
    for (let i = 0; i < layers; i++) {
      const k = i / (layers - 1);
      const r = (7 + k * 25) * s * (1 + pulse * 0.04);
      g.fillStyle(0x8fd8ff, 0.011 * breathe);
      g.fillEllipse(cx, cy, r * 1.5, r * 2.3);
    }
    // Soft wisps that rise slowly from the feet, swell, and dissolve.
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const life = (time * 0.00022 + i / 9) % 1;
      const fade = Math.sin(life * Math.PI);
      const x = cx + Math.sin(i * 7.3 + time * 0.0007) * (9 + life * 5) * s;
      const y = cy + 22 * s - life * 46 * s;
      const r = (2 + life * 4) * s;
      g.fillStyle(0xe4f6ff, 0.05 * fade);
      g.fillCircle(x, y, r * 1.8);
      g.fillStyle(0xe4f6ff, 0.07 * fade);
      g.fillCircle(x, y, r);
      g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.08 * fade);
      g.fillCircle(x, y, r * 0.45);
    }
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqAura) return;
    sc.__lqAura = { g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(9.5) };
    sc.events.on('update', (time) => draw(sc, time));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqAura = null;
    });
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqAura) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('aura attach failed', e);
      }
    }
  }, 1000);
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Divine Dog (Megumi's shadow beast). Tap Ctrl once (no need to hold it) to summon a black dog out of the player's
 * shadow; the player rides it with eyes shut, relaxed. Tap Ctrl again to send it back. Only looks that carry
 * `shadow: true` (the Megumi preset) can do this.
 *
 * The dog is drawn every frame with Phaser graphics, in two layers: `back` under the rider and `front` over the rider
 * (the head and front legs when the dog faces the camera). The rider is the normal player sprite, swapped for a
 * "riding" texture (closed eyes, no ground shadow, see the `riding` flag in 10-core-characters-and-scene.js) and
 * lifted a few pixels so it sits on the dog's back.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);

  const BLACK = 0x0a0a12,
    FAR = 0x06060b,
    DARK = 0x15152a,
    RIM = 0x3a3a68,
    OUT = 0x2e2c58,
    EYE = 0xe6e8ff,
    GLOW = 0x6a4aa8,
    FURH = 0x2c2c3a, // head and mane fur: a touch lighter than the body so the shaggy tufts read
    STREAK = 0x70708a,
    YEL = 0xe8cc22,
    RED = 0xc02830,
    FANG = 0xeeeae0,
    NOSE = 0x4a2a20;
  const LIFT = 9; // how many art pixels the rider is raised (front/back views)
  const LIFT_SIDE = 7.5; // same for the smaller side-view dog
  const state = { riding: false };

  // Draws the dog. o = { x, y (ground), s (scale), dir, flip, moving, time, part: 'back' | 'front', alpha }.
  // Local units are art pixels: x grows towards the dog's nose (mirrored when flipped), y is up from the ground (< 0).
  function drawDog(g, o) {
    const s = o.s,
      sx = o.flip ? -1 : 1,
      back = o.part === 'back',
      // The side views are drawn 18% smaller than the front/back ones so the dog is not bigger than its rider.
      k = o.dir === 'up' || o.dir === 'down' ? 1 : 0.82;
    const R = (x, y, w, h, c, a = 1) => {
      g.fillStyle(c, a * o.alpha);
      g.fillRect(o.x + (sx > 0 ? x : -(x + w)) * s * k, o.y + y * s * k, w * s * k, h * s * k);
    };
    const E = (x, y, w, h, c, a = 1) => {
      g.fillStyle(c, a * o.alpha);
      g.fillEllipse(o.x + sx * x * s * k, o.y + y * s * k, w * s * k, h * s * k);
    };
    const T = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, c) => {
      g.fillStyle(c, o.alpha);
      g.fillTriangle(o.x + sx * x1 * s * k, o.y + y1 * s * k, o.x + sx * x2 * s * k, o.y + y2 * s * k, o.x + sx * x3 * s * k, o.y + y3 * s * k);
    };
    // Pixel-art rounded block (corners cut by one pixel), used for the stocky front/back body.
    const B = (x, y, w, h, c) => {
      R(x + 1, y, w - 2, h, c);
      R(x, y + 1, w, h - 2, c);
    };
    const ph = o.moving ? o.time * 0.014 : 0;
    const wag = Math.sin(o.time * 0.006) * 1.5;
    const dir = o.dir;
    const swing = (p0, amp) => (o.moving ? Math.sin(ph + p0) * amp : 0);
    const lift = (p0, amp) => (o.moving ? Math.max(0, Math.cos(ph + p0)) * amp : 0);
    if (dir === 'down') {
      if (back) {
        // Wide body that sticks out on both sides of the rider, with a pale violet outline so it reads against the
        // dark uniform.
        B(-12.5, -19, 25, 11, OUT);
        B(-11.5, -18, 23, 9, BLACK);
        R(-10, -10, 20, 1, DARK, 0.9);
        R(-9, -18, 18, 1, RIM, 0.8);
      } else {
        // Front legs step alternately, then chest, a low head with big ears, snout and pale eyes.
        const l = lift(0, 2),
          r = lift(Math.PI, 2);
        R(-10, -10, 6, 10 - l, OUT);
        R(4, -10, 6, 10 - r, OUT);
        R(-9, -10, 4, 10 - l, BLACK);
        R(5, -10, 4, 10 - r, BLACK);
        R(-9, -1 - l, 5, 1, DARK);
        R(4, -1 - r, 5, 1, DARK);
        B(-11, -15, 22, 12, OUT);
        B(-10, -14, 20, 10, BLACK);
        R(-8, -15, 16, 12, OUT);
        T(-7, -12, -12.5, -9, -7, -4, FURH);
        T(7, -12, 12.5, -9, 7, -4, FURH);
        T(-7, -9, -11, -3, -5, -6, FURH);
        T(7, -9, 11, -3, 5, -6, FURH);
        R(-7, -14, 14, 10, FURH);
        T(-8, -14, -10, -26, -1.5, -14, OUT);
        T(8, -14, 10, -26, 1.5, -14, OUT);
        T(-7, -14, -8.8, -24, -2.5, -14, FURH);
        T(7, -14, 8.8, -24, 2.5, -14, FURH);
        T(-4, -14, -2, -18, 0, -14, FURH);
        T(0, -14, 2, -18, 4, -14, FURH);
        T(-5.5, -15, -7, -21, -3.5, -15, DARK);
        T(5.5, -15, 7, -21, 3.5, -15, DARK);
        R(-3, -8, 6, 4, BLACK);
        R(-1.5, -8, 3, 2, DARK);
        R(-5, -11, 2, 1, YEL);
        R(3, -11, 2, 1, YEL);
        R(-6, -12, 4, 1, BLACK);
        R(2, -12, 4, 1, BLACK);
        R(-0.5, -14, 1, 1, RED);
        R(-1, -13, 1, 1, RED);
        R(-4, -9, 8, 1, STREAK, 0.5);
        T(-1.5, -5, -0.5, -3, 0.5, -5, FANG);
        T(-5, -5, -2.5, -1, 0, -5, BLACK);
        T(0, -5, 2.5, -1, 5, -5, BLACK);
      }
    } else if (dir === 'up') {
      // Seen from behind, the dog's rump, hind legs and tail sit in front of the rider and hide his legs, as they
      // would for someone really sitting on its back (drawn in the back layer, his legs looked like the dog's).
      if (!back) {
        const l = lift(0, 2),
          r = lift(Math.PI, 2);
        R(-10, -11, 6, 11 - l, OUT);
        R(4, -11, 6, 11 - r, OUT);
        R(-9, -11, 4, 11 - l, BLACK);
        R(5, -11, 4, 11 - r, BLACK);
        R(-9, -1 - l, 5, 1, DARK);
        R(4, -1 - r, 5, 1, DARK);
        B(-12.5, -19, 25, 11, OUT);
        B(-11.5, -18, 23, 9, BLACK);
        R(-10, -10, 20, 1, DARK, 0.9);
        R(-9, -18, 18, 1, RIM, 0.8);
        // Bushy tail hanging down over the rump.
        T(-4, -15, 4, -15, wag * 0.6, -3, OUT);
        T(-3, -15, 3, -15, wag * 0.6, -4, BLACK);
        R(-1, -14, 1, 7, RIM, 0.5);
      }
    } else {
      // Side view (also used for the two diagonal views): a long, deep-chested wolf with a bushy tail.
      if (back) {
        // Legs: [x, phase, colour]. The far pair is darker and drawn first.
        const legs = [
          [-13, 0, FAR],
          [6, Math.PI * 1.5, FAR],
          [-8, Math.PI, BLACK],
          [10, Math.PI / 2, BLACK],
        ];
        for (const [lx, lp, col] of legs) {
          const sw = swing(lp, 2.5),
            up = lift(lp, 2);
          R(lx + sw, -11, 4, 11 - up, col);
          R(lx + sw, -1 - up, 5, 1, DARK);
        }
        T(-16, -19, -28, -13 + wag, -16, -11, BLACK);
        T(-16, -18, -24, -17 + wag * 0.5, -27, -13 + wag, BLACK);
        R(-11, -20, 20, 10, BLACK);
        E(-10, -14.5, 13, 13, BLACK);
        E(9, -14.5, 13, 14, BLACK);
        E(0, -10, 22, 5, DARK, 0.7);
        R(-10, -20, 19, 1, RIM, 0.85);
        T(8, -9, 10, -4, 12.5, -9, BLACK);
        T(12, -9, 14.5, -5, 16, -10, BLACK);
        // Neck and mane sit under the rider (back layer); only the head is drawn over him.
        T(9, -22, 1, -19, 9, -11, FURH);
        T(12, -24, 3, -26, 12, -16, FURH);
        R(9, -25, 9, 14, FURH);
        T(13, -28, 5, -32, 13, -23, FURH);
        T(12, -26, 4, -27, 12, -20, FURH);
        R(11, -22, 6, 1, STREAK, 0.6);
        R(10, -18, 5, 1, STREAK, 0.5);
      } else {
        // Shaggy wolf head: thick neck, a mane of jagged tufts (cheeks and neck, sweeping back and down), pointed
        // ears, narrow snout with a brown nose and one fang, a yellow eye with a dark pupil under an angry brow, and
        // red marks on the forehead.
        T(16, -19, 11, -13, 20, -18, FURH);
        T(20, -19, 17, -13, 24, -19, FURH);
        T(22, -19, 21, -15, 25, -20, FURH);
        R(14, -28, 10, 10, FURH);
        R(22, -26, 6, 5, FURH);
        R(27, -26, 2, 2, NOSE);
        R(22, -21, 5, 2, DARK);
        T(24, -21, 25.5, -17.5, 26.5, -21, FANG);
        T(15, -28, 16.5, -39, 21, -28, FURH);
        T(16.5, -29, 17.5, -36, 19.5, -29, BLACK);
        T(21, -28, 24, -37, 25, -28, FAR);
        T(16, -29, 18, -34, 20, -29, FURH);
        R(20, -28, 5, 1, BLACK);
        R(21, -27, 2, 2, YEL);
        R(22, -26.5, 1, 1.5, BLACK);
        R(17, -28, 1, 1, RED);
        R(19, -29, 1, 1, RED);
        R(19, -27, 1, 1, RED);
        R(15, -26, 5, 1, STREAK, 0.7);
        R(14, -29, 8, 1, RIM, 0.8);
      }
    }
  }

  function summonFx(g, o) {
    // Dark puddle spreading under the dog and a few violet specks rising from it while it appears or leaves.
    const k = o.e;
    if (k <= 0 || k >= 1) return;
    const s = o.s;
    g.fillStyle(0x05050a, 0.55 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI));
    g.fillEllipse(o.x, o.y + 1 * s, (14 + 30 * k) * s, (4 + 6 * k) * s);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const life = (k * 1.4 + i / 7) % 1;
      const x = o.x + Math.sin(i * 5.1 + o.time * 0.004) * 12 * s;
      const y = o.y - life * 22 * s;
      g.fillStyle(GLOW, 0.45 * Math.sin(life * Math.PI));
      g.fillRect(x, y, 2 * s, 2 * s);
    }
  }

  function release(sc, st) {
    st.active = false;
    st.lastOrigin = undefined;
    st.back.clear();
    st.front.clear();
    try {
      sc.applyRankLook();
    } catch (e) {
      /* the scene is being rebuilt */
    }
  }

  function frame(sc, time, delta) {
    const st = sc.__lqShadow;
    if (!st) return;
    st.back.clear();
    st.front.clear();
    const look = sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg && sc.store.game.rpg.look;
    const p = sc.player;
    const able = !!(look && look.shadow && p && p.visible);
    if (!able) {
      state.riding = false;
      st.t = 0;
      if (st.active) release(sc, st);
      return;
    }
    const target = state.riding ? 1 : 0;
    const step = Math.min(1, (delta || 16) / 450);
    st.t = target > st.t ? Math.min(target, st.t + step) : Math.max(target, st.t - step);
    if (st.t <= 0) {
      if (st.active) release(sc, st);
      return;
    }
    st.active = true;
    if (st.look !== look) {
      st.look = look;
      st.key = window.LQCharacter.ensure(sc, Object.assign({}, look, { riding: true }));
    }
    // The scene picks the sprite frame from playerKey each frame, so keep it on the riding set while the dog is out.
    sc.playerKey = st.key;
    const e = st.t * st.t * (3 - 2 * st.t);
    const s = p.scaleX || 1;
    // applyRankLook resets the origin; detect that and re-base (same trick as aura.js).
    if (st.lastOrigin === undefined || Math.abs(p.originY - st.lastOrigin) > 1e-6) st.baseOrigin = p.originY;
    const moving = !!sc.pMoving;
    const bob = moving ? Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 0.014)) * 0.9 : Math.sin(time * 0.002) * 0.5;
    // The side-view dog is smaller, so the rider sits lower on its back there.
    const dirNow = (sc.pFace && sc.pFace.dir) || 'down';
    const lift = dirNow === 'up' || dirNow === 'down' ? LIFT : LIFT_SIDE;
    st.lastOrigin = st.baseOrigin + (lift * e + bob) / (p.height || 50);
    p.setOrigin(0.5, st.lastOrigin);
    const face = sc.pFace || {};
    const o = {
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y + 9 * s + (1 - e) * 12 * s,
      s,
      dir: face.dir || 'down',
      flip: !!face.flip,
      moving,
      time,
      alpha: e,
      e: st.t,
    };
    st.back.fillStyle(0x000000, 0.28 * e);
    st.back.fillEllipse(p.x, p.y + 10 * s, 38 * s, 7 * s);
    summonFx(st.back, o);
    drawDog(st.back, Object.assign({ part: 'back' }, o));
    drawDog(st.front, Object.assign({ part: 'front' }, o));
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqShadow) return;
    sc.__lqShadow = {
      back: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(9.9),
      front: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(10.1),
      t: 0,
      active: false,
    };
    sc.events.on('update', (time, delta) => frame(sc, time, delta));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqShadow = null;
    });
  }

  function toggle() {
    const sc = getScene();
    const look = sc && sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg && sc.store.game.rpg.look;
    if (!look || !look.shadow) return;
    state.riding = !state.riding;
  }

  // A "tap" is Ctrl pressed and released with nothing else in between (so Ctrl+C, Ctrl+click etc. do not count).
  let ctrlAlone = false;
  const typing = () => {
    const a = document.activeElement;
    return !!a && (/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(a.tagName) || a.isContentEditable);
  };
  window.addEventListener(
    'keydown',
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Control') {
        if (!e.repeat) ctrlAlone = !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && !e.metaKey;
      } else ctrlAlone = false;
    },
    true,
  );
  window.addEventListener('mousedown', () => (ctrlAlone = false), true);
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => (ctrlAlone = false));
  window.addEventListener(
    'keyup',
    (e) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Control' || !ctrlAlone) return;
      ctrlAlone = false;
      if (!typing()) toggle();
    },
    true,
  );

  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqShadow) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('shadow attach failed', err);
      }
    }
  }, 1000);

  window.LQShadow = { toggle, isRiding: () => state.riding, drawDog };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Gojo Satoru: the unlock greeting and the Six Eyes.
 *
 * 1. Greeting (LQGojo.greet()): when the 'mineral-trip' achievement completes, the screen goes dark and one line is
 *    typed out in glowing blue: "Throughout heaven and earth, I alone am the honored one." Text only, no domain art.
 *    Preview: open index.html?honored=1, or run LQGojo.preview() in the Console.
 *
 * 2. Six Eyes (looks with `sixEyes: true`, the Gojo preset): tap Ctrl (or the 👁 button) to lift the blindfold. For
 *    DURATION ms the player sees through walls:
 *      👆 Sukuna's fingers that are still missing,
 *      🌑 Ten Shadows marks whose clue has been told,
 *      🗣 villagers to talk to for the current quests (Ten Shadows, the quest panel, the town quests),
 *      🏠 / 📍 buildings and spots the current quest asks for.
 *    Things inside buildings shine through the roof; things off screen get an arrow on the edge of the view.
 *    Then the eyes rest for COOLDOWN ms. Tap again to close them early.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);
  const lookOf = (sc) => sc && sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg && sc.store.game.rpg.look;
  // Older saves wore Gojo before the sixEyes flag existed: the Infinity aura plus the blindfold is the same preset.
  const hasSixEyes = (look) => !!look && (!!look.sixEyes || (look.aura === 'infinity' && !!look.blindfold));

  // ---- 1. greeting ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const GREET_LINES = ['Throughout heaven and earth,', 'I alone am the honored one.'];
  const GREET_FONT = 'Cinzel, "Trajan Pro", "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif';
  const G_FADE_IN = 450;
  const G_CHAR = 48; // ms per letter
  const G_GAP = 350; // pause between the two lines
  const G_HOLD = 1500; // the finished line stays up
  const G_FADE_OUT = 800;

  function chime() {
    try {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      const ac = new AC();
      const t = ac.currentTime;
      [659, 988, 1319].forEach((hz, i) => {
        const o = ac.createOscillator();
        const g = ac.createGain();
        o.type = 'sine';
        o.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz, t + i * 0.09);
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t + i * 0.09);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.12, t + i * 0.09 + 0.04);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + i * 0.09 + 1.6);
        o.connect(g).connect(ac.destination);
        o.start(t + i * 0.09);
        o.stop(t + i * 0.09 + 1.7);
      });
      setTimeout(() => ac.close().catch(() => {}), 2400);
    } catch (e) {
      /* sound is optional */
    }
  }

  try {
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.load) document.fonts.load('700 40px Cinzel').catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    /* the serif fallback is used instead */
  }

  let greeting = null;
  function greet() {
    if (greeting) return greeting;
    greeting = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      cv.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:9800;pointer-events:none;opacity:0';
      document.body.appendChild(cv);
      const W = (cv.width = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth));
      const H = (cv.height = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight));
      const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
      const reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      const typeEnd = G_FADE_IN + GREET_LINES[0].length * G_CHAR + G_GAP + GREET_LINES[1].length * G_CHAR;
      const total = typeEnd + G_HOLD + G_FADE_OUT;
      const start = performance.now();
      let sounded = false;
      const frame = (now) => {
        const el = now - start;
        if (el >= total) {
          cv.remove();
          greeting = null;
          resolve();
          return;
        }
        const fadeOut = el > typeEnd + G_HOLD ? 1 - (el - typeEnd - G_HOLD) / G_FADE_OUT : 1;
        cv.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, el / G_FADE_IN, fadeOut)));
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#03060d';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.08, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
        vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(70,170,255,0.20)');
        vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = vg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        // How many letters of each line are typed so far.
        const t0 = el - G_FADE_IN;
        const n1 = reduce ? GREET_LINES[0].length : Math.max(0, Math.min(GREET_LINES[0].length, Math.floor(t0 / G_CHAR)));
        const t1 = t0 - GREET_LINES[0].length * G_CHAR - G_GAP;
        const n2 = reduce ? GREET_LINES[1].length : Math.max(0, Math.min(GREET_LINES[1].length, Math.floor(t1 / G_CHAR)));
        if (!sounded && n2 > 0) {
          sounded = true;
          chime();
        }
        const size = Math.max(17, Math.min(W * 0.036, 46));
        ctx.font = `700 ${size}px ${GREET_FONT}`;
        if ('letterSpacing' in ctx) ctx.letterSpacing = `${(size * 0.08).toFixed(1)}px`;
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        const lh = size * 1.6;
        const shown = [n1, n2];
        GREET_LINES.forEach((ln, i) => {
          const part = ln.slice(0, shown[i]);
          const w = ctx.measureText(ln).width;
          const x = (W - Math.min(w, W * 0.94)) / 2;
          const y = H / 2 + (i - 0.5) * lh;
          // The second line is the boast: a stronger glow.
          ctx.shadowColor = '#4fc3ff';
          ctx.shadowBlur = size * (i ? 0.75 : 0.45);
          ctx.fillStyle = i ? '#ffffff' : '#dcefff';
          ctx.fillText(part, x, y, W * 0.94);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          const typing = shown[i] > 0 && shown[i] < ln.length;
          const lastIdle = i === 1 && shown[1] === ln.length && Math.floor(el / 380) % 2 === 0;
          if (typing || lastIdle) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd8ff';
            ctx.fillRect(x + Math.min(ctx.measureText(part).width, W * 0.94) + 3, y - size * 0.55, Math.max(2, size * 0.06), size * 1.1);
          }
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
    return greeting;
  }

  if (/[?&]honored=1\b/.test(location.search)) window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(() => greet(), 800));

  // ---- 2. Six Eyes ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const DURATION = 12000;
  const COOLDOWN = 8000;
  const EYE_BLUE = 0x8fe8ff;
  const COLORS = { finger: 0xc77dff, shadow: 0x8f9bff, npc: 0x7fe9ff, place: 0xffd36b };
  const MAX_ARROWS = 5;
  const st = { active: false, until: 0, readyAt: 0, e: 0, msg: '', msgUntil: 0 };

  const CSS = `
#lq-sixeyes-veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(0,0,0,0) 52%,rgba(70,175,255,.16) 80%,rgba(160,225,255,.30) 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 80px rgba(120,210,255,.35)}
#lq-sixeyes-hud{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:64px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:42;pointer-events:none;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);box-sizing:border-box;background:#06142ae0;border:1px solid #7fd8ff;border-radius:12px;padding:7px 12px;color:#eaf8ff;font:600 12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 0 18px #4fc3ff55;display:none}
#lq-sixeyes-hud b{color:#8fe8ff}
#lq-sixeyes-hud small{display:block;color:#b9d9f2;font-weight:500}
#lq-skill{position:fixed;right:13px;top:calc(50% + 34px);z-index:41;display:none;background:#0c1a33f2;color:#dff4ff;border:1px solid #4fa8e0;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0006}
#lq-skill:hover{border-color:#8fe8ff}
#lq-skill.on{background:#174a7a;border-color:#bff0ff;box-shadow:0 0 16px #4fc3ff88}
#lq-skill.rest{opacity:.65}
@media(max-width:700px){#lq-skill{top:auto;bottom:176px}#lq-sixeyes-hud{top:228px;bottom:auto;font-size:11px}}
`;
  let veil = null,
    hud = null,
    btn = null;
  function mountUi() {
    if (veil) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
    veil = document.createElement('div');
    veil.id = 'lq-sixeyes-veil';
    hud = document.createElement('div');
    hud.id = 'lq-sixeyes-hud';
    hud.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.id = 'lq-skill';
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.title = 'Six Eyes: see through walls (Ctrl)';
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.blur(); // keep Space/Enter for the game
      toggle();
    });
    document.body.append(veil, hud, btn);
  }

  function say(text, ms = 1800) {
    st.msg = text;
    st.msgUntil = performance.now() + ms;
  }

  function toggle() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!hasSixEyes(lookOf(sc))) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (st.active) {
      st.active = false;
      st.readyAt = now + COOLDOWN;
      return;
    }
    if (now < st.readyAt) {
      say(`👁 The Six Eyes are resting… ${Math.ceil((st.readyAt - now) / 1000)}s`);
      return;
    }
    st.active = true;
    st.until = now + DURATION;
    chime();
  }

  // ---- what the Six Eyes can see ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Returns { here: [{kind, icon, label, x, y, k, wall}], away: {finger, shadow, npc: [names], otherTown} }.
  function sense(sc) {
    const here = [];
    const away = { finger: 0, shadow: 0, npc: [], otherTown: 0 };
    const area = sc.area.id;
    const ins = sc.inside;
    const A = window.LQAchievements;
    const building = (name) => sc.area.buildings.find((b) => b.name === name);
    // Seen from outdoors, things inside a building glow over the middle of its roof.
    const roof = (name, dx) => {
      const b = building(name);
      return b ? { x: (b.x + b.w / 2) * 32 + dx, y: (b.y + b.h / 2) * 32, k: 1 } : null;
    };
    const collectibles = (kind, icon, list, isLive, spot, dx) => {
      for (const it of list) {
        if (!isLive(it)) continue;
        if (it.area !== area) {
          away[kind]++;
          continue;
        }
        let p = null;
        if (ins) p = spot(it.id); // indoors: only what lies in this room
        else p = it.in ? roof(it.in, dx) : { x: it.x * 32 + 16, y: it.y * 32 + 16, k: 1 };
        if (!p) {
          away[kind]++;
          continue;
        }
        here.push({ kind, icon, label: !ins && it.in ? it.in : '', x: p.x, y: p.y, k: p.k || 1, wall: !ins && !!it.in });
      }
    };
    const F = window.LQFingers;
    if (F && A && !A.isUnlocked('sukuna-fingers'))
      collectibles('finger', '👆', F.list, (f) => !F.isFound(f.id), (id) => F.spot(id), -12);
    const TS = window.LQTenShadows;
    if (TS && TS.isStarted())
      collectibles('shadow', '🌑', TS.list, (s) => TS.isTold(s.id) && !TS.isFound(s.id), (id) => TS.spot(id), 12);

    // Villagers to talk to, with the reason (first reason wins).
    const people = new Map();
    const want = (id, why) => id && !people.has(id) && people.set(id, why);
    if (TS && A && !A.isUnlocked('ten-shadows')) {
      if (!TS.isStarted()) want('librarian', 'Ten Shadows');
      else
        for (const s of TS.list)
          if (!TS.isTold(s.id) && !TS.isFound(s.id) && !(s.needs && TS.count() < s.needs)) want(s.npc, 'shadow clue');
    }
    let placeGoal = null;
    try {
      const step = window.LQV8 && window.LQV8.currentStep ? window.LQV8.currentStep() : null;
      if (step && step.kind === 'npc') want(step.npc, 'quest');
      if (step && /^(enter|floor|inspect)$/.test(step.kind) && step.building) placeGoal = { building: step.building };
    } catch (e) {
      /* quest panel not ready */
    }
    try {
      const q = sc.quests && sc.quests.active && sc.quests.active();
      if (q) {
        const s = q.steps[sc.quests.progress(q)];
        if (s && s.kind === 'talk') want(s.npc, 'town quest');
        if (s && s.kind === 'visit' && sc.area.places[s.place]) {
          const p = sc.area.places[s.place];
          if (!ins) here.push({ kind: 'place', icon: '📍', label: 'Quest spot', x: p.x * 32 + 16, y: p.y * 32 + 16, k: 1, wall: false });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      /* town quests not ready */
    }
    if (placeGoal && !ins) {
      const b = building(placeGoal.building);
      if (b) here.push({ kind: 'place', icon: '🏠', label: b.name, x: b.door * 32 + 16, y: (b.y + b.h) * 32 + 4, k: 1, wall: false, b });
    }
    for (const [id, why] of people) {
      const n = sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((x) => x.def.id === id);
      if (!n) {
        away.otherTown++; // villagers of the other town are not in this scene
        continue;
      }
      const name = (n.def.name || id).split(' (')[0];
      if (!n.sprite.visible) {
        away.npc.push(name + ' (resting)');
        continue;
      }
      if (!!n.inside !== !!ins) {
        away.npc.push(name);
        continue;
      }
      const k = n.sprite.scaleX || 1;
      here.push({ kind: 'npc', icon: '🗣', label: `${name} · ${why}`, x: n.sprite.x, y: n.sprite.y - 6 * k, k, wall: false, npc: n });
    }
    return { here, away };
  }

  // ---- drawing ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // While the eyes are open the world sinks under a dark layer (depth DIM). Only the player and what the Six Eyes
  // see are lifted above it, each with a glowing outline that follows its shape; nothing is labelled.
  const DIM = 59;
  const DIM_ALPHA = 0.85; // how dark the world gets
  const D = { glow: 59.2, aura: 59.4, player: 59.5, npc: 59.6, npcLabel: 59.65, marks: 59.7, markText: 59.75, top: 59.8 };
  const BASE = { aura: 9.5, player: 10, npc: 9, npcLabel: 11, marks: 8.8, markText: 8.9 };

  // Lift (or put back) the game objects that should shine through the dark layer.
  function lift(sc, s, on, npcs) {
    const set = (o, d) => o && o.depth !== d && o.setDepth(d);
    set(sc.player, on ? D.player : BASE.player);
    set(sc.__lqAura && sc.__lqAura.g, on ? D.aura : BASE.aura);
    set(sc.__lqFingers && sc.__lqFingers.g, on ? D.marks : BASE.marks);
    const ts = sc.__lqTenShadows;
    if (ts) {
      set(ts.g, on ? D.marks : BASE.marks);
      ts.texts.forEach((t) => set(t, on ? D.markText : BASE.markText));
    }
    const want = new Set(on ? npcs : []);
    for (const n of s.lifted) if (!want.has(n)) set(n.sprite, BASE.npc), set(n.label, BASE.npcLabel);
    for (const n of want) set(n.sprite, D.npc), set(n.label, D.npcLabel);
    s.lifted = want;
  }

  // A pixel-crisp outline: four copies of the sprite, filled with one colour, nudged one pixel each way.
  function outline(sc, s, spr, color, alpha) {
    const off = Math.max(1, spr.scaleX || 1);
    for (const [dx, dy] of [[-off, 0], [off, 0], [0, -off], [0, off]]) {
      let img = s.glows[s.gi++];
      if (!img) s.glows.push((img = sc.add.image(0, 0, spr.texture.key).setDepth(D.glow)));
      img
        .setTexture(spr.texture.key, spr.frame.name)
        .setOrigin(spr.originX, spr.originY)
        .setScale(spr.scaleX, spr.scaleY)
        .setFlipX(spr.flipX)
        .setPosition(spr.x + dx, spr.y + dy)
        .setAlpha(alpha)
        .setVisible(true);
      fillTint(img, color);
    }
  }

  // Solid-colour tint: Phaser 4 uses setTint + FILL mode (setTintFill was removed); Phaser 3 has setTintFill.
  function fillTint(img, color) {
    const P = window.Phaser;
    if (img.setTintMode && P && P.TintModes) img.setTint(color).setTintMode(P.TintModes.FILL);
    else img.setTintFill(color);
  }

  // Soft glow with no hard edge: stacked faint discs.
  function halo(g, x, y, r, color, a) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.fillStyle(color, a);
      g.fillCircle(x, y, r * (1 - i * 0.14));
    }
  }

  function drawWorld(sc, s, seen, time, e) {
    const cam = sc.cameras.main;
    const v = cam.worldView;
    const z = cam.zoom || 1;
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.005);
    s.dim.fillStyle(0x030812, DIM_ALPHA * e);
    s.dim.fillRect(v.x - 4, v.y - 4, v.width + 8, v.height + 8);
    const g = s.g;
    const top = s.top.setAlpha(e);
    s.gi = 0;
    const px = sc.player.x,
      py = sc.player.y;
    const onScreen = (t) => t.x > v.x && t.x < v.right && t.y > v.y && t.y < v.bottom;
    const inView = [],
      outView = [];
    for (const t of seen.here) {
      t.d = Math.hypot(t.x - px, t.y - py);
      (onScreen(t) || (t.b && t.b.x * 32 < v.right && (t.b.x + t.b.w) * 32 > v.x && t.b.y * 32 < v.bottom && (t.b.y + t.b.h) * 32 > v.y) ? inView : outView).push(t);
    }
    // The player keeps a faint blue rim so Gojo still stands out.
    outline(sc, s, sc.player, 0x8fe8ff, 0.55 * e);
    lift(sc, s, true, inView.filter((t) => t.npc).map((t) => t.npc));
    inView.forEach((t, i) => {
      const c = COLORS[t.kind];
      const k = t.k;
      if (t.kind === 'npc') {
        halo(g, t.npc.sprite.x, t.npc.sprite.y - 14 * k, 26 * k, c, 0.035 * e);
        outline(sc, s, t.npc.sprite, c, (0.7 + 0.3 * pulse) * e);
      } else if (t.kind === 'place' && t.b) {
        // The whole building is traced in light.
        const x = t.b.x * 32,
          y = t.b.y * 32,
          w = t.b.w * 32,
          h = t.b.h * 32;
        [[7, 0.12], [4, 0.25], [1.5, 0.9]].forEach(([lw, a]) => {
          g.lineStyle(lw, c, a * (0.75 + 0.25 * pulse) * e);
          g.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
        });
      } else if (t.kind === 'place') {
        g.lineStyle(2, c, (0.6 + 0.4 * pulse) * e);
        g.strokeEllipse(t.x, t.y + 6, 34, 12);
        halo(g, t.x, t.y, 22, c, 0.04 * e);
      } else {
        halo(g, t.x, t.y, 30 * k, c, (0.05 + 0.03 * pulse) * e);
        if (t.wall) {
          // Seen through the roof: the object itself, drawn over the building.
          if (t.kind === 'finger' && window.LQFingers && window.LQFingers.draw) window.LQFingers.draw(top, t.x, t.y, 1, time, i);
          if (t.kind === 'shadow' && window.LQTenShadows && window.LQTenShadows.drawMark) window.LQTenShadows.drawMark(top, t.x, t.y, 1, time, i);
        }
      }
    });
    for (let i = s.gi; i < s.glows.length; i++) s.glows[i].setVisible(false);
    // Glowing chevrons on the edge of the view for what lies beyond it (nearest first, no text).
    const m = 22 / z;
    outView
      .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d)
      .slice(0, MAX_ARROWS)
      .forEach((t) => {
        const c = COLORS[t.kind];
        const cx = Math.min(v.right - m, Math.max(v.x + m, t.x));
        const cy = Math.min(v.bottom - m, Math.max(v.y + m, t.y));
        const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - cy, t.x - cx);
        const chevron = (size, a) => {
          const L = size / z,
            W2 = size * 0.7 / z;
          const tipX = cx + Math.cos(ang) * L,
            tipY = cy + Math.sin(ang) * L;
          const bx = cx - Math.cos(ang) * L * 0.5,
            by = cy - Math.sin(ang) * L * 0.5;
          top.fillStyle(c, a);
          top.fillTriangle(tipX, tipY, bx + Math.cos(ang + Math.PI / 2) * W2, by + Math.sin(ang + Math.PI / 2) * W2, bx + Math.cos(ang - Math.PI / 2) * W2, by + Math.sin(ang - Math.PI / 2) * W2);
        };
        chevron(17, 0.15);
        chevron(13, 0.3);
        chevron(9, 0.95);
      });
  }

  // One short line: time left, and what is hidden elsewhere (indoors, outdoors or in the other town).
  function hudText(seen, now) {
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((st.until - now) / 1000));
    const a = seen.away;
    const bits = [];
    if (a.finger) bits.push(`👆${a.finger}`);
    if (a.shadow) bits.push(`🌑${a.shadow}`);
    if (a.npc.length + a.otherTown) bits.push(`🗣${a.npc.length + a.otherTown}`);
    return `<b>👁 ${left}s</b>${bits.length ? ` · elsewhere ${bits.join(' ')}` : ''}`;
  }

  let lastHud = 0;
  function frame(sc, time, delta) {
    const s = sc.__lqSixEyes;
    if (!s) return;
    s.g.clear();
    s.dim.clear();
    s.top.clear();
    const now = performance.now();
    const look = lookOf(sc);
    const able = hasSixEyes(look) && sc.player && sc.player.visible && !sc.switching && sc.area;
    mountUi();
    btn.style.display = hasSixEyes(look) ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (st.active && (now >= st.until || !able)) {
      st.active = false;
      st.readyAt = now + COOLDOWN;
    }
    const target = st.active ? 1 : 0;
    const step = Math.min(1, (delta || 16) / 350);
    st.e = target > st.e ? Math.min(1, st.e + step) : Math.max(0, st.e - step);
    // Button label: ready / open / resting.
    const rest = now < st.readyAt ? Math.ceil((st.readyAt - now) / 1000) : 0;
    const label = st.active ? '👁 Six Eyes ✦' : rest ? `👁 ${rest}s` : '👁 Six Eyes';
    if (btn.textContent !== label) btn.textContent = label;
    btn.classList.toggle('on', st.active);
    btn.classList.toggle('rest', !st.active && !!rest);
    veil.style.opacity = String(st.e);
    // The eyes: blindfold off, glowing blue, while the Six Eyes are open.
    if (st.e > 0 && able) {
      if (s.look !== look) {
        s.look = look;
        s.key = window.LQCharacter.ensure(sc, Object.assign({}, look, { blindfold: false, eyeGlow: true, eye: EYE_BLUE }));
      }
      sc.playerKey = s.key;
      s.worn = true;
    } else if (s.worn) {
      s.worn = false;
      try {
        sc.applyRankLook();
      } catch (e) {
        /* the scene is being rebuilt */
      }
    }
    if (st.e <= 0 || !able) {
      if (s.on) {
        s.on = false;
        lift(sc, s, false, []);
        s.glows.forEach((img) => img.setVisible(false));
      }
      if (now < st.msgUntil) {
        hud.style.display = 'block';
        hud.innerHTML = st.msg;
      } else hud.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    const seen = sense(sc);
    s.on = true;
    drawWorld(sc, s, seen, time, st.e);
    if (now - lastHud > 200) {
      lastHud = now;
      hud.style.display = 'block';
      hud.innerHTML = hudText(seen, now);
    }
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqSixEyes) return;
    sc.__lqSixEyes = {
      dim: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(DIM),
      g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(D.glow),
      top: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(D.top),
      glows: [],
      gi: 0,
      lifted: new Set(),
      on: false,
      key: null,
      look: null,
      worn: false,
    };
    sc.events.on('update', (time, delta) => frame(sc, time, delta));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqSixEyes = null;
    });
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqSixEyes) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('six eyes attach failed', e);
      }
    }
  }, 1000);

  // Ctrl tap (pressed and released alone), the same key as Megumi's Divine Dog; each skill checks its own look.
  let ctrlAlone = false;
  const typing = () => {
    const a = document.activeElement;
    return !!a && (/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(a.tagName) || a.isContentEditable);
  };
  window.addEventListener(
    'keydown',
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Control') {
        if (!e.repeat) ctrlAlone = !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && !e.metaKey;
      } else ctrlAlone = false;
    },
    true,
  );
  window.addEventListener('mousedown', () => (ctrlAlone = false), true);
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => (ctrlAlone = false));
  window.addEventListener(
    'keyup',
    (e) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Control' || !ctrlAlone) return;
      ctrlAlone = false;
      if (!typing()) toggle();
    },
    true,
  );

  window.LQGojo = {
    greet,
    preview: () => greet(),
    toggleSixEyes: toggle,
    isSixEyesOpen: () => st.active,
    // What the Six Eyes would show right now (for testing in the Console).
    sense: () => {
      const sc = getScene();
      return sc && sc.area ? sense(sc) : null;
    },
  };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Device choice: right after Start on the title screen, the player must say how they play: 💻 Computer, 📱 Phone or
 * 📲 iPad / tablet. The likely answer is pre-selected (from the screen size and touch support), but nothing goes on
 * until the player confirms: there is no close button and Esc does nothing. The answer is remembered in localStorage
 * and only asked once; it can be changed later from the Menu (see LQDevice.change()).
 *
 * The choice is written to <html data-device="pc|phone|tablet"> so CSS and other scripts can adapt (touch controls
 * only appear on phone and tablet), and a 'lifequest:device' event is sent whenever it changes.
 *
 * window.LQDevice.ask() returns a promise that resolves once a device is chosen (at once if it was chosen before).
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const KEY = 'lifequest.device';
  const DEVICES = [
    { id: 'pc', icon: '💻', title: 'Computer', desc: 'Keyboard: WASD or arrow keys to move, E to talk.' },
    { id: 'phone', icon: '📱', title: 'Phone', desc: 'On-screen joystick and buttons, sized for small screens.' },
    { id: 'tablet', icon: '📲', title: 'iPad / tablet', desc: 'On-screen joystick and larger buttons.' },
  ];
  const valid = (id) => DEVICES.some((d) => d.id === id);

  function read() {
    try {
      const v = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      return valid(v) ? v : null;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Best guess, only used to pre-select an answer. The primary pointer decides (a touchscreen laptop still has a
  // mouse or trackpad as its main pointer); iPads that report themselves as a Mac are caught by 'MacIntel' + touch.
  function guess() {
    const mq = (q) => !!(window.matchMedia && matchMedia(q).matches);
    const ipadAsMac = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && (navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0) > 1;
    if (ipadAsMac) return 'tablet';
    if (!mq('(pointer: coarse)')) return 'pc';
    const short = Math.min(screen.width || innerWidth, screen.height || innerHeight);
    return short >= 600 ? 'tablet' : 'phone';
  }

  let current = read();
  function apply(id) {
    current = id;
    document.documentElement.dataset.device = id;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:device', { detail: { device: id } }));
  }
  if (current) apply(current);

  const CSS = `
#lq-device{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:260;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;box-sizing:border-box;background:#070a16f2;color:#eef2ff;font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;animation:lqdev-in .35s ease}
@keyframes lqdev-in{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
#lq-device .box{width:min(560px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#151d36,#0e1428);border:1px solid #3b4a7a;border-radius:18px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000c}
#lq-device h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:21px}
#lq-device p.sub{margin:0 0 16px;color:#aab6d6;font-size:14px}
#lq-device .opts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
#lq-device .opt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-align:center;padding:16px 10px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #34416b;background:#121a33;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
#lq-device .opt:hover{border-color:#6b82c9}
#lq-device .opt.on{border-color:#ffd36b;background:#1e2748}
#lq-device .opt .ic{font-size:34px;line-height:1}
#lq-device .opt>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
#lq-device .opt b{font-size:15px}
#lq-device .opt small{color:#9fadcf;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35}
#lq-device .opt .tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#1b2630;background:#ffd36b;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px;visibility:hidden}
#lq-device .opt.guess .tag{visibility:visible}
#lq-device .go{margin-top:16px;width:100%;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#ffd36b;color:#1b2630;font-family:inherit;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#lq-device .go:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
#lq-device .note{margin:10px 0 0;color:#7f8db3;font-size:12px;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:520px){#lq-device .opts{grid-template-columns:1fr}#lq-device .opt{flex-direction:row;text-align:left;padding:12px}#lq-device .opt>div{gap:2px;flex:1}#lq-device .opt .ic{font-size:28px}}
`;

  // Shows the chooser and resolves with the chosen id. There is no way to skip it.
  function open() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const st = document.createElement('style');
      st.textContent = CSS;
      document.head.appendChild(st);
      const pre = current || guess();
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = 'lq-device';
      el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
      el.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
      el.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'lq-device-title');
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="box">
        <h2 id="lq-device-title">How are you playing?</h2>
        <p class="sub">Pick your device so the game can show the right controls.</p>
        <div class="opts" role="radiogroup">${DEVICES.map(
          (d) => `<button type="button" class="opt${d.id === pre ? ' on' : ''}${d.id === guess() ? ' guess' : ''}" role="radio" aria-checked="${d.id === pre}" data-dev="${d.id}">
            <span class="ic">${d.icon}</span><div><b>${d.title}</b><small>${d.desc}</small></div><span class="tag">Detected</span></button>`,
        ).join('')}</div>
        <button type="button" class="go">Continue</button>
        <p class="note">You can change this later in Menu → Settings.</p>
      </div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      let pick = pre;
      const opts = [...el.querySelectorAll('.opt')];
      const select = (id) => {
        pick = id;
        opts.forEach((o) => {
          o.classList.toggle('on', o.dataset.dev === id);
          o.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(o.dataset.dev === id));
        });
      };
      opts.forEach((o) => o.addEventListener('click', () => select(o.dataset.dev)));
      const go = el.querySelector('.go');
      // Esc must not close it, and keys must not reach the game underneath.
      const onKey = (ev) => {
        if (ev.key === 'Escape') ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopPropagation();
      };
      addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
      go.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!valid(pick)) return;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(KEY, pick);
        } catch (e) {
          /* private mode: the choice lasts for this visit only */
        }
        removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        el.remove();
        st.remove();
        apply(pick);
        resolve(pick);
      });
      setTimeout(() => go.focus(), 50);
    });
  }

  window.LQDevice = {
    list: DEVICES,
    get: () => current,
    guess,
    // First visit: ask (cannot be skipped). Later visits: resolve at once with the saved choice.
    // index.html?device=ask always asks (handy for testing the first-visit screen).
    ask: () => (current && !/[?&]device=ask\b/.test(location.search) ? Promise.resolve(current) : open()),
    // From the Menu: ask again, with the current choice pre-selected.
    change: () => open(),
    isTouch: () => current === 'phone' || current === 'tablet',
  };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * On-screen controls for phones and tablets (device chosen in device.js: <html data-device="phone|tablet">).
 *
 *  - Joystick (bottom left): drag to walk in 8 directions.
 *  - 💬 button (bottom right): the E key, i.e. go through the door ahead or talk to the nearest person.
 *  - Character skill (above 💬): Gojo's 👁 Six Eyes button (from gojo.js, moved here) or Megumi's 🐕 Divine Dog.
 *
 * The game already reads window.__townControls next to the keyboard (10-core-characters-and-scene.js): up / down /
 * left / right while held, and actionRequested for one E press. 15-ui-assistant-panel.js replaces that object when the
 * game starts, so it is looked up again on every write instead of being kept.
 *
 * On touch devices the minimap moves to the top-left corner so the joystick has the bottom-left corner to itself.
 * The controls hide while a panel, chat or menu is open, and on computers they never appear.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);
  const isTouch = () => /^(phone|tablet)$/.test(document.documentElement.dataset.device || '');
  const controls = () => (window.__townControls = window.__townControls || {});

  const CSS = `
#lq-touch{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;pointer-events:none;display:none}
#lq-touch.on{display:block}
#lq-touch .joy{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:60px;width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffffff14 0,#ffffff0a 60%,#ffffff05 100%);border:2px solid #ffffff38;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0006;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
#lq-touch .knob{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:52px;height:52px;margin:-26px 0 0 -26px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#ffffffd0,#c9d6f0b0 60%,#8ea2c8a0);box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0007;transition:transform .08s ease-out}
#lq-touch .joy.held .knob{transition:none}
#lq-touch .act{position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:70px;width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ffd36bcc;background:#1b2440e6;color:#fff;font-size:30px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #0008}
#lq-touch .act.down,#lq-touch .skill.down{transform:scale(.92);filter:brightness(1.25)}
#lq-touch .skill{position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:154px;display:none;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #6c7fb8;background:#141c33f0;color:#eef3ff;font:600 14px system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0007}
#lq-touch .skill.show{display:block}
#lq-touch .skill.on{border-color:#bff0ff;background:#174a7a}
html[data-device="tablet"] #lq-touch .joy{left:30px;bottom:90px;width:150px;height:150px}
html[data-device="tablet"] #lq-touch .knob{width:64px;height:64px;margin:-32px 0 0 -32px}
html[data-device="tablet"] #lq-touch .act{right:34px;bottom:100px;width:88px;height:88px;font-size:36px}
html[data-device="tablet"] #lq-touch .skill{right:34px;bottom:206px;font-size:16px;padding:12px 18px}
/* Room for the controls: minimap to the top left, Character button up, Six Eyes button into the skill slot. */
html[data-device="phone"] #v8-map-wrap{top:64px!important;bottom:auto!important;left:8px!important;width:190px!important;transform:none!important}
html[data-device="tablet"] #v8-map-wrap{top:80px!important;bottom:auto!important;left:14px!important;transform:none!important}
html[data-device="phone"] #lq-quick{top:auto!important;bottom:214px!important;transform:none!important}
html[data-device="phone"] #lq-skill{top:auto!important;bottom:154px!important;right:20px!important}
html[data-device="tablet"] #lq-skill{top:auto!important;bottom:206px!important;right:34px!important;font-size:16px!important;padding:12px 18px!important}
html[data-device="phone"] #lq-sixeyes-hud{top:250px!important;bottom:auto!important}
`;

  let root = null,
    joy = null,
    knob = null,
    act = null,
    skill = null;

  function mount() {
    if (root) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
    root = document.createElement('div');
    root.id = 'lq-touch';
    root.innerHTML = `<div class="joy" role="application" aria-label="Joystick: drag to walk"><div class="knob"></div></div>
      <button type="button" class="act" aria-label="Talk / interact (E)">💬</button>
      <button type="button" class="skill" aria-label="Character skill">🐕 Divine Dog</button>`;
    document.body.appendChild(root);
    joy = root.querySelector('.joy');
    knob = root.querySelector('.knob');
    act = root.querySelector('.act');
    skill = root.querySelector('.skill');
    bindJoystick();
    bindButton(act, () => {
      controls().actionRequested = true;
    });
    bindButton(skill, () => {
      if (window.LQShadow) window.LQShadow.toggle();
    });
  }

  // ---- joystick ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let pointer = null;
  function setDirs(dx, dy) {
    const c = controls();
    // 8 directions: a component counts once it is a good part of the push (about 22° either side of an axis).
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const on = len > 0.25;
    const ux = on ? dx / len : 0,
      uy = on ? dy / len : 0;
    c.right = on && ux > 0.38;
    c.left = on && ux < -0.38;
    c.down = on && uy > 0.38;
    c.up = on && uy < -0.38;
  }
  function release() {
    pointer = null;
    joy.classList.remove('held');
    knob.style.transform = '';
    setDirs(0, 0);
  }
  function bindJoystick() {
    const move = (ev) => {
      const r = joy.getBoundingClientRect();
      const R = r.width / 2;
      let dx = (ev.clientX - (r.left + R)) / R,
        dy = (ev.clientY - (r.top + R)) / R;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (len > 1) (dx /= len), (dy /= len);
      knob.style.transform = `translate(${dx * R * 0.62}px,${dy * R * 0.62}px)`;
      setDirs(dx, dy);
    };
    joy.addEventListener('pointerdown', (ev) => {
      ev.preventDefault();
      pointer = ev.pointerId;
      try {
        joy.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
      } catch (e) {
        /* capture is optional */
      }
      joy.classList.add('held');
      move(ev);
    });
    joy.addEventListener('pointermove', (ev) => {
      if (ev.pointerId === pointer) move(ev);
    });
    for (const t of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture'])
      joy.addEventListener(t, (ev) => {
        if (ev.pointerId === pointer) release();
      });
  }

  function bindButton(el, fn) {
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (ev) => {
      ev.preventDefault();
      el.classList.add('down');
      fn();
    });
    for (const t of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'pointerleave']) el.addEventListener(t, () => el.classList.remove('down'));
    // Keyboard / screen reader activation (click without a pointer press).
    el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      if (ev.detail === 0) fn();
    });
  }

  // ---- when to show -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const shown = (id) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    return !!el && !el.hidden && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none' && el.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0;
  };
  function blocked(sc) {
    if (!sc || !sc.player || sc.sleeping) return true;
    if ((sc.chat && sc.chat.isOpen) || (sc.settings && sc.settings.isOpen) || (sc.helper && sc.helper.isOpen) || (sc.briefing && sc.briefing.isOpen))
      return true;
    return ['lq-title', 'lq-device', 'lq-auth', 'lq-cc', 'l11-shell', 'v8-panel', 'ai-panel', 'rpg-panel', 'v10-panel', 'journal', 'quests'].some(shown);
  }

  function tick() {
    if (!isTouch()) {
      if (root && root.classList.contains('on')) {
        root.classList.remove('on');
        release();
      }
      return;
    }
    mount();
    const sc = getScene();
    const on = !blocked(sc);
    if (root.classList.contains('on') !== on) {
      root.classList.toggle('on', on);
      if (!on) release();
    }
    if (!on) return;
    // Megumi's Divine Dog gets a button here; Gojo already has his own (👁, moved into the same slot by the CSS).
    const look = sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg && sc.store.game.rpg.look;
    const dog = !!(look && look.shadow && window.LQShadow);
    skill.classList.toggle('show', dog);
    if (dog) {
      const riding = window.LQShadow.isRiding();
      skill.classList.toggle('on', riding);
      const label = riding ? '🐕 Dismiss' : '🐕 Divine Dog';
      if (skill.textContent !== label) skill.textContent = label;
    }
  }

  setInterval(tick, 250);
  window.addEventListener('lifequest:device', tick);
  // Lifting a finger outside the page, switching apps or rotating must never leave the player walking.
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => root && release());
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => root && document.hidden && release());

  window.LQTouch = { refresh: tick };
})();

</script>

      const size = () => {

        cx.fillStyle = c;
        cx.beginPath();
        cx.arc(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        cx.fill();

        const chars = [...text].map((ch) => GLYPHS[ch] || GLYPHS[' ']);
        const width = chars.reduce((s, g) => s + g[0].length + 1, -1);

        for (const g of chars) {

          x += g[0].length + 1;
        }
      };
      const wrap = (v, m) => ((v % m) + m) % m;
      const hash = (n) => {
        const s = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453;
        return s - Math.floor(s);
      };

      function sky() {
        const gr = cx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GY);
        gr.addColorStop(0, '#5fb2f0');
        gr.addColorStop(0.65, '#a9dcf7');
