          R(x + 6, y - 4, 18, 5, '#ffffffd9');
          R(x + 20, y - 2, 10, 3, '#ffffffd9');
        }
      }
      function mountains() {
        for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
          const a = x + cam * 0.15;
          const h = 26 + 14 * Math.sin(a / 41) + 9 * Math.sin(a / 17 + 1.3);
          R(x, GY - 18 - h, 1, h + 18, '#9cc4d4');
          if (h > 40) R(x, GY - 18 - h, 1, 3, '#eef6fa');
        }
      }
      function hills() {
        for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
          const a = x + cam * 0.35;
          const h = 14 + 7 * Math.sin(a / 29) + 4 * Math.sin(a / 11 + 2);
          R(x, GY - 6 - h, 1, h + 6, '#78bb62');
          R(x, GY - 6 - h, 1, 2, '#93cf77');
        }
      }
      function trees() {
        const step = 23;
        const first = Math.floor((cam * 0.6) / step) - 1;
        for (let i = first; i < first + Math.ceil(W / step) + 3; i++) {
          if (hash(i + 7) < 0.35) continue;
          const x = i * step - cam * 0.6 + hash(i) * 10;
          const s = 0.8 + hash(i + 3) * 0.5;
          const base = GY - 5;
          R(x - 1, base - 9 * s, 3, 9 * s, '#6b4a2e');
          disc(x + 0.5, base - 12 * s, 6 * s, '#3f8f4c');
          disc(x - 2, base - 15 * s, 4 * s, '#4ea25a');
        }
      }
      function townBehindStation() {
        if (!brake) return;
        const colors = ['#d9534f', '#3f7fbf', '#e0a33a', '#5aa36b', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22', '#3aa7a3'];
        for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
          const x = brake.c0 * 0.6 + W + 30 + k * 28 - cam * 0.6;
          if (x < -40 || x > W + 40) continue;
          const h = 14 + (k % 3) * 5;
          const base = GY - 6;
          R(x, base - h, 22, h, '#f4ead6');
          R(x - 2, base - h - 7, 26, 8, colors[k]);
          R(x + 2, base - h - 11, 18, 4, colors[k]);
          R(x + 4, base - h + 4, 5, 5, '#7fc4ef');
          R(x + 13, base - h + 4, 5, 5, '#7fc4ef');
          if (k === 3) {
            // the clock tower of the Town Hall
            R(x + 7, base - h - 26, 8, 16, '#e8dcc0');
            R(x + 6, base - h - 30, 10, 5, '#3f7fbf');
            disc(x + 11, base - h - 19, 2.5, '#fffbe6');
          }
        }
      }
      function station() {
        if (!brake) return;
        const cxs = brake.c0 + brake.D + W / 2 - cam; // centre of the station on screen
        if (cxs < -160 || cxs > W + 160) return;
        // platform behind the track
        R(cxs - 130, GY - 9, 260, 6, '#b9b2a6');
        R(cxs - 130, GY - 9, 260, 1, '#e0dad0');
        R(cxs - 130, GY - 4, 260, 2, '#8d8578');
        // station building
        const bx = cxs - 44;
        const by = GY - 9;
        R(bx, by - 34, 88, 34, '#f1e2c4');
        R(bx, by - 34, 88, 3, '#e2cfa6');
        R(bx - 6, by - 42, 100, 9, '#b8483e');
        R(bx - 2, by - 47, 92, 6, '#c9554a');
        R(bx + 36, by - 22, 16, 22, '#7a4a2a');
        R(bx + 43, by - 22, 1, 22, '#5a361e');
        for (const wx of [8, 22, 60, 74]) {
          R(bx + wx, by - 24, 8, 9, '#7fc4ef');
          R(bx + wx, by - 24, 8, 1, '#5a8fb0');
        }
        // sign board, lettered with a tiny pixel font so it stays sharp when scaled up
        R(bx + 12, by - 58, 64, 12, '#1d3a5f');
        R(bx + 13, by - 57, 62, 10, '#24497a');
        pixelText('ENGLISH TOWN', bx + 44, by - 55, '#ffe9a8');
        R(bx + 18, by - 47, 2, 5, '#3b3b3b');
        R(bx + 68, by - 47, 2, 5, '#3b3b3b');
        // lamp posts and a flower box
        for (const lx of [-110, -70, 70, 110]) {
          R(cxs + lx, GY - 30, 2, 21, '#2f3a44');
          R(cxs + lx - 2, GY - 33, 6, 4, '#2f3a44');
          R(cxs + lx - 1, GY - 32, 4, 2, '#fff2b0');
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) R(bx - 2 + k * 9, by - 3, 4, 3, k % 2 ? '#e74c3c' : '#f1c40f');
      }
      // Top of the near rail (track() draws it at GY + 3); every wheel rests on this line.
      // Refreshed every frame in track() (drawn before the train), because GY changes on resize.
      let RAIL = GY + 3;
      function track() {
        RAIL = GY + 3;
        R(0, GY - 3, W, 7, '#9b8f80');
        for (let x = -8; x < W + 8; x += 8) R(wrap(x - cam, W + 16) - 8, GY - 2, 5, 5, '#6d5640');
        R(0, GY - 2, W, 1, '#d4d8dc');
        R(0, GY - 1, W, 1, '#7b8086');
        R(0, GY + 3, W, 1, '#c3c8cc');
        R(0, GY + 4, W, H - GY - 4, '#6cb553');
        R(0, GY + 4, W, 2, '#86c96a');
        for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) {
          const x = wrap(k * 41 - cam * 1.25, W + 40) - 20;
          const y = GY + 10 + hash(k + 11) * Math.max(6, H - GY - 18);
          R(x, y, 2, 2, ['#f6e05e', '#ffffff', '#f28cb1'][k % 3]);
          R(x - 2, y + 2, 6, 1, '#4f9a3f');
        }
      }
      function wheel(x, y, r, a) {
        disc(x, y, r, '#2a2a30');
        disc(x, y, r - 1.2, '#55555f');
        cx.strokeStyle = '#c9c9d2';
        cx.lineWidth = 1;
        cx.beginPath();
        cx.moveTo(x - Math.cos(a) * (r - 1), y - Math.sin(a) * (r - 1));
        cx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * (r - 1), y + Math.sin(a) * (r - 1));
        cx.stroke();
        disc(x, y, 1, '#c9c9d2');
      }
      const PEOPLE = [
        { skin: '#f0c8a0', hair: '#3a2418' },
        { skin: '#e3b48c', hair: '#d8d8d8' },
        { skin: '#f3cfae', hair: '#1f1a16' },
        { skin: '#c98f66', hair: '#222222' },
        { skin: '#f6d2b0', hair: '#c8702a' },
        { skin: '#e8b88a', hair: '#2a3a35' },
      ];
      function carriage(x, y, idx, now, youWin) {
        R(x, y - 24, 50, 22, '#f4e6c4');
        R(x - 1, y - 27, 52, 4, '#7a4a35');
        R(x + 1, y - 29, 48, 2, '#8d5a42');
        R(x, y - 9, 50, 3, '#1f8a8a');
        R(x, y - 4, 50, 2, '#c9b893');
        for (let w = 0; w < 4; w++) {
          const wx = x + 4 + w * 11;
          R(wx, y - 21, 9, 9, '#a9dcf7');
          const you = youWin === w;
          const p = you ? me : PEOPLE[(idx * 4 + w) % PEOPLE.length];
          if (you || hash(idx * 10 + w) > 0.3) {
            const bob = Math.sin(now / 300 + w + idx) > 0.6 ? 1 : 0;
            R(wx + 2, y - 13 - bob, 5, 4, you ? p.top : '#8aa2c8');
            R(wx + 3, y - 17 - bob, 4, 4, p.skin);
            R(wx + 3, y - 18 - bob, 4, 2, p.hair);
          }
          R(wx, y - 21, 9, 1, '#ffffff99');
        }
        R(x + 50, y - 14, 4, 2, '#3b3b3b');
        // Wheels sit on the near rail (RAIL) and do not bounce; only the body jiggles on its springs.
        const a = cam / 3.5;
        const wy = RAIL - 3.5;
        wheel(x + 9, wy, 3.5, a);
        wheel(x + 18, wy, 3.5, a + 1);
        wheel(x + 32, wy, 3.5, a + 2);
        wheel(x + 41, wy, 3.5, a + 3);
      }
      function locomotive(x, y) {
        // cab
        R(x, y - 30, 20, 27, '#c8433a');
        R(x - 1, y - 33, 22, 4, '#2b2f3a');
        R(x + 4, y - 26, 12, 9, '#a9dcf7');
        R(x + 4, y - 26, 12, 1, '#ffffff99');
        R(x + 9, y - 24, 4, 4, '#f6d2b0');
        R(x + 8, y - 26, 6, 2, '#1f3552');
        // boiler
        R(x + 20, y - 21, 31, 16, '#2b5f8a');
        R(x + 20, y - 21, 31, 2, '#3f7fb5');
        for (const bx of [26, 36, 46]) R(x + bx, y - 21, 2, 16, '#f3c14b');
        R(x + 30, y - 25, 6, 4, '#f3c14b');
        R(x + 41, y - 31, 6, 10, '#2b2f3a');
        R(x + 40, y - 33, 8, 3, '#2b2f3a');
        R(x + 51, y - 19, 5, 13, '#c8433a');
        R(x + 54, y - 15, 3, 3, '#fff2b0');
        R(x, y - 5, 57, 3, '#2b2f3a');
        // cow-catcher
        R(x + 55, y - 4, 4, 3, '#8a8f96');
        const a = cam / 5;
        wheel(x + 10, RAIL - 4.5, 4.5, a);
        wheel(x + 26, RAIL - 5.5, 5.5, a + 1);
        wheel(x + 40, RAIL - 5.5, 5.5, a + 2);
        // side rod joining the two driving wheels, pinned 3px off their centres
        R(x + 26 + Math.cos(a + 1) * 3, RAIL - 5.5 + Math.sin(a + 1) * 3, 15, 1.5, '#c9c9d2');
      }
      function train(now) {
        const total = 50 + 4 + 50 + 4 + 57;
        const left = Math.round(W / 2 - total / 2);
        const jig = (k) => (speed > 8 && Math.sin(now / 70 + k * 1.7) > 0.7 ? 1 : 0);
        const y = GY - 2;
        carriage(left, y - jig(0), 0, now, -1);
        carriage(left + 54, y - jig(1), 1, now, 2);
        locomotive(left + 108, y - jig(2));
        // smoke
        // Puffs while moving; once stopped, only a thin wisp that fades quickly.
        const moving = speed > 8;
        smokeT += moving ? 1 : 0.12;
        if (smokeT > 7) {
          smokeT = 0;
          smoke.push({ x: left + 108 + 44, y: GY - 37, r: moving ? 2.5 : 1.5, life: 0, max: moving ? 2.4 : 1.1 });
        }
        for (const p of smoke) {
          p.life += 1 / 60;
          p.x -= (speed / 60) * 0.85 + 0.15;
          p.y -= 0.32;
          p.r += 0.07;
        }
        for (let k = smoke.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) if (smoke[k].life > smoke[k].max) smoke.splice(k, 1);
        for (const p of smoke) disc(p.x, p.y, p.r, `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.max(0, 0.75 * (1 - p.life / p.max)).toFixed(2)})`);
        // a small bouncing arrow over the player's window
        if (lines[li] && lines[li].you) {
          const wx = left + 54 + 4 + 2 * 11 + 4;
          const b = Math.round(Math.sin(now / 160) * 2);
          R(wx - 4, y - 40 + b, 9, 2, '#ffd84a');
          R(wx - 3, y - 38 + b, 7, 2, '#ffd84a');
          R(wx - 2, y - 36 + b, 5, 2, '#ffd84a');
          R(wx - 1, y - 34 + b, 3, 2, '#ffd84a');
        }
      }
      function draw(now) {
        cx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
        sky();
        mountains();
        hills();
        trees();
        townBehindStation();
        station();
        track();
        train(now);
        // soft dark edges
        const v = cx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
        v.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)');
        v.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        v.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        v.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)');
        cx.fillStyle = v;
        cx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      }

      // ---- text ----
      function show(i) {
        li = i;
        const l = lines[i];
        box.classList.add('show');
        enEl.textContent = '';
        viEl.textContent = l.vi;
        viEl.classList.remove('show');
        typing = { text: l.en, n: 0, t: 0 };
        dots.forEach((d, k) => d.classList.toggle('on', k <= i));
        nextBtn.textContent = i === lines.length - 1 ? "Let's go! ▸" : 'Next ▸';
        if (l.brake && !brake) {
          const D = W + 140;
          brake = { t0: performance.now(), c0: cam, D, T: (2 * D) / CRUISE };
        }
      }
      function finishTyping() {
        if (!typing) return;
        enEl.textContent = typing.text;
        typing = null;
        viEl.classList.add('show');
      }
      function next() {
        if (ended) return;
        if (li < 0) {
          show(0);
          return;
        }
        if (typing) {
          finishTyping();
          return;
        }
        if (li < lines.length - 1) show(li + 1);
        else end();
      }
      function end() {
        if (ended) return;
        ended = true;
        root.classList.remove('on');
        removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
          removeEventListener('resize', size);
          root.remove();
          try {
            if (paused && sc && sc.scene) sc.scene.resume();
          } catch (e) {}
          playing = null;
          resolve();
        }, 650);
      }
      const onKey = (ev) => {
        // The scene owns the keyboard while it plays: the game must not move or open menus behind it.
        ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (ev.repeat) return;
        if (ev.key === ' ' || ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === 'e' || ev.key === 'E' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') next();
      };
      addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
      root.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        if (ev.target.closest('.skip')) {
          end();
          return;
        }
        next();
      });

      function frame(now) {
        if (!document.body.contains(root)) return;
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
        last = now;
        if (brake) {
          const p = Math.min(1, (now - brake.t0) / 1000 / brake.T);
          cam = brake.c0 + brake.D * (1 - (1 - p) * (1 - p));
          speed = CRUISE * (1 - p);
        } else cam += speed * dt;
        if (li < 0 && now - t0 > 2500) show(0);
        if (typing) {
          typing.t += dt;
          const n = Math.min(typing.text.length, Math.floor(typing.t * 40));
          if (n !== typing.n) {
            typing.n = n;
            enEl.textContent = typing.text.slice(0, n);
          }
          if (n >= typing.text.length) finishTyping();
        }
        draw(now);
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
    return playing;
  }

  // ---- 2. tutorial ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function steps() {
    const t = isTouch();
    const name = plainName() || 'Alex';
    const k = (key) => '<kbd>' + key + '</kbd>';
    return [
      {
        id: 'move',
        en: t ? 'Use the joystick in the bottom-left corner to walk.' : 'Walk with ' + k('W') + k('A') + k('S') + k('D') + ' or the arrow keys.',
        vi: t ? 'Dùng cần điều khiển ở góc dưới bên trái để đi lại.' : 'Đi lại bằng các phím W A S D hoặc phím mũi tên.',
      },
      {
        id: 'find',
        en: 'Mia is waiting for you at the school. Follow the yellow arrow to find her.',

      {

  const stepIndex = (id) => steps().findIndex((s) => s.id === id);

  let coachEl = null;
  let coachKey = '';
  let base = null;

  function mountCoach() {
    if (coachEl && document.body.contains(coachEl)) return coachEl;
    ensureCss();
    coachEl = document.createElement('div');
    coachEl.id = 'lq-tut';
    coachEl.hidden = true;
    coachEl.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    coachEl.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    coachEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="hd"><span class="tag">🎓 Tutorial <span class="num"></span></span><span class="bar"><i></i></span>' +
      '<button type="button" class="skip" title="Skip the tutorial (replay it from Menu → Settings)">Skip</button></div>' +
      '<p class="en"></p><p class="vi"></p><div class="act"></div>';
    coachEl.querySelector('.skip').addEventListener('click', skip);
    coachEl.querySelector('.act').addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      const b = ev.target.closest('button');
      if (!b) return;
      b.blur();
      if (b.dataset.do === 'next') advance();
      else if (b.dataset.do === 'example') useExample(b.dataset.text);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(coachEl);
    return coachEl;
  }
  function hideCoach() {
    if (coachEl) coachEl.hidden = true;
  }
  function renderCoach(i, list, shownStep, note) {
    const el = mountCoach();
    const key = i + '|' + shownStep.id + '|' + (note || '') + '|' + isTouch();
    if (key !== coachKey) {
      const changed = coachKey.split('|')[0] !== String(i);
      coachKey = key;
      el.querySelector('.num').textContent = i + 1 + '/' + list.length;
      el.querySelector('.bar i').style.width = Math.round((i / list.length) * 100) + '%';
      el.querySelector('.en').innerHTML = (note ? note.en + ' ' : '') + shownStep.en;
      el.querySelector('.vi').textContent = (note ? note.vi + ' ' : '') + shownStep.vi;
      const act = el.querySelector('.act');
      act.innerHTML = '';
      if (shownStep.example && !note) {
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'ex';
        b.dataset.do = 'example';
        b.dataset.text = shownStep.example;
        b.textContent = '✍️ ' + shownStep.example;
        act.appendChild(b);
      }
      if (shownStep.next) {
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.dataset.do = 'next';
        b.textContent = shownStep.next;
        act.appendChild(b);
      }
      if (changed) {
        el.classList.remove('pop');
        void el.offsetWidth;
        el.classList.add('pop');
      }
    }
    el.hidden = false;
  }
  function useExample(text) {
    const sc = getScene();
    const input = sc && sc.chat && sc.chat.input;
    if (!input || !sc.chat.isOpen) return;
    input.value = text;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    input.focus();
  }

  function advance() {
    const g = game();
    if (!g || !g.tut) return;
    const list = steps();
    g.tut.step = Math.min(list.length, (g.tut.step | 0) + 1);
    base = null;
    if (g.tut.step >= list.length) finish(false);
    else save();
  }
  function jumpTo(id) {
    const g = game();
    const i = stepIndex(id);
    if (!g || !g.tut || i < 0 || (g.tut.step | 0) >= i) return;
    g.tut.step = i;
    base = null;
    save();
  }
  function finish(skipped) {
    const g = game();
    if (!g) return;
    g.tut = Object.assign(g.tut || {}, { done: Date.now(), skipped: !!skipped });
    save();
    hideCoach();
    coachKey = '';
    if (skipped) toast('🎓 Tutorial skipped', 'You can replay it any time', 'Menu → Settings → Intro & tutorial');
    else toast('🎓 Tutorial complete', 'Welcome to English Town!', 'Finish “First Day in Town” on the quest card.');
  }
  function skip() {
    finish(true);
  }

  // Panels that cover the screen: the card waits behind them.
  const COVERS = ['l11-shell', 'v8-panel', 'ai-panel', 'rpg-panel', 'v10-panel', 'journal', 'quests', 'helper', 'settings', 'briefing', 'lq-guide', 'lq-levels', 'lq-voice', 'lq-cc', 'lq-train', 'lq-device', 'lq-auth', 'lq-title'];

  function tutorialTick() {
    const sc = getScene();
    const g = game();
    if (playing || !sc || !g || !sc.player || !g.tut || !g.tut.intro || g.tut.done) return hideCoach();
    const list = steps();
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, g.tut.step | 0));
    const s = list[i];
    const msgs = (g.stats && g.stats.messages) || 0;
    if (!base || base.i !== i) base = { i, x: sc.player.x, y: sc.player.y, msgs };
    const chatId = sc.chat && sc.chat.isOpen ? sc.chat.currentId : null;

    // Talking to Mia early skips the steps before it.
    if (chatId === 'kid' && i < stepIndex('say')) return jumpTo('say');

    const mia = sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((n) => n.def && n.def.id === 'kid');
    const miaHere = !!(mia && mia.sprite && mia.sprite.visible && !!mia.inside === !!sc.inside);
    const dMia = miaHere ? Math.hypot(sc.player.x - mia.sprite.x, sc.player.y - mia.sprite.y) : Infinity;

    let shownStep = s;
    let note = null;
    if (s.id === 'move' && Math.hypot(sc.player.x - base.x, sc.player.y - base.y) > 80) return advance();
    if (s.id === 'find' && dMia < 90) return advance();
    if (s.id === 'talk' && dMia > 220) shownStep = list[stepIndex('find')];
    if (s.id === 'say') {
      if (chatId !== 'kid') {
        shownStep = list[stepIndex('talk')];
        note = { en: 'Talk to Mia again.', vi: 'Hãy nói chuyện lại với Mia.' };
        if (dMia > 220) shownStep = list[stepIndex('find')];
      } else if (msgs > base.msgs) return advance();
    }
    if (s.id === 'tips' && !chatId) return advance();
    if (s.id === 'menu' && shown('l11-shell')) return advance();

    // Hide behind big panels, and while chatting with someone other than Mia (or chatting at all on the last steps).
    const chatOk = s.id === 'say' || s.id === 'tips';
    if (COVERS.some(shown) || (chatId && (!chatOk || chatId !== 'kid'))) return hideCoach();
    renderCoach(i, list, shownStep, note);
    // On small screens the chat is tall: the card moves up over the minimap so it does not hide the chat's ✕.
    coachEl.classList.toggle('chatting', !!chatId);
  }

  // ---- yellow arrow to Mia (steps "find" and "talk") --------------------------------------------------------------
  function drawGuide(sc, time) {
    const st = sc.__lqIntro;
    if (!st) return;
    const gfx = st.g;
    gfx.clear();
    const g = game();
    if (playing || sc?.area?.id !== 'english-town' || !g || !g.tut || !g.tut.intro || g.tut.done || !sc.player || sc.switching) return;
    const id = steps()[Math.max(0, g.tut.step | 0)];
    if (!id || (id.id !== 'find' && id.id !== 'talk' && id.id !== 'say')) return;
    if (sc.chat && sc.chat.isOpen) return;
    const mia = sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((n) => n.def && n.def.id === 'kid');
    if (!mia || !mia.sprite || !mia.sprite.visible || !!mia.inside !== !!sc.inside) return;
    const mx = mia.sprite.x;
    const my = mia.sprite.y;
    const b = Math.sin(time * 0.006) * 4;
    // a bouncing marker over Mia's head
    const hy = my - 52 + b;
    gfx.fillStyle(0x3a2a00, 1);
    gfx.fillTriangle(mx - 10, hy - 2, mx + 10, hy - 2, mx, hy + 12);
    gfx.fillStyle(0xffd84a, 1);
    gfx.fillTriangle(mx - 7, hy, mx + 7, hy, mx, hy + 9);
    // an arrow around the player pointing at her
    const px = sc.player.x;
    const py = sc.player.y - 16;
    const d = Math.hypot(mx - px, my - py);
    if (d < 110) return;
    const a = Math.atan2(my - 16 - py, mx - px);
    const r0 = 30 + Math.sin(time * 0.008) * 3;
    const tip = { x: px + Math.cos(a) * (r0 + 16), y: py + Math.sin(a) * (r0 + 16) };
    const l = { x: px + Math.cos(a) * r0 + Math.cos(a + Math.PI / 2) * 9, y: py + Math.sin(a) * r0 + Math.sin(a + Math.PI / 2) * 9 };
    const rr = { x: px + Math.cos(a) * r0 - Math.cos(a + Math.PI / 2) * 9, y: py + Math.sin(a) * r0 - Math.sin(a + Math.PI / 2) * 9 };
    gfx.lineStyle(3, 0x3a2a00, 1);
    gfx.strokeTriangle(tip.x, tip.y, l.x, l.y, rr.x, rr.y);
    gfx.fillStyle(0xffd84a, 1);
    gfx.fillTriangle(tip.x, tip.y, l.x, l.y, rr.x, rr.y);
  }
  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqIntro) return;
    sc.__lqIntro = { g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(12) };
    sc.events.on('update', (time) => drawGuide(sc, time));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqIntro = null;
    });
  }

  // ---- when to start ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // A save counts as new when nothing has happened in it yet.
  function isNewSave(g) {
    const quests = Object.values(g.quests || {}).some((v) => Number(v) > 0);
    const ach = g.ach && g.ach.done && Object.keys(g.ach.done).length > 0;
    const msgs = (g.stats && g.stats.messages) || 0;
    return !quests && !ach && msgs === 0 && (g.day || 1) <= 1;
  }
  function readyToPlay(sc) {
    if (!sc || !sc.player || !sc.store || !sc.store.game || sc.switching) return false;
    if (['lq-title', 'lq-device', 'lq-auth', 'lq-cc', 'lq-train'].some(shown)) return false;
    if (window.LQCreatorUI && window.LQCreatorUI.hasLook && !window.LQCreatorUI.hasLook()) return false;
    return true;
  }
  function selectFirstQuest() {
    const v = window.LQV8;
    try {
      if (v && v.select && !(v.isDone && v.isDone('first-day'))) v.select('first-day');
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function tick() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqIntro) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('intro guide attach failed', e);
      }
    }
    // After "First Day in Town" is finished, the quest card moves on to The Ten Shadows.
    const v = window.LQV8;
    try {
      if (v && v.selected && v.isDone && v.selected() === 'first-day' && v.isDone('first-day')) v.select('ten-shadows');
    } catch (e) {}

    if (playing || !readyToPlay(sc) || sc?.area?.id !== 'english-town') return hideCoach();
    const g = sc.store.game;
    if (!g.tut) {
      // Older saves with progress never see the intro; they can still replay it from the Settings.
      g.tut = isNewSave(g) ? { step: 0 } : { intro: 'old', done: 'old' };
      save();
    }
    if (!g.tut.intro) {
      playIntro().then(() => {
        const gg = game();
        if (!gg) return;
        gg.tut = Object.assign(gg.tut || {}, { intro: Date.now(), step: 0 });
        delete gg.tut.done;
        base = null;
        coachKey = '';
        save();
        selectFirstQuest();
      });
      return;
    }
    tutorialTick();
  }
  setInterval(() => {
    try {
      tick();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('intro tick failed', e);
    }
  }, 300);

  // ?intro=1 plays the opening scene right away (for checking it), without touching the save.
  try {
    if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('intro') === '1' && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('preview') !== 'art-district') {
      const go = () => playIntro();
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', go);
      else go();
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  window.LQIntro = {
    // Opening scene only; does not change the save.
    preview: () => getScene()?.area?.id === 'english-town' ? playIntro() : Promise.resolve(false),
    // Menu → Settings: play the scene again, then start the tutorial from the first step.
    replay() {
      if (getScene()?.area?.id !== 'english-town') return;
      const g = game();
      if (!g) return;
      g.tut = { step: 0 };
      base = null;
      coachKey = '';
      save();
      tick();
    },
    skip,
    isPlaying: () => !!playing,
    status() {
      const g = game();
      const t = g && g.tut;
      const list = steps();
      return t ? { intro: !!t.intro, done: !!t.done, skipped: !!t.skipped, step: t.step | 0, stepId: (list[t.step | 0] || {}).id || null } : null;
    },
  };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Title screen (the lobby). It is the first thing a visitor sees: game name, short intro, a Start button,
 * "by the New Horizons" and a small "Claude" credit. While it is shown the loader keeps downloading the game
 * in the background, so pressing Start feels instant.
 *
 * window.LQTitle.show() returns a promise that resolves when the player presses Start.
 */
(function () {
  const CSS = `
#lq-title{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#070a16;color:#eef2ff;font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .6s ease}

#lq-title h1{margin:22px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;font-size:clamp(34px,7.5vw,68px);line-height:1;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#fff}

#lq-title .key-row input:focus{outline:2px solid #6f8cff;outline-offset:1px}

  // ---- animated night town drawn at low resolution (pixel art look) ----
  function startScene(cv) {
    const cx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const SCALE = 3;
    let W = 0, H = 0, stars = [], layers = [], raf = 0, last = 0, trainX = -200, trainWait = 3;
    const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

    function build() {
      W = Math.ceil(innerWidth / SCALE);
      H = Math.ceil(innerHeight / SCALE);
      cv.width = W;
      cv.height = H;
      stars = Array.from({ length: Math.floor((W * H) / 260) }, () => ({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H * 0.6, p: Math.random() * 6, s: Math.random() < 0.15 ? 2 : 1 }));
      const ground = H - 12;
      layers = [
        { col: '#101c33', win: '#27406b', min: 26, max: 62, gap: [0, 2], drift: 0 },
        { col: '#0a1326', win: '#f3d27a', min: 14, max: 44, gap: [0, 3], drift: 0 },
      ].map((L) => {
        const items = [];
        let x = -4;
        while (x < W + 10) {
          const w = Math.floor(rnd(8, 18)), h = Math.floor(rnd(L.min, L.max));
          const wins = [];
          for (let wx = x + 2; wx < x + w - 2; wx += 4) for (let wy = ground - h + 3; wy < ground - 3; wy += 5) wins.push({ x: wx, y: wy, on: Math.random() < 0.4, t: rnd(2, 9) });
          items.push({ x, w, h, wins, roof: Math.random() < 0.3 });
          x += w + Math.floor(rnd(L.gap[0], L.gap[1] + 1));
        }
        return Object.assign({}, L, { items });
      });
    }

    function draw(t, dt) {
      const ground = H - 12;
      const sky = cx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      sky.addColorStop(0, '#060917');
      sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#10163a');
      sky.addColorStop(1, '#262a66');
      cx.fillStyle = sky;
      cx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      for (const s of stars) {
        const a = reduce ? 0.8 : 0.45 + 0.55 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t / 900 + s.p));
        cx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${a})`;
        cx.fillRect(Math.floor(s.x), Math.floor(s.y), s.s, s.s);
      }
      // moon
      const mx = Math.floor(W * 0.8), my = Math.floor(H * 0.2);
      cx.fillStyle = '#fff6c8';
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(mx, my, 7, 0, 7);
      cx.fill();
      cx.fillStyle = '#12234a';
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(mx + 3, my - 1, 6, 0, 7);
      cx.fill();
      // far hills
      cx.fillStyle = '#0d1a35';
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) cx.fillRect(x, ground - 14 - Math.floor(6 * Math.sin(x / 17) + 4 * Math.sin(x / 7)), 1, 30);
      // skyline (two layers) with twinkling windows
      for (const L of layers) {
        for (const b of L.items) {
          cx.fillStyle = L.col;
          cx.fillRect(b.x, ground - b.h, b.w, b.h);
          if (b.roof) cx.fillRect(b.x + 2, ground - b.h - 3, b.w - 4, 3);
          for (const w of b.wins) {
            if (!reduce) {
              w.t -= dt / 1000;
              if (w.t <= 0) {
                w.on = !w.on;
                w.t = rnd(3, 12);
              }
            }
            if (w.on) {
              cx.fillStyle = L.win;
              cx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, 2, 2);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      // ground and rails
      cx.fillStyle = '#060b16';
      cx.fillRect(0, ground, W, H - ground);
      cx.fillStyle = '#3b4a66';
      cx.fillRect(0, ground + 3, W, 1);
      cx.fillStyle = '#1d2740';
      for (let x = (Math.floor(t / 60) % 6) - 6; x < W; x += 6) cx.fillRect(x, ground + 4, 2, 2);
      // a train crossing now and then
      if (!reduce) {
        if (trainX > W + 20 || trainWait > 0) {
          trainWait -= dt / 1000;
          if (trainWait <= 0 && trainX > W + 20) trainX = -90;
        }
        if (trainX <= W + 20 && trainWait <= 0) {
          trainX += (dt / 1000) * 46;
          if (trainX > W + 20) trainWait = rnd(6, 11);
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const x = Math.floor(trainX - i * 22);
            cx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#16b3a5' : '#e8eef2';
            cx.fillRect(x, ground - 9, 20, 8);
            cx.fillStyle = '#16b3a5';
            cx.fillRect(x, ground - 4, 20, 2);
            cx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
            for (let w = 2; w < 18; w += 5) cx.fillRect(x + w, ground - 7, 3, 2);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    function frame(now) {
      const dt = Math.min(80, now - (last || now));
      last = now;
      draw(now, dt);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    build();
    addEventListener('resize', build);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      removeEventListener('resize', build);
    };
  }

  let shown = null;

  function show() {
    if (shown) return shown;
    shown = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const st = document.createElement('style');
      st.textContent = CSS;
      document.head.appendChild(st);
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = 'lq-title';
      el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'LIFEQUEST AI welcome screen');
      el.innerHTML = `
        <canvas aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div class="glow"></div><div class="shade"></div>
        <div class="inner">
          <span class="eyebrow">Learn English · Role-play</span>
          <h1><span>LIFEQUEST</span><b>AI</b></h1>
          <p class="tag">Live in the town, learn English every day</p>
          <p class="intro">Explore a world of eight regions, practise English with residents, complete quests and discover their stories. New expressions, animated portraits and grounded conversations bring each encounter to life.</p>
          <div class="keybox" style="display:none" aria-hidden="true">
            <b>Optional local development key</b>
            <p>NPC chats, sentence hints and the AI Coach work best with your own free Gemini key. It is saved only in this browser and sent only to Google. You can skip this and add it later.</p>
            <div class="key-row"><input id="lq-title-key" type="password" placeholder="Paste your API key here" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Gemini API key"><button type="button" id="lq-title-keyshow" aria-label="Show or hide the key">Show</button></div>
            <div class="key-links"><a href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Get a free API key ↗</a><span class="key-state" id="lq-title-keystate" role="status"></span></div>
          </div>
          <p class="intro" style="font-size:12px;margin:6px auto 12px;opacity:.9">AI connects through the game server when configured. Offline conversations are also available.</p>
          <button type="button" class="start" id="lq-title-start"><span>Start</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
        </div>
        <div class="by">by the New Horizons</div>
        <div class="credit">Claude</div>`;      document.body.appendChild(el);
      const stop = startScene(el.querySelector('canvas'));
      const btn = el.querySelector('#lq-title-start');
      queueMicrotask(()=>globalThis.LQRuntime1044?.installRecovery(btn));
      setTimeout(() => btn.focus({ preventScroll: true }), 50);
      const keyInput = el.querySelector('#lq-title-key');
      const keyState = el.querySelector('#lq-title-keystate');
      const SAVE_KEY = 'english-town-ai';
      const readCfg = () => {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY) || '{}') || {};
        } catch (e) {
          return {};
        }
      };
      const say = (text, err) => {
        keyState.textContent = text;
        keyState.classList.toggle('err', !!err);
      };
      if (String(readCfg().geminiKey || '').trim()) {
        keyInput.placeholder = 'Leave blank to keep the saved key';
        say('✅ A key is already saved');
      }
      el.querySelector('#lq-title-keyshow').addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        const show = keyInput.type === 'password';
        keyInput.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
        ev.currentTarget.textContent = show ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
      });
      // Returns false (and shows why) when the typed key is unusable; an empty field just means "skip".
      const saveTypedKey = () => {
        const v = keyInput.value.trim();
        if (!v) return true;
        if (v.length < 20 || /\s/.test(v)) {
          say('That does not look like an API key', true);
          keyInput.focus();
          return false;
        }
        try {
          const cfg = readCfg();
          cfg.geminiKey = v;
          localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg));
        } catch (e) {
          say('Could not save the key in this browser', true);
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      };
      let done = false;
      const go = async () => {
        if (done || btn.disabled || !saveTypedKey()) return;
        done = true;
        if(globalThis.LQPrimary1056?.enabled){btn.disabled=true;const proceed=await globalThis.LQPrimary1056.beforeStart();if(!proceed){done=false;btn.disabled=false;return;}btn.disabled=false;}
        removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        el.classList.add('out');
        setTimeout(() => {
          stop();
          el.remove();
          st.remove();
        }, 650);
        resolve();
      };
      const onKey = (ev) => {
        // Typing in the key field, or pressing a key on the Show / link controls, must keep its normal meaning;
        // only Enter in the key field starts the game.
        const t = ev.target;
        if (t !== btn && t && /^(INPUT|BUTTON|A)$/.test(t.tagName) && !(t === keyInput && ev.key === 'Enter')) return;
        if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') {
          ev.preventDefault();
          go();
        }
      };
      btn.addEventListener('click', go);
      addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    });
    return shown;
  }

  window.LQTitle = { show };
})();

(function(root){'use strict';
const T=32, profiles={
 town:{label:'English Town',kind:'worn stone',road:[0x5b6964,0x9a9e8f,0xc1c7ad],leaf:[0x34583e,0x68915d,0xa6c57b],flower:0xe9c58f,trim:0x9f8767},
 mine:{label:'Minerals Town',kind:'slate',road:[0x494b4e,0x90918a,0xb5ae91],leaf:[0x4e5455,0x758787,0xa9c4c6],flower:0x9adbcf,trim:0xa48b65},
 past:{label:'70 Years Ago',kind:'packed earth',road:[0x69543d,0xb1976b,0xd9c397],leaf:[0x44583b,0x78905c,0xa7ac72],flower:0xefcc7d,trim:0x9b7955},
 art:{label:'Art District',kind:'mosaic',road:[0x5c5268,0xa59b9e,0xd3c0ba],leaf:[0x43534c,0x779173,0xc1c18b],flower:0xed9bb2,trim:0xc29582},
 tech:{label:'Tech-Co',kind:'precision paving',road:[0x364d5e,0x8295a2,0xc0d7df],leaf:[0x36565b,0x6f9990,0x9ed3b9],flower:0x97d8db,trim:0x749cae},
 royal:{label:'Old Oriaris',kind:'limestone',road:[0x655d62,0xb7a591,0xe4d3b0],leaf:[0x3d6248,0x77935d,0xc0bc85],flower:0xd9a5bd,trim:0xc5a16f},
 wish:{label:'Wish Valley',kind:'root and earth',road:[0x4a4e37,0x918361,0xc7bb83],leaf:[0x2d5e46,0x569b61,0xb4d28a],flower:0xbfe8c9,trim:0xbc9a6b},
 vocalt:{label:'Vocalt — Greedy Land',kind:'market brick',road:[0x704c4a,0xab8172,0xe0b99a],leaf:[0x4b6048,0x8e9864,0xc8bc7e],flower:0xe3ac68,trim:0xd7ae79},
 trail:{label:'Mountain trails',kind:'scree',road:[0x4c5758,0x899795,0xc1c9bd],leaf:[0x405e54,0x769789,0xbdc5a3],flower:0xc4d8dd,trim:0x879e9e},
 valley:{label:'Forgotten Valley',kind:'weathered stone',road:[0x556052,0x929783,0xc0c4a4],leaf:[0x3a5e43,0x759460,0xb9c682],flower:0xe2cda3,trim:0xa99970}
};
function key(a){const id=String(a?.id||'').toLowerCase(),theme=String(a?.theme||'').toLowerCase();if(id.includes('forgotten'))return 'valley';if(id.includes('wish'))return 'wish';if(id.includes('vocalt')||id.includes('greedy'))return 'vocalt';if(id.includes('old-oriaris'))return 'royal';if(id.includes('tech'))return 'tech';if(theme==='past'||id.includes('past'))return 'past';if(theme==='art'||id.includes('art-district'))return 'art';if(theme==='mine'||id.includes('mining'))return 'mine';if(id.includes('trail')||id.includes('camp'))return 'trail';return 'town';}
function hash(x,y,s=0){let n=Math.imul(x|0,374761393)^Math.imul(y|0,668265263)^Math.imul(s|0,1274126177);n=Math.imul(n^(n>>>13),1274126177);return ((n^(n>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296;}
function rect(g,c,x,y,w,h,a=1){if(w>0&&h>0)g.fillStyle(c,a).fillRect(Math.floor(x),Math.floor(y),Math.floor(w),Math.floor(h));}
function line(g,c,x,y,u,v,a=1,w=1){g.lineStyle(w,c,a).lineBetween(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(u),Math.round(v));}
function stone(g,x,y,w,h,p,r,a=.65){rect(g,p[0],x+1,y+1,w-2,h-1,a);rect(g,p[1],x+2,y,w-4,h-2,a);rect(g,p[1],x+1,y+1,w-2,h-3,a);rect(g,p[2],x+2,y,w-5,1,a*.8);if(r>.58)rect(g,p[2],x+2,y+2,2,1,a*.55);if(r>.84)rect(g,p[0],x+w-4,y+2,1,h-4,a*.65);}
function roadTile(g,x,y,k,edge=0){const p=profiles[k],r=hash(x,y,91),X=x*32,Y=y*32;
 if(['past','wish','trail'].includes(k)){for(let i=0;i<5;i++){let xx=X+3+Math.floor(hash(x,y,21+i)*24),yy=Y+3+Math.floor(hash(x,y,35+i)*24);if(k==='trail'&&i<2)stone(g,xx,yy,6+i,4,p.road,r,.43);else{rect(g,p.road[0],xx,yy+1,3+(i%3),1,.38);rect(g,p.road[2],xx,yy,2+i%2,1,.43);}}}
 else {const w=k==='tech'?16:k==='royal'?16:10,h=k==='tech'?16:8;for(let row=0;row<32/h;row++){const off=k==='tech'?0:((y*32/h+row)%2)*Math.floor(w/2);for(let col=-off;col<32;col+=w){const a=Math.max(0,col),b=Math.min(32,col+w),rw=b-a;if(rw<4)continue;const n=hash(x*32+col,Y+row*h,4);if(n<.19)continue;stone(g,X+a,Y+row*h,rw,h,p.road,n,k==='tech'?.24:.32);}}}
 // Native-pixel curbs only follow a road's logical boundary, not every tile.
 const d=p.road[0],l=p.road[2];if(edge&1){rect(g,d,X,Y,32,2,.48);rect(g,l,X,Y+2,32,1,.55);}if(edge&2){rect(g,d,X+30,Y,2,32,.48);rect(g,l,X+29,Y,1,32,.42);}if(edge&4){rect(g,d,X,Y+30,32,2,.46);rect(g,l,X,Y+29,32,1,.42);}if(edge&8){rect(g,d,X,Y,2,32,.48);rect(g,l,X+2,Y,1,32,.55);}
 if(k==='art'&&r>.94){const cx=X+16,cy=Y+16;for(let i=0;i<5;i++){rect(g,p.trim,cx-5+i,cy+i,11-i*2,1,.55);rect(g,p.trim,cx-5+i,cy-i,11-i*2,1,.55);}rect(g,p.road[2],cx-1,cy-1,3,3,.55);}
}
function tuft(g,x,y,p,r,flower=false){rect(g,p.leaf[0],x-5,y+1,12,2,.32);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const dx=-4+i*3,h=3+Math.floor(hash(x+i,y,88)*7);rect(g,p.leaf[0],x+dx,y-h+1,2,h,.78);rect(g,p.leaf[1],x+dx,y-h+1,1,h-1,.92);rect(g,p.leaf[2],x+dx+(i%2?1:-1),y-h,2,2,.76);}if(flower){rect(g,p.flower,x-3,y-9,3,2,.93);rect(g,p.flower,x+4,y-6,3,2,.88);rect(g,0xffe7ad,x-2,y-8,1,1,.94);}}
function groundTile(g,x,y,k,nearRoad){const p=profiles[k],X=x*32,Y=y*32,r=hash(x,y,88),grove=(Math.sin(x*.51+y*.19)+Math.sin(y*.69-x*.31)+2)/4;
 if(r<.28+grove*.31){let xx=X+7+Math.floor(hash(x,y,12)*17),yy=Y+8+Math.floor(hash(x,y,13)*16);if(k==='mine'||k==='trail')stone(g,xx-3,yy,5+Math.floor(r*8),4,p.leaf,r,.71);else if(k==='tech'){rect(g,p.leaf[0],xx-2,yy,9,2,.5);rect(g,p.leaf[1],xx-1,yy-3,6,3,.65);rect(g,p.leaf[2],xx,yy-4,3,1,.7);}else tuft(g,xx,yy,p,r,r<.14&&grove>.48);}
 if(nearRoad&&hash(x,y,71)<.36){const xx=X+8+Math.floor(hash(x,y,72)*15),yy=Y+6+Math.floor(hash(x,y,73)*18);stone(g,xx,yy,5,3,p.road,r,.55);}
}
function roof(g,b,a){const k=key(a),x=b.x*32-5,y=b.y*32,w=b.w*32+10,h=Math.round(b.h*32*((b.floors??1)===2?.4:.55));if(w<34||h<16||!Number.isFinite(b.color))return;const base=b.color,shade=(d)=>{const ch=j=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,((base>>j)&255)+d));return (ch(16)<<16)|(ch(8)<<8)|ch(0)};const hi=shade(48),mid=shade(18),dark=shade(-48);for(let row=0,yy=y+6;yy+7<y+h-3;yy+=9,row++){const off=row%2?6:0;for(let xx=x+off+3;xx+7<x+w-3;xx+=12){const n=hash(xx,yy,71);rect(g,shade(Math.round((n-.5)*20)),xx,yy+1,8,5,.75);rect(g,hi,xx,yy,8,1,.64);rect(g,dark,xx,yy+6,9,1,.7);if(n>.66)rect(g,mid,xx+1,yy+2,3,1,.86);if(n<.17)rect(g,dark,xx+7,yy+2,1,2,.66);}}// Eave edge, drainage, and small metal fasteners on the already-existing roof.
rect(g,dark,x+3,y+h-6,w-6,2,.56);rect(g,hi,x+3,y+h-7,w-6,1,.54);for(let xx=x+8;xx<x+w-8;xx+=21){rect(g,shade(-35),xx,y+h-5,2,2,.62);rect(g,hi,xx,y+h-5,1,1,.6);}if(k==='mine')for(let xx=x+10;xx<x+w-10;xx+=28)rect(g,0x9eb3ae,xx,y+4,2,2,.54);}
function court(g,b,a,k){const p=profiles[k],cx=(b.door+.5)*32,y=(b.y+b.h)*32;if(!Number.isFinite(cx)||!Number.isFinite(y)||cx<0||y+18>=a.h*32)return;const safe=(px,py)=>!a.isTileBlocked?.(Math.floor(px/32),Math.floor(py/32))&&!a.warpAt?.(Math.floor(px/32),Math.floor(py/32));
 // Separate stone sill, stair treads and threshold in front of an existing door.
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const w=32+i*6,yy=y+3+i*5;if(!safe(cx,yy)||!safe(cx-w/2,yy)||!safe(cx+w/2-1,yy))continue;rect(g,p.road[0],cx-w/2,yy,w,5,.68);rect(g,p.road[1],cx-w/2+1,yy,w-2,3,.68);rect(g,p.road[2],cx-w/2+2,yy,w-4,1,.8);}
}
function finishWorld(g,a){if(!a||!Number.isFinite(a.w)||!Number.isFinite(a.h))return;const k=key(a),p=profiles[k],blocked=new Uint8Array(a.w*a.h);function mask(o,pad){for(let y=Math.max(0,Math.floor(o.y-pad));y<Math.min(a.h,Math.ceil(o.y+o.h+pad));y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,Math.floor(o.x-pad));x<Math.min(a.w,Math.ceil(o.x+o.w+pad));x++)blocked[y*a.w+x]=1;}
 for(const b of a.buildings||[])mask(b,1);for(const o of a.obstacles||[])mask(o,0);for(const w of a.warps||[])mask(w,1);
 const road=(x,y)=>x>=0&&y>=0&&x<a.w&&y<a.h&&!!a.isRoad?.(x,y);
 for(let y=1;y<a.h-1;y++)for(let x=1;x<a.w-1;x++){if(blocked[y*a.w+x]||a.isTileBlocked?.(x,y))continue;const edge=(!road(x,y-1)?1:0)|(!road(x+1,y)?2:0)|(!road(x,y+1)?4:0)|(!road(x-1,y)?8:0);if(road(x,y))roadTile(g,x,y,k,edge);else if(hash(x,y,14)>.19)groundTile(g,x,y,k,edge!==15);}
 for(const b of a.buildings||[])court(g,b,a,k);
 // Water receives layered shore reflection on the existing water footprint only.
 for(const o of a.obstacles||[]){if(!['pond','fountain'].includes(o.kind)||o.w<1||o.h<1)continue;const X=o.x*32,Y=o.y*32,W=o.w*32,H=o.h*32;for(let i=0;i<Math.min(40,Math.floor(W*H/240));i++){const u=X+7+Math.floor(hash(o.x,i,22)*Math.max(1,W-15)),v=Y+7+Math.floor(hash(o.y,i,28)*Math.max(1,H-15));rect(g,0x274c56,u,v+1,Math.min(6,X+W-u-5),1,.36);rect(g,0xbcd6ce,u,v,Math.min(5,X+W-u-5),1,.46);}}
}
function room(g,s){if(!s||!Number.isFinite(s.w)||!Number.isFinite(s.h))return;const W=s.w*32,H=s.h*32,items=s.items||[],open=(x,y)=>!items.some(i=>x>=i.x*32-3&&x<(i.x+i.w)*32+3&&y>=i.y*32-3&&y<(i.y+i.h)*32+3);const floor=s.floor||'stone',wood=floor==='wood',carpet=floor==='carpet';
 for(let y=76;y<H-22;y+=wood?8:16)for(let x=12;x<W-12;x+=wood?20:16){if(!open(x,y)||hash(x,y,82)<.48)continue;if(wood){rect(g,0x332a25,x,y+3,6+Math.floor(hash(x,y,6)*9),1,.12);rect(g,0xf9d3a2,x+2,y+2,5,1,.16);}else if(carpet){rect(g,0xffddb1,x,y,2,1,.19);}else{rect(g,0xffffff,x,y,4,1,.18);rect(g,0x252a2a,x+1,y+3,3,1,.14);}}
 // Local contact shadows drawn before furniture; no room layout changes.
 for(const i of items){if(!Number.isFinite(i.x)||!Number.isFinite(i.y)||i.y<2||i.w<=0||i.h<=0||/rug|carpet|floor|window/i.test(i.k||''))continue;const x=i.x*32,y=(i.y+i.h)*32,w=i.w*32;if(y>H-6||x<6||x+w>W-6)continue;rect(g,0x17232a,x+3,y-2,w-2,6,.16);rect(g,0x17232a,x+7,y+4,w-8,2,.09);}
}
const runtime=new WeakMap();function clear(sc){const s=runtime.get(sc);if(s){s.g?.destroy();runtime.delete(sc);}}
function motion(sc,time){if(!sc?.area||!sc.player||!sc.add?.graphics)return;let s=runtime.get(sc);if(s?.id!==sc.area.id){clear(sc);s=null;}if(!s){s={id:sc.area.id,g:sc.add.graphics().setDepth(.25),next:0};runtime.set(sc,s);}if(time<s.next)return;s.next=time+100;const g=s.g;g.clear();if(sc.inside||sc.switching||key(sc.area)==='valley')return;const cam=sc.cameras?.main?.worldView;if(!cam)return;const minutes=sc.store?.game?.minutes??720,night=minutes<360||minutes>1140,p=profiles[key(sc.area)];let count=0;
 for(const o of sc.area.obstacles||[]){let X=o.x*32,Y=o.y*32,W=o.w*32,H=o.h*32;if(X+W<cam.x-32||Y+H<cam.y-32||X>cam.right+32||Y>cam.bottom+32)continue;if(['pond','fountain'].includes(o.kind)){for(let j=0;j<Math.min(8,Math.floor(W*H/300));j++){const phase=(time*.00037+hash(o.x,j,9))%1,u=X+8+Math.floor(hash(o.y,j,7)*Math.max(1,W-18)),v=Y+9+Math.floor(hash(o.x,j,13)*Math.max(1,H-18)),w=3+Math.floor(phase*7);if(u+w<X+W-5)rect(g,night?0x9db9dc:0xe0f5dc,u,v,w,1,.18*Math.sin(phase*Math.PI));}}else if(['tree','pine'].includes(o.kind)&&!night&&count++<32){const x=X+W*.5,y=Y+H-2;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const u=(time*.0006+hash(o.x,j,12))%1;rect(g,p.leaf[2],x+Math.sin(u*5+j)*6,y+u*16,2,1,.38*Math.sin(u*Math.PI));}}}
}
root.LQ91Art=Object.freeze({profiles,key,hash,roadTile,groundTile,roof,court,finishWorld,room,motion,clear});
})(globalThis);

</script>
