          if (status === 'inappropriate') choices = beginner
            ? ["Please speak kindly. We can talk about something else.", "I don't like those words. Please be respectful."]
            : ["I'd rather we spoke to each other with a little respect.", "Those words don't sit well with me. Could we speak a little more kindly?", "I would rather not go there. We can talk if we keep it respectful."];
          else if (status === 'unclear') choices = ["I'm not quite following. Could you say that another way?", "I may have missed your meaning. Could you explain a little more?"];
          else choices = lqNpcSubtextLines[beginner ? 'plain' : lqNpcSubtextRole(npc)];
          const recent = (Array.isArray(history) ? history : []).slice(-16).map(x => String(x?.text || '').trim());
          return choices.find(line => !recent.includes(line)) || choices[0];
        }
        function lqNpcTopicReply(reply, status, npc, history = [], level) {
          // Soft refusals still need a comprehensible boundary. Do not mistake a metaphor for noncompliance.
          const voice = String(reply || '').replace(/[‘’]/g,"'");
          const boundary = /\b(?:different (?:subject|topic)|another subject|outside my|out of my|beyond my|not (?:really )?(?:my (?:field|area|job|specialty|expertise)|the right person|an expert|sure)|i (?:do not|don't|cannot|can't) (?:know|help|answer|discuss|solve|take on|do that)|i(?:'m| am) not (?:sure|the right person|an expert|the one)|i wish i (?:knew|could help)|i(?:'d| would) (?:rather|leave)|rather not|someone (?:else|who knows|better qualified|with the right skills)|better luck|better person|better suited|better with|my (?:skills|talents) (?:stop|end)|won't help me with that|but not that|not every path|different shelf|leave that to|need someone|can't put on the menu|no answers to that|has limits|stick to what i know|not one for|leave .* to|not something i|isn't my|not my field|(?:a bit|too) hard for me|not my strong suit|not my cup of tea|not something i can|out of my depth)\b/i;
          const respect = /\b(?:rather (?:not|we spoke)|do not|don't (?:like|appreciate|want)|not comfortable|keep (?:it|things|our conversation) (?:kind|respectful|appropriate)|please (?:be|stay|speak)|speak (?:kindly|respectfully|a little more kindly)|respect|don't sit well|not (?:okay|acceptable)|kindness|better words|no need for|not welcome|won't (?:discuss|talk|accept))\b/i;
          if (status === 'off_topic' && !boundary.test(voice)) return lqNpcSubtextFallback(status,npc,history,level);
          if (status === 'inappropriate' && !respect.test(voice) && !boundary.test(voice)) return lqNpcSubtextFallback(status,npc,history,level);
          if (status === 'topic_shift') {
            // A meaningful transition can be implicit. Remove a redundant stock announcement only.
            return reply.replace(/^\s*(?:oh[,!]?\s*)?(?:a new topic|a different subject|a change of subject)[!.]\s*/i,'').trim() || reply;
          }
          return reply;
        }
        // Narrow offline rules: identify explicit requests for unrelated assistant-like work,
        // not ordinary mentions of school, computers, art, money, animals or other interests.
        function lqNpcOfflineOutside(message) {
          const q = String(message).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/đ/gi,'d').toLowerCase();
          return /\b(?:write|generate|give me|show me|create|debug|fix)\b[^.!?]{0,75}\b(?:source code|python code|javascript code|html code|a python (?:program|script)|a program in python|a sql query|a computer program)\b/.test(q)
            || /\b(?:solve|calculate|work out|do)\b[^.!?]{0,65}\b(?:my homework|my math problem|this equation|the equation|this algebra problem|this integral)\b/.test(q)
            || /^(?:what is|what's|calculate|solve|tinh)\s+\d+(?:\s*[+*/×÷-]\s*\d+)+\s*[?=.!]*$/.test(q)
            || /\b(?:viet|tao|sua)\s+(?:cho (?:toi|minh)\s+)?(?:ma nguon|code|chuong trinh python)\b/.test(q)
            || /\b(?:giai|lam)\s+(?:cho (?:toi|minh)\s+)?(?:bai tap toan|bai toan|phuong trinh|bai tap ve nha)\b/.test(q);
        }

var LQ78Meaning=(()=>{

 function last(history){return [...(history||[])].reverse().find(x=>x.role==='npc')?.text||'';}

 // V78.1: distinguish information, actual action, and quoted/conditional examples.
 function speechAct(input){const q=normalize(input).replace(/\bdont\b/g,"don't").replace(/\bcant\b/g,"can't").replace(/\bwont\b/g,"won't");
  const corrected=q.split(/(?:[.!;]\s*|,\s*|\s+)(?:actually|on second thought|rather|instead|i mean)\b[:,]?\s*/).filter(Boolean);
  const text=corrected.at(-1)||q;
  const reported=/\b(?:he|she|they|my friend|my teacher|the customer|sam) (?:said|asked|wrote|told me)\b|\b(?:as an example|for example|example sentence|in a sentence|repeat after me|how do i say)\b/.test(q)||/^\s*["“].+["”]\s*[.!?]*$/.test(q);
  const hypothetical=/\b(?:if i (?:buy|bought|want|wanted|need|needed|send|sent|were|had)|if someone|in theory|in a story|let's say|supposing|what would happen|would you .* if|could you .* if)\b/.test(text);
  const denial=/\b(?:not (?:going to|ready to|planning to|buying|ordering|sending|booking|asking for)|no longer|changed my mind|cancel (?:my|the|that)|not really|don['’]?t (?:actually |really )?(?:want|need|intend|plan)|not interested)\b/.test(text)||rx.neg.test(text);
  const info=/\b(?:want to know|would like to know|need to know|tell me (?:about|how|whether|if|what|why|a story about|the meaning of)|explain (?:how|what|why)|wonder (?:how|whether|if|what)|how (?:do|would|could|can) (?:i|someone|people) (?:buy|order|send|book|get)|what (?:does|do|is|are)|why (?:do|would|should|can)|where (?:can|do|could) i (?:buy|send|get|find)|can you explain|do you (?:sell|have|offer))\b/.test(text);
  const direct=/^(?:please\s+)?(?:i(?:'d| would) like|i (?:want|need|will take|wish to|would love)|i'll take|i'd love|can i|could i|may i|let me|please|could you|would you|can you)\b/.test(text)||/^(?:one|two|three|a|an)\s+.{1,45}\bplease[.!?]*$/.test(text);
  const bare=/^(?:buy|send|order|book|stamp|coffee|tea|letter|parcel|ticket|room)[.!?]*$/.test(text);
  const challenge=/\b(?:ignore|forget|override|bypass)\b.{0,55}\b(?:instructions|rules|mission|quest|system)\b|\b(?:give|grant|award|add) (?:me )?(?:unlimited|infinite|\d{3,}) (?:coins|money|gold|reputation)\b|\b(?:all|every) (?:missions?|quests?) (?:are|is|have been) (?:done|completed)\b/.test(q);
  return {text,corrected:corrected.length>1,reported,hypothetical,denial,info,direct,bare,challenge};

 function localIntent(npc,history,input){const a=classify(npc,history,input);return a;}
 function storyEligible(npc,history,input){const a=classify(npc,history,input);return !(a.neg||a.hyp||a.quote||a.injection||a.sarcasm||a.hostile||a.outside||a.act.bare||a.act.info||a.act.denial||a.act.reported)&&a.q.split(/\s+/).length>=3;}

 }
 function offline(npc,history,input,wasDone,ctx){const a=classify(npc,history,input),q=a.q,role=lqNpcSubtextRole(npc),short=String(npc?.name||'Resident').split(' (')[0];const make=(reply,mood,topicStatus='smalltalk',affinityDelta=0)=>({reply,mood,topicStatus,affinityDelta,goalDone:false,remember:'',correction:cr(input),replySource:'Offline rules'});

        function jt(response, wasDone, npc, history = [], level = (typeof cefrService !== "undefined" ? cefrService.getLevel() : "B1")) {
          const parsed = lqNpcExtractJson(response);
          const failLine = 'Sorry, could you say that again?';
          if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            // Plain prose is allowed. Corrupted JSON and code never reach the player.
            return {
              reply: lqNpcSafeText(response, failLine),
              correction: '',
              goalDone: false,
              remember: '',
              affinityDelta: 0,
            };
          }
          const status = lqNpcTopicStatuses.has(parsed.topicStatus) ? parsed.topicStatus : '';
          const safeReply = lqNpcSafeText(parsed.reply, failLine);
          const ok = safeReply !== failLine;
          const reply = ok ? lqNpcTopicReply(safeReply, status, npc, history, level) : safeReply;
          const cleanExtra = (x) => lqNpcSafeText(x, '').slice(0, 180);
          const delta = Number(parsed.affinityDelta);
          const mood = ok && lqNpcMoods.has(parsed.mood) ? parsed.mood : '';
          return {
            reply,
            topicStatus: status,
            mood,
            replySource: cleanExtra(parsed.replySource),
            moodSource: cleanExtra(parsed.moodSource),
            notice: cleanExtra(parsed.notice),
            correction: cleanExtra(parsed.correction),
            vietnameseTip: cleanExtra(parsed.vietnameseTip),
            naturalAlternative: cleanExtra(parsed.naturalAlternative),
            vocabulary: cleanExtra(parsed.vocabulary).slice(0, 90),
            remember: ok ? cleanExtra(parsed.remember).slice(0, 130) : '',
            goalDone: ok && !wasDone && (status==='relevant'||status==='topic_shift') && parsed.goalDone === true,
            affinityDelta:
              ok && Number.isFinite(delta) ? Math.max(-3, Math.min(3, Math.round(delta))) : 0,
          };
        }

            async generate(e,signal) {

              if (!t.ok) {

                // can tell a rate limit apart from a network hiccup.
                let err = Error(await this.explainError(t));

                  n?.finishReason ? `Empty answer (${n.finishReason})` : `Empty answer from Gemini`,
                );

              // If a model rejects it (400 mentioning "think"), generate() retries once without it.
              let think = t ? window.LQGemini.thinkingConfig(this.model) : null;
              let n = {
                ...e.generationConfig,

              };
              return this.viaProxy
                ? fetch(Pt, {
                    method: `POST`,

            async pickModel() {

            }
            async explainError(e) {
              let t = ``;
              this.lastRetryAfterSec = 0;
              try {
                let body = (await e.json()).error ?? {};
                t = body.message ?? ``;
                // A 429 usually carries RetryInfo with a delay like "23s".
                let info = (body.details ?? []).find((d) => /RetryInfo/.test(d?.[`@type`] ?? ``));
                let secs = parseFloat(info?.retryDelay ?? ``);
                if (Number.isFinite(secs) && secs > 0) this.lastRetryAfterSec = Math.ceil(secs);
              } catch {}
              return e.status === 429
                ? `Free-tier limit reached. Wait a minute and try again.`
                : e.status === 400 && /api key/i.test(t)
                  ? `The API key is not valid.`
                  : e.status === 403

        function __lqStreetArtBuilding(g, b) {
          if (window.LQArtV69?.facade?.(g,b)) { window.LQArtV71?.accentFacade?.(g,b); return; }
          if (window.LQArtV68?.facade) { window.LQArtV68.facade(g, b); window.LQArtV71?.accentFacade?.(g,b); return; }
          if (window.LQArtV67?.facade) { window.LQArtV67.facade(g, b); return; }
          const x = b.x * 32, y = b.y * 32, w = b.w * 32, h = b.h * 32;
          const roof = Math.round(h * 0.48), frontY = y + roof, wallH = h - roof;
          const ink = 0x252b33, concrete = b.wall || 0x82878c;

        function __lqFreightShed(g, b) {

        function __lqPaintArtBase(g, t) {
          const W = t.w, H = t.h, T = 32;
          const rnd = pn(20261106);
          const base = [0x565d65, 0x60676e, 0x686f76, 0x50575f, 0x73797e];
          // Every tile is concrete or worn asphalt; no grass or pastoral terrain in this district.
          for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {

            g.fillStyle(0x30363d, 0.18).fillRect(x*T + 2, y*T + 2, 28, 1);

          }

          // These are floor decorations only; no collision or pathfinding tiles are changed.
          const plazaX = 35*T, plazaY = 23*T;

        function Un(e, t, n) {

              ),

              return this.primary.label;
            }
            // Rate-limit cool-down: after a 429 every Gemini call is skipped until this time (ms), so the free quota
            // is not burnt on requests that would fail anyway. NPCs answer offline meanwhile.
            coolUntil = 0;
            coolSecondsLeft() {
              return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((this.coolUntil - Date.now()) / 1e3));
            }
            noteError(err) {
              if (err && err.status === 429) {
                let secs = Math.min(120, Math.max(20, err.retryAfterSec || 30));
                this.coolUntil = Date.now() + secs * 1e3;
              }
            }
            // Only network problems, timeouts and server errors (5xx) are worth one more try. A 429, a bad key or a
            // blocked request fails again straight away and only costs another request.
            isRetryable(err) {
              let s = err && err.status;
              return !s || s >= 500;
            }
            async offlineWithNotice(e, t, n, r, i, notice) {
              let o = await this.fallback.respond(e, t, n, r, i);
              try {
                o && typeof o == `object` && (o.notice = notice + (o.notice ? ` | ${o.notice}` : ``), o.replySource = `Offline rules`);
              } catch {}
              return o;
            }
            restingNotice() {
              return `The AI is resting for about ${this.coolSecondsLeft()}s (free Gemini limit reached), so this reply is offline. You can keep chatting.`;
            }
            async respond(e, t, n, r, i) {
              if (this.coolSecondsLeft() > 0) return this.offlineWithNotice(e, t, n, r, i, this.restingNotice());
              try {
                return await this.primary.respond(e, t, n, r, i);
              } catch (first) {
                 if(i.lq107Signal?.aborted)throw first;
                let err = first;
                if (this.isRetryable(first)) {
                  try {
                    await new Promise((e) => setTimeout(e, 500));
                     if(i.lq107Signal?.aborted)throw i.lq107Signal.reason;
                    return await this.primary.respond(e, t, n, r, i);
                  } catch (second) {
                    err = second;
                  }
                }
                 if(i.lq107Signal?.aborted)throw err;
                console.error(`[LIFEQUEST] Gemini error:`, err);
                this.noteError(err);
                let notice =
                  err && err.status === 429
                    ? this.restingNotice()
                    : `Gemini error: ${(err && err.message) || err}. Open Settings > Test to check your key.`;
                return this.offlineWithNotice(e, t, n, r, i, notice);
              }
            }
            async greet(e, t) {
              if (!this.primary.greet || this.coolSecondsLeft() > 0) return ``;
              try {
                return await this.primary.greet(e, t);
              } catch (err) {
                this.noteError(err);
                throw err;
              }
            }
            async summarize(e, t, n, r) {
              if (!this.primary.summarize || this.coolSecondsLeft() > 0) return ``;
              try {
                return await this.primary.summarize(e, t, n, r);
              } catch (err) {
                this.noteError(err);
                throw err;
              }
            }
            async check(e) {
              try {
                if (this.primary.check) return await this.primary.check(e);
              } catch {}
              return this.fallback.check(e);
            }
            explain(e) {
              return this.primary.explain(e);
            }
          };
        async function fr() {
          return window.LQGemini.proxyAvailable();
        }
        async function pr(e = vt()) {
          return e.geminiKey
            ? new dr(new Rt(e.geminiKey, e.geminiModel), new lr())
            : (await fr())
              ? new dr(new Rt(``, e.geminiModel, !0), new lr())
              : [`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, ``].includes(location.hostname) &&
                  (await ur.isAvailable())
                ? new dr(new ur(), new lr())
                : new lr();
        }

        const LQ9 = (() => {

          const PI = Math.PI,

          const hash = (x, y, z = 0) => {
            let n =
              (Math.imul(x | 0, 374761393) +

          } // Rendered after furniture into the cached indoor texture.
          function drawInterior(g, s) {
            const W = s.w * 32,
              H = s.h * 32;
            const isMine =
              s.floor === 'stone' ||
              s.floor === 'mine' ||
              s.items.some((i) => ['orepile', 'crystal', 'forge', 'minecart'].includes(i.k));
            // Wall architecture and baseboards that enhance depth without changing obstacles.
            for (let x = 9; x < W - 9; x += 32) {
              rect(g, x, 54, 24, 2, 0xfff0d2, 0.17);
              rect(g, x + 3, 58, 13, 1, 0x352a38, 0.18);
            }
            // Decorative wall lamps, translucent shafts, artistic floor reflections.
            for (let x = 45; x < W - 40; x += 112) {
              if (s.items.some((i) => i.y < 2 && i.x * 32 < x + 12 && i.x * 32 + i.w * 32 > x - 12))
                continue;
              oval(g, x, 46, 26, 14, 0xffe5ad, 0.21);
              rect(g, x - 5, 44, 10, 4, 0x9b7c51, 0.68);
              rect(g, x - 2, 40, 4, 6, 0xffeebc, 0.89);
              g.fillStyle(0xffdf97, 0.028).fillTriangle(
                x - 13,
                62,
                x + 13,
                62,
                x + 68,
                Math.min(H - 18, 158),
              );
              g.fillStyle(0xffe2a0, 0.026).fillTriangle(
                x - 13,
                62,
                x + 68,
                Math.min(H - 18, 158),
                x - 68,
                Math.min(H - 18, 158),
              );
            }
            // Carpet stitches, marble highlights, scattered small artistic floor mosaics.
            for (let row = 3; row < s.h - 1; row++)
              for (let cx = 1; cx < s.w - 1; cx++) {
                if (hash(cx, row, s.w) < 0.79) continue;
                let x = cx * 32 + hash(cx, row, 9) * 18 + 4,
                  y = row * 32 + hash(cx, row, 7) * 18 + 4;
                rect(g, x, y, 2, 1, isMine ? 0x96e9e0 : 0xfff6dd, 0.11);
              }
            for (const it of s.items) {
              const x = it.x * 32,
                y = it.y * 32,
                w = it.w * 32,
                h = it.h * 32,
                cx = x + w / 2;
              if (it.k === 'table' || it.k === 'desk' || it.k === 'counter') {
                if (w >= 60) {
                  // Individually shaded mugs and paperwork; no change to physical collision.
                  rect(g, x + 11, y + 8, 14, 10, 0xf8e6c5, 0.79);
                  line(g, x + 13, y + 11, x + 21, y + 11, 0x7e90a2, 0.59);
                  oval(g, x + w - 20, y + 10, 12, 9, 0xffedce, 0.87);
                  oval(g, x + w - 20, y + 9, 7, 5, 0x765142, 0.85);
                  rect(g, x + 3, y + 2, w - 6, 2, 0xffffff, 0.2);
                }
              } else if (it.k === 'sofa') {
                for (let k = 0; k < it.w; k++) {
                  const tx = x + k * 32 + 9;
                  rect(g, tx, y + 11, 15, 12, 0xffefd8, 0.19);
                  rect(g, tx + 3, y + 12, 3, 2, 0xffeacc, 0.34);
                }
              } else if (it.k === 'bed' || it.k === 'hospbed') {
                rect(g, x + 8, y + 12, 12, 4, 0xffffff, 0.42);
                rect(g, x + w - 15, y + h - 20, 9, 8, 0xffffff, 0.18);
              } else if (it.k === 'shelf' || it.k === 'goods') {
                for (let k = 0; k < Math.max(2, Math.floor(w / 18)); k++) {
                  rect(
                    g,
                    x + 6 + k * 16,
                    y + 6,
                    4,
                    10,
                    [0xffdf87, 0x75c4ae, 0xffb0a3, 0x7db2df][k % 4],
                    0.62,
                  );
                }
              } else if (it.k === 'plant') {
                oval(g, cx - 6, y + 10, 12, 7, 0xd8ffae, 0.45);
              } else if (
                it.k === 'crystal' ||
                it.k === 'forge' ||
                it.k === 'fireplace' ||
                it.k === 'lantern'
              ) {
                const warm = ['forge', 'fireplace', 'lantern'].includes(it.k),
                  color = warm ? 0xffb66f : 0x7bffee;
                for (let r = 2; r >= 1; r--) oval(g, cx, y + h / 2, 60 * r, 45 * r, color, 0.026);
                for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++)
                  rect(g, cx - 20 + j * 10, y + 7 + (j % 2) * 5, 2, 3, color, 0.5);
              } else if (it.k === 'stairs') {
                for (let sy = y + 6; sy < y + h - 6; sy += 9) {
                  rect(g, x + 5, sy, w - 10, 2, 0xffffff, 0.22);
                  rect(g, x + 8, sy + 2, w - 16, 1, 0x111b2e, 0.35);
                }
              }
            }
            // Architectural trim and vignette: corners are richer, central walk area stays clear.
            rect(g, 6, H - 6, W - 12, 3, 0xffe9c4, 0.12);
            rect(g, 7, 67, 3, H - 74, 0x16202b, 0.23);
            rect(g, W - 10, 67, 3, H - 74, 0x16202b, 0.23);
            for (const x of [18, W - 24])
              for (const y of [81, H - 25])
                oval(g, x, y, 14, 14, isMine ? 0x7bf2e4 : 0xffd4a1, 0.05);
            window.LQWorldV15?.interior(g, s);
            if (window.LQArtV69?.paintInterior?.(g, s)) {}
            else if (window.LQArtV68?.paintInterior) window.LQArtV68.paintInterior(g, s);
            else window.LQArtV67?.paintInterior(g, s);
            window.LQArtV74?.paintInterior?.(g, s);
          }
          const lightColor = (scene) => (mine(scene.area) ? 0x8df6ff : 0xffe8ad);
          const destroy = (scene) => {
            const arr = scene.__lq9Visuals || [];
            for (const v of arr)
              try {
                v.node.destroy();
              } catch {}
            scene.__lq9Visuals = [];
          };
          const quality = () => {
            try {
              let x = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lifequest_v8_preferences') || '{}');
              return x.performance === 'low' ? 0 : x.performance === 'high' ? 2 : 1;
            } catch {
              return 1;
            }
          };
          function createLights(scene) {
            destroy(scene);
            if (quality() === 0) return;
            const inside = scene.inside;
            const spots = [];
            if (inside) {
              const unit = 32 * inside.k;
              for (const it of inside.spec.items || []) {
                if (
                  ![
                    'forge',
                    'fireplace',
                    'lantern',
                    'crystal',
                    'stove',
                    'cakecase',
                    'screen',
                    'portal',
                  ].includes(it.k)
                )
                  continue;
                if (spots.length >= 13) break;
                spots.push({
                  x: Yr + (it.x + it.w / 2) * unit,
                  y: Xr + (it.y + it.h / 2) * unit,
                  color: ['forge', 'fireplace', 'stove', 'cakecase'].includes(it.k)
                    ? 0xffad54
                    : 0x7feddc,
                  interior: true,
                });
              }
              for (let i = 1; i < inside.spec.w - 1; i += 4) {
                if (spots.length >= 16) break;
                spots.push({
                  x: Yr + (i + 0.5) * unit,
                  y: Xr + 1.7 * unit,
                  color: 0xffd08c,
                  interior: true,
                  window: true,
                });
              }
            } else {
              const max = scene.area.theme === 'art' ? (quality() === 2 ? 20 : 12) : (quality() === 2 ? 17 : 10);
              const buildings = [...scene.area.buildings].sort((a, b) => b.w * b.h - a.w * a.h);
              for (const b of buildings) {
                if (spots.length >= max) break;
                spots.push({
                  x: b.door * 32 + 16,
                  y: (b.y + b.h) * 32 - 25,
                  color: scene.area.theme === 'art' ? [0xff4f87,0x35c8d0,0xffd447,0x9470e8][spots.length % 4] : lightColor(scene),
                  interior: false,
                });
              }
              for (const o of scene.area.obstacles) {
                if (o.kind !== 'lamp' || spots.length >= max + 7) continue;
                spots.push({
                  x: (o.x + 0.5) * 32,
                  y: (o.y + 0.3) * 32,
                  color: 0xffed9e,
                  interior: false,
                });
              }
            }
            const glows = [];
            for (const s of spots) {
              // Soft light pools are rendered above the night tint, but behind UI.
              const radius = s.window ? 40 : s.interior ? 58 : 42;
              const a = scene.add
                .circle(s.x, s.y, radius, s.color, 0.055)
                .setDepth(s.interior ? 4 : 51)
                .setBlendMode(Y.BlendModes.ADD);
              const b = scene.add
                .circle(s.x, s.y, Math.max(9, radius * 0.35), s.color, 0.095)
                .setDepth(s.interior ? 4 : 51)
                .setBlendMode(Y.BlendModes.ADD);
              scene.__lq9Visuals.push({ node: a }, { node: b });
              glows.push({
                a,
                b,
                x: s.x,
                y: s.y,
                phase: hash(s.x | 0, s.y | 0) * 6.28,
                color: s.color,
                interior: s.interior,
              });
            }
            // A tiny pool of luminous fireflies (English Town) or floating ore motes (Minerals Town).
            const particles = [];
            const total = quality() === 2 ? 22 : 9;
            const rocky = mine(scene.area);
            const artistic = scene.area.theme === 'art';
            if (!inside) {
              const candidates = [];
              for (let i = 0; i < total * 8; i++) {
                const x = 32 + hash(i, 31) * Math.max(64, scene.area.w * 32 - 64);
                const y = 32 + hash(i, 72) * Math.max(64, scene.area.h * 32 - 64);
                const tx = (x / 32) | 0,
                  ty = (y / 32) | 0;
                if (tileRoad(scene.area, tx, ty) || avoid(scene.area, tx, ty)) continue;
                candidates.push({ x, y });
                if (candidates.length >= total) break;
              }
              for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                const base = candidates[i];
                const dot = scene.add
                  .circle(base.x, base.y, rocky ? 2.8 : 2, artistic ? [0xff4f87,0x35c8d0,0xffd447,0x9470e8,0x83c96b][i % 5] : rocky ? 0x85fff0 : 0xfff0a8, artistic ? 0.38 : 0.3)
                  .setDepth(51)
                  .setBlendMode(Y.BlendModes.ADD);
                scene.__lq9Visuals.push({ node: dot });
                particles.push({
                  node: dot,
                  x: base.x,
                  y: base.y,
                  p: i * 0.63 + hash(i, 3) * 3,
                  rocky,
                  art: artistic,
                });
              }
            } else if (
              inside.spec.items.some((item) => item.k === 'crystal' || item.k === 'forge')
            ) {
              for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(total, 12); i++) {
                const anchor = inside.spec.items.filter(
                  (item) => item.k === 'crystal' || item.k === 'forge',
                )[
                  i %
                    inside.spec.items.filter((item) => item.k === 'crystal' || item.k === 'forge')
                      .length
                ];
                const unit = 32 * inside.k,
                  baseX = Yr + (anchor.x + 0.5) * unit,
                  baseY = Xr + (anchor.y + 0.5) * unit;
                const dot = scene.add
                  .circle(baseX, baseY, 2.8, anchor.k === 'forge' ? 0xffb072 : 0x85fff0, 0.24)
                  .setDepth(8)
                  .setBlendMode(Y.BlendModes.ADD);
                scene.__lq9Visuals.push({ node: dot });
                particles.push({
                  node: dot,
                  x: baseX,
                  y: baseY,
                  p: i * 0.88 + hash(i, 5) * 4,
                  rocky: true,
                  interior: true,
                });
              }
            }
            scene.__lq9Particles = particles;
            scene.__lq9Glows = glows;
            scene.__lq9Tick = 0;
          }
          function tick(scene, delta) {
            if (!scene || !scene.__lq9Glows || scene.switching) return;
            const q = quality();
            if (q === 0) {
              for (const g of scene.__lq9Glows) {
                g.a.setAlpha(0);
                g.b.setAlpha(0);
              }
              return;
            }
            scene.__lq9Tick = (scene.__lq9Tick || 0) + delta;
            if (scene.__lq9Tick < 90) return;
            scene.__lq9Tick = 0;
            const t = performance.now() / 1000;
            const minute = scene.store?.game?.minutes || 720;
            const dark = minute < 360 || minute > 1080;
            for (const g of scene.__lq9Glows) {
              const fade = g.interior ? 0.6 : dark ? 1 : 0.08;
              const wave = 0.87 + 0.13 * Math.sin(t * (g.color === 0xffad54 ? 5.5 : 2) + g.phase);
              g.a.setAlpha(fade * wave * (q === 2 ? 1 : 0.65));
              g.b.setAlpha(fade * (0.87 + 0.13 * Math.cos(t * 3 + g.phase)) * (q === 2 ? 1 : 0.65));
            }
            for (const p of scene.__lq9Particles || []) {
              const alive = p.interior || p.rocky || p.art || dark;
              p.node.setVisible(alive);
              if (!alive) continue;
              const sp = t * 0.65 + p.p;
              p.node.setPosition(p.x + Math.sin(sp) * 10, p.y + Math.cos(sp * 1.3) * 8);
              p.node.setAlpha((0.28 + 0.23 * Math.sin(sp * 2)) * (q === 2 ? 1 : 0.7));
            }
          }

          function v11ArtTerrain(g, a) {

            }

            for(const [tx,ty,c] of [[17,21,0xff4f87],[48,21,0x35c8d0],[18,38,0xffd447],[49,38,0x9470e8]]) {

              line(g,x+194,y+16,x+207,y+25,0x9470e8,0.56,3);
              line(g,x+207,y+25,x+194,y+34,0x9470e8,0.56,3);

            // Tunnel floor details and warm safety lamps.
            if(a.id==='art-district') {
              const x=30*T,y=44*T,w=12*T;
              for(let yy=y+12;yy<y+12*T-8;yy+=32) {
                rect(g,x+6,yy,w-12,1,0x9aa1a7,0.22);
                rect(g,x+6,yy+2,w-12,1,0x050a10,0.32);

              for(const xx of [31,40]) {

          /* LIFEQUEST V11 - high-contrast silhouettes, material detail and readable pixel art.
   Rendered exclusively into existing cached textures, so geometry/collisions remain identical. */
          function v11Terrain(g, a) {
            if (a.theme === 'art') { v11ArtTerrain(g, a); return; }
            drawTerrain(g, a);
            const mining = mine(a);
            const W = a.w,
              H = a.h;
            for (let y = 1; y < H - 1; y++)
              for (let x = 1; x < W - 1; x++) {
                if (avoid(a, x, y)) continue;
                const p = hash(x, y, 111),
                  q = hash(x, y, 209),
                  px = x * 32,
                  py = y * 32;
                if (tileRoad(a, x, y)) {
                  // Fine aggregate, asphalt seams and restrained wear only where roads already exist.
                  if (p > 0.36) {
                    rect(
                      g,
                      px + 4 + ((q * 19) | 0),
                      py + 5 + ((p * 18) | 0),
                      3,
                      1,
                      mining ? 0xced6dc : 0xcbd1d8,
                      0.22,
                    );
                  }
                  if (p < 0.13) {
                    line(g, px + 9, py + 21, px + 15, py + 22, 0x151e2d, 0.3);
                    line(g, px + 15, py + 22, px + 19, py + 19, 0xffffff, 0.09);
                  }
                  if (p > 0.92) {
                    rect(g, px + 3, py + 3, 26, 1, 0xffffff, 0.07);
                    rect(g, px + 3, py + 4, 26, 1, 0x101825, 0.08);
                  }
                } else if (mining) {
                  // Hand-shaped angular shards and mineral streaks; visual-only.
                  if (p > 0.59) {
                    g.fillStyle(0x667d85, 0.28).fillTriangle(
                      px + 5,
                      py + 23,
                      px + 12,
                      py + 11,
                      px + 21,
                      py + 25,
                    );
                    line(g, px + 12, py + 11, px + 17, py + 20, 0xd4e9e0, 0.2);
                  }
                  if (q > 0.94) {
                    rect(g, px + 22, py + 7, 2, 6, 0x77dfd7, 0.48);
                    rect(g, px + 23, py + 6, 1, 2, 0xffffff, 0.53);
                  }
                } else {
                  if (p > 0.5) {
                    line(g, px + 8, py + 25, px + 10, py + 18, 0x28613e, 0.35);
                    line(g, px + 12, py + 25, px + 11, py + 20, 0xa8d480, 0.28);
                  }
                  if (q > 0.83) {
                    const c = [0xffd4a6, 0xf8e4a7, 0xb6dbff][((q * 100) | 0) % 3];
                    rect(g, px + 19, py + 14, 3, 3, c, 0.65);
                    rect(g, px + 20, py + 13, 1, 1, 0xffffff, 0.65);
                  }
                  if (p < 0.09) oval(g, px + 18, py + 22, 15, 6, 0x26502b, 0.1);
                }
              }
            // Kerbstones and real-world continuity. Only draw strips where an existing road meets an existing non-road tile.
            for (let y = 1; y < H - 1; y++)
              for (let x = 1; x < W - 1; x++) {
                if (!tileRoad(a, x, y) || avoid(a, x, y)) continue;
                const px = x * 32,
                  py = y * 32;
                if (!tileRoad(a, x, y - 1)) {
                  rect(g, px, py, 32, 3, mining ? 0x9f978d : 0xd8d4c7, 0.55);
                  rect(g, px, py + 3, 32, 2, 0x121921, 0.24);
                  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++)
                    rect(g, px + k * 16 + 2, py + 1, 1, 2, 0xffffff, 0.14);
                }
                if (!tileRoad(a, x - 1, y)) {
                  rect(g, px, py, 3, 32, mining ? 0x9f978d : 0xd8d4c7, 0.52);
                  rect(g, px + 3, py, 2, 32, 0x121921, 0.2);
                }
              }
          }
          function v11Landscape(g, a) {
            drawLandscape(g, a);
            for (const o of a.obstacles) {
              const x = o.x * 32,
                y = o.y * 32,
                w = Math.max(1, o.w || 1) * 32,
                h = Math.max(1, o.h || 1) * 32;
              const id = hash(o.x, o.y, 678);
              if (o.kind === 'tree' || o.kind === 'pine') {
                // A leaf cluster with asymmetric facets rather than a circular glow.
                const cx = x + w / 2,
                  cy = y + Math.min(21, h * 0.38);
                const shade = o.kind === 'pine' ? 0x184d3f : 0x245b3b;
                oval(g, cx + 4, cy + 15, Math.min(w * 0.65, 35), 10, 0x0d2a25, 0.24);

                    ? [0x376f61, 0x4e9877, 0x9ec9aa]
                    : [0x397d45, 0x69a65b, 0xb0d77d];
                for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {

                rect(g, cx + 8, cy + 1, 3, 2, 0xd8ffd0, 0.22);

                  rect(g, sx + 3, yy + 2, 12, 1, 0x1e658f, 0.27);

                rect(g, x + w * 0.5 - 3, y + 5, 6, 5, 0x493f39, 0.75);

                line(g, x + w * 0.5 - 5, y + 11, x + w * 0.5 + 5, y + 11, 0xffd58c, 0.29, 2);
              }
            }

          function v11Building(g, b, a) {
            drawBuilding(g, b, a);
            const mining = mine(a);
            const x = b.x * 32,
              y = b.y * 32,
              w = b.w * 32,
              h = b.h * 32;
            const roof = Math.round(h * ((b.floors ?? 1) === 2 ? 0.4 : 0.55));
            const n = String(b.name || '');
            const iron = /Mine|Smithy|Tool Shop|Rail Station|Station|Gem Shop/i.test(n);
            const civic = /Town Hall|Bank|Library|School|Hospital/i.test(n);
            const cafe = /Cafe|Restaurant|Hotel|Inn|Market/i.test(n);
            const timber = /House|Home|Cabin|Apartments/i.test(n);
            const edge = iron ? 0x768995 : civic ? 0xf0d4a5 : cafe ? 0xf6cfac : 0xdfc39c;
            // Roof-edge volume: highlights facing northwest; lower bevel facing southeast.
            rect(g, x + 9, y + 8, Math.max(5, w - 18), 3, edge, 0.32);
            rect(g, x + 7, y + roof - 9, Math.max(5, w - 14), 4, 0x1c2430, 0.19);

            for (let row = y + 17, k = 0; row < y + roof - 14; row += 15, k++) {
              for (let xx = x + 16 + (k % 2) * 10; xx < x + w - 14; xx += 24) {
                if (iron) {
                  rect(g, xx, row, 15, 1, edge, 0.24);
                  rect(g, xx + 2, row + 3, 1, 5, 0x0d1722, 0.15);
                } else {
                  g.lineStyle(1, edge, 0.2).lineBetween(xx, row, xx + 15, row + 2);
                  rect(g, xx + 1, row + 3, 5, 1, 0xffffff, 0.13);
                }
              }

            // Distinct facade identity with no new geometry outside building bounds.
            if (iron) {
              for (let j = 0; j < Math.min(5, b.w - 2); j++) {

              }
              rect(g, x + w * 0.23, y + roof - 7, w * 0.54, 3, 0xf3cf8a, 0.4);

                    xx,
                    y + roof * 0.65 - 6,
                    xx + 4,
                    y + roof * 0.65,

                  );
                }
            } else if (civic) {

                rect(g, xx + 5, y + roof + 11, 2, Math.max(8, h - roof - 36), 0x263042, 0.15);
              }

            let roomName = s.__lqVisualName;

            const isMedical = /hospital|first-aid|clinic/i.test(rn);
            const isEducation = /library|school/i.test(rn);

            const accentMap = {
              creative: 0xef81bf, heritage: 0xe3c494, medical: 0x80d0d7,
              education: 0xc4b18a, industrial: 0x85b4bb, food: 0xf0c388,
              civic: 0xd8c9a4, home: 0xd0b295, neutral: 0xc1c9d2,
            };
            const accent=accentMap[theme];
            const dark=theme === 'industrial' ? 0x253943 : theme === 'creative' ? 0x423753 : 0x57463d;
            // Architectural baseboards and wall panel separation under original furniture.
            rect(g, 7, 63, W-14, 3, dark, .36);
            rect(g, 7, 68, W-14, 2, accent, .30);
            rect(g, 7, 73, W-14, 2, 0xffffff, .12);
            rect(g, 8, H-15, W-16, 3, dark, .24);
            rect(g, 8, H-12, W-16, 1, accent, .16);
            // Narrow architectural border shadows and skirting: no floor-space obstruction.
            for (const px of [13,W-16]) {
              rect(g, px, 80, 3, Math.max(0,H-98), dark, .14);
              rect(g, px+1, 82, 1, Math.max(0,H-100), 0xffffff, .11);
            }
            // Wall panels with tiny material-specific marks.
            for (let px=25;px<W-25;px+=64) {
              rect(g, px, 8, 37, 2, accent, .23);
              rect(g, px+2, 12, 1, 28, dark, .16);
              rect(g, px+33, 12, 1, 28, dark, .14);
              rect(g, px+4, 42, 29, 1, accent, .20);
              if (theme==='heritage' || theme==='home') {
                rect(g,px+2,48,32,2,0xa27e59,.20);
                line(g,px+4,15,px+27,38,0x76573d,.08,1);
              } else if (theme==='creative') {
                for(let i=0;i<3;i++) rect(g,px+6+i*9,17+(i%2)*7,6,11,
                  [0xfaa0c9,0x75decf,0xf5d37b][i],.28);
              } else if (theme==='industrial') {
                rect(g,px+5,34,23,2,0xb1c5c7,.24);
                for(let i=0;i<3;i++) rect(g,px+8+i*8,18,2,2,0xf2e1bd,.35);
              } else {
                rect(g,px+6,18,24,16,accent,.06);
              }
            }
            // Signature crest/institution panel above the furnishing band.
            const crestX=W/2, crestY=31;
            oval(g,crestX,crestY,46,36,accent,.08);
            if(theme==='medical') {
              rect(g,crestX-4,crestY-15,8,30,0xf8ffff,.75);
              rect(g,crestX-15,crestY-4,30,8,0xf8ffff,.75);
              rect(g,crestX-2,crestY-13,4,26,0xc75555,.89);
              rect(g,crestX-13,crestY-2,26,4,0xc75555,.89);
            } else if(theme==='education') {
              rect(g,crestX-18,crestY-9,16,19,0xd3b987,.74);
              rect(g,crestX+2,crestY-9,16,19,0xe3cda9,.78);
              line(g,crestX,crestY-8,crestX,crestY+10,0x584a3e,.8,2);
              line(g,crestX-17,crestY-10,crestX-1,crestY-6,0xffffff,.3,1);
              line(g,crestX+1,crestY-6,crestX+17,crestY-10,0xffffff,.3,1);
            } else if(theme==='creative') {
              for(let j=0;j<4;j++) {
                const px=crestX+(j-1.5)*10;
                rect(g,px,crestY-12+j%2*4,7,19,
                  [0xffbc66,0x81d9c8,0xf388b8,0x9f8de9][j],.78);
              }
              dot(g,0xffffff,crestX,crestY-15,2,.65);
            } else if(theme==='industrial') {
              g.fillStyle(0x7fd7cf,.68).fillTriangle(crestX,crestY-17,crestX-12,crestY+9,crestX+11,crestY+9);
              g.fillStyle(0xdbfcf5,.54).fillTriangle(crestX,crestY-17,crestX-12,crestY+9,crestX-2,crestY+8);
            } else if(theme==='heritage') {
              rect(g,crestX-15,crestY-11,30,22,0x76523d,.81);
              g.fillStyle(0xd6b782,.81).fillTriangle(crestX-18,crestY-11,crestX+18,crestY-11,crestX,crestY-23);
              rect(g,crestX-3,crestY-1,6,11,0xf5d9a4,.45);
            } else if(theme==='food') {
              oval(g,crestX,crestY,31,21,0xffefd7,.77);
              oval(g,crestX,crestY,21,12,0x9b7350,.69);
              rect(g,crestX-11,crestY+11,22,3,accent,.85);
              dot(g,0xf9eee0,crestX-5,crestY-2,3,.66);
            } else if(theme==='civic') {
              oval(g,crestX,crestY,32,32,0x5d6679,.62);
              oval(g,crestX,crestY,25,25,accent,.44);
              rect(g,crestX-4,crestY-9,8,18,0xf8e2b8,.51);
              rect(g,crestX-12,crestY+5,24,4,0xeed7ae,.54);
            } else {
              oval(g,crestX,crestY,20,20,accent,.34);
            }
            // Floor craftsmanship only: micro highlights along tiles and carpet edges.
            // Do not draw large furniture-sized shapes in walkable tiles.
            if (theme==='creative') {
              for(let ty=3;ty<s.h-1;ty+=2) for(let tx=1;tx<s.w-1;tx+=2) {
                const hsh=hash(tx,ty,s.w*9+s.h);
                if(hsh<.73)continue;
                rect(g,tx*32+4+(hsh*9|0),ty*32+15,8,2,
                  [0xe8a9d4,0x90cfcc,0xeacc9b][(tx+ty)%3],.18);
              }
            } else if (s.floor==='wood') {
              for(let yy=102;yy<H-14;yy+=32) for(let xx=22;xx<W-20;xx+=88) {
                rect(g,xx+(yy%64),yy,18,1,0xffe6ba,.10);
                rect(g,xx+(yy%64)+20,yy+3,10,1,0x3b281e,.1);
              }
            } else if (s.floor==='tile'||s.floor==='checker'||s.floor==='stone') {
              for(let yy=96;yy<H-16;yy+=64) for(let xx=18;xx<W-16;xx+=64) {
                rect(g,xx,yy,7,1,accent,.11);
                rect(g,xx,yy,1,7,accent,.11);
              }
            }
            // Extra detail on EXISTING furniture only, preserving room furniture footprint.
            for(const obj of s.items||[]){
              const px=obj.x*32,py=obj.y*32,pw=obj.w*32,ph=obj.h*32;
              if(['shelf','goods','rack'].includes(obj.k)) {
                rect(g,px+4,py+3,Math.max(3,pw-8),2,accent,.28);
                for(let i=0;i<Math.min(9,Math.floor((pw-14)/11));i++)
                  rect(g,px+8+i*11,py+10+(i%2)*3,4,7,
                    [0xe3c68c,0xb5d2ce,0xa7c4ee,0xd6a9a0][i%4],.53);
              } else if(['desk','counter','table'].includes(obj.k)) {
                rect(g,px+4,py+2,Math.max(4,pw-8),2,0xffffff,.18);
                if(pw>60) {
                  rect(g,px+8,py+8,12,8,0xf4e8cf,.46);
                  line(g,px+10,py+11,px+18,py+11,0x6d8492,.41,1);
                }
              } else if(obj.k==='plant') {
                dot(g,0xd2f4af,px+16,py+8,3,.47);
                dot(g,0xf2e49e,px+11,py+14,2,.35);
              } else if(obj.k==='rug') {
                rect(g,px+4,py+4,Math.max(4,pw-8),2,accent,.16);
                rect(g,px+4,py+ph-6,Math.max(4,pw-8),2,accent,.16);
              }
            }
          }

          /* ===== MINERALS CENTRAL STATION: modern station south of Minerals Town (solid colours, no translucent overlays) ===== */
          function drawStation(g, a) {
            if (a.id !== 'mining-town' && a.id !== 'english-town') return;
            const T = 32;
            const K = {
              ink: 0x1b2630,
              steel: 0x2f3d48,
              steel2: 0x4a5a66,
              steel3: 0x7b8b96,
              con: 0xcfd4d3,
              con2: 0xc2c9c9,
              con3: 0xa9b2b4,
              seam: 0x97a1a4,
              white: 0xf3f6f4,
              teal: 0x16b3a5,
              teal2: 0x0f857d,
              glass: 0x8fdcd6,
              glass2: 0x62b9b8,
              glassDk: 0x2d6f78,
              amber: 0xf3b94d,
              red: 0xd9534f,
              green: 0x58c26a,
              roofA: 0x5b6a74,
              roofB: 0x4a5862,
              bal: 0x8a8478,
              bal2: 0x726c62,
              tie: 0x4a3a2c,
              tie2: 0x5f4a37,
              rail: 0xdde3e6,
              wood: 0xb98a52,
              wood2: 0x9c723f,
              soil: 0x5a3f2c,
            };
            const R = (x, y, w, h, c) => rect(g, x, y, w, h, c, 1);
            const pave = (x0, y0, x1, y1, c1, c2, sm) => {
              for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++)
                for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
                  const h = hash(x, y, 41);
                  R(x * T, y * T, T, T, (x + y) & 1 ? c1 : c2);
                  R(x * T, y * T + T - 1, T, 1, sm);
                  R(x * T + T - 1, y * T, 1, T, sm);
                  if (h > 0.88) R(x * T + 8 + (((h * 40) | 0) % 12), y * T + 10, 5, 1, sm);
                }
            };
            // Ground: forecourt, side walks, concourse, gateway, platforms.
            pave(4, 47, 55, 51, K.con, K.con2, K.seam);
            R(4 * T, 47 * T, 52 * T, 4, K.con3);
            pave(4, 52, 10, 62, K.con2, K.con, K.seam);
            pave(51, 52, 55, 62, K.con2, K.con, K.seam);
            pave(11, 58, 50, 62, 0xd8dcdb, 0xcdd2d1, K.seam);
            pave(28, 52, 32, 57, 0xb9c1c2, 0xafb8b9, K.seam);
            pave(4, 63, 55, 64, 0xbcc3c3, 0xb2baba, 0x9aa3a5);
            pave(4, 67, 55, 68, 0xbcc3c3, 0xb2baba, 0x9aa3a5);
            R(30 * T + 10, 52 * T, 12, 11 * T, K.teal);
            R(4 * T, 64 * T + T - 8, 52 * T, 6, K.amber);
            R(4 * T, 64 * T + T - 2, 52 * T, 2, K.ink);
            R(4 * T, 67 * T + 2, 52 * T, 6, K.amber);
            R(4 * T, 68 * T + T - 8, 52 * T, 6, K.amber);
            // Tracks.
            const track = (ty) => {
              const y = ty * T,
                W = a.w * T;
              R(0, y, W, 2 * T, K.bal);
              for (let xx = 0; xx < W; xx += 16)
                if (hash(xx >> 4, ty, 57) > 0.5) R(xx, y, 16, 2 * T, K.bal2);
              for (let xx = 4; xx < W; xx += 14) {
                R(xx, y + 6, 6, 2 * T - 12, K.tie);
                R(xx, y + 6, 2, 2 * T - 12, K.tie2);
              }
              R(0, y + 12, W, 4, K.rail);
              R(0, y + 16, W, 2, K.steel3);
              R(0, y + 44, W, 4, K.rail);
              R(0, y + 48, W, 2, K.steel3);
            };
            track(65);
            track(69);
            R(0, 71 * T, a.w * T, 8, K.bal2);
            // Hall: roof, glass curtain wall, sign band.
            const hall = (xa, xb) => {
              const x = xa * T,
                w = (xb - xa + 1) * T,
                ry = 52 * T,
                fy = 55 * T;
              R(x, ry, w, 3 * T, K.roofA);
              for (let xx = x + 16; xx < x + w; xx += 16) R(xx, ry + 4, 1, 3 * T - 12, K.roofB);
              for (let xx = x + 48; xx < x + w; xx += 96) R(xx, ry + 4, 2, 3 * T - 12, K.steel3);
              R(x + 10, ry + 14, w - 20, 34, K.steel);
              R(x + 13, ry + 17, w - 26, 28, K.glassDk);
              R(x + 13, ry + 17, w - 26, 14, K.glass2);
              for (let xx = x + 13; xx < x + w - 13; xx += 26) {
                R(xx, ry + 17, 2, 28, K.steel2);
                R(xx + 8, ry + 20, 3, 10, K.glass);
              }
              R(x, ry, w, 5, K.con3);
              R(x, ry + 3 * T - 26, w, 10, K.con);
              R(x, ry + 3 * T - 16, w, 3, K.ink);
              R(x, ry + 3 * T - 13, w, 5, K.con3);
              R(x, fy, w, 28, 0x24505a);
              R(x, fy, w, 3, K.teal);
              R(x, fy + 25, w, 3, K.ink);
              for (let xx = x + 8; xx < x + w - 8; xx += 64) {
                R(xx, fy + 10, 3, 3, K.amber);
                R(xx + 32, fy + 10, 3, 3, K.white);
              }
              R(x, fy + 28, w, 68, K.con3);
              R(x + 4, fy + 32, w - 8, 56, K.glass2);
              for (let xx = x + 4; xx < x + w - 4; xx += 32) R(xx, fy + 32, 2, 56, K.steel2);
              R(x + 4, fy + 56, w - 8, 2, K.steel2);
              for (let xx = x + 14; xx < x + w - 20; xx += 96) {
                R(xx, fy + 36, 5, 18, K.glass);
                R(xx + 9, fy + 40, 3, 10, K.glass);
                R(xx, fy + 60, 5, 22, K.glass);
              }
              R(x, fy + 90, w, 6, K.steel);
              R(x, 58 * T, w, 5, K.con3);
            };
            hall(11, 27);
            hall(33, 50);
            R(11 * T - 4, 52 * T, 4, 6 * T, K.steel);
            R(51 * T, 52 * T, 4, 6 * T, K.steel);
            // Sign band details: departure boards and train pictograms.
            const board = (tx) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = 55 * T + 4;
              R(x, y, 6 * T, 20, 0x10161c);
              R(x, y, 6 * T, 2, K.steel2);
              R(x + 4, y + 17, 6 * T - 8, 2, K.amber);
            };
            board(21);
            board(35);
            for (const tx of [12, 48]) {
              const x = tx * T + 4,
                y = 55 * T + 8;
              R(x, y, 24, 10, K.white);
              for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) R(x + 3 + k * 7, y + 2, 4, 4, K.glassDk);
              R(x + 2, y + 10, 4, 3, K.steel);
              R(x + 18, y + 10, 4, 3, K.steel);
            }
            // Gateway: steel frame, LED headers, columns.

            // Twin clock towers.
            R(28 * T - 6, 55 * T, 5 * T + 12, 10, K.steel);
            R(28 * T - 6, 55 * T + 10, 5 * T + 12, 3, K.teal);
            const tower = (tx) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = 47 * T;
              R(x, y + 34, 96, 5 * T - 34, K.con);
              R(x + 86, y + 34, 10, 5 * T - 34, K.con3);
              R(x, y + 34, 6, 5 * T - 34, K.white);
              R(x + 34, y + 58, 28, 84, K.steel);
              R(x + 37, y + 61, 22, 78, K.glassDk);
              R(x + 37, y + 61, 22, 36, K.glass2);
              R(x + 46, y + 61, 3, 78, K.steel2);
              for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                R(x + 12, y + 62 + k * 28, 12, 16, K.glassDk);
                R(x + 72, y + 62 + k * 28, 12, 16, K.glassDk);
              }
              R(x - 6, y, 108, 40, K.steel);
              R(x - 6, y, 108, 5, K.teal);
              oval(g, x + 48, y + 22, 34, 34, K.ink);
              oval(g, x + 48, y + 22, 30, 30, K.white);
              line(g, x + 48, y + 22, x + 48, y + 11, K.ink, 1, 2);
              line(g, x + 48, y + 22, x + 56, y + 26, K.ink, 1, 2);
              R(x - 10, y - 8, 116, 8, K.steel2);
              R(x + 44, y - 14, 8, 6, K.amber);
            };
            tower(25);
            tower(33);
            // Plaza dressing.
            const planter = (tx, ty) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T;
              R(x, y, 3 * T, 2 * T, K.con3);
              R(x + 4, y + 4, 3 * T - 8, 2 * T - 12, K.soil);
              R(x, y + 2 * T - 8, 3 * T, 8, K.steel2);
              for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                const px = x + 10 + i * 12,
                  py = y + 14 + ((i * 7) % 3) * 8;
                oval(g, px, py, 14, 12, i % 2 ? 0x4aa85c : 0x6fcf7a);
                if (i % 3 === 0) R(px - 2, py - 8, 3, 3, [K.amber, K.red, 0xf2f2f2][(i / 3) | 0]);
              }
            };
            planter(14, 48);
            planter(44, 48);
            const lamp = (tx, ty) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T;
              R(x + 10, y + 26, 12, 5, K.steel2);
              R(x + 14, y + 6, 4, 22, K.steel);
              R(x + 8, y + 2, 16, 7, K.steel2);
              R(x + 10, y + 4, 12, 3, K.amber);
            };
            lamp(20, 49);
            lamp(40, 49);
            // Concourse fixtures.
            const counter = (tx, ty, tw) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T,
                w = tw * T;
              R(x, y, w, 13, 0xe9edea);
              R(x, y + 13, w, 19, K.steel2);
              R(x, y + 16, w, 3, K.teal);
              R(x, y + 29, w, 3, K.ink);
              for (let xx = x + 10; xx < x + w - 24; xx += 48) {
                R(xx, y + 2, 20, 8, K.ink);
                R(xx + 2, y + 4, 16, 4, K.green);
              }
              R(x + 2, y - 4, w - 4, 5, K.glass);
            };
            counter(15, 59, 6);
            counter(41, 59, 6);
            const bench = (tx, ty, tw) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T,
                w = tw * T;
              R(x, y + 4, w, 7, K.wood2);
              R(x, y + 12, w, 9, K.wood);
              for (let xx = x + 16; xx < x + w; xx += 16) R(xx, y + 12, 1, 9, K.wood2);
              R(x + 4, y + 21, 5, 9, K.steel);
              R(x + w - 9, y + 21, 5, 9, K.steel);
              R(x, y + 28, w, 3, K.con3);
            };
            bench(23, 60, 4);
            bench(34, 60, 4);
            const kiosk = (tx, ty, tc) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T,
                w = 3 * T;
              R(x, y + 14, w, 50, 0xeceeee);
              for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) R(x + i * 16, y, 16, 16, i % 2 ? K.white : tc);
              R(x, y + 16, w, 3, K.ink);
              R(x + 8, y + 24, w - 16, 22, K.glassDk);
              R(x + 8, y + 24, w - 16, 9, K.glass2);
              R(x + 4, y + 46, w - 8, 6, K.wood);
              R(x + 14, y + 40, 6, 6, K.amber);
              R(x + 60, y + 40, 6, 6, K.red);
              R(x, y + 56, w, 8, K.steel2);
            };
            kiosk(11, 60, K.teal);
            kiosk(48, 60, K.amber);
            const column = (tx, ty) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T;
              R(x + 10, y + 4, 12, 26, K.steel);
              R(x + 13, y + 4, 3, 26, K.steel3);
              R(x + 5, y, 22, 6, K.steel2);
              R(x + 6, y + 26, 20, 6, K.con3);
            };
            column(21, 62);
            column(40, 62);
            const fare = (tx, ty) => {
              const x = tx * T,
                y = ty * T;
              R(x + 7, y + 8, 18, 22, K.steel2);
              R(x + 7, y + 8, 18, 5, K.white);
              R(x + 13, y + 16, 6, 3, K.green);
              R(x + 9, y + 26, 14, 4, K.ink);
            };
            for (let tx = 22; tx <= 27; tx++) fare(tx, 62);
            for (let tx = 34; tx <= 39; tx++) fare(tx, 62);
            // Passenger train (Platform 1 side): white EMU with teal stripe.
            {
              const x = 15 * T,
                y = 65 * T,
                w = 32 * T,
                car = w / 4;
              R(x, y + 2, w, 16, 0xdde3e2);
              for (let xx = x + 20; xx < x + w - 20; xx += 64) {
                R(xx, y + 6, 22, 8, K.steel3);
                R(xx + 2, y + 8, 18, 2, K.con);
              }
              R(x, y + 18, w, 40, K.white);
              R(x, y + 24, w, 14, K.glassDk);
              R(x, y + 24, w, 3, K.glass2);
              for (let xx = x + 10; xx < x + w; xx += 20) R(xx, y + 24, 3, 14, K.white);
              R(x, y + 42, w, 6, K.teal);
              R(x, y + 58, w, 6, K.steel2);
              for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++)
                for (const d of [28, car / 2 - 10, car - 48]) {
                  const dx = x + car * c + d;
                  R(dx, y + 20, 22, 38, 0xc9d3d6);
                  R(dx + 3, y + 24, 16, 14, K.glassDk);
                  R(dx + 10, y + 20, 2, 38, K.steel2);
                }
              for (let c = 1; c < 4; c++) R(x + car * c - 3, y + 2, 6, 60, K.ink);
              oval(g, x + 4, y + 34, 36, 62, K.white);
              oval(g, x + w - 4, y + 34, 36, 62, K.white);
              R(x - 8, y + 24, 12, 14, K.ink);
              R(x + w - 4, y + 24, 12, 14, K.ink);
              R(x - 6, y + 42, 5, 5, K.amber);
              R(x + w + 1, y + 42, 5, 5, K.amber);
            }
            // Ore express (Platform 2 side): teal locomotive + five hopper wagons loaded with ore.
            {
              const x0 = 22 * T,
                y = 69 * T;
              R(x0, y + 2, 160, 14, 0x3b4a55);
              oval(g, x0 + 40, y + 9, 22, 10, K.steel);
              oval(g, x0 + 90, y + 9, 22, 10, K.steel);
              oval(g, x0 + 135, y + 9, 16, 8, K.steel);

          function drawFront(g,s){
            const d=s.__lq53;if(!d)return;
            const p=d.theme,role=d.role, W=s.w*32,H=s.h*32,cx=W/2;
            const R=(x,y,w,h,c,a=1)=>g.fillStyle(c,a).fillRect(x,y,Math.max(0,w),Math.max(0,h));
            const L=(x,y,X,Y,c,a=.65,w=1)=>g.lineStyle(w,c,a).lineBetween(x,y,X,Y);
            const C=(x,y,r,c,a=1)=>g.fillStyle(c,a).fillCircle(x,y,r);
            // Soft integrated foreground craftsmanship: never covers real furniture or walkable floor.
            if(p.id==='living'){
              for(let xx=13;xx<W;xx+=66){L(xx,4,xx+14,20,0x204a35,.68,3);C(xx+14,19,3,0x9fca7c,.56);}
              for(let xx=10;xx<W-10;xx+=90){R(xx,57,45,2,0xc2d297,.24);}
            } else if(p.id==='royal') {
              for(let xx=27;xx<W-20;xx+=85){R(xx+9,54,36,5,0xedc886,.57);R(xx+25,54,4,12,0xf5dfb3,.43);}
            } else if(p.id==='industrial') {
              for(let xx=22;xx<W-20;xx+=80){R(xx,52,6,14,0xc0cdcb,.46);R(xx-7,60,20,4,0x202f38,.67);}
            } else if(p.id==='tech') {
              for(let xx=24;xx<W-20;xx+=76){R(xx,54,47,3,0x8bf6e5,.57);R(xx+12,59,22,2,0x135f78,.5);}
            } else if(p.id==='atelier') {

            } else if(p.id==='bazaar') {
              for(let xx=18;xx<W-18;xx+=64){R(xx,53,39,4,0xf3d4a1,.47);R(xx+5,58,29,2,p.ink,.45);}
              if(role==='lord'){R(cx-29,17,58,5,p.accent,.65);}
            } else {

          const movable = new Set(['table','chair','sofa','counter','desk','schooldesk','shelf','goods','plant','crate','barrel','locker','pew','glass','lantern','rug','mat','paint','poster','clock','flag']);
          const wallDecor = new Set(['paint','poster','clock','flag','glass','mirror','pigeon','board','menu','screen','cross']);
          const passableDecor = new Set(['rug','mat',...wallDecor]);
          const keep = new Set(['stairs','portal','altar','cell','vault','firetruck','bed','hospbed','forge','fireplace','stove','minecart','orepile','crystal','partition','piano']);
          function reflow(spec,theme,seed) {
            // Reflow generic rooms. Preserve curated huge layouts, story-specific fixtures and all existing item kinds.
            const source=spec.__lq53Source;
            if(spec.w>23||spec.h>16||source.length<5)return {items:source.map(v=>({...v})),moved:0,curated:true};
            const w=spec.w,h=spec.h, cx=Math.floor(w/2), side=(theme==='royal'||theme==='tech')?2:1;
            const blocked=Array.from({length:h},()=>Array(w).fill(false));
            const reserved=Array.from({length:h},()=>Array(w).fill(false));
            const paintCells=(arr,obj,value)=>{for(let y=obj.y;y<obj.y+obj.h;y++)for(let x=obj.x;x<obj.x+obj.w;x++)if(x>=0&&y>=0&&x<w&&y<h)arr[y][x]=value;};
            for(let y=h-3;y<h;y++)for(let x=cx-1;x<=cx+1;x++)if(x>=0&&x<w)reserved[y][x]=true;
            for(const pos of [...Object.values(spec.spots||{}),...(spec.guests||[])]){
              if(!Array.isArray(pos))continue; const x=pos[0]|0,y=pos[1]|0;
              if(y>=2&&y<h&&x>=0&&x<w){reserved[y][x]=true;for(let xx=x-1;xx<=x+1;xx++)if(xx>=0&&xx<w)reserved[y][xx]=true;}
            }
            const fixed=[],floorItems=[],decor=[];
            for(const it of source){ const v={...it};if(wallDecor.has(v.k)){decor.push(v);continue;}
              if(keep.has(v.k)||!movable.has(v.k)){fixed.push(v);if(!passableDecor.has(v.k))paintCells(blocked,v,true);continue;}
              floorItems.push(v);
            }
            // Keep immovable story fixtures, including stair/portal and the bedroom's own bed.
            const result=[...fixed],placed=[];
            const canPlace=(obj,x,y)=>{
              if(x<1||y<2||x+obj.w>w-1||y+obj.h>=h-1)return false;
              for(let yy=y;yy<y+obj.h;yy++)for(let xx=x;xx<x+obj.w;xx++)if(blocked[yy][xx]||reserved[yy][xx])return false;
              return true;
            };
            const cells=[];
            // Each culture has a different spatial plan. Right/left bay priority, ring, axial or staggered benches.
            for(let y=2;y<h-2;y++)for(let x=1;x<w-1;x++){
              const dx=Math.abs(x+0.5-w/2),dy=Math.abs(y+0.5-h*.52);
              let rank=0;
              if(theme==='civic')rank=(x<w*.47?0:5)+y*2+(x%3);
              else if(theme==='industrial')rank=Math.abs(x-w*.22)*2+Math.min(y,h-3-y)*3;
              else if(theme==='heritage'||theme==='ranger')rank=Math.abs(Math.hypot(dx/w,dy/h)-.28)*42+(x%2)*2;
              else if(theme==='atelier')rank=Math.abs((x*3+y*2)%(Math.max(5,w-4)))*2+Math.abs(x-w*.3);
              else if(theme==='tech')rank=(y%3)*12+Math.abs(x-w*.25)*2;
              else if(theme==='royal')rank=dx<2?30:dx+Math.abs(y-h*.35)*.8;
              else if(theme==='living')rank=Math.abs(Math.hypot(dx/w,dy/h)-.31)*58;
              else if(theme==='bazaar')rank=(x<w*.34?0:x>w*.7?4:18)+y*.8;
              rank+=(hash(seed+'|'+x+'|'+y)%7)*.09;
              cells.push({x,y,rank});
            }
            cells.sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank);
            // Large fixtures first: physically meaningful bays; chairs/plant accents are placed last.
            floorItems.sort((a,b)=>b.w*b.h-a.w*a.h||(hash(seed+a.k)-hash(seed+b.k)));
            for(const item of floorItems){
              if(passableDecor.has(item.k)) {placed.push({...item});continue;}
              const preferBack=/^(counter|desk|shelf|goods|locker|crate|barrel|schooldesk)$/.test(item.k);
              const options=preferBack?[...cells].sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank+(a.y-b.y)*.7):cells;
              let target=null;
              for(const p of options){if(canPlace(item,p.x,p.y)){target={x:p.x,y:p.y};break;}}
              if(!target&&canPlace(item,item.x,item.y))target={x:item.x,y:item.y};

function atmosphere(c){
 const {W,H,r,l,t,e,o,p,s,style,rnd}=c;
 // Native pixel geometry, not canvas filters: directional light beams fall across
 // existing floor tiles, varying by cultural setting and the room's occupation.
 let tint={living:0xe1f2a5,royal:0xffd69e,tech:0x8af4f5,industrial:0xf4ba83,heritage:0xffcf94,ranger:0xc2e5af,civic:0xffd5a6,atelier:0xffddb6,bazaar:0xffd199}[style]||p.glow;
 const ww=W*.24;
 for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
  let sx=style==='living'?W*(k?.64:.36):W*(k?.76:.24), dx=(k?1:-1)*Math.min(W*.2,140);
  t(sx-27,68,sx+22,68,sx+dx+57,Math.min(H-32,190),tint,.045);
  t(sx-27,68,sx+dx+57,Math.min(H-32,190),sx+dx-48,Math.min(H-32,190),tint,.033);
  e(sx+dx,Math.min(H-32,190),W*.19,22,tint,.04);
 }
 // Shadow under any real fixture: tells the player where the furniture actually sits.
 for(const it of s.items||[]){
  if(['rug','mat','paint','poster','clock','flag','glass','mirror','board','screen','menu','stairs','portal','lantern'].includes(it.k))continue;

// V55 ROOM DENSITY PASS: physical props, never visual-only solid objects.
// Validate the whole walkable graph before installing them in the real room spec.
const enrichStats={rooms:0,added:0,kept:0};
function enrichRoom(spec){
 if(!spec||spec.__lq55Enriched)return 0;
 spec.__lq55Enriched=true;enrichStats.rooms++;
 const d=spec.__lq53;if(!d||!Array.isArray(spec.items)||spec.w<10||spec.h<9){enrichStats.kept++;return 0}
 const W=spec.w,H=spec.h,cx=Math.floor(W/2),role=d.role||'',style=d.theme?.id||'civic';
 const noBlock=new Set(['rug','mat','paint','poster','flag','glass','mirror','board','menu','screen','clock','stairs','portal','lantern']);
 const real=new Set(['plant','barrel','crate','rack','shelf','chair','goods','locker','wardrobe','glasscase','cakecase']);
 const used=Array.from({length:H},()=>Array(W).fill(false));
 const occup=(it,mark)=>{if(noBlock.has(it.k))return;for(let y=Math.max(0,it.y|0);y<Math.min(H,it.y+it.h);y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,it.x|0);x<Math.min(W,it.x+it.w);x++)used[y][x]=mark};
 spec.items.forEach(it=>occup(it,true));
 const occupied=(x,y)=>x<1||x>=W-1||y<2||y>=H-1||used[y][x];
 const reachCheck=()=>{
  let start=[cx,H-2],seen=new Set(),todo=[start];
  if(occupied(...start))return false;
  const key=(x,y)=>x+','+y;seen.add(key(...start));
  for(let i=0;i<todo.length;i++){const [x,y]=todo[i];for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const a=x+dx,b=y+dy,k=key(a,b);if(!seen.has(k)&&!occupied(a,b)){seen.add(k);todo.push([a,b])}}}
  // Preserve visits to guests and NPC placements if they were reachable beforehand.
  for(const pos of [...Object.values(spec.spots||{}),...(spec.guests||[])]){
   if(!Array.isArray(pos))continue;const a=pos[0]|0,b=pos[1]|0;
   if(!occupied(a,b)&&!seen.has(key(a,b)))return false;
  }
  // Ensure every preexisting physical fixture has an accessible neighboring cell.
  for(const it of spec.items){if(noBlock.has(it.k))continue;let ok=false;
   for(let y=it.y-1;y<=it.y+it.h;y++)for(let x=it.x-1;x<=it.x+it.w;x++){
    if(x>=it.x&&x<it.x+it.w&&y>=it.y&&y<it.y+it.h)continue;
    if(seen.has(key(x,y))){ok=true;break;}
   }
   if(!ok)return false;
  }
  return true;
 };
 // Do not change a room with an already unconnected design.
 if(!reachCheck()){enrichStats.kept++;return 0;}
 const recipe={
   living:['plant','plant','crate','lantern'],
   bazaar:['goods','crate','barrel','plant'],
   royal:['plant','lantern','plant','chair'],
   industrial:['barrel','crate','rack','barrel'],
   tech:['plant','locker','chair','lantern'],
   atelier:['plant','crate','chair','plant'],
   heritage:['crate','barrel','chair','lantern'],
   ranger:['crate','plant','barrel','plant'],
   civic:['plant','chair','crate','plant']
 }[style]||['plant','crate'];
 // Physical prop arrangement along the real side bays, not in the entrance axis.
 const spots=[];
 for(let y=3;y<H-3;y++){for(const x of [1,W-2,2,W-3,3,W-4]){
  if(x>=cx-2&&x<=cx+2&&y>H-6)continue;
  spots.push({x,y,score:Math.abs(x-cx)*.6+Math.abs(y-H*.55)*.4});
 }}
 spots.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
 let added=0;
 for(let n=0;n<Math.min(recipe.length,6);n++){
  const k=recipe[n],obj={k,x:0,y:0,w:1,h:1,c:undefined};let placed=false;
  for(let i=n%2;i<spots.length;i++){
   const {x,y}=spots[i];if(occupied(x,y))continue;
   // Don't crowd existing furniture; leave at least 1 tile between two new solids.
   if([[0,1],[0,-1],[1,0],[-1,0]].some(([dx,dy])=>occupied(x+dx,y+dy)))continue;
   obj.x=x;obj.y=y;occup(obj,true);
   if(reachCheck()){spec.items.push({...obj});added++;placed=true;break;}
   occup(obj,false);
  }
  if(!placed)continue;
 }
 enrichStats.added+=added;if(!added)enrichStats.kept++;return added;
}

 function station(sc){
  if(!sc?.inside||!sc.player)return null;
  const items=sc.inside.spec.items ||[],unit=32*sc.inside.k;
  // Follow original E interaction radius; only existing, physically drawn furniture qualifies.
  const allowed=new Set(['desk','table','shelf','counter','forge','stove','board','clock','paint','glasscase','rack','bed','altar','crystal','chair','schooldesk','glass','bookshelf']);
  let best=null,dist=Infinity;
  for(const item of items){if(!allowed.has(item.k))continue;
   const x=Yr+(item.x+item.w/2)*unit,y=Xr+(item.y+item.h/2)*unit;
   const d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-x,sc.player.y-y);
   if(d<dist&&d<unit*2.25){best=item;dist=d;}
  }
  return best;
 }

 function inspect(sc){if(!sc.inside||!station(sc))return false;return show(sc);}
 function refresh(sc){
  const inside=sc.inside;if(!inside)return;
  const k='v57_room_'+hash(inside.spec.__lq57?.key||'')+'_'+(++frameCounter);
  try{const gfx=sc.add.graphics();Dr(gfx,inside.spec);gfx.generateTexture(k,inside.spec.w*32,inside.spec.h*32);gfx.destroy();
   sc.textures.get(k).setFilter(Y.Textures.FilterMode.NEAREST);
   const prev=inside.__v57texture;inside.objs[0].setTexture(k);inside.__v57texture=k;
   if(prev&&sc.textures.exists(prev))sc.textures.remove(prev);
  }catch(e){console.warn('V57 room refresh issue:',e)}
 }
 function onEnter(sc){
  if(!sc.inside)return;ensureUI();const a=sc.inside;
  preEnter(sc,sc.area.id,a.b.name,a.spec,a.floor);
  // The first room texture was already produced after preEnter() in enterBuilding.
  if(!a.__v57layer){const layer=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.3);a.objs.push(layer);a.__v57layer=layer;}
  // Restore the saved room state if it was changed after the cached texture was first produced.
  if(a.spec.__lq57?.complete)refresh(sc);
 }
 const residentState=new WeakMap();
 function animateResident(sc,n,delta){
  if(!sc.inside||!n?.sprite?.visible)return;
  let st=residentState.get(n);if(!st){st={x:n.sprite.x,y:n.sprite.y,clock:0,phase:0};residentState.set(n,st)}
  st.clock+=Math.min(50,Math.max(0,delta));
  if(st.clock>8800){st.clock=0;st.phase=(st.phase+1)%3;}
  const minute=sc.store.game?.minutes||720;const open=minute>=450&&minute<=1190;
  const shift=st.phase===0?0:st.phase===1?(open?11:5):-8;
  const destX=st.x+shift*sc.inside.k;
  const safe=(!sc.blocked(destX,n.sprite.y)&&Math.abs(sc.player.x-destX)>14*sc.inside.k);
  const x=safe?destX:st.x;
  n.sprite.x+=(x-n.sprite.x)*Math.min(.06,delta/220);
 }
 let tick=0;
 function update(sc,dt){
  if(!sc?.inside){if(prompt)prompt.hidden=true;if(mobileAction)mobileAction.hidden=true;return;}
  if(!ui)ensureUI();
  // Display a compact E hint only if the interaction is actually reachable.
  tick+=Math.min(60,dt||16);if(tick>160){tick=0;
   const st=station(sc), showHint=!!st&&!sc.chat?.isOpen&&!sc.briefing?.isOpen&&ui.hidden;
   prompt.hidden=!showHint;
   const device=document.documentElement.dataset.device||'';if(mobileAction)mobileAction.hidden=!(showHint&&(device==='phone'||device==='tablet'));
   if(showHint){const d=sc.inside.spec.__lq57;prompt.textContent=`E · ${st.k} — ${d?.complete?'Xem thành quả':'Hoạt động và khám phá'}`;}
  }
  const layer=sc.inside.__v57layer;if(!layer)return;
  const d=sc.inside.spec.__lq57;const ms=sc.store.game?.minutes||720;
  layer.clear();const k=sc.inside.k, xx=Yr, yy=Xr;
  // Small, non-solid animated lighting effects; always behind the player and NPCs.
  const t=((sc.time?.now||0)/1000);
  const points=d?.style==='industrial'?[[.24,.11],[.74,.11]]:d?.style==='living'?[[.32,.12],[.68,.12]]:d?.style==='royal'?[[.19,.13],[.81,.13]]:[[.3,.14],[.7,.14]];
  const W=sc.inside.spec.w*32*k,H=sc.inside.spec.h*32*k;
  for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){const p=points[i],x=xx+p[0]*W,y=yy+p[1]*H,a=.27+.18*Math.sin(t*1.8+i);
   layer.fillStyle(d?.style==='tech'?0x78fbf6:d?.style==='industrial'?0xffc27c:0xffdcab,a).fillCircle(x,y,3*k);
   layer.fillStyle(0xffe4a1,Math.max(.01,a*.22)).fillCircle(x,y,11*k);
  }
  if(d?.complete&&ms>=1120){const x=xx+W*.5,y=yy+H*.17;layer.fillStyle(0xe8d298,.25).fillCircle(x,y,9*k);}
 }
 function onLeave(){if(prompt)prompt.hidden=true;if(mobileAction)mobileAction.hidden=true;close();}
 function decorateExterior(sc){
  if(!sc?.area?.buildings?.length||!sc?.add||!sc?.store)return 0;
  if(Array.isArray(sc.__lq57Outdoor))for(const x of sc.__lq57Outdoor){const i=sc.areaObjs?.indexOf(x)??-1;if(i>=0)sc.areaObjs.splice(i,1);try{x.destroy();}catch(_){}}
  sc.__lq57Outdoor=[];
  const st=state(sc);let count=0;
  for(const b of sc.area.buildings){
   if(!st?.completed?.[key(sc.area.id,b.name,0)])continue;
   const x=b.door*32+16,y=(b.y+b.h)*32-45;
   const gfx=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(11);
   gfx.fillStyle(0xeed790,.25).fillCircle(x,y,14);
   gfx.fillStyle(0xffd88c,1).fillRect(x-3,y-9,6,17);
   gfx.fillStyle(0xfff4cd,1).fillRect(x-8,y-4,16,6);
   gfx.fillStyle(0x4d926b,1).fillRect(x-2,y+4,4,7);
   sc.__lq57Outdoor.push(gfx);sc.areaObjs?.push(gfx);count++;
  }
  return count;
 }
 function diagnostics(){const s=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();return {version:'57.0',currentRoom:s?.inside?.spec?.__lq57||null,hasStation:!!station(s),completed:Object.keys(s?.store?.game?.v57?.completed||{}).length,registeredStyles:Object.keys(areaStyles).length};}
 return Object.freeze({version:'57.0',preEnter,onEnter,onLeave,drawBack:art,inspect,station,update,animateResident,scenario,diagnostics,decorateExterior,refresh,close});
})();

 function classify(area,building){const n=String(building).toLowerCase();
  if(area==='wish-valley'&&/vaela|root home/.test(n))return 'vaela';
  if(area==='mining-town'&&/mine|workshop|smithy|freight/.test(n))return 'mine';
  if(area==='old-oriaris'&&/opera/.test(n))return 'opera';
  if(area==='vocalt-greedy-land'&&/chronos|clock|bellwright/.test(n))return 'clock';
  return STYLE[area]||'civic';
 }
 function preEnter(sc,area,building,spec,floor){if(!spec)return;

 }

 function painter(g,s){const d=s.__lq58;if(!d)return null;const p=PAL[STYLE[d.area]]||PAL.civic;const W=s.w*32,H=s.h*32;

  const ln=(x,y,X,Y,c,a=1,w=2)=>g.lineStyle(w,c,a).lineBetween(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(X),Math.round(Y));
  const tr=(x,y,X,Y,U,V,c,a=1)=>g.fillStyle(c,a).fillTriangle(x,y,X,Y,U,V);
  const rectOutline=(x,y,w,h,fill,edge)=>{r(x-3,y-3,w+6,h+7,p.ink);r(x,y,w,h,fill);r(x+2,y+2,w-4,2,p.light,.45);r(x+3,y+h-5,w-6,3,edge||p.shade,.8)};

  return {d,p,W,H,r,ell,circ,ln,tr,rectOutline,detail};
 }

 function nearestItem(sc){if(!sc?.inside||!sc.player)return null;
  const spec=sc.inside.spec,unit=32*sc.inside.k,good=new Set(['desk','table','counter','shelf','board','clock','forge','anvil','crystal','glasscase','rack','stove','paint','altar','computer','terminal','bed','cabinet','bookshelf','workbench','minecart']);
  let closest=null,best=Infinity;for(const it of spec.items||[]){if(!good.has(it.k))continue;
   const x=Yr+(it.x+it.w*.5)*unit,y=Xr+(it.y+it.h*.5)*unit;const dist=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-x,sc.player.y-y);
   if(dist<best&&dist<unit*2.6){closest=it;best=dist;}}
  return closest;
 }

 function renderPuzzle(sc,d,question,step){

   };

     const renderStage=()=>{

       box.innerHTML='<div class="lq58-puzzle-stage"><div class="lq58-eyebrow">THỨ TỰ THAO TÁC</div><div class="lq58-slot-row"></div><div class="lq58-token-row"></div><p class="lq58-muted" id="lq58-puzzle-message">Chọn đúng thao tác tiếp theo để hoàn thiện công việc.</p></div>';

 function indoorRoute(sc,start,goal){ // Local BFS of walkable tile centres, no diagonal cuts through solid furniture.
  const unit=32*sc.inside.k,spec=sc.inside.spec;
  const toGrid=p=>[clamp(Math.round((p[0]-Yr)/unit-.5),1,spec.w-2),clamp(Math.round((p[1]-Xr)/unit-.5),2,spec.h-2)];
  const from=toGrid(start),dest=toGrid(goal),encode=(x,y)=>y*spec.w+x;
  const q=[[...from]],seen=new Set([encode(...from)]),prev=new Map();let j=0,stop=encode(...dest);
  while(j<q.length&&q.length<250){const [x,y]=q[j++],code=encode(x,y);if(code===stop)break;
    for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy;if(xx<1||xx>=spec.w-1||yy<2||yy>=spec.h-2)continue;
      const k=encode(xx,yy);if(seen.has(k))continue;const wx=Yr+(xx+.5)*unit,wy=Xr+(yy+.5)*unit;
      if(sc.blocked(wx,wy))continue;seen.add(k);prev.set(k,code);q.push([xx,yy]);}}
  if(!seen.has(stop))return [];
  const out=[];let k=stop;while(k!==encode(...from)&&out.length<18){let x=k%spec.w,y=Math.floor(k/spec.w);out.unshift([Yr+(x+.5)*unit,Xr+(y+.5)*unit]);k=prev.get(k);if(k===undefined)return []}return out;
 }

   }
 }

 // Candidate walkable interior tile near the center and the selected functional station.
 function interiorAnchor(sc){if(!sc?.inside)return null;
  const room=sc.inside,s=room.spec,k=room.k||1,W=s.w,H=s.h,u=TILE*k;
  const item=s.items?.find(it=>/clock|shelf|desk|table|counter|plant|paint|board|stove|vault|machine|pigeon/i.test(it.k))||null;
  const objective=item?[item.x+(item.w||1)/2,item.y+(item.h||1)/2+1.6]:[W/2,H/2];
  const toPos=(x,y)=>({x:Yr+(x+.5)*u,y:Xr+(y+.5)*u,tileX:x,tileY:y});
  const allowed=(x,y)=>x>=1&&y>=3&&x<W-1&&y<H-2&&!sc.blocked?.(Yr+(x+.5)*u,Xr+(y+.5)*u);
  let sx=clamp(Math.floor((sc.player.x-Yr)/u),1,W-2),sy=clamp(Math.floor((sc.player.y-Xr)/u),3,H-3);
  if(!allowed(sx,sy)){let found=false;for(let r=1;r<4&&!found;r++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r&&!found;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){if(allowed(sx+dx,sy+dy)){sx+=dx;sy+=dy;found=true;break}}if(!found)return null}
  const q=[[sx,sy]],seen=new Set([sy*W+sx]);let j=0,best=toPos(sx,sy),min=Infinity;
  while(j<q.length&&j<W*H){const [x,y]=q[j++];
    const dist=(x-objective[0])**2+(y-objective[1])**2+(y===H-3?3:0);
    if(dist<min){min=dist;best=toPos(x,y)}
    for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy,key=yy*W+xx;if(seen.has(key)||!allowed(xx,yy))continue;seen.add(key);q.push([xx,yy])}
  }
  return best
 }

 // Bounded local BFS prevents companions from cutting through walls or crossing locked gates.
 function followerRoute(sc,start,goal){const W=sc.area.w,H=sc.area.h,T=TILE;
  const sx=clamp(Math.floor(start.x/T),1,W-2),sy=clamp(Math.floor(start.y/T),1,H-2);
  const gx=clamp(Math.floor(goal.x/T),1,W-2),gy=clamp(Math.floor(goal.y/T),1,H-2);
  const allowed=(x,y)=>x>=1&&y>=1&&x<W-1&&y<H-1&&Math.abs(x-sx)<=22&&Math.abs(y-sy)<=22&&!sc.blocked?.((x+.5)*T,(y+.5)*T)&&!sc.area.warpAt?.(x,y);
  if(!allowed(sx,sy))return[];
  const id=(x,y)=>y*W+x,q=[[sx,sy]],visited=new Set([id(sx,sy)]),parents=new Map();let k=0,stop=null,best=id(sx,sy),mind=Infinity;
  while(k<q.length&&k<1450){const [x,y]=q[k++],code=id(x,y),dis=Math.abs(x-gx)+Math.abs(y-gy);if(dis<mind){mind=dis;best=code}if(dis<=2){stop=code;break}
   for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy,key=id(xx,yy);if(visited.has(key)||!allowed(xx,yy))continue;visited.add(key);parents.set(key,code);q.push([xx,yy])}
  }
  const target=stop??best,origin=id(sx,sy),pts=[];let node=target;
  while(node!==origin&&parents.has(node)&&pts.length<100){pts.push({x:(node%W+.5)*T,y:(Math.floor(node/W)+.5)*T});node=parents.get(node)}
  pts.reverse();return pts;
 }
 function walkFollower(sc,dt){if(!follower)return;if(sc!==follower.sc||areaId(sc)!==follower.area||sc.inside){clearFollower();return}
  const p=sc.player,sprite=follower.sprite,x=sprite.x,y=sprite.y,dist=Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.y-y);if(dist<58){follower.path=[];return}
  followerAcc+=clamp(dt,0,100);
  if(followerAcc>=1050||!follower.path?.length){followerAcc=0;follower.path=followerRoute(sc,{x,y},{x:p.x,y:p.y})}
  const waypoint=follower.path?.[0];if(!waypoint)return;
  const dx=waypoint.x-x,dy=waypoint.y-y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<6){follower.path.shift();return}
  const speed=Math.min(d,76*clamp(dt,0,100)/1000),nx=x+dx/d*speed,ny=y+dy/d*speed;
  if(!sc.blocked?.(nx,ny)&&!sc.area.warpAt?.(Math.floor(nx/TILE),Math.floor(ny/TILE)))sprite.setPosition(nx,ny);else follower.path=[];
 }
