 function interact(){const sc=scene();if(!valid(sc))return;const obj=currentObject(sc);if(!obj){toast('Hãy đến gần công trình quan trọng, vật chứng hoặc NPC.');return}
  if(obj.kind==='museum'){viewMuseum(sc);return}
  if(obj.kind==='echo'){const result=echoInteract(sc,obj.echo);tab='echo';togglePanel(true);paintPanel();toast(result?'Đã ghép đủ hai vật chứng và nhận kỷ vật!':'Đã lưu manh mối; tìm nửa còn lại ở vùng khác.');return}
  if(obj.kind==='npc'){tab='people';togglePanel(true);return}
  if(obj.kind==='mission'||obj.kind==='building'){showTask(sc);return}
 }
 function action(cmd){const sc=scene();if(cmd==='close'){togglePanel(false);return}if(cmd.startsWith('tab:')){tab=cmd.slice(4);pending=null;paintPanel();return}
  if(!valid(sc))return;if(cmd==='interact'){interact();return}
  if(cmd==='mission'){showTask(sc);return}
  if(cmd==='task:back'){paintPanel();return}
  if(cmd==='detail:open'){if(!atQuestLocation(sc))return;showDetailView(sc);return}
  if(cmd.startsWith('detail:spot:')){if(!atQuestLocation(sc)||pending?.kind!=='inspect')return;const i=Number(cmd.slice(12));if(i>=0&&i<=2&&!pending.found.includes(i))pending.found.push(i);detailButtons(sc);return}
  if(cmd==='detail:finish'){if(!atQuestLocation(sc)||pending?.kind!=='inspect'||pending.found.length!==3)return;pending=null;missionAdvance(sc,'inspect');showTask(sc);return}
  if(cmd==='task:speak'){if(!atQuestLocation(sc))return;const v=document.getElementById('lq60-task-sentence')?.value||'',res=study(sc,v);if(!res.ok){toast(res.message);return}missionAdvance(sc,'speak');toast('✓ Nhiệm vụ hoàn thành: công trình đã thay đổi!');paintPanel();return}
  if(cmd.startsWith('sequence:')){
   if(!atQuestLocation(sc))return;const w=cmd.slice(9);if(!pending||pending.kind!=='sequence')return;

  function outdoors(sc,dt){if(!sc?.area||!sc.player||!sc.add?.graphics)return;

    for(let yy=ly;yy<=hy&&drawn<density;yy++)for(let xx=lx;xx<=hx&&drawn<density;xx++){

  }

 function compare(a,b){if(!a||!b)return 0;
  let partsA=a.footprint.split('|'),partsB=b.footprint.split('|');let score=0;
  for(let k=0;k<partsA.length;k++){score+=(partsA[k]===partsB[k]?[.34,.24,.13,.10,.10,.09][k]:0)}
  return Math.round(score*100);

 function audit(){let arr=[...visits.values()],dupes=[],rooms=[];
  for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
   let a=arr[i],top={score:0,key:''};for(let j=0;j<i;j++){let q=compare(a,arr[j]);if(q>top.score)top={score:q,key:arr[j].key}}
   let occupiedPixels=a.occupied.reduce((t,it)=>t+Math.max(0,it.w)*Math.max(0,it.h),0);
   const area=a.W*a.H,percent=Math.round(occupiedPixels/area*100);
   let notes=[];if(percent<5)notes.push('Mật độ vật thể thấp — xem lại công năng, không tự rải đồ');
   if(percent>32)notes.push('Vật thể dày — cần kiểm tra hành lang');
   if(top.score>=85)notes.push('Bố cục khá giống '+top.key+' — xem lại silhouette/mặt bằng');
   rooms.push({key:a.key,name:a.building,area:a.p.label,shape:a.shape,role:a.role,occupiedPercent:percent,nearest:top,notes});
   if(top.score>=85)dupes.push({a:a.key,b:top.key,score:top.score});
  }
  stats.scanned=arr.length;stats.duplicates=dupes.length;
  return {rooms,duplicates:dupes,stats:{...stats}};
 }

function wallMark(d,x,y,k,p,scale=1){const {a,b,d:dark,glow}=p;

 }else if(k==='conduit'){

  break;}
 case 'arch':{

function floorStage(d,p){const W=p.W,H=p.H,c=p.region,cy=lim(H*.55,160,H-118),cx=p.floorCenterX;
 // Floor embellishment is passable and visually subordinate to the actual furniture and door.
 if(p.type==='vaela'||p.dominant==='branch'){
  const rx=Math.min(132,W*.29),ry=Math.min(80,(H-130)*.30);
  d.oval(cx,cy,rx*2+15,ry*2+15,c.d,.24);d.oval(cx,cy,rx*2,ry*2,0xa88755,.28);
  for(let k=0;k<11;k++){let th=k*Math.PI*2/11;d.line(cx+Math.cos(th)*33,cy+Math.sin(th)*21,cx+Math.cos(th)*rx,cy+Math.sin(th)*ry,c.b,.31,2)}
  d.ring(cx,cy,35,c.b,.24,3);
 }else if(p.dominant==='gantry'){
  for(const dx of [-22,22])d.rect(cx+dx,110,5,H-183,c.b,.34);
  for(let y=125;y<H-72;y+=25)d.rect(cx-16,y,38,3,c.a,.46);
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++){let yy=138+j*46;d.rect(42,yy,70,5,c.d,.43);d.rect(W-112,yy,70,5,c.d,.43)}
 }else if(p.dominant==='arch'){
  d.rect(cx-26,115,52,H-187,c.d,.34);d.rect(cx-13,114,26,H-186,0xb25e6d,.32);
  for(let j=0;j<5;j++){let yy=130+j*34;d.line(40,yy,Math.min(W-40,120),yy+14,c.b,.26,2);d.line(W-40,yy,W-120,yy+14,c.b,.26,2)}
 }else if(p.dominant==='clock'){
  d.ring(cx,cy,Math.min(W*.21,93),c.d,.30,7);d.ring(cx,cy,Math.min(W*.17,78),c.b,.28,2);
  for(let k=0;k<12;k++){const a=k*Math.PI/6;d.rect(cx+Math.sin(a)*70-2,cy-Math.cos(a)*70-2,4,4,c.b,.35)}
 }else if(p.dominant==='glass'){
  for(let j=0;j<5;j++){let yy=130+j*(H-210)/4;d.rect(cx-25,yy,50,4,c.glow,.24)}
  for(let dx of [-70,70])d.line(cx+dx,125,cx+dx,H-96,c.a,.33,3);
 }else if(p.dominant==='sawtooth'){
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){let x=42+k*(W-84)/4;d.tri(x,127,x+70,137,x+33,H-128,[0x9e7c97,0x6d9b91,0xc1977e][k%3],.13)}
 }else if(p.dominant==='truss'){
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++){let y=129+k*(H-204)/4;d.line(40,y,W-40,y+12,c.b,.20,3)}
 }else{
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){let y=148+k*41;d.rect(35,y,Math.min(72,W*.17),4,c.b,.19);d.rect(W-107,y,Math.min(72,W*.17),4,c.b,.19)}
 }
 // Leave the door lane quiet and unmarked to maintain entrance readability.
 d.line(W*.5-23,H-39,W*.5+23,H-39,c.b,.31,2);
}
// Secondary architectural language reflects owner profession and individual layout.
// All pieces are flat floor inlays or wall-mounted; they are not freestanding props.
function occupationIdentity(d,p){
 const W=p.W,H=p.H,c=p.region,v=p.layoutVariant;
 const flip=(v%2)?1:-1;
 const anchor=W*(flip>0?.75:.25),second=W-anchor;
 const upper=130+v%3*8;
 if(p.role==='family'){
   // Family rooms: conversational rugs, asymmetrical alcove seams, low wall textile.
   d.oval(anchor,upper+48,Math.min(93,W*.24),50,c.b,.16);
   d.oval(anchor,upper+48,Math.min(70,W*.18),35,c.d,.17);
   for(let k=0;k<5;k++)d.line(anchor-28+k*14,upper+26,anchor-20+k*13,upper+62,c.a,.26,2);
   wallMark(d,second,66,'loom',c,.57);
 }else if(p.role==='work'){
   // Shops and workshops: a visual flow lane points from production to display.
   const x1=flip>0?35:W-35,x2=flip>0?W*.37:W*.63;
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
    const xx=x1+(x2-x1)*(j+1)/4;
    d.rect(xx-13,upper+j*26,26,4,c.d,.33);
    d.rect(xx-8,upper+j*26+5,16,2,c.b,.35);
   }
   wallMark(d,anchor,70,p.region.kind==='merchant'?'dial':'conduit',c,.62);
 }else if(p.role==='learning'){
   // Study/archive: a vertical reference strip and a reading zone on the wall.
   for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
    const xx=anchor-30+j*13;
    d.rect(xx,39+(j%2)*5,8,47,c.d,.62);
    d.rect(xx+2,42+(j%2)*5,4,41,j%2?c.b:c.a,.45);
   }
   d.rect(second-32,upper,65,4,c.b,.25);
   wallMark(d,second,63,'frame',c,.62);
 }else if(p.role==='tech'){
   // Routing diagram is an inset on the floor, not an extra blocking console.
   for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
    const y=upper+j*19;
    d.line(anchor-28,y,anchor+18,y,c.glow,.26,2);
    d.circle(anchor+20,y,2,c.b,.42);
   }
   wallMark(d,second,66,'conduit',c,.7);
 }else{
   // Communal gathering places: radial floor inlay, ceremonial wall display.
   d.ring(anchor,upper+48,31,c.b,.24,3);
   for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
    const a=j*Math.PI*2/7;
    d.rect(anchor+Math.cos(a)*35-2,upper+48+Math.sin(a)*35-2,4,4,c.a,.39);
   }
   wallMark(d,second,66,p.dominant==='arch'?'arched':'frame',c,.64);
 }
 // Individual construction seams, derived from a stable building ID instead of clutter.
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
   const x=26+((v*41+j*103)%(Math.max(50,W-52)));
   d.rect(x,21,3,23+(v+j)%4*7,c.d,.25);
   d.rect(x+3,24,2,13+(v+j)%4*7,c.b,.31);
 }
}

 const d=G(g);heroWalls(d,p);floorStage(d,p);occupationIdentity(d,p);
 // Signature landmarks in the actual upper wall, intentionally different shapes.
 if(p.type==='vaela'){
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++)wallMark(d,p.W*.32+j*p.W*.18,67,'leaf',p.region,1.25);
 }else if(p.type==='great-mine'){

 }else if(p.type==='grand-opera'){
   d.rect(p.W*.29,16,p.W*.42,21,0x6e3451,.95);d.rect(p.W*.32,19,p.W*.36,7,p.region.b,.76);

   wallMark(d,p.W/2,40,'dial',p.region,1.45);
 }
}
function objectDetail(g,it,s){if(!options.enabled||!it?.k)return;const p=profile(s);if(!p)return;
 const x=it.x*TILE,y=it.y*TILE,w=it.w*TILE,h=it.h*TILE,k=String(it.k||'').toLowerCase(),d=G(g),c=p.region;
 if(!Number.isFinite(x+y+w+h)||w<16||h<16)return;
 const xmin=x+3,xmax=x+w-3,ymin=y+3,ymax=y+h-3;
 // Every line is clipped conceptually to the real object's own bounding box.
 if(/shelf|cabinet|book|display|rack/.test(k)){
   for(let j=0;j<Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Math.floor((w-10)/17)));j++){
      const xx=xmin+4+j*Math.max(10,(w-15)/Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Math.floor((w-10)/17))));
      if(xx+5>xmax)break;
      d.rect(xx,ymin+6,3,Math.min(17,h-12),j%2?c.a:c.b,.86);
      if(h>33)d.rect(xx+1,ymax-7,4,3,c.glow,.53);
   }
 }else if(/desk|table|bench|counter|stove|forge|furnace|machine/.test(k)){
   const lineY=ymin+Math.min(10,(h-6)*.28);
   d.line(xmin+6,lineY,xmax-6,lineY,c.b,.62,2);
   for(let j=0;j<Math.min(4,Math.floor(w/21));j++){
      const xx=xmin+11+j*21;
      if(xx+4<xmax&&lineY+9<ymax){d.rect(xx,lineY+5,6,5,j%2?c.glow:c.d,.76);d.rect(xx+1,lineY+6,2,2,c.b,.82)}
   }
   if(p.type==='chronos'||p.region.kind==='merchant'){
      const cx=x+w*.71,cy=y+h*.53;let rr=Math.min(11,w*.11,h*.25);
      if(rr>3){d.circle(cx,cy,rr,c.b,.83);d.circle(cx,cy,rr*.7,c.d,.81);d.line(cx,cy,cx+rr*.4,cy-rr*.3,c.glow,.86,2)}
   }
 }else if(/bed|sofa|chair|seat/.test(k)){
   d.rect(xmin+4,ymin+4,Math.max(4,w-15),Math.min(6,h-9),c.b,.59);
   if(h>28)d.rect(xmin+8,ymax-6,Math.max(4,w-23),2,c.d,.51);
 }else if(/plant|herb|tree/.test(k)){
   const mid=x+w*.5,top=y+h*.31;
   d.line(mid,top+5,mid,ymax-7,c.d,.76,2);
   d.oval(mid-5,top,Math.min(9,w*.25),Math.min(7,h*.2),c.a,.82);
   d.oval(mid+5,top-4,Math.min(9,w*.25),Math.min(7,h*.2),c.glow,.63);
 }
}

function insideAmbient(sc,elapsed){if(!sc?.inside?.spec||!options.enabled||!options.ambient)return;
 const ins=sc.inside,s=ins.spec,p=profile(s),key=p?.key;if(!p)return;
 if(sceneRef!==sc||insideKey!==key||!insideGraphics?.active){
   if(insideGraphics){try{insideGraphics.destroy()}catch{}}
   insideGraphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.35);ins.objs.push(insideGraphics);sceneRef=sc;insideKey=key;
 }
 frame+=elapsed||16;if(frame<110)return;frame=0;
 const d=G(insideGraphics),clock=(sc.time?.now||0)/1000,scale=TILE*ins.k,baseX=ins.objs[0].x,baseY=ins.objs[0].y,c=p.region;
 insideGraphics.clear();const gameMinutes=Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes??720),night=gameMinutes<400||gameMinutes>1130;
 let n=0;for(const it of p.objects){if(n>=8)break;
  const k=String(it.k||'').toLowerCase(),ix=baseX+(it.x+it.w*.5)*scale,iy=baseY+(it.y+.5)*scale;
  if(!Number.isFinite(ix+iy))continue;
  if(/lamp|candle|torch|fire|forge|furnace|stove|crystal/.test(k)){
    const r=4+Math.sin(clock*3+n)*1.2;
    d.circle(ix,iy,Math.max(2,r*ins.k),/crystal/.test(k)?0x9ceaf5:0xffd48c,night?.37:.18);
    d.circle(ix,iy,Math.max(1,2*ins.k),c.glow,.60);n++;
  }else if(/clock|gear|machine|engine|meter/.test(k)){
    const r=Math.max(5,6*ins.k),xx=ix+Math.cos(clock*.8+n)*r*.5,yy=iy+Math.sin(clock*.8+n)*r*.5;
    d.line(ix,iy,xx,yy,c.glow,.54,Math.max(1,ins.k));n++;
  }else if(/plant|herb|tree|vase/.test(k)){
    const wind=Math.sin(clock*1.3+n)*Math.min(4,ins.k*2.0);
    d.line(ix,iy+2*ins.k,ix+wind,iy-7*ins.k,c.a,.55,2);n++;
  }
 }
}
function outsideAmbient(sc,elapsed){if(!sc?.area||sc.inside||!options.outdoor||!options.enabled)return;
 if(outsideScene!==sc||!outsideGraphics?.active){
  try{outsideGraphics?.destroy()}catch{}
  outsideGraphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(6.6);outsideScene=sc;
 }
 frame+=elapsed||16;if(frame<200)return;frame=0;
 outsideGraphics.clear();let count=0;
 const d=G(outsideGraphics),c=REGIONS[sc.area.id]||REGIONS['english-town'],clock=(sc.time?.now||0)/1000;
 const buildingList=(sc.area.buildings||[]).map(b=>({b,x:(b.door+.5)*TILE,y:(b.y+.15)*TILE}))
  .filter(q=>Math.abs(q.x-sc.player.x)<530&&Math.abs(q.y-sc.player.y)<400)
  .sort((a,b)=>(a.x-sc.player.x)**2+(a.y-sc.player.y)**2-(b.x-sc.player.x)**2-(b.y-sc.player.y)**2).slice(0,7);
 for(const entry of buildingList){
  const {b,x,y}=entry;
  // Only on the existing upper facade, never inside walkway or door trigger.
  const cx=x+((hash(sc.area.id+b.name)%3)-1)*11;
  const t=Math.sin(clock*1.2+count)*2;
  if(c.kind==='industrial'){
    d.rect(cx-2,y-2,4,16,c.b,.48);d.rect(cx+8,y+5+t,2,10,c.glow,.56);
  }else if(c.kind==='organic'||c.kind==='heritage'){
    d.line(cx-9,y+4,cx-2+t,y-11,c.d,.43,3);d.oval(cx-3+t,y-12,9,5,c.a,.60);
  }else if(c.kind==='royal'||c.kind==='merchant'){
    d.rect(cx-4,y-7,9,13,c.b,.40);d.rect(cx-2,y-4,5,6,c.glow,.22+.10*(Math.sin(clock*2)+1));
  }else if(c.kind==='tech'){
    d.rect(cx-8,y-6,16,7,c.a,.25);d.rect(cx-7,y-3,5+(Math.floor(clock*2)%8),2,c.glow,.58);
  }else if(c.kind==='studio'){
    d.line(cx-7,y+3,cx+7,y-6,c.a,.34,2);d.rect(cx+2,y-2,4,4,c.glow,.37);
  }else{
    d.rect(cx-4,y-7,8,14,c.a,.31);d.rect(cx-1,y-5,2,9,c.glow,.31);
  }
  count++;
 }
}

function audit(){const all=[...rooms.values()],issues=[],families={},byMap={};let occupied=0;
 for(const p of all){families[p.dominant]=(families[p.dominant]||0)+1;byMap[p.area]=(byMap[p.area]||0)+1;
  const sum=p.paths.reduce((a,o)=>a+o.w*o.h,0),ratio=sum/(p.W*p.H);occupied+=ratio;
  if(ratio>.38)issues.push({room:p.key,type:'crowded',score:Math.round(ratio*100)});
  if(ratio<.035)issues.push({room:p.key,type:'sparse',score:Math.round(ratio*100)});
 }
 const near=[];
 for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++)for(let j=0;j<i;j++){
  const a=all[i],b=all[j];if(a.area!==b.area)continue;
  const matches=['dominant','type','layoutVariant','role'].reduce((n,k)=>n+(a[k]===b[k]),0);
  if(matches===4&&Math.abs(a.W-b.W)<33&&Math.abs(a.H-b.H)<33)near.push([a.key,b.key]);
 }
 return {version:VERSION,rooms:all.length,families,byMap,nearMatches:near.slice(0,25),issues,avgFurniturePercent:Math.round(occupied/Math.max(1,all.length)*100)};
}

 function unionArea(rects,W,H){
   const a=rects.map(q=>({x:clamp(q.x,0,W),r:clamp(q.x+q.w,0,W),y:clamp(q.y,0,H),b:clamp(q.y+q.h,0,H)})).filter(q=>q.r>q.x&&q.b>q.y);
   if(!a.length)return 0;
   const X=[...new Set(a.flatMap(q=>[q.x,q.r]))].sort((u,v)=>u-v);
   let total=0;
   for(let i=0;i<X.length-1;i++){
     let segments=a.filter(q=>q.x<X[i+1]&&q.r>X[i]).map(q=>[q.y,q.b]).sort((u,v)=>u[0]-v[0]);
     let lo=-1,hi=-1,covered=0;
     for(const [u,v] of segments){if(lo<0){lo=u;hi=v;}else if(u>hi){covered+=hi-lo;lo=u;hi=v;}else hi=Math.max(hi,v)}
     if(lo>=0)covered+=hi-lo;
     total+=(X[i+1]-X[i])*covered;
   }
   return total;
 }
 function occupancyGrid(p,c=12,rw=9){
   let bits=new Uint8Array(c*rw);
   for(let row=0;row<rw;row++)for(let col=0;col<c;col++){
     let x0=p.W*col/c,y0=p.H*row/rw,x1=p.W*(col+1)/c,y1=p.H*(row+1)/rw;
     const q=p.paths||[];
     bits[row*c+col]=q.some(k=>Math.min(k.x+k.w,x1)-Math.max(k.x,x0)>0.2*(x1-x0)&&Math.min(k.y+k.h,y1)-Math.max(k.y,y0)>0.2*(y1-y0))?1:0;
   }
   return bits;
 }
 function similarity(a,b){
   if(!a||!b||a.area!==b.area)return 0;
   const ga=occupancyGrid(a),gb=occupancyGrid(b);let intersection=0,union=0;
   for(let i=0;i<ga.length;i++){if(ga[i]&&gb[i])intersection++;if(ga[i]||gb[i])union++;}
   const spatial=union?intersection/union:0;
   const size=Math.max(0,1-(Math.abs(a.W-b.W)+Math.abs(a.H-b.H))/(Math.max(a.W,b.W)+Math.max(a.H,b.H)));
   const typ=a.type===b.type?1:0,dom=a.dominant===b.dominant?1:0;
   return Math.round(100*(spatial*.58+size*.24+typ*.12+dom*.06));
 }
 function report(){
   const rooms=[...roomStore.values()],issues=[],similar=[],byMap={};
   for(const p of rooms){
     byMap[p.area]=(byMap[p.area]||0)+1;
     const occupied=unionArea(p.paths,p.W,p.H),ratio=occupied/(p.W*p.H);
     const doorClear=p.paths.every(q=>!(q.x<p.W/2+24&&q.x+q.w>p.W/2-24&&q.y+q.h>p.H-60));
     if(ratio>.42)issues.push({room:p.key,kind:'dense',coverage:Math.round(ratio*100)});
     if(ratio<.035)issues.push({room:p.key,kind:'sparse',coverage:Math.round(ratio*100)});
     if(!doorClear)issues.push({room:p.key,kind:'door-review',coverage:Math.round(ratio*100)});
   }
   for(let i=0;i<rooms.length;i++)for(let j=0;j<i;j++){
     if(rooms[i].area!==rooms[j].area)continue;
     const score=similarity(rooms[i],rooms[j]);
     if(score>=86)similar.push({a:rooms[i].key,b:rooms[j].key,score});
   }
   similar.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
   return {version:VERSION,observedRooms:rooms.length,byMap,similar:similar.slice(0,50),totalSimilar:similar.length,issues,physicsIndex:window.LQPrecisePhysics?.indexStats?.()||null,render:ambientStats,settings:{...opts}};
 }
 function drawAmbient(sc,dt){

        function Pr(e) {
          return {
            skin: kr,
            hair: 5913122,
            style: `short`,
            outfit: e,
            pants: 3820154,
            hat: { kind: `cap`, color: Ir(e, 0.75) },
          };
        }
        var Fr = 2826800;
        function Ir(e, t) {
          let n = Math.min(255, Math.round(((e >> 16) & 255) * t)),
            r = Math.min(255, Math.round(((e >> 8) & 255) * t)),
            i = Math.min(255, Math.round((e & 255) * t));
          return (n << 16) | (r << 8) | i;
        }
        function Lr(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
          (e.fillStyle(Fr, 1).fillRect(t - 1, n - 1, r + 2, i + 2),
            e.fillStyle(a, 1).fillRect(t, n, r, i));
        }
        function Rr(e, t, n, r, i) {
          (e.fillStyle(Fr, 1).fillCircle(t, n, r + 1), e.fillStyle(i, 1).fillCircle(t, n, r));
        }
        function zr(e, t, n, r) {
          const __eyeColor = typeof t.eye === 'number' ? t.eye : 2236979;
          // Uniform characters (Gojo) walk in a relaxed way: short steps, arms stay still with hands in the pockets.
          const __k = t.uniform || t.kimono ? 1 : 2;
          let i = n === `side`,
            a = n === `dside` || n === `uside`,
            o = n === `up` || n === `uside`,
            s = r === 1 ? __k : 0,
            c = r === 2 ? __k : 0,
            l = t.uniform || t.kimono ? 0 : r === 1 ? 1 : r === 2 ? -1 : 0,

            d = a ? 0.5 : 0;
          const __glide = !!t.glide;

          // is identical (it glides, it does not step); the slow up/down bob is done by aura.js on the live sprite.
          if (__glide) {
            e.fillStyle(0, 0.16).fillEllipse(12, 35, 11, 4);
            e.translateCanvas(0, -4);
          } else if (!t.riding) e.fillStyle(0, 0.28).fillEllipse(12, 35, 16, 6);
          // Gliding legs: normal-sized legs, tilted 30 degrees backwards when seen from the side (far leg darker).
          // From the front/back the tilt points along the view direction, so they are drawn as ordinary legs.
          const __glideLegs = () => {
            if (i) {
              const L = 7,
                h = L * Math.cos(Math.PI / 6),
                dx = L * Math.sin(Math.PI / 6);

                const pt = (u, side) => [x + side - dx * u, 27 + h * u];
                const quad = (u0, u1) => [pt(u0, 0), pt(u0, 5), pt(u1, 5), pt(u1, 0)];

                  for (let k = 1; k < pts.length; k++) e.lineTo(pts[k][0], pts[k][1]);
                  e.closePath();
                  e.fillStyle(c, 1);
                  e.fillPath();
                  if (stroke) {
                    e.lineStyle(1, Fr, 1);
                    e.strokePath();
                  }
                };
                fill(quad(0, 1), color, true);
                fill(quad(0.72, 1), 3811874, false);
              };
              leg(8, Ir(t.pants, 0.78));
              leg(10, t.pants);
            } else if (a) {
              f(6, 0);
              f(12, 0);
            } else {
              f(6, 0);
              f(13, 0);

            let i = 7 - r;

          };

            (__glide

        function __lqDrawHair(g, c, dir, dx) {
          const spec = __hairSpecs[c.style];
          if (!spec) return;
          const hair = typeof c.hair === 'number' ? c.hair : 0x5a3b2a;
          const view = dir === 'up' || dir === 'uside' ? spec.back : dir === 'side' ? spec.side : spec.front;
          if (!view) return;
          for (const [x, y, w, h] of view.blocks || []) Lr(g, x + dx, y, w, h, hair);
          if (c.hat) return;
          for (const p of view.polys || []) {
            // One filled silhouette with a thin dark outline.
            g.beginPath();
            g.moveTo(p[0] + dx, p[1]);
            for (let i = 2; i < p.length; i += 2) g.lineTo(p[i] + dx, p[i + 1]);
            g.closePath();
            g.fillStyle(hair, 1);
            g.fillPath();
            g.lineStyle(1, Fr, 1);
            g.strokePath();
          }
          const blobs = [...(view.puffs || []), ...(view.knots || [])];
          if (view.outline === 'clean') {
            // All outlines first, then all fills, so overlapping shapes merge into one silhouette without inner seams.
            g.fillStyle(Fr, 1);
            for (const [x, y, r] of blobs) g.fillCircle(x + dx, y, r + 1);
            g.lineStyle(2, Fr, 1);
            for (const q of view.tris || []) g.strokeTriangle(q[0] + dx, q[1], q[2] + dx, q[3], q[4] + dx, q[5]);
            g.fillStyle(hair, 1);
            for (const [x, y, r] of blobs) g.fillCircle(x + dx, y, r);
          } else for (const [x, y, r] of blobs) Rr(g, x + dx, y, r, hair);
          g.fillStyle(hair, 1);
          for (const q of view.tris || []) g.fillTriangle(q[0] + dx, q[1], q[2] + dx, q[3], q[4] + dx, q[5]);
          if (view.outline === true) {
            g.lineStyle(1, Fr, 1);
            for (const q of view.tris || []) g.strokeTriangle(q[0] + dx, q[1], q[2] + dx, q[3], q[4] + dx, q[5]);
          }
          const lum = (((hair >> 16) & 255) + ((hair >> 8) & 255) + (hair & 255)) / 3;
          g.lineStyle(1, Ir(hair, lum < 90 ? 1.9 : 0.8), 1);
          for (const l of view.lines || []) g.lineBetween(l[0] + dx, l[1], l[2] + dx, l[3]);

        zr = function (g, c, dir, frame) {
          __v11BaseCharacter(g, c, dir, frame);
          // Riding a shadow beast (Megumi): eyes shut, relaxed. The open eyes are painted over with skin, then a thin
          // dark line is drawn where each eye was.
          if (c.riding && dir !== 'up' && dir !== 'uside') {
            const exs = dir === 'side' ? [17] : dir === 'dside' ? [11, 16] : [8, 14];
            for (const ex of exs) {
              g.fillStyle(c.skin, 1).fillRect(ex, 13, 2, 3);
              g.fillStyle(0x241c1e, 1).fillRect(ex, 15, 2, 1);
            }
          }
          // A few one-pixel material highlights, carried in cached textures only.
          const col = typeof c.outfit === 'number' ? c.outfit : 0x5a84bb;
          const bright = (v, k) => Math.min(255, Math.round(v * k));
          const hi =
            (bright((col >> 16) & 255, 1.32) << 16) |
            (bright((col >> 8) & 255, 1.32) << 8) |
            bright(col & 255, 1.32);
          const face = dir === 'down' || dir === 'dside';
          g.fillStyle(hi, 0.42).fillRect(8, 20, 7, 1);
          g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.16).fillRect(10, 23, 2, 1);
          g.fillStyle(0x141b2d, 0.34).fillRect(7, 33, 4, 1).fillRect(14, 33, 4, 1);
          if (face) {
            g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.27).fillRect(7, 11, 2, 1);
            g.fillRect(15, 11, 2, 1);
          }
          if (c.apron) {
            g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.2).fillRect(9, 23, 5, 1);
          }
          if (c.glasses) {
            g.fillStyle(0xd7f1ff, 0.19).fillRect(8, 13, 2, 1);
          }
          // Extra hair styles and a backpack for the character creator.
          const hairColor = typeof c.hair === 'number' ? c.hair : 0x5a3b2a;
          const isSide = dir === 'side',
            isDiag = dir === 'dside' || dir === 'uside',
            isBack = dir === 'up' || dir === 'uside',
            dx = isDiag ? 0.5 : 0;
          if (c.style === 'bob') {
            if (isBack) Lr(g, 4, 10, isDiag ? 15 : 16, 10, hairColor);
            else if (isSide) Lr(g, 4, 10, 6, 9, hairColor);
            else {
              Lr(g, 2, 10, 4, 9, hairColor);
              Lr(g, 18, 10, 4, 9, hairColor);
            }
          } else if (c.style === 'ponytail') {
            if (isBack) Lr(g, 10, 14, 4, 12, hairColor);
            else if (isSide) Lr(g, 4, 11, 3, 10, hairColor);
            else Lr(g, 19, 12, 3, 8, hairColor);

          } else if (c.style === 'curly' && !c.hat) {

              [5, 7],
              [19, 7],
              [8, 3],
              [16, 3],

          // Head details of a kimono wearer follow the raised head (see zr).
          if (c.kimono) g.translateCanvas(0, -1);
          // Glowing eyes: a white spark and a pale lower highlight so a light eye colour reads as luminous.
          if (c.eyeGlow && typeof c.eye === 'number' && dir !== 'up' && dir !== 'uside') {
            const exs = isSide ? [17] : isDiag ? [11, 16] : [8, 14];

          }

            else g.fillRect(5, 14, 3, 1).fillRect(16, 14, 3, 1).fillRect(6, 18, 3, 1).fillRect(15, 18, 3, 1).fillRect(10, 14, 4, 1).fillRect(12, 10, 1, 2);

        const __lqStyleAlias = { gojo: 'storm', itadori: 'scruffy', megumi: 'thorn', nobara: 'flare', maki: 'highpony', geto: 'longbun', nanami: 'swept', sukuna: 'blaze', yuta: 'tousled', toji: 'crop' };
        const __lqStyle = (s) => __lqStyleAlias[s] || s || 'short';
        function __lqLookKey(l) {
          const s = JSON.stringify([
            l.skin,
            l.hair,
            __lqStyle(l.style),
            l.eye,
            l.outfit,
            l.pants,
            l.hat && [l.hat.kind, l.hat.color],
            !!l.glasses,
            !!l.dress,
            l.backpack || 0,
            !!l.blindfold,
            !!l.collar,
            l.tie || 0,
            !!l.uniform,
            !!l.eyeGlow,
            l.aura === 'infinity',
            !!l.extraEyes,
            !!l.faceMarks,
            !!l.kimono,
            l.trim || 0,
            !!l.riding,
          ]);
          let h = 5381;
          for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) + h + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
          return 'pl' + h.toString(36);
        }
        function __lqLookToAppearance(l) {
          return {
            skin: l.skin,
            hair: l.hair,
            style: __lqStyle(l.style),
            eye: l.eye,
            outfit: l.outfit,
            pants: l.pants,
            hat: l.hat ? { kind: l.hat.kind, color: l.hat.color } : undefined,
            glasses: !!l.glasses,
            dress: !!l.dress,
            backpack: l.backpack || undefined,
            blindfold: !!l.blindfold,
            collar: !!l.collar,
            tie: l.tie || undefined,
            uniform: !!l.uniform,
            eyeGlow: !!l.eyeGlow,
            // Infinity users glide: they hover above the ground with their legs trailing behind.
            glide: l.aura === 'infinity',
            extraEyes: !!l.extraEyes,
            faceMarks: !!l.faceMarks,
            kimono: !!l.kimono,
            trim: l.trim || undefined,
            riding: !!l.riding,
          };
        }
        window.LQCharacter = {
          pad: __LQ_PAD,
          size: { w: 24, h: 38 + __LQ_PAD },
          keyFor: __lqLookKey,
          appearance: __lqLookToAppearance,
          ensure(scene, look) {
            const key = __lqLookKey(look);
            VrTall(scene, key, __lqLookToAppearance(look), __LQ_PAD);
            return key;
          },
          imageFor(scene, look, dir = 'down', frame = 0) {
            const key = this.ensure(scene, look);
            return scene.textures.get(`ch_${key}_${dir}_${frame}`).getSourceImage();
          },
        };
        function Hr(e, t, n) {
          let r = Math.abs(t),
            i = Math.abs(n);
          (r < 0.01 && i < 0.01) ||
            (i < r * 0.4
              ? ((e.dir = `side`), (e.flip = t < 0))
              : r < i * 0.4
                ? (e.dir = n < 0 ? `up` : `down`)
                : ((e.dir = n < 0 ? `uside` : `dside`), (e.flip = t < 0)));
        }
        function Ur(e, t, n, r) {
          // Sprites flagged lqSlow (kimono wearers) change walk frame 2.4x less often: a slow, dignified pace.
          let i = r ? 1 + (Math.floor(n.phase / (e.lqSlow ? 24 : 10)) % 2) : 0,
            a = `ch_${t}_${n.dir}_${i}`;
          (e.texture.key !== a && e.setTexture(a),
            e.setFlipX(n.flip && n.dir !== `down` && n.dir !== `up`));
        }

              vi = matched[2].trim();

            const i = data.words.findIndex((w) => w.en.toLowerCase() === en.toLowerCase());
            const word = { en, vi, box: 0, due: 0 };
            if (i >= 0) data.words[i] = word;
            else data.words.push(word);
            data.words = data.words.slice(-300);
            save();
            return `📒 Saved “${en}” — ${vi}. Type “flashcard” to review.`;
          }
          if (/^(so tu vung|danh sach tu|tu da luu|saved words|my words)$/.test(s)) {
            if (!data.words.length)
              return '📒 Your word book is empty. Try “save word: explore = khám phá” or “flashcard” to get a sample card.';
            return (
              `📒 Word book (${data.words.length}):\n` +
              data.words
                .slice(-18)
                .map((w, i) => `${i + 1}. ${w.en} — ${w.vi}`)
                .join('\n') +
              '\nYou can export everything with the 📒 button below.'
            );
          }
          if (/^(flashcard|the ghi nho|the tu vung|on tu|review words|review cards)$/.test(s)) {
            ensureStarter();
            const now = Date.now();
            const due = data.words.filter((w) => (w.due || 0) <= now);
            const list = due.length ? due : data.words;
            card = list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)];
            return `🃏 FLASHCARD — ${card.en}\nDo you remember the meaning? Type “flip card” to check, then type “remember” or “forgot” to schedule your review. (${due.length} words due)`;
          }
          if (/^(lat the|show answer|flip card|xem dap an)$/.test(s))
            return card
              ? `🔎 ${card.en} = ${card.vi}.\nType “remember” if you know it or “forgot” if not.`
              : 'Type “flashcard” to pick a card first.';
          if (/^(nho|quen|remember|forgot|kho nho|da thuoc)$/.test(s) && card) {
            const ok = /^(nho|remember|da thuoc)$/.test(s);
            card.box = ok ? Math.min(4, (card.box || 0) + 1) : 0;
            const days = [0, 1, 3, 7, 14][card.box];
            card.due = Date.now() + days * 86400000;
            data.practice++;
            day().review++;
            const word = card.en;
            card = null;
            save();
            return `${ok ? '✅ Remembered' : '🔁 Needs review'}: ${word}. ${days ? 'Review again in ' + days + ' day(s).' : 'It will come up again right away.'}\nType “flashcard” to keep practicing.`;
          }
          if (/^(thong ke|tien do|study stats|my progress|ket qua hoc tap)$/.test(s)) {
            const rate = data.quizzes ? Math.round((100 * data.correct) / data.quizzes) : 0;
            return `${summary()}\n🎯 Accuracy: ${rate}%\n📅 Today: ${day().quiz} quiz questions, ${day().review} cards reviewed.\nTip: do 3 quizzes and review 5 flashcards every day.`;
          }
          if (/^(thu thach hom nay|nhiem vu hom nay|daily challenge|daily quest)$/.test(s)) {
            const d = day(),
              tasks = [
                ['Answer 3 quiz questions', d.quiz, 3],
                ['Review 5 flashcards', d.review, 5],
              ];
            return (
              '🏆 TODAY\'S CHALLENGE\n' +
              tasks
                .map(
                  ([label, value, total]) =>
                    `${value >= total ? '✅' : '▫️'} ${label}: ${Math.min(total, value)}/${total}`,
                )
                .join('\n') +
              '\nType “quiz” or “flashcard” to complete the challenge.'
            );
          }
          if (/^(lo trinh hoc|ke hoach hoc|study plan|learning plan|hoc gi hom nay)$/.test(s)) {
            const advice =
              level === 'A1' || level === 'A2'
                ? 'focus on short sentence patterns, vocabulary and pronunciation'
                : level === 'B1'
                  ? 'focus on situational conversations and verb tenses'
                  : 'focus on natural expression, reasoning and vocabulary nuance';
            return `🎯 PERSONAL STUDY PLAN (${level}) — 15 minutes/day\n1. 3 min: flashcards (5 words).\n2. 4 min: quiz (3 questions).\n3. 5 min: scenario: cafe / library / hospital.\n4. 3 min: write one sentence and use “fix: …”.\nFocus: ${advice}.\n${summary()}`;
          }
          if (/^(kich ban|scenario)\s*[:：]/.test(s)) {
            const t = s.split(/[:：]/).slice(1).join(':').trim();
            if (/ca phe|cafe|coffee/.test(t))
              return '🎬 CAFE\nYou are ordering a drink at Sunny Cafe. Start the conversation with: “Could I have a cup of tea, please?”\nTo rehearse over several turns, type “practice conversation”.';
            if (/thu vien|library|book/.test(t))
              return '🎬 LIBRARY\nYou need to find an English book. Start with: “Excuse me, could you recommend a book for me?”\nTry visiting the librarian, Green, in town.';
            if (/benh vien|hospital|doctor/.test(t))
              return '🎬 HOSPITAL\nYou need to describe your symptoms: “I have a headache. Could you help me?”\nPractice using these words: appointment, healthy, careful.';
            return '🎬 Choose a scenario: “scenario: cafe”, “scenario: library” or “scenario: hospital”.';
          }
          return null;
        }

          const rows = [

            a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url;
          a.download = 'LIFEQUEST_SO_TU_VUNG.csv';
          a.click();
          setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
        }

        function state() {
          const g = game();

          if (!Number.isFinite(v.totalChats) || v.totalChats < 0) v.totalChats = 0;

            v.inventory = { note: 1 };

          v.story.step = Math.max(0, Number(v.story.step) || 0);

          if (!Array.isArray(v.generated)) v.generated = [];
          if (!v.daily || typeof v.daily !== 'object') v.daily = {};
          if (!Number.isFinite(v.energy)) v.energy = 100;
          return v;

        const save = () => getScene()?.store?.save?.();
        function levelInfo(xp) {
          let lv = 1,
            required = 0;
          while (lv < 30) {
            const next = required + Math.round(55 + 27 * lv + 10 * Math.sqrt(lv));
            if (xp < next) break;
            required = next;
            lv++;
          }
          return {
            level: lv,
            start: required,
            next: required + Math.round(55 + 27 * lv + 10 * Math.sqrt(lv)),
          };
        }
        function notify(message) {
          manualMessage = message;
          const toast = $('rpg-toast');
          if (!toast) return;
          toast.textContent = message;
          toast.classList.add('shown');
          clearTimeout(hintTimer);
          hintTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('shown'), 4300);
        }
        function giveXP(amount, reason) {
          const r = state();
          if (!r) return;
          const before = levelInfo(r.xp).level;
          r.xp += Math.max(0, Math.round(amount));
          const after = levelInfo(r.xp).level;
          save();
          refresh();
          notify(
            after > before
              ? `🎉 Level up ${after}! +${amount} XP · ${reason}`
              : `✨ +${amount} XP · ${reason}`,
          );
        }
        function changeItem(id, count) {
          const s = state();
          if (!s || !items[id]) return;
          s.inventory[id] = Math.max(0, (Number(s.inventory[id]) || 0) + count);
          save();

        function relationship(id) {
          const s = state();
          if (!s) return { talks: 0, trust: 0, lastDay: 0, lastMessage: '' };
          if (!s.relationships[id])
            s.relationships[id] = { talks: 0, trust: 0, lastDay: 0, lastMessage: '', dailyXP: 0 };
          return s.relationships[id];
        }
        function adjustRelationship(id, amount) {

        function advance(text) {
          const s = state(),
            c = chapter();
          if (!s || !c) return [];
          s.story.step++;
          if (s.story.step < c.steps.length) {
            save();
            refresh();
            notify(text || '📜 Quest updated');
            return [`📜 ${text || 'Step completed!'}  ${c.steps[s.story.step]}`];
          }
          const decision = s.story.choice;
          s.story.done.push(c.id);
          s.story.index++;
          s.story.step = 0;
          s.story.choice = '';

          const rewardCash =
            c.rewards.money + (c.id === 'letter' && decision === 'Quickly' ? 12 : 0);
          const g = game();
          g.money += rewardCash;
          changeItem(c.rewards.item, 1);
          giveXP(rewardXP, `Completed ${c.title}`);
          save();

          notify(`🏆 ${c.title} complete · +$${rewardCash}`);
          return [
            `🏆 Chapter complete! +${rewardXP} XP, +$${rewardCash}, ${items[c.rewards.item].name}`,
          ];

        function isEnglishMessage(message) {
          return (
            /^[\x20-\x7E]+$/.test(message.trim()) &&
            /[a-zA-Z]+/.test(message) &&
            message.trim().split(/\s+/).length >= 3

        function onNpcMessage(id, message) {
          const scene = getScene(),
            s = state();
          if (!scene || !s) return [];
          const npc = scene.npcs?.find((n) => n.def.id === id)?.def;
          const day = scene.store.game.day;
          const rel = relationship(id);
          if (rel.lastDay !== day) {
            rel.lastDay = day;
            rel.dailyXP = 0;
          }
          rel.talks++;
          rel.lastMessage = String(message).slice(0, 250);
          rel.trust = Math.min(100, rel.trust + (isEnglishMessage(message) ? 2 : 1));
          s.totalChats++;
          const result = [];
          if (isEnglishMessage(message) && rel.dailyXP < 16) {
            rel.dailyXP += 4;
            s.xp += 4;
            result.push('✨ +4 XP conversation practice');
          }
          const c = chapter(),
            st = step(),
            m = fold(message),
            en = isEnglishMessage(message);
          if (c?.id === 'letter') {
            if (st === 0 && id === 'barista' && en) {
              result.push(...advance('Lily gave you the message.'));
            } else if (
              st === 2 &&
              id === 'mayor' &&
              en &&
              /\b(letter|message|lily|cafe|help|town)\b/.test(m)
            )
              result.push(...advance('The mayor received the message.'));
          }
          if (c?.id === 'guide') {
            if (st === 0 && id === 'librarian' && en)
              result.push(...advance('The librarian needs you to find the book.'));
            else if (
              st === 2 &&
              s.story.choice === 'Ask Tom' &&
              id === 'shopkeeper' &&
              en &&
              /\b(book|library|guide|lost|find|shop)\b/.test(m)
            )
              result.push(...advance('Tom gave you a clue.'));
            else if (
              st === 3 &&
              id === 'librarian' &&
              en &&
              /\b(book|found|shop|tom|guide|help)\b/.test(m)
            )
              result.push(...advance('You brought the news back to the librarian.'));
          }
          if (c?.id === 'festival') {
            if (
              st === 0 &&
              id === 'mayor' &&
              en &&
              /\b(festival|town|party|idea|event|help|plan)\b/.test(m)
            )
              result.push(...advance('The mayor agreed to consider the plan.'));
            else if (
              st === 2 &&
              id === (s.story.choice === 'Green garden' ? 'barista' : 'kid') &&
              en
            )
              result.push(...advance('You consulted a resident.'));
            else if (
              st === 3 &&
              id === 'mayor' &&
              en &&
              /\b(festival|plan|music|garden|party|event|help)\b/.test(m)
            )
              result.push(...advance('The plan has been approved.'));
          }
          for (const quest of s.generated.filter((q) => q.status === 'active')) {
            if (quest.npc === id && en && quest.keywords.some((w) => m.includes(fold(w)))) {
              quest.status = 'done';
              quest.completedDay = day;
              scene.store.game.money += quest.money;
              s.xp += quest.xp;
              changeItem('token', 1);
              result.push(`✅ ${quest.title}: +${quest.xp} XP, +$${quest.money}, 🎟️`);
              notify(`🏅 Quest complete: ${quest.title}`);
            }
          }
          save();
          refresh();
          return result;
        }

        function clockHour(h) {
          const min = Math.round(Number(h) * 60);
          return (
            String(Math.floor(min / 60) % 24).padStart(2, '0') +
            ':' +
            String(min % 60).padStart(2, '0')
          );
        }
        function restorePosition(scene) {
          const point = scene?.store?.game?.rpg?.lastPosition;
          if (!point || point.area !== scene.area?.id || scene.inside) return;
          const x = Number(point.x),
            y = Number(point.y);
          if (
            !Number.isFinite(x) ||
            !Number.isFinite(y) ||
            x < 32 ||
            y < 32 ||
            x >= scene.area.w * 32 - 32 ||
            y >= scene.area.h * 32 - 32
          )
            return;
          if (window.LQValleyPlay.isValley(scene)) {
            if(window.LQValleyPlay.restoreSkywayPosition(scene,point))return;
            if (scene.area.warpAt(Math.floor(x / 32), Math.floor(y / 32))) return;
            if (scene.blocked(x, y)) {
              const near = window.LQValleyPlay.closestGround(scene, x, y);
              if (near) scene.player.setPosition(near.x, near.y);
              return;
            }
          }
          if (typeof scene.blocked === 'function' && scene.blocked(x, y)) return;
          scene.player?.setPosition(x, y);
        }
        function savePosition(scene) {
          const s = state();
          if (!s || !scene?.player || !scene?.area) return;
          if (scene.inside) {
            const r = scene.inside;
            s.lastInterior = {
              area: scene.area.id,
              building: r.b.name,
              ...(r.heritage?{buildingId:r.heritage.id,surfaceId:r.heritage.surface?.surfaceId,saveSchema:r.heritage.layout?.geo56?4:r.heritage.layout?.geo55?3:r.heritage.layout?.network?2:1}:{}),
              floor: r.floor || 0,
              tx: +((scene.player.x - Yr) / (32 * r.k)).toFixed(3),
              ty: +((scene.player.y - Xr) / (32 * r.k)).toFixed(3),
            };
            save();
            return;
          }
          if (s.lastInterior) {
            delete s.lastInterior;
            save();
          }
          const { x, y } = scene.player,
            p = s.lastPosition || {};
          if (p.area === scene.area.id && (p.surface||null)===(scene._lqSurface||null) && Math.hypot(x - (p.x || 0), y - (p.y || 0)) < 8) return;
          s.lastPosition = { area: scene.area.id, x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y), ...(scene._lqSurface==='skyway'?{surface:'skyway',entry:scene._lqSkywayEntry}:window.LQValleyContent?.crossingOf(scene._lqSurface)?{surface:scene._lqSurface,entry:scene._lqCrossEntry}:{}) };
          save();
        }
        function activeGenerated() {
          const s = state();
          return s?.generated?.find((q) => q.status === 'active') || null;
        }
        async function makeQuest() {
          const s = state(),
            ctx = getTownContext();
          if (!s || !ctx) return notify('The town hasn\'t finished loading.');
          if (activeGenerated()) {
            notify('📜 Finish your current AI quest before creating a new one.');
            return;
          }
          const completedToday = s.generated.filter((q) => q.createdDay === ctx.day).length;
          if (completedToday >= 3) {
            notify('⏰ You can have at most 3 AI quests per in-game day. Wait for the next day.');
            return;
          }
          const available = ctx.npcs.filter(
            (n) => n.available && !n.indoors && n.activity && !/sleep/i.test(n.activity),
          );
          if (!available.length) {
            notify(
              'No NPCs are active outdoors right now. Head to a busier area or wait until daytime.',
            );
            return;
          }
          const choice =
            available[(s.generated.length + ctx.day + ctx.position.x) % available.length];
          const tpl =
            generatedTemplates[(s.generated.length + ctx.day) % generatedTemplates.length];
          let title = tpl.title,
            summary = tpl.summary,
            instruction = tpl.instruction;
          const ai = {};
          try {
            Object.assign(ai, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('english-town-ai') || '{}'));
          } catch {}
          const key = String(
            ai.geminiKey || window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.GEMINI_API_KEY || '',
          ).trim();
          const model =
            String(
              ai.geminiModel || window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.MODEL || 'gemini-2.5-flash',
            ).trim() || 'gemini-2.5-flash';
          const prompt = `Create engaging English-learning RPG dialogue quest flavor. Return only JSON with keys "title", "summary_vi", "instruction_en". NPC: ${choice.name}; role: ${choice.activity}. Quest's unchangeable completion criterion: ${tpl.instruction}. Player level: ${cefrService.getLevel()}. Title max 55 chars, Vietnamese summary max 150 chars, English instruction max 140 chars. Do NOT claim any rewards or change targets.`;
          const config = {
            contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
            generationConfig: window.LQGemini.genConfig(model, {
              temperature: 0.7,
              maxOutputTokens: 270,
              responseMimeType: 'application/json',
            }),
          };
          const button = $('rpg-generate');
          if (button) {
            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = '✨ AI is writing…';
          }
          try {
            // Flavor is optional: quest validation and rewards remain entirely local & deterministic.
            if (key || (await window.LQGemini.proxyAvailable())) {
              const controller = new AbortController();
              const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 14000);
              try {
                const url = key
                  ? `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`
                  : window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.PROXY_URL || '/api/gemini';
                const resp = await fetch(url, {
                  method: 'POST',
                  headers: key
                    ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': key }
                    : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                  body: JSON.stringify(key ? config : { model, body: config }),
                  signal: controller.signal,
                });
                if (resp.ok) {
                  const data = await resp.json();
                  const content = (data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || [])
                    .map((p) => p.text || '')
                    .join('');
                  const parsed = JSON.parse(content.replace(/^```(?:json)?|```$/g, '').trim());
                  if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                    if (typeof parsed.title === 'string' && parsed.title.length < 80)
                      title = parsed.title.slice(0, 60);
                    if (typeof parsed.summary_vi === 'string' && parsed.summary_vi.length < 230)
                      summary = parsed.summary_vi.slice(0, 160);
                    // Keep the original validated objective. Generated prose must not change completion rules.
                  }
                }
              } finally {
                clearTimeout(timer);
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Quest flavor uses offline fallback:', e?.message);
          } finally {
            if (button) {
              button.disabled = false;
              button.textContent = '✨ Create new quest';
            }
          }
          const quest = {
            id: `daily-${ctx.day}-${s.generated.length + 1}`,
            npc: choice.id,
            npcName: choice.name,
            title,
            summary,
            instruction,
            keywords: tpl.keywords,
            xp: tpl.xp,
            money: tpl.money,
            status: 'active',
            createdDay: ctx.day,
          };
          s.generated.push(quest);
          s.generated = s.generated.slice(-30);
          save();
          refresh();
          notify(`📜 New quest from ${choice.name}: ${quest.title}`);
        }
        function handleCoach(message) {
          const m = fold(message);
          const match = String(message).match(
            /^\s*(?:nhớ(?:\s+giùm)?\s+rằng|nho rang|remember that)\s*[:：]?\s*(.+)$/i,
          );
          if (match) return storeFact(match[1]);
          if (/^(?:quen ghi nho|xoa ghi nho|forget memories|show memory|ghi nho|bo nho)$/.test(m)) {
            open('memory');
            return '🧠 Opened the memory tab. You can delete individual entries here.';
          }
          if (/^(?:tui do|hanh trang|inventory|backpack|cua hang|shop)$/.test(m)) {
            open(/shop|cua hang/.test(m) ? 'shop' : 'bag');
            return '🎒 I opened your bag / shop.';
          }
          if (
            /^(?:cap do|kinh nghiem|my level|xp|trang thai nhan vat|character status|money|tien)$/.test(
              m,
            )
          ) {
            const s = state(),
              g = game();
            if (!s || !g) return 'Loading.';
            return `🎮 Level ${levelInfo(s.xp).level}, ${s.xp} XP, $${g.money}, ${s.totalChats} conversations. Press the 🎒 RPG button on the toolbar for details.`;
          }
          if (
            /^(?:cot truyen|nhiem vu cot truyen|story|story quest|chuong tiep|quest story)$/.test(m)
          ) {
            open('story');
            return storyText();
          }
          if (/^(?:lich npc|lich sinh hoat|npc schedule|npc relationships|quan he npc)$/.test(m)) {
            open('people');
            return '👥 Opened NPC schedules, friendships and conversations.';
          }
          if (/^(?:tao nhiem vu|nhiem vu ai|generate quest|new ai quest|quest ai)$/.test(m)) {
            open('quests');
            void makeQuest();
            return '✨ I am creating a conversation quest based on the NPCs who are around. If Gemini is not connected, the game will use a pre-written quest.';
          }
          return null;
        }
        function open(tab = 'story') {
          visibleTab = tab;
          $('rpg-panel').hidden = false;
          refresh();
        }
        function close() {
          $('rpg-panel').hidden = true;
        }
        function renderStory(s) {
          const c = chapter();
          if (!c)
            return `<div class="rpg-good">🏆 You have completed all 3 chapters! Keep taking AI quests or practice English with NPCs.</div>`;
          const choices = {
            letter: ['Carefully', 'Quickly'],
            guide: ['Search the market', 'Ask Tom'],
            festival: ['Music', 'Green garden'],
          }[c.id];
          const chooseNow = s.story.step === 1;
          const actualStep = (v, i) =>
            c.id === 'guide' && i === 2 && s.story.choice === 'Search the market'
              ? 'Go to the Market to look for clues. No need to chat with Tom.'
              : c.id === 'festival' && i === 2
                ? s.story.choice === 'Green garden'
                  ? 'Ask Lily about the green garden.'
                  : 'Ask Mia about the music idea.'
                : v;
          return `<h3>📜 ${escape(c.title)}</h3><p>${escape(c.summary)}</p><ol class="rpg-steps">${c.steps.map((v, i) => `<li class="${i < s.story.step ? 'done' : i === s.story.step ? 'current' : ''}">${escape(actualStep(v, i))}</li>`).join('')}</ol>${chooseNow ? `<div class="rpg-card"><b>Make a decision:</b><div class="rpg-actions">${choices.map((c) => `<button data-rpg-choice="${escape(c)}">${escape(c)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>` : ''}<p class="rpg-muted">${s.story.choice ? `You chose: ${escape(s.story.choice)} · ` : ''}To complete a conversation step, go to the right NPC, press E and say an English sentence of at least 3 words that fits the goal.</p><div class="rpg-card">🎁 Reward: ${c.rewards.xp} XP, $${c.rewards.money} and ${items[c.rewards.item].name}</div>`;
        }
        function renderQuest(s) {
          return (
            `<h3>✨ Situational AI Quests</h3><p class="rpg-muted">AI can write the quest content if Gemini is connected. If not, the game still creates offline quests. Goals and rewards are always verified by the game.</p><button id="rpg-generate" class="rpg-primary">✨ Create new quest</button>` +
            (s.generated.length
              ? s.generated
                  .slice()
                  .reverse()
                  .map(
                    (q) =>
                      `<div class="rpg-card"><b>${escape(q.title)}</b> ${q.status === 'done' ? '✅' : ''}<p>${escape(q.summary)}</p><div>🎯 ${escape(q.npcName)} · ${escape(q.instruction)}</div><div class="rpg-muted">Use at least 3 English words, including one of these words: ${escape(q.keywords.join(', '))}.</div><small>+${q.xp} XP · $${q.money} · ${q.status === 'active' ? 'In progress' : 'Completed'}</small></div>`,
                  )
                  .join('')
              : '<p>No AI quests yet. Press the create button to get started.</p>') +
            `<p class="rpg-muted">Limit of 3 quests per in-game day, with at most 1 quest in progress.</p>`
          );
        }
        function renderBag(s) {
          const entries = Object.entries(s.inventory).filter(([id, n]) => n > 0 && items[id]);
          return `<h3>🎒 Your Bag</h3>${entries.length ? entries.map(([id, n]) => `<div class="rpg-card rpg-item"><div><b>${items[id].name}</b><div class="rpg-muted">${items[id].desc}</div></div><div>x${n} ${!items[id].quest && items[id].bonus ? `<button data-rpg-use="${id}">Use</button>` : ''}</div></div>`).join('') : '<p>No items yet.</p>'}<p class="rpg-muted">Story items are kept as keepsakes. Don't clear your browser data unless you have exported your save in the ⚙ AI section.</p>`;
        }
        function renderShop() {
          return `<h3>💰 Smart Economy V10</h3><p>Go to a shop, meet the NPC and open Economy with the B key to buy things. Remote purchases are not possible.</p><button onclick="window.LQ10_ECONOMY?.show('shop')">🛒 Open V10 Shop</button>`;
        }
        function renderPeople() {
          const all = currentSchedules();
          return `<h3>👥 Residents & Live Schedules</h3><p class="rpg-muted">Activity data comes directly from the in-game time; NPCs may go home, sleep, or move to another area.</p>${all.map((n) => `<div class="rpg-card"><b>${escape(n.name)}</b> <span class="rpg-muted">${n.available ? '🟢 Around' : '🌙 Unavailable'}</span><div>🕒 ${escape(n.activity || 'Unknown')} · 🤝 Bond ${n.trust}/100 · 💬 ${n.talks} chats</div>${n.lastMessage ? `<small>Last said: “${escape(n.lastMessage)}”</small>` : ''}${n.timetable.length ? `<details><summary>View 24-hour schedule</summary>${n.timetable.map((w) => `<div class="rpg-schedule">${clockHour(w.from)}–${clockHour(w.to)} · ${escape(w.label)}</div>`).join('')}</details>` : ''}</div>`).join('')}`;
        }
        function renderMemory(s) {
          return `<h3>🧠 Player Memory</h3><p class="rpg-muted">Only information you explicitly ask to be remembered is saved. The AI receives these memories along with the quest context.</p><form id="rpg-memory-form"><input id="rpg-fact" maxlength="180" placeholder="Example: My name is Minh and I like reading books" required/><button>Save</button></form>${s.playerFacts.length ? s.playerFacts.map((f, i) => `<div class="rpg-card rpg-item"><span>${escape(f)}</span><button data-rpg-forget="${i}" title="Delete this entry">Delete</button></div>`).join('') : '<p>No memories yet. You can also chat: “Remember that I like reading books”.</p>'}`;
        }
        function refresh() {
          const g = game(),
            s = state();
          if (!s || !g) return;
          const info = levelInfo(s.xp),
            percent = Math.max(
              0,
              Math.min(100, ((s.xp - info.start) / (info.next - info.start)) * 100),
            );
          const hud = $('rpg-hud');
          if (hud) {
            hud.innerHTML = `<span>⭐ Level ${info.level}</span><span>$${g.money}</span><span class="rpg-xp"><i style="width:${percent}%"></i></span><small>${s.xp}/${info.next} XP</small>`;
          }
          const panel = $('rpg-panel');
          if (!panel || panel.hidden) return;
          const labels = {
            story: '📜 Story',
            quests: '✨ AI Quests',
            bag: '🎒 Bag',
            shop: '🏪 Shop',
            people: '👥 NPC',
            memory: '🧠 Memory',
          };
          $('rpg-tabs').innerHTML = Object.entries(labels)
            .map(
              ([id, text]) =>
                `<button data-rpg-tab="${id}" class="${visibleTab === id ? 'active' : ''}">${text}</button>`,
            )
            .join('');
          $('rpg-title').textContent = `⭐ Level ${info.level} · $${g.money} · ${s.xp} XP`;
          const content = {
            story: renderStory,
            quests: renderQuest,
            bag: renderBag,
            shop: renderShop,
            people: renderPeople,
            memory: renderMemory,
          }[visibleTab];
          $('rpg-content').innerHTML = content(s);
        }
        let lastScene = null,
          lastTick = 0;
        function heartbeat() {
          const scene = getScene();
          if (scene !== lastScene) {
            lastScene = scene;
            refresh();
          }
          if (!scene) return;
          const s = state(),
            market = scene.area?.places?.market;
          if (
            s?.story?.index === 1 &&
            s.story.step === 2 &&
            s.story.choice === 'Search the market' &&
            !scene.inside &&
            market
          ) {
            const dist = Math.hypot(
              scene.player.x - (market.x * 32 + 16),
              scene.player.y - (market.y * 32 + 16),
            );
            if (dist < 82) advance('You found a clue at the Market.');
          }
          const sec = Date.now();
          if (sec - lastTick > 1400) {
            lastTick = sec;
            refresh();
          }
          if (sec - lastPositionSave > 4000) {
            lastPositionSave = sec;
            savePosition(scene);
          }
        }
        function init() {
          $('rpg-open').addEventListener('click', () => open('story'));
          $('rpg-close').addEventListener('click', close);
          $('rpg-panel').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'rpg-panel') {
              close();
              return;
            }
            const el = e.target.closest(
              '[data-rpg-tab], [data-rpg-choice], [data-rpg-use], [data-rpg-buy], [data-rpg-forget], #rpg-generate',
            );
            if (!el) return;
            if (el.dataset.rpgTab) open(el.dataset.rpgTab);
            else if (el.dataset.rpgChoice) choose(el.dataset.rpgChoice);
            else if (el.dataset.rpgUse) use(el.dataset.rpgUse);
            else if (el.dataset.rpgBuy) buy(el.dataset.rpgBuy);
            else if (el.dataset.rpgForget != null) forgetFact(Number(el.dataset.rpgForget));
            else if (el.id === 'rpg-generate') void makeQuest();
          });
          $('rpg-panel').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id !== 'rpg-memory-form') return;
            e.preventDefault();
            notify(storeFact($('rpg-fact').value));
          });
          $('rpg-panel').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
          });
          $('rpg-panel').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
          document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (
              e.code === 'KeyR' &&
              !e.repeat &&
              !['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName) &&
              !document.getElementById('chat').offsetParent
            ) {
              if ($('rpg-panel').hidden) open('story');
              else close();
            }
          });
          setInterval(heartbeat, 850);
          window.addEventListener('beforeunload', save);
          window.addEventListener('lifequest:status', () => setTimeout(refresh, 0));
          refresh();
        }
        return {
          init,
          state,
          refresh,
          open,
          close,
          restorePosition,
          onNpcOpen,
          onNpcMessage,
          npcContext,
          coachContext,
          handleCoach,
          storeFact,
          makeQuest,
          storyText,
          levelInfo,
        };
      })();

            ['I ___ to school yesterday.', 'went', 'go', 'goes', 'a', 'Yesterday → went.'],
            [
              'How ___ apples do you need?',
              'many',
              'much',
              'long',
              'a',
              'Use “many” with countable nouns.',
            ],
            ['She is ___ than me.', 'taller', 'tall', 'tallest', 'a', 'Comparative: taller.'],
            [
              'There ___ some books on the desk.',
              'are',
              'is',
              'am',
              'a',
              '“Books” is plural → are.',
            ],

          B1: [

              'If it rains, I ___ at home.',
              'will stay',
              'stayed',
              'staying',
              'a',
              'First conditional: if + present, will + verb.',
            ],

              'I have lived here ___ 2020.',
              'since',
              'for',

            ],

          B2: [
