        const validInt = (v, min = 0, max = 1e9) => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= min && v <= max;
        function state() {
          const g = game();
          if (!g) return null;
          if (!g.rpg || typeof g.rpg !== 'object') g.rpg = {};
          if (!g.rpg.inventory || typeof g.rpg.inventory !== 'object') g.rpg.inventory = {};
          let s = g.economy;
          if (!s || typeof s !== 'object' || Array.isArray(s)) s = g.economy = {};
          if (!validInt(s.bank)) s.bank = 0;
          if (!Array.isArray(s.ledger)) s.ledger = [];
          if (!s.unlocked || typeof s.unlocked !== 'object') s.unlocked = {};
          if (!s.flags || typeof s.flags !== 'object') s.flags = {};
          if (!s.gifts || typeof s.gifts !== 'object') s.gifts = {};
          if (!s.homeSlots || typeof s.homeSlots !== 'object') s.homeSlots = {};
          if (!s.jobs || typeof s.jobs !== 'object') s.jobs = {};
          if (!s.goal || typeof s.goal !== 'object')
            s.goal = { name: 'English Book B1', amount: 200 };
          s.version = 10;
          return s;
        }
        function inventory() {
          return game()?.rpg?.inventory || {};
        }
        function count(id) {
          return Number(inventory()[id]) || 0;
        }
        function capacity() {
          return count('backpack') ? 48 : 24;
        }
        function usedSpace() {
          return Object.entries(inventory()).reduce(
            (sum, [id, v]) => sum + (catalog[id] ? Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(v) || 0)) : 0),
            0,
          );
        }
        function log(type, amount, label, extra = {}) {
          const s = state();
          const g = game();
          if (!s) return;
          const time = Date.now();
          const tx = `${g.day}-${g.minutes}-${time}-${s.ledger.length}`;
          s.ledger.unshift({
            id: tx,
            type,
            amount,
            label,
            day: g.day,
            minutes: g.minutes,
            ...extra,
          });
          s.ledger = s.ledger.slice(0, MAX_HISTORY);
        }
        function save() {
          scene()?.store?.save?.();
          adventure.refresh?.();
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('lifequest:status'));
          render();
        }
        function notice(text) {
          msg = String(text);
          const n = $('v10-status');
          if (n) n.textContent = msg;
          const toast = $('rpg-toast');
          if (toast && typeof toast.textContent === 'string') toast.textContent = msg;
        }
        function context() {
          const sc = scene();
          if (!sc) return { inside: '', near: [], area: '', day: 1 };
          const p = sc.player;
          return {
            inside: sc.inside?.b?.name || '',
            area: sc.area?.id || '',
            day: sc.store.game.day,
            near: (sc.npcs || [])
              .filter(
                (n) =>
                  n.sprite?.visible &&
                  Boolean(n.inside) === Boolean(sc.inside) &&
                  Math.hypot(n.sprite.x - p.x, n.sprite.y - p.y) < 74,
              )
              .map((n) => n.def.id),
          };
        }
        function canShop(shop) {
          const c = context();
          if (c.inside === shop) return true;
          const sc = scene();
          if (!sc || sc.inside) return false;
          if (
            shop === 'Rail Station' &&
            ['english-town', 'mining-town'].includes(sc.area?.id) &&
            sc.player.x >= 4 * 32 &&
            sc.player.x < 56 * 32 &&
            sc.player.y >= 47 * 32 &&
            sc.player.y < 72 * 32
          )
            return true;
          const b = sc.area?.buildings?.find((x) => x.name === shop);
          if (!b) return false;
          return (
            Math.hypot(sc.player.x - (b.door * 32 + 16), sc.player.y - ((b.y + b.h) * 32 + 12)) < 70
          );
        }
        function checkShop(shop) {
          if (!shops[shop]) return 'Shop not found.';
          if (!canShop(shop))
            return `You need to be at the entrance of or inside ${shop} to trade. Press M for the map or ask the AI for directions.`;
          return '';
        }
        function amount(n) {
          const v = Number(n);
          return validInt(v, 1, 999) ? v : NaN;
        }
        function shopItems(shop) {
          return Object.entries(catalog).filter(([, def]) => def.shops.includes(shop));
        }
        function transactBuy(shop, id, qty) {
          const sc = scene(),
            s = state(),
            def = catalog[id],
            g = game();
          if (!sc || !s || !g) return { ok: false, message: 'The game is not ready yet.' };
          if (busy) return { ok: false, message: 'A transaction is already being processed.' };
          const problem = checkShop(shop);
          if (problem) return { ok: false, message: problem };
          if (!def || !def.shops.includes(shop))
            return { ok: false, message: 'This item is not sold at this shop.' };
          const n = amount(qty);
          if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n > 10)
            return { ok: false, message: 'You can only buy 1–10 items at a time.' };
          if (def.effect === 'room' && n !== 1)
            return { ok: false, message: 'You can only rent one room at a time.' };
          const sig = `${shop}:${id}:${n}`;
          if (lastPurchase.signature === sig && Date.now() - lastPurchase.at < 700)
            return {
              ok: false,
              message: 'Your previous transaction was received. Please wait a moment before buying again.',
            };
          const total = def.price * n;
          if (!validInt(total) || !validInt(g.money) || g.money < total)
            return {
              ok: false,
              message: `You need $${Math.max(0, total - g.money)} more. Complete quests to earn money.`,
            };
          if (def.unique && count(id) > 0)
            return { ok: false, message: 'You already own this item.' };
          if (def.unique && n !== 1)
            return { ok: false, message: 'Upgrade items can only be bought one at a time.' };
          if (def.category !== 'service' && usedSpace() + n > capacity())
            return {
              ok: false,
              message: `Your bag only has ${Math.max(0, capacity() - usedSpace())} free slots. Use some items or buy a backpack.`,
            };
          busy = true;
          try {
            g.money -= total;
            if (def.category === 'service' && def.effect === 'room') {
              s.flags.roomUntilDay = g.day;
              s.flags.roomShop = shop;
              s.flags.roomName = id;
            } else if (def.category === 'service' && def.effect === 'mail') {
              s.flags.pendingMail = (Number(s.flags.pendingMail) || 0) + n;
            } else if (def.category !== 'service') {
              inventory()[id] = count(id) + n;
            }
            if (def.effect === 'lesson') s.unlocked[def.lesson] = true;
            log('purchase', -total, `${def.name} ×${n}`, { shop, item: id, qty: n });
            lastPurchase = { signature: sig, at: Date.now() };
            save();
            return {
              ok: true,
              message: `✅ Bought ${def.name} ×${n} at ${shop}. -$${total}. “Could I have a receipt, please?”`,
            };
          } finally {
            busy = false;
          }
        }
        function bankAction(kind, raw) {
          const c = context(),
            g = game(),
            s = state();
          if (!g || !s) return 'The game is not ready yet.';
          if (!canShop('Bank')) return 'You must go to the Bank to deposit or withdraw money.';
          const n = Number(raw);
          if (!validInt(n, 1, 1000000)) return 'Enter a whole amount from 1 to 1,000,000.';
          if (kind === 'deposit') {
            if (!validInt(g.money) || g.money < n) return 'You do not have enough cash in your wallet.';
            if (s.bank + n > 1000000000) return 'This exceeds the account limit.';
            g.money -= n;
            s.bank += n;
            log('deposit', -n, `Savings deposit $${n}`);
          } else if (kind === 'withdraw') {
            if (s.bank < n || g.money + n > 1000000000)
              return 'Insufficient balance or over the safe limit.';
            s.bank -= n;
            g.money += n;
            log('withdraw', n, `Savings withdrawal $${n}`);
          } else return 'Invalid command.';
          save();
          return `🏦 Success! Wallet $${g.money}; savings $${s.bank}. Your total assets are unchanged because money just moved between two accounts.`;
        }
        function moveItem(id, delta) {
          const n = count(id);
          if (n + delta < 0) return false;
          inventory()[id] = n + delta;
          return true;
        }
        function consume(id) {
          const def = catalog[id],
            sc = scene(),
            g = game(),
            s = state();
          if (!def || !sc || count(id) < 1) return 'You do not own this item.';
          if (def.effect === 'energy') {
            g.rpg.energy = Math.min(100, (Number(g.rpg.energy) || 0) + def.energy);
            moveItem(id, -1);
            log('use', 0, `Used ${def.name}`);
            save();
            return `✨ ${def.name}: +${def.energy} energy (max 100).`;
          }
          if (def.effect === 'equip') {
            s.flags[id + 'Equipped'] = !s.flags[id + 'Equipped'];
            save();
            return s.flags[id + 'Equipped'] ? `✅ Equipped ${def.name}.` : `Put away ${def.name}.`;
          }
          if (def.effect === 'lesson') {
            openTab = 'learning';
            show('learning');
            return `📖 Opened lesson ${def.lesson || 'English'}.`;
          }
          if (def.effect === 'upgrade') {
            s.flags.largeBag = true;
            save();
            return '🎒 Large backpack: 48 inventory slots.';
          }
          if (def.effect === 'gift') {
            const npc = context().near[0];
            if (!npc) return 'Go near an NPC and open your inventory to give a gift.';
            const day = sc.store.game.day;
            const key = `${npc}_${day}`;
            if (s.gifts[key]) return 'You already gave this NPC a gift today.';
            s.gifts[key] = true;
            moveItem(id, -1);
            if (g.rpg.relationships?.[npc])
              g.rpg.relationships[npc].trust = Math.min(
                100,
                (Number(g.rpg.relationships[npc].trust) || 0) + 5,
              );
            sc.store.get(npc).affinity = Math.min(100, (sc.store.get(npc).affinity || 0) + 4);
            log('gift', 0, `Gave ${def.name} to ${npc}`);
            save();
            return `🎁 Gave ${def.name}! Your relationship with ${npc} improved.`;
          }
          if (def.effect === 'travel') {
            return 'Go to platform 1 and step onto the front of the train. The conductor will check your ticket on board.';
          }
          if (false) {
            const c = context();
            if (!canShop('Rail Station')) return 'Go to the Rail Station to use your train ticket.';
            const portals = sc.area?.portals || {};
            const trainRoutes = {
              'english-town': {
                to: 'mining-town',
                spawn: { x: 30, y: 50 },
                label: 'Minerals Central Station',
              },
              'mining-town': {
                to: 'english-town',
                spawn: { x: 30, y: 50 },
                label: 'English Town Central Station',
              },
            };
            const target =
              trainRoutes[sc.area?.id] ||
              (sc.area?.warps || []).find((p) => p?.to && p.to !== sc.area.id) ||
              Object.values(portals).find((p) => p?.to && p.to !== sc.area.id);
            if (!target) return 'The station has no valid route from this area; your ticket is kept.';
            moveItem(id, -1);
            log('travel', 0, `Train trip: ${sc.area?.name || ''}`);
            save();
            try {
              sc.switchArea(target.to, target.spawn, target.label || 'Rail Station');
              return '🚂 Traveling to the next town.';
            } catch {
              moveItem(id, 1);
              save();
              return 'Travel failed; your ticket was refunded.';
            }
          }
          if (def.effect === 'repair') {
            if (context().inside !== 'Smithy') return 'Go to the Smithy to use the repair kit.';
            moveItem(id, -1);
            const day = g.day;
            const key = `repair-${day}`;
            if (!s.jobs[key]) {
              s.jobs[key] = true;
              g.rpg.xp = (Number(g.rpg.xp) || 0) + 20;
              log('work', 0, 'Repair practice +20 XP');
            }
            save();
            return '🧰 You practiced repairing tools. +20 XP if this is your first time today.';
          }
          if (def.effect === 'decorate') {
            if (context().inside !== "Hero's Home")
              return 'Go to Hero’s Home to place the items you bought.';
            const slots = [0, 1, 2];
            const index = Number(s.homeSlots[id] ?? 0);
            s.homeSlots[id] = slots[(index + 1) % slots.length];
            renderHomeDecor();
            save();
            return `🏠 Moved ${def.name} (position ${s.homeSlots[id] + 1}/3).`;
          }
          if (def.effect === 'display') {
            return `💎 ${def.name} is kept as a collectible. You can show it off to NPCs.`;
          }
          return `${def.name}: find the right place to use it.`;
        }
        function restAction() {
          const sc = scene(),
            s = state(),
            g = game();
          const place = context().inside;
          if (!['Hotel', 'Mining Inn'].includes(place))
            return 'Go inside the Hotel or Mining Inn to rest overnight.';
          if (!s || s.flags.roomShop !== place || Number(s.flags.roomUntilDay) !== g.day)
            return 'You need to rent a valid room at the inn desk first.';
          if (sc.sleeping) return 'You are already resting.';
          sc.sleeping = true;
          try {
            g.minutes = 420;
            sc.newDay();
            sc.snapNpcs();
            s.flags.roomUntilDay = -1;
            s.flags.roomShop = '';
            log('rest', 0, `Overnight rest at ${place}`);
            save();
            return '🌅 Good morning! You rested overnight at the inn.';
          } finally {
            sc.sleeping = false;
          }
        }

        const RAIL_CLERKS = ['ticketclerk', 'etclerk'],
          RAIL_CHECKERS = ['stationmaster', 'etmaster'];
        function railPop(icon, text) {
          let n = $('lq-rail-pop');
          if (!n) {
            n = document.createElement('div');
            n.id = 'lq-rail-pop';
            document.body.appendChild(n);
          }
          n.innerHTML = '<span>' + icon + '</span><b>' + esc(text) + '</b>';
          n.classList.add('shown');
          clearTimeout(railPop.t);
          railPop.t = setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove('shown'), 4200);
          railBadge();
        }
        function railBadge() {
          const b = $('lq-rail-badge');
          if (!b) return;
          const p = count('boarding_pass'),
            k = count('rail_ticket');
          if (p > 0) {
            b.hidden = false;
            b.className = 'ok';
            b.textContent = '✅ Ticket checked · have a safe trip';
          } else if (k > 0) {
            b.hidden = false;
            b.className = '';
            b.textContent = '🎫 Train ticket · go to platform 1 and step onto the front of the train to board';
          } else b.hidden = true;
        }
        function ensureRailUi() {
          if ($('lq-rail-badge')) return;
          const st = document.createElement('style');
          st.textContent =
            '#lq-rail-badge{position:fixed;top:92px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:26;background:#1b2a3aee;color:#ffe9a8;border:2px solid #f3b94d;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 18px #0008;pointer-events:none}#lq-rail-badge.ok{background:#12372aee;color:#c9ffdd;border-color:#58c26a}#lq-rail-pop{position:fixed;left:50%;top:38%;transform:translate(-50%,-30%) scale(.9);z-index:120;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:#101a28f2;color:#fff;border:2px solid #f3b94d;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 22px;font:700 18px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 14px 40px #000a;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s}#lq-rail-pop span{font-size:42px}#lq-rail-pop.shown{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}';

          document.head.appendChild(st);
          const b = document.createElement('div');
          b.id = 'lq-rail-badge';
          b.hidden = true;
          document.body.appendChild(b);
          setInterval(railBadge, 700);
        }
        function railFlow(id, message) {
          const g = game();
          if (!g || !state()) return [];
          const clerk = RAIL_CLERKS.includes(id),
            checker = RAIL_CHECKERS.includes(id);
          if (!clerk && !checker) return [];
          if (!canShop('Rail Station')) return [];
          const text = norm(message);
          if (clerk) {
            if (!/(ticket|tickets|travel|train|go to|trip|minerals|english town)/.test(text))
              return [];
            if (count('boarding_pass') > 0 || count('rail_ticket') > 0)
              return [
                '🎫 You already have a ticket. Go to platform 1 and step onto the front of the train; the conductor will check your ticket on board. “Please board the train at platform one.”',
              ];
            if (usedSpace() >= capacity())
              return ['🎒 Your bag is full. Free up some space, then ask for the ticket again.'];
            moveItem('rail_ticket', 1);
            log('travel', 0, 'Received a free train ticket');
            save();
            railPop('🎫', 'You received: Train ticket');
            return [
              '🎫 Your free train ticket is in your bag. “Here is your ticket. Please board the train at platform one.” Step onto the front of the train at platform 1; your ticket will be checked on board.',
            ];
          }
          if (!/(ticket|train|platform|board|check|inspect|here|please)/.test(text)) return [];
          if (count('rail_ticket') > 0 || count('boarding_pass') > 0)
            return [
              '🚆 Your ticket is good. Step onto the front of the train at platform 1; the conductor will check your ticket on board. “The conductor will check your ticket on the train.”',
            ];
          return [
            '⚠️ You do not have a ticket yet. Ask for one at the ticket window (window one) in English first. “Tickets are at window one.”',
          ];
        }
        const TRAIN_CSS =
          '#lq-train{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:#000;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s}#lq-train.on{opacity:1}#lq-train canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated}#lq-train-hdr{position:absolute;top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#101a28e6;color:#ffe9a8;border:2px solid #f3b94d;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;font:700 14px system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}#lq-train-box{position:absolute;left:50%;top:64px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(720px,92vw);box-sizing:border-box;background:#141824f2;border:2px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px;color:#fff;font:16px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;display:none}#lq-train-box.show{display:block}#lq-train-name{color:#ffd36b}#lq-train-line{margin:6px 0 0}#lq-train-line small{display:block;color:#a9b8d0;margin-top:2px}#lq-train-btn{margin-top:10px;background:#f3b94d;color:#1b2630;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;font:800 15px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;animation:lqpulse 1s infinite alternate}@keyframes lqpulse{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.07)}}';
        let rideActive = false;
        function noPass() {
          railPop('🚆', 'You need a train ticket to board');
          notice(
            'Ask for a ticket at the ticket window (talk to the ticket clerk in English), then come back to board the train.',
          );
        }
        function boardTrain(zone, sc) {
          if (rideActive || !zone || !sc) return;
          if (count('rail_ticket') < 1 && count('boarding_pass') < 1) {
            noPass();
            return;
          }
          rideActive = true;
          try {
            startRide(zone, sc);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('train ride failed', err);
            rideActive = false;
            try {
              sc.scene.resume();
            } catch {}
          }
        }
        function mixColor(a, b, t) {
          const p = (h) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)),
            x = p(a),
            y = p(b);
          return (
            '#' +
            x
              .map((v, i) =>
                Math.round(v + (y[i] - v) * t)
                  .toString(16)
                  .padStart(2, '0'),
              )
              .join('')
          );
        }
        function startRide(zone, sc) {
          const toMine = zone.to === 'mining-town',
            dest = toMine ? 'Minerals Town' : 'English Town',
            origin = toMine ? 'English Town' : 'Minerals Town',
            dir = toMine ? 1 : -1;
          const town = {
              sky: '#6fbcff',
              sky2: '#dff3ff',
              far: '#8fb7a8',
              hill: '#79b27e',
              tree: '#3f8a4f',
              ground: '#8cc56d',
            },
            mine = {
              sky: '#8497a8',
              sky2: '#d3dce2',
              far: '#7d8e9b',
              hill: '#6b7f8b',
              tree: '#4a6670',
              ground: '#8b8a80',
            };
          const P0 = toMine ? town : mine,
            P1 = toMine ? mine : town;
          const checked = count('boarding_pass') > 0;
          try {
            sc.scene.pause();
          } catch {}
          const root = document.createElement('div');
          root.id = 'lq-train';
          root.innerHTML =
            '<canvas></canvas><div id="lq-train-hdr"></div><div id="lq-train-box"><b id="lq-train-name"></b><p id="lq-train-line"></p><button type="button" id="lq-train-btn" hidden>[E] Show ticket</button></div>';
          document.body.appendChild(root);
          const cv = root.querySelector('canvas'),
            cx = cv.getContext('2d'),
            hdr = root.querySelector('#lq-train-hdr'),
            box = root.querySelector('#lq-train-box'),
            nameEl = root.querySelector('#lq-train-name'),
            lineEl = root.querySelector('#lq-train-line'),
            btn = root.querySelector('#lq-train-btn');
          requestAnimationFrame(() => root.classList.add('on'));
          const say = (who, en, vi, speak) => {
            nameEl.textContent = who;
            lineEl.innerHTML = esc(en) + (vi ? '<small>' + esc(vi) + '</small>' : '');
            box.classList.add('show');
            if (speak)
              try {
                speechService.speak(en);
              } catch {}
          };
          const size = () => {
            cv.width = innerWidth;
            cv.height = innerHeight;
          };
          size();
          addEventListener('resize', size);
          const stops = [
            { x: 72, l: 'Good day. Tickets, please.' },
            { x: 142, l: 'Thank you, sir. Have a nice trip.' },
            { x: 212, you: true },
            { x: 282, l: 'Tickets, please... Thank you, young man.' },
          ];
          let phase = 'depart',
            pt = 0,
            speed = 0,
            scroll = 0,
            condX = -30,
            si = 0,
            last = performance.now(),
            raf = 0,
            done = false,
            prog = 0;
          const setPhase = (p) => {
            phase = p;
            pt = 0;
          };
          const nextStop = () => {
            si++;
            box.classList.remove('show');
            setPhase(si >= stops.length ? 'exit' : 'walk');
          };
          function inspect() {
            if (phase !== 'ask') return;
            btn.hidden = true;
            if (count('rail_ticket') > 0) {
              moveItem('rail_ticket', -1);
              moveItem('boarding_pass', 1);
              log('travel', 0, 'Ticket checked on the train');
              save();
            }
            railPop('✅', 'Ticket checked');
            say(
              'Conductor',
              'Thank you! Enjoy your trip to ' + dest + '.',
              'Thank you! Have a pleasant trip.',
              true,
            );
            setPhase('check');
          }
          const onKey = (ev) => {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if ((ev.key === 'e' || ev.key === 'E') && !ev.repeat) inspect();
          };
          addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
          btn.onclick = inspect;
          function finish() {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
            removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
            removeEventListener('resize', size);
            root.remove();
            if (count('boarding_pass') > 0) {
              moveItem('boarding_pass', -1);
              log('travel', 0, 'Train trip: ' + origin + ' → ' + dest);
              save();
            }
            rideActive = false;
            try {
              sc.scene.resume();
            } catch {}
            sc.switchArea(zone.to, zone.spawn, zone.label);
          }
          function update(dt) {
            pt += dt;
            scroll += speed * dt * 140;
            if (phase !== 'ask') prog = Math.min(1, prog + dt / 14);
            if (phase === 'depart') {
              speed = Math.min(1, pt / 1.2);
              hdr.textContent = '🚆 Train leaving ' + origin + ' station' + '…';
              if (pt > 1.4) {
                hdr.textContent = '🚆 Train heading to ' + dest + ' station' + '…';
                setPhase('walk');
              }
            } else if (phase === 'walk') {
              const st = stops[si];
              condX = Math.min(st.x, condX + 62 * dt);
              if (condX >= st.x) {
                if (st.you && !checked) {
                  setPhase('ask');
                  say(
                    'Conductor',
                    'Tickets, please!',
                    'Ticket check! Press E to show your ticket.',
                    true,
                  );
                  btn.hidden = false;
                } else {
                  if (st.l) say('Conductor', st.l, '', false);
                  setPhase('pause');
                }
              }
            } else if (phase === 'pause') {
              if (pt > 1.1) nextStop();
            } else if (phase === 'check') {
              if (pt > 1.8) nextStop();
            } else if (phase === 'exit') {
              condX += 62 * dt;
              if (condX > 430) setPhase('cruise');
            } else if (phase === 'cruise') {
              hdr.textContent = '🚉 Arriving at ' + dest + ' station' + '…';
              if (pt > 2.4) {
                setPhase('arrive');
                root.classList.remove('on');
              }
            } else if (phase === 'arrive') {
              speed = Math.max(0.15, speed - dt * 0.8);
              if (pt > 0.7) finish();
            }
          }
          const R = (x, y, w, h, c) => {
            cx.fillStyle = c;
            cx.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
          };
          const shade = (c, k) => mixColor(c, '#000000', k);
          function seat(sx) {
            R(sx - 17, 126, 8, 40, '#2a6670');

            R(sx - 12, 167, 26, 13, '#1f4f58');

          }

            }
            if (o.item === 'book') {

              R(sx + 7, 141, 10, 2, '#b33a3a');
              R(sx + 8, 145, 8, 1, '#999');
              R(sx + 8, 148, 8, 1, '#999');
            } else if (o.item === 'paper') {
              R(sx + 8, 132, 13, 22, '#ece9de');
              R(sx + 10, 135, 9, 2, '#555');
              R(sx + 10, 140, 9, 1, '#999');
              R(sx + 10, 144, 9, 1, '#999');
              R(sx + 10, 148, 9, 1, '#999');
            } else if (o.item === 'phone') {
              R(sx + 9, 142, 3, 6, '#1b1b1b');

          function scenery(wx, wy, ww, wh, now) {
            cx.save();
            cx.beginPath();
            cx.rect(wx, wy, ww, wh);
            cx.clip();
            const g = cx.createLinearGradient(0, wy, 0, wy + wh);
            g.addColorStop(0, mixColor(P0.sky, P1.sky, prog));
            g.addColorStop(1, mixColor(P0.sky2, P1.sky2, prog));
            cx.fillStyle = g;
            cx.fillRect(wx, wy, ww, wh);
            cx.fillStyle = '#fff6c8';
            cx.beginPath();
            cx.arc(170, wy + 16, 9, 0, 7);
            cx.fill();
            cx.fillStyle = '#fff6c855';
            cx.beginPath();
            cx.arc(170, wy + 16, 15, 0, 7);
            cx.fill();
            for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
              const x = ((((k * 83 - scroll * 0.06) % 498) + 498) % 498) - 40,
                y = wy + 8 + (k % 3) * 9;
              R(x, y, 28, 5, '#ffffffcc');
              R(x + 7, y - 4, 14, 5, '#ffffffcc');
            }
            const far = mixColor(P0.far, P1.far, prog),
              hill = mixColor(P0.hill, P1.hill, prog),
              tc = mixColor(P0.tree, P1.tree, prog),
              gr = mixColor(P0.ground, P1.ground, prog),
              base = wy + wh - 12,
              mf = toMine ? prog : 1 - prog;
            for (let x = wx; x < wx + ww; x += 3) {
              const ax = x + scroll * 0.12,
                h = 16 + 13 * Math.abs(Math.sin(ax / 37)) + 5 * Math.sin(ax / 11);
              R(x, base - h, 3, h + 4, far);
            }
            for (let x = wx; x < wx + ww; x += 3) {
              const ax = x + scroll * 0.3,
                h = 7 + 6 * Math.sin(ax / 26) + 3 * Math.sin(ax / 8);
              R(x, base - h, 3, h + 6, hill);
            }
            R(wx, base, ww, 12, gr);
            R(wx, base, ww, 2, mixColor(gr, '#ffffff', 0.25));
            R(wx, base + 8, ww, 4, shade(gr, 0.2));
            for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {

                R(x - 5, base - 8, 10, 1, shade(tc, 0.25));
                if (k % 3 === 0) R(x + 5, base - 6, 2, 5, '#81f3df');
              } else {
                R(x - 1, base - 8, 2, 8, '#6b4a2e');
                R(x - 5, base - 18, 10, 10, tc);
                R(x - 3, base - 22, 6, 4, tc);
                R(x - 5, base - 10, 10, 2, shade(tc, 0.25));
              }
            }
            R(wx, base + 5, ww, 1, '#5b4630');
            for (let m = 0; m < 20; m++) {
              const x = ((((m * 23 - scroll * 1.3) % 460) + 460) % 460) - 30;
              R(x, base + 2, 2, 9, '#5b4630');
            }
            for (let m = 0; m < 6; m++) {

                  x = ((((k * 57 - scroll * 2.2) % 420) + 420) % 420) - 20;

            R(wx + 8, wy, 5, wh, '#ffffff12');
            R(wx + 16, wy, 2, wh, '#ffffff0c');
          }

          function draw(now) {
            const W = cv.width,
              H = cv.height,
              s = Math.min(W / 400, H / 225),
              sway = speed > 0.1 ? Math.sin(now / 60) * 0.5 * speed : 0;
            cx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            cx.fillStyle = '#0b0f14';
            cx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            const ox = (W - 400 * s) / 2,
              oy = (H - 225 * s) / 2 + sway * s;
            if (dir > 0) cx.setTransform(s, 0, 0, s, ox, oy);
            else cx.setTransform(-s, 0, 0, s, ox + 400 * s, oy);
            cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
            R(0, 0, 400, 225, '#5f8187');
            R(0, 0, 400, 16, '#34484e');
            R(0, 16, 400, 3, '#243438');
            for (let x = 24; x < 400; x += 88) {
              R(x, 6, 44, 4, '#fff6c2');
              R(x - 4, 10, 52, 3, '#fff6c218');
            }
            R(0, 30, 400, 2, '#aab6ba');
            R(0, 32, 400, 2, '#6f7c80');
            for (const b of [
              [40, 19, 22, 11, '#8a5a3b'],

              [150, 20, 26, 10, '#4a6a8a'],
              [250, 18, 20, 12, '#a64b4b'],
              [320, 21, 24, 9, '#6b5b8a'],
            ])
              R(b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4]);
            for (const wx of [14, 112, 210, 308]) scenery(wx, 38, 80, 64, now);
            R(0, 102, 400, 63, '#4f7178');
            for (let x = 0; x < 400; x += 10) R(x, 104, 1, 59, '#46666c');

              R(x + 8, 213, 8, 2, '#436b82');

              seat(p.sx);
              sitter(p.sx, p.o, now);
            }
            for (const x of [100, 190, 280, 370]) {
              const sw = Math.sin(now / 380 + x) * 2;
              R(x, 19, 1, 12, '#cfd6d8');
              R(x - 3 + sw, 31, 7, 2, '#cfd6d8');
              R(x - 3 + sw, 31, 2, 5, '#cfd6d8');
              R(x + 2 + sw, 31, 2, 5, '#cfd6d8');
            }
            const walking = phase === 'walk' || phase === 'exit',

              R(224, 166 + bob, 10, 6, '#ffd36b');

              R(227, 170 + bob, 5, 1, '#c98a1c');
            }

              R(209, 102 + b, 6, 2, '#ffd36b');

            if (
              condX > -28 &&
              condX < 420 &&
              phase !== 'cruise' &&
              phase !== 'arrive' &&
              phase !== 'depart'
            )
              conductor(condX, 214, walking ? now / 130 : 0, now);
            const v = cx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 225);
            v.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)');

          function frame(now) {
            if (done) return;
            const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
            last = now;
            update(dt);
            if (!done) {
              draw(now);
              raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
            }
          }
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        function onNpcConversation(id, message) {
          const rail = railFlow(id, message);
          if (rail.length) return rail;
          const s = state(),
            g = game();
          if (
            !s ||
            !g ||
            id !== 'postman' ||
            !canShop('Post Office') ||
            (Number(s.flags.pendingMail) || 0) < 1
          )
            return [];
          const text = norm(message);
          if (!/(letter|parcel|post|mail|stamp|gui thu|gui hang|send)/.test(text)) return [];
          s.flags.pendingMail -= 1;
          s.flags.sentLetters = (Number(s.flags.sentLetters) || 0) + 1;
          log('mail', 0, 'Sent a letter/parcel at the post office');
          save();
          return ['📮 Sam has received your parcel! “Your parcel has been sent.”'];
        }
        function mineAction() {
          const sc = scene(),
            s = state(),
            g = game();
          if (!s || !sc) return 'The game has not finished loading.';
          if (!context().inside?.includes('Great Mine'))
            return 'Go down to the Great Mine to mine.';
          if (count('pickaxe') < 1) return 'Buy a pickaxe at the Smithy or Tool Shop first.';
          const key = `mine:${g.day}`;
          const n = Number(s.jobs[key]) || 0;
          if (n >= 2) return 'You have already mined 2 samples today.';
          if (usedSpace() >= capacity()) return 'Your bag is full.';
          s.jobs[key] = n + 1;
          inventory().ore = (Number(inventory().ore) || 0) + 1;
          log('earn-item', 0, 'Mined 1 ore sample');
          save();
          return '⛏️ You found ore! Take it to the Smithy to trade for tools (it cannot be sold for unlimited cash).';
        }
        function jobAction(english) {
          const c = context(),
            s = state(),
            g = game();
          if (!s || !g) return 'The game has not finished loading.';
          const role = Object.entries(shops).find(([name]) => c.inside === name)?.[0];
          if (
            !role ||
            !['Sunny Cafe', 'Library', 'Post Office', 'Smithy', 'Tool Shop'].includes(role)
          )
            return 'Go to Sunny Cafe, Library, Post Office or Smithy to get a job.';
          const spoken = String(english || '').trim();
          if (
            !/\b(i (?:can|would like to|want to|have|will)|could i|may i|let me|please)\b/i.test(
              spoken,
            ) ||
            spoken.length < 10
          )
            return 'Say a full sentence in English. For example: “Could I help you with your work, please?”';
          const key = `job:${role}:${g.day}`;
          if (s.jobs[key])
            return 'You already worked here today. Come back tomorrow.';
          if (role === 'Smithy' && count('ore') < 1)
            return 'At the Smithy, you need 1 ore sample to finish the job.';
          if (role === 'Smithy') {
            inventory().ore -= 1;
          }
          const payout = {
            'Sunny Cafe': 25,
            Library: 30,
            'Post Office': 35,
            'Smithy': 45,
            'Tool Shop': 28,
          }[role];
          s.jobs[key] = true;
          g.money += payout;
          g.rpg.xp = (Number(g.rpg.xp) || 0) + 10;
          log('job', payout, `Job at ${role}`);
          save();
          return `✅ Finished the job at ${role}! +$${payout}, +10 XP. Practice the sentence “I have finished my work.”`;
        }

        function renderHomeDecor() {
          const sc = scene();
          if (decorationGraphics) {
            try {
              decorationGraphics.destroy();
            } catch {}
            decorationGraphics = null;
          }
          if (
            !sc?.inside ||
            sc.inside.b.name !== "Hero's Home" ||
            typeof sc.add?.graphics !== 'function'
          )
            return;
          const s = state();
          const k = sc.inside.k,
            unit = 32 * k;
          const bounds = sc.inside.spec;
          const g = sc.add.graphics().setDepth(2);
          decorationGraphics = g;
          for (const [id, v] of Object.entries(visualHome)) {
            if (count(id) < 1) continue;
            const offset = Number(s.homeSlots[id] || 0),
              x = v[0] + (offset % 3),
              y = v[1] + (offset === 2 ? 1 : 0);
            if (x >= bounds.w - 1 || y >= bounds.h - 1) continue;
            const baseX = sc.inside.objs?.[0]?.x ?? 20000,
              baseY = sc.inside.objs?.[0]?.y ?? 0;
            const X = baseX + x * unit,
              Y = baseY + y * unit;
            g.fillStyle(0x0e2030, 0.19).fillEllipse(
              X + unit / 2,
              Y + unit * 0.8,
              unit * 0.78,
              unit * 0.33,
            );
            g.fillStyle(v[2], 0.92).fillRoundedRect(
              X + unit * 0.14,
              Y + unit * 0.26,
              unit * 0.72,
              unit * 0.52,
              Math.max(2, k * 2),
            );
            g.lineStyle(Math.max(1, k), 0xffffff, 0.35).strokeRoundedRect(
              X + unit * 0.17,
              Y + unit * 0.29,
              unit * 0.65,
              unit * 0.44,
              Math.max(2, k * 2),
            );
            if (id === 'lamp')
              g.fillStyle(0xffe9a4, 0.17).fillCircle(X + unit * 0.5, Y + unit * 0.46, unit * 0.8);
          }
        }

            }</p>`;
          } else if (openTab === 'ledger') {
            root.innerHTML = `<h3>🧾 Transaction history</h3><p>The ledger keeps up to ${MAX_HISTORY} recent transactions and does not include your API key.</p><div class="v10-ledger">${s.ledger.length ? s.ledger.map((tx) => `<div><span><b>${esc(tx.label)}</b><small>Day ${tx.day} · ${esc(tx.type)}</small></span><b class="${tx.amount < 0 ? 'expense' : 'income'}">${tx.amount > 0 ? '+' : ''}${tx.amount}$</b></div>`).join('') : '<p>No transactions yet.</p>'}</div><button data-v10-action="export">⬇ Download spending history CSV</button>`;
          }
          $('v10-status').textContent = msg;
        }
        function openLesson(id) {
          const it = financeLessons.find((x) => x[0] === id);
          if (!it) return;
          active = { id, correct: it[2], wrong: it[3], picked: null };
          const pane = $('v10-quiz');
          pane.hidden = false;
          pane.innerHTML = `<h3>📖 ${esc(it[1])}</h3><p>Choose the more natural English sentence:</p>${[
            it[2],
            it[3],
          ]
            .sort((a, b) => (id.length % 2 ? a.localeCompare(b) : b.localeCompare(a)))
            .map((t) => `<button data-v10-answer="${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</button>`)
            .join('')}<button data-v10-action="quiz-close">Close</button>`;
        }
        function answerLesson(text) {
          if (!active) return;
          const s = state(),
            g = game();
          const ok = text === active.correct;
          if (ok && !s.jobs['lesson-' + active.id]) {
            s.jobs['lesson-' + active.id] = true;
            g.rpg.xp = (Number(g.rpg.xp) || 0) + 12;
            log('lesson', 0, `Lesson ${active.id}: +12 XP`);
            save();
          }
          notice(
            ok
              ? '✅ Correct! ' + active.correct + ' · +12 XP the first time.'
              : '💡 Try again. A better sentence: ' + active.correct,
          );
          $('v10-quiz').hidden = true;
          active = null;
        }
        function exportCsv() {
          const s = state();
          if (!s) return;
          const csv = [
            ['day', 'minutes', 'type', 'amount', 'label'],
            ...s.ledger.map((t) => [t.day, t.minutes, t.type, t.amount, t.label]),
          ]
            .map((row) => row.map((v) => '"' + String(v ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""') + '"').join(','))
            .join('\r\n');
          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = URL.createObjectURL(
            new Blob(['\ufeff' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }),
          );
          a.download = 'LIFEQUEST_V10_CHI_TIEU.csv';
          a.click();
          setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 1000);
        }
        function afterSceneChange() {
          if (decorationGraphics) {
            try {
              decorationGraphics.destroy();
            } catch {}
            decorationGraphics = null;
          }
          renderHomeDecor();
        }
        function aiShopping(text) {
          const t = norm(text),
            ctx = context(),
            nearShop = ctx.inside && shops[ctx.inside] ? ctx.inside : null;
          const m = t.match(/(?:mua|buy|order|purchase)\s+(?:cho toi|me|a|an|mot|one)?\s*(.*)/);
          if (m) {
            const id = Object.entries(catalog).find(
              ([key, it]) =>
                norm(it.name).includes(m[1]) ||
                norm(m[1]).includes(norm(it.name).replace(/^[^\p{L}]+/u, '')) ||
                key === norm(m[1]).replace(/\s+/g, '_'),
            )?.[0];
            if (id) {
              const it = catalog[id],
                where = nearShop || it.shops[0];
              chosenShop = where;
              show('shop', where);
              return `🛒 ${it.name} costs $${it.price}, available at ${it.shops.join(', ')}. ${canShop(where) ? 'Pick the item and press Buy to confirm the purchase.' : 'Go to the shop first; the AI never deducts money by itself.'}`;
            }
          }
          if (
            /(toi co|i have|ngan sach|budget|afford|mua duoc gi)/.test(t) &&
            /(\$|\b\d+\b|mua|buy|budget)/.test(t)
          ) {
            const n = Number(t.match(/\d+/)?.[0]) || money();
            const results = Object.values(catalog)
              .filter((x) => x.price <= n)
              .slice(0, 8)
              .map((x) => `${x.name} $${x.price}`)
              .join(' · ');
            return `💰 With $${n} you could consider: ${results}. Cash in your wallet: $${money()}. Open the Shop (B) to check prices and confirm a purchase.`;
          }
          if (/(kiem tien|lam viec|earn money|find a job)/.test(t))
            return '💼 Earn money from NPC quests or a once-a-day job at Sunny Cafe, Library, Post Office or Smithy. Go to the matching building and open the Economy window (B), then Inventory → Work.';
          if (/(tiet kiem|ngan hang|bank|deposit|withdraw|saving)/.test(t)) {
            show('bank');
            return `🏦 You have $${money()} in your wallet and $${state()?.bank || 0} in savings. Go to the Bank to deposit/withdraw. Saving does not create extra virtual money.`;
          }
          if (/(gia|bao nhieu|how much|price|cheaper|discount)/.test(t)) {
            const sample = Object.values(catalog)
              .slice(0, 4)
              .map((x) => `${x.name}: $${x.price}`)
              .join(', ');
            return `🛍️ Prices are fixed in shops, for example: ${sample}. Try asking “How much does it cost?” or “Do you have anything cheaper?”`;
          }
          return null;
        }
        function init() {
          const panel = $('v10-panel');
          if (!panel) return;
          ensureRailUi();
          $('v10-open').addEventListener('click', () => show('shop'));
          $('v10-close').addEventListener('click', close);
          panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === panel) {
              close();
              return;
            }
            const b = e.target.closest('button');
            if (!b) return;
            if (b.dataset.v10Tab) {
              openTab = b.dataset.v10Tab;
              render();
              return;
            }
            if (b.dataset.v10Buy) {
              const id = b.dataset.v10Buy;
              if (!confirm(`Buy ${catalog[id].name} for $${catalog[id].price}?`)) return;
              notice(transactBuy(chosenShop, id, 1).message);
              return;
            }
            if (b.dataset.v10Use) {
              notice(consume(b.dataset.v10Use));
              return;
            }
            if (b.dataset.v10Lesson) {
              openLesson(b.dataset.v10Lesson);
              return;
            }
            if (b.dataset.v10Answer) {
              answerLesson(b.dataset.v10Answer);
              return;
            }
            const a = b.dataset.v10Action;
            if (!a) return;
            if (a === 'deposit' || a === 'withdraw') {
              const value = $('v10-bank-amount')?.value;
              notice(bankAction(a, Number(value)));
            } else if (a === 'goal') {
              const n = Number($('v10-goal-amount').value);
              if (!validInt(n, 1, 1e6)) {
                notice('The goal must be a valid amount.');
                return;
              }
              state().goal = { name: $('v10-goal-name').value.slice(0, 60), amount: n };
              save();
              notice('🎯 Savings goal saved.');
            } else if (a === 'mine') notice(mineAction());
            else if (a === 'job') {
              const english = prompt(
                'To get a job, say a sentence in English (for example: Could I help you with your work, please?)',
              );
              if (english !== null) notice(jobAction(english));
            } else if (a === 'rest') notice(restAction());
            else if (a === 'refresh-home') {
              renderHomeDecor();
              notice('Room updated.');
            } else if (a === 'export') exportCsv();
            else if (a === 'quiz-close') $('v10-quiz').hidden = true;
          });
          panel.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'v10-shop-select') {
              chosenShop = e.target.value;
              render();
            }
          });
          for (const node of [panel, $('v10-quiz')]) {
            node.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                close();
                if ($('v10-quiz')) $('v10-quiz').hidden = true;
              }
            });
            node.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
          }
          document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (
              ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(e.target?.tagName) ||
              e.altKey ||
              e.ctrlKey ||
              e.metaKey
            )
              return;
            if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'b' && !e.repeat) {
              e.preventDefault();
              panel.hidden ? show('shop') : close();
            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
          });
          const npcButton = $('v10-npc-shop');
          if (npcButton)
            npcButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const sc = scene(),
                id = sc?.chat?.currentId,
                link = Object.entries(shops).find(
                  ([, v]) =>
                    v.npc === id &&
                    canShop(
                      Object.entries(shops).find(
                        ([name, s]) => s.npc === id && canShop(name),
                      )?.[0] || '',
                    ),
                )?.[0];
              if (link) show('shop', link);
              else notice('Go to the right shop to buy items.');
            });
          setInterval(() => {
            const sc = scene(),
              btn = $('v10-npc-shop');
            if (btn && sc) {
              const npc = sc.chat?.currentId;
              const possible = Object.entries(shops).find(
                ([name, v]) => v.npc === npc && canShop(name),
              );
              btn.hidden = !possible;
            }
            if (sc?.inside?.b?.name === "Hero's Home" && !decorationGraphics) renderHomeDecor();
            else if (!sc?.inside && decorationGraphics) {
              decorationGraphics.destroy();
              decorationGraphics = null;
            }
            if (!panel.hidden) render();
          }, 1200);
          const oldNpcMessage = adventure.onNpcMessage;
          adventure.onNpcMessage = function (id, message) {
            const original = oldNpcMessage.call(adventure, id, message) || [];
            return [...original, ...onNpcConversation(id, message)];
          };
          const currentAssistantRun = assistantCore.run;
          assistantCore.run = async function (input, ...args) {
            const answer = aiShopping(input);
            if (answer) return { kind: 'text', reply: answer, local: true };
            return currentAssistantRun.call(assistantCore, input, ...args);
          };
          // Hide the old global RPG shop; it cannot take remote purchases anymore.
          window.LQ10_ECONOMY = {
            catalog,
            shops,
            show,
            transactBuy,
            bankAction,
            consume,
            state,
            context,
            mineAction,
            jobAction,
            onNpcConversation,
            boardTrain,
          };
        }
        return {
          init,
          show,
          close,
          render,
          notice,
          renderHomeDecor,
          afterSceneChange,
          state,
          shopItems,
          transactBuy,
          bankAction,
          consume,
          aiShopping,
          context,
          restAction,
          jobAction,
          mineAction,
          onNpcConversation,
          boardTrain,
        };
      })();

            });
        }
        function close() {
          const x = shell();
          if (!x || x.hidden) return;
          x.hidden = true;
          el('l11-menu-btn')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          (lastFocus?.isConnected ? lastFocus : el('l11-menu-btn'))?.focus?.({
            preventScroll: true,
          });
        }
        function existingIsOpen() {
          return [
            'chat',
            'helper',
            'journal',
            'quests',
            'settings',
            'briefing',
            'v10-panel',
            'rpg-panel',
            'v8-panel',
            'ai-panel',
            'lq-guide',
            'lq-levels',
            'lq-voice',
          ].some((id) => {
            const x = el(id);
            if (!x) return false;
            if (x.hidden) return false;
            if (
              id === 'chat' ||
              id === 'helper' ||
              id === 'journal' ||
              id === 'quests' ||
              id === 'settings' ||
              id === 'briefing'
            )
              return getComputedStyle(x).display !== 'none';
            return true;
          });
        }
        function open(name = 'maps') {
          if (!shell()) return;
          if (existingIsOpen()) return;
          lastFocus = document.activeElement;
          shell().hidden = false;
          el('l11-menu-btn')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          page(name);
          if (name === 'maps') el('l11-nav').scrollLeft = 0;
          el('l11-close')?.focus();
        }
        function toggle() {
          if (!shell().hidden) close();
          else open('maps');
        }
        function adapt(type, tab) {
          close();
          if (type === 'v10') {
            window.LQ10_ECONOMY?.show(tab || 'shop');
            return;
          }
          if (type === 'v8') {
            el('v8-menu-btn')?.click();
            if (tab && tab !== 'quests')
              el('v8-panel')?.querySelector(`[data-v8-tab="${tab}"]`)?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (type === 'rpg') {
            el('rpg-open')?.click();
            if (tab) {
              const node = [...(el('rpg-tabs')?.querySelectorAll('button') || [])].find(
                (b) =>
                  b.dataset.tab === tab ||
                  b.dataset.rpgTab === tab ||
                  b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(tab),
              );
              node?.click();
            }
            return;
          }
        }
        function action(a) {
          if (!a) return;
          if (a.startsWith('ach:')) return window.LQAchievements?.action(a.slice(4));
          if (a.startsWith('travel:')) {
            const id = a.slice(7);
            const sc = window.__lifequestGetScene?.();
            if(window.LQCareerWorlds && !window.LQCareerWorlds.allowed(id)){window.LQCareerWorlds.feedback(sc,id);return;}
            const destination = window.LQWorldMaps?.destination?.(id);
            if (!sc || !destination || typeof sc.switchArea !== 'function' || sc.switching) return;
            if (sc.area?.id === id) return;
            close();
            sc.switchArea(destination.id, destination.spawn, '🧭 Travelled using the Map Menu');
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'map') {
            close();
            const x = el('v8-map-hide'); // do not mutate prefs without using the original shortcut handler
            document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'm', bubbles: true }));
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'ai' || a === 'ai:quiz') {
            close();
            el('ai-open')?.click();
            if (a === 'ai:quiz') {
              const inp = el('ai-input');
              if (inp) {
                inp.value = 'quiz';
                inp.focus();
              }
            }
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'helper') {
            close();
            el('group-menu')?.querySelector('[data-act="helper"]')?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'settings') {
            close();
            el('group-menu')?.querySelector('[data-act="settings"]')?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'guide') {
            close();
            el('guide-open')?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'device') {
            close();
            window.LQDevice?.change();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'tutorial') {
            close();
            window.LQIntro?.replay();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'voice') {
            close();
            el('voice-open')?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (a === 'levels') {
            close();
            el('level-open')?.click();
            return;
          }
          if (a.startsWith('v10:')) return adapt('v10', a.slice(4));
          if (a.startsWith('rpg:')) return adapt('rpg', a.slice(4));
          if (a.startsWith('v8:')) return adapt('v8', a.slice(3));
        }
        function updateHUD() {
          const sc = window.__lifequestGetScene?.(),
            g = sc?.store?.game;
          if (!sc || !g) return;
          const inside = sc.inside;
          const q = V8?.currentQuest?.();
          const step = V8?.nextStep?.();
          const place = sc.area?.name || 'English Town';
          const loc = inside?.b?.name
            ? ` · ${inside.b.name}${inside.floor ? ' · floor ' + inside.floor : ''}`
            : '';
          const l = `${place}${loc} · ${window.LQPast?.dayLabel ? window.LQPast.dayLabel(g.day) : `Day ${g.day || 1}`} ·${String(Math.floor((g.minutes || 0) / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor((g.minutes || 0) % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          if (el('l11-place')?.textContent !== l) el('l11-place').textContent = l;
          const chatNode = el('chat');
          const talking = !!chatNode && getComputedStyle(chatNode).display !== 'none';
          el('l11-current').hidden = talking;
          el('ai-open').hidden = talking;
          const a = adventure?.state?.() || {};
          const r = a.level || 1,
            xp = a.xp || 0;
          const hud = `Lv. ${r} · $${g.money || 0}`;
          if (hud !== lastHud) {
            lastHud = hud;
            el('l11-stats').textContent = hud;
            el('l11-xp').textContent = `${xp} XP`;
          }
          // V8 objective is authoritative; fallback to original quest log when unavailable.
          let title = q?.title || 'Explore & learn English',
            detail = step?.text || 'Press G to see your quests';
          if (!q?.title) {
            const goal = sc.quests?.hudLine?.();
            if (goal) detail = String(goal).slice(0, 95);
          }
          if (el('l11-objective').textContent !== title) el('l11-objective').textContent = title;
          if (el('l11-objdetail').textContent !== detail) el('l11-objdetail').textContent = detail;
        }
        function init() {
          const menu = el('l11-menu-btn');
          if (!menu) return;
          menu.addEventListener('click', toggle);
          el('l11-close')?.addEventListener('click', close);
          shell()?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === shell()) close();
          });
          el('l11-nav')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const b = e.target.closest('[data-l11-page]');
            if (b) page(b.dataset.l11Page);
          });
          el('l11-page')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const b = e.target.closest('[data-l11-action]');
            if (b) action(b.dataset.l11Action);
          });
          document.addEventListener(
            'keydown',
            (e) => {
              if (
                e.isComposing ||
                ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(e.target?.tagName) ||
                e.target?.isContentEditable
              )
                return;
              if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
              if (!shell().hidden) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                  close();
                  return;
                }
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                  const focus = [...shell().querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled])')].filter(
                    (b) => b.offsetParent !== null,
                  );
                  if (focus.length) {
                    const start = focus[0],
                      end = focus.at(-1);
                    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === start) {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      end.focus();
                    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === end) {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      start.focus();
                    }
                  }
                }
                if (e.key === 'g' || e.key === 'G') e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                return;
              }
              if ((e.key === 'g' || e.key === 'G') && !e.repeat && !existingIsOpen()) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                open();
              }
            },
            true,
          );
          // Older visible shortcuts route through the one-nav shell; the targets themselves still retain native callbacks.
          el('group-btn')?.addEventListener(
            'click',
            (e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopImmediatePropagation();
              toggle();
            },
            true,
          );
          el('v8-menu-btn')?.addEventListener(
            'click',
            (e) => {
              if (e.isTrusted) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                open('maps');
              }
            },
            true,
          );
          updateHUD();
          setInterval(updateHUD, 650);
          window.LQ11_UI = { open, close, page, action };
        }
        return { init };
      })();

      adventure.init();
      V8.init();
      LQ10.init();
      startGame();
      LQ11.init();
      $('lq-loading').hidden = true;

<script>
/*
 * LifeQuest loader.
 * The game used to be one huge function inside index.html. It is now split into small files under js/game/.
 * The files are plain slices of that function body, so they share one scope: we download them in order,
 * join them and run them as a single function. (This needs http://, i.e. localhost or GitHub Pages — not file://.)
 */
(function () {
  const startupInfo = document.getElementById('lq-loading');

  function displayError(message) {
    startupInfo.hidden = false;
    startupInfo.innerHTML =
      '<strong>Could not load the game</strong><p>' +
      message +
      '</p><small>Reload the page. The Phaser 4.2.1 graphics library is loaded from vendor/phaser.min.js (or a CDN if that file is missing).</small>';
  }

  function loadScript(src) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = src;
      s.async = true;
      s.onload = () => resolve();
      s.onerror = () => reject(Error(src));
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  async function loadPhaser() {
    // The single-file build already embeds Phaser, so window.Phaser exists and nothing is downloaded.
    if (window.Phaser) return window.Phaser;
    for (const u of [
      // Local copy first (split/ and LIFEQUEST_deploy ship vendor/phaser.min.js), so the game starts without Internet.
      'vendor/phaser.min.js',
      'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/phaser/4.2.1/phaser.min.js',
      'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js',
      'https://unpkg.com/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js',
    ]) {
      try {
        await loadScript(u);
        if (window.Phaser) return window.Phaser;
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not load Phaser from', u);
      }
    }
    throw Error('Could not load the Phaser library');
  }

  const PARTS = [
    'js/game/01-services.js',
    'js/game/02-core-npcs-and-schedules.js',
    'js/game/03-core-areas-and-map.js',
    'js/game/04-core-quest-helpers.js',
    'js/game/05a-core-npc-dialogue-profiles.js',
    'js/game/05b-core-npc-dialogue-profiles.js',
    'js/game/06-core-npc-chat-engine.js',
    'js/game/07a-core-ai-provider-and-world-art.js',
    'js/game/07b-core-ai-provider-and-world-art.js',
    'js/game/08-core-interiors.js',
    'js/game/09-core-graphics-v9.js',
    'js/game/10-core-characters-and-scene.js',
    'js/game/11-study-lab.js',
    'js/game/12-adventure-rpg.js',
    'js/game/13-assistant-core.js',
    'js/game/14-v8-quests-and-minimap.js',
    'js/game/15-ui-assistant-panel.js',
    'js/game/16-economy.js',
    'js/game/17-train-and-tickets.js',
    'js/game/18-economy-shop-and-npc-hooks.js',
    'js/game/19-menu-v11.js',
    'js/game/20-startup.js',
  ];

  async function loadGameSource() {
    // The single-file build (build-single.ps1) embeds the game source in the page.
    const embedded = document.getElementById('lq-game-src');
    if (embedded) return embedded.textContent + '\n//# sourceURL=lifequest-game.js';
    if (location.protocol === 'file:') {
      throw new Error(
        'Open the game over http (e.g. http://localhost:8080/) or GitHub Pages, not directly via file://.',
      );
    }
    const texts = await Promise.all(
      // 22 files at once: a simple local server (python -m http.server) sometimes drops a connection ("Failed to
      // fetch"), so each file is tried up to 3 times before giving up.
      PARTS.map(async (url) => {
        let last;
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
          try {
            const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-cache' });
            if (res.ok) return res.text();
            last = new Error('Could not load ' + url + ' (' + res.status + ')');
          } catch (e) {
            last = e;
          }
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300 * (attempt + 1)));
        }
        throw last;
      }),
    );
    return texts.join('\n') + '\n//# sourceURL=lifequest-game.js';
  }

  async function boot() {
    try {
      // Start downloading Phaser and the game while the title screen is shown.
      const phaserReady = loadPhaser();
      const sourceReady = loadGameSource();
      phaserReady.catch(() => {});
      sourceReady.catch(() => {});
      if (window.LQTitle) await window.LQTitle.show();
      // How the player plays (computer / phone / tablet): asked once, right after Start (device.js).
      if (window.LQDevice) await window.LQDevice.ask();
      if (window.LQAuth && !window.__lqVocaltPreviewMode) await window.LQAuth.start();
      const Phaser = await phaserReady;
      const source = await sourceReady;
      const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () {}).constructor;
      const running = new AsyncFunction('Phaser', source)(Phaser);
      if (window.LQCreatorUI) window.LQCreatorUI.watch();
      await running;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('LifeQuest HTML failed to start:', e);
      displayError('Could not start: ' + (e?.message || e));
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();

</script>

 if(!scene?.sys?.isActive?.()||scene.area?.id!==AREA||scene.inside||scene.switching||!scene.player?.active)return false;
 if(scene.chat?.isOpen||scene.briefing?.isOpen||scene.helper?.isOpen||scene.settings?.isOpen||scene.journal?.isOpen||scene.quests?.isOpen)return false;
 if(window.LQOrigins?.isPlaying?.(scene)||window.LQIntro?.isPlaying?.()||window.LQPast?.isFilming?.()||window.LQArtDistrict?.isFilming?.())return false;
 for(const id of ['lq-title','lq-past','lq-art','lq-intro','lq-shrine','ll-panel','lq-mine-choice'])if(visible(document.getElementById(id)))return false;
 return true;
}

function initUI(){
 if(ui)return;
 styles();

 document.addEventListener('keydown',onKey,true);
}
function onKey(e){
 if(active){if(['Escape'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();finish(true);}else if(['Enter',' '].includes(e.key)&&!e.repeat&&!e.ctrlKey&&!e.metaKey){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();next();}else if(!['Tab','Shift','Control','Alt'].includes(e.key)) {e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();}return;}
 if(modal&&!modal.hidden){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();closeChoice();}return;}
 if((e.key==='e'||e.key==='E')&&nearObject&&!(document.activeElement?.matches?.('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]'))){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();inspectNearest();}
}
function startMusic(){
 if(!active || music)return;
 try{
   const Audio=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!Audio)return;
   const ac=new Audio();ac.resume?.();const master=ac.createGain();master.gain.value=.12;master.connect(ac.destination);
   const tones=[220,277.18,329.63,246.94,293.66,369.99,196,246.94,329.63,220,277.18,329.63];
   let step=0;const playNote=()=>{if(!active||ac.state==='closed')return;
      const f=tones[step++%tones.length],now=ac.currentTime;
      for(const [frequency,volume] of [[f,.21],[f/2,.09]]){
       const osc=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency,now);
       g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume,now+.04);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+1.5);
       osc.connect(g);g.connect(master);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+1.6);
      }
   };playNote();const timer=setInterval(playNote,950);music={ac,timer};
 }catch(e){console.warn('Mine cinematic audio:',e)}
}
function stopMusic(){if(!music)return;clearInterval(music.timer);try{music.ac.close()}catch{}music=null;}
function play(replay){
 const scene=sc(); if(active||!ready(scene))return false;
 initUI();
 const cam=scene.cameras?.main;if(!cam)return false;
 const kb=scene.input?.keyboard,ctrl=window.__townControls;
 active={scene,area:AREA,cam,zoom:cam.zoom||1,keyboard:kb,keyboardWasOn:kb?.enabled??true,replay:!!replay,
   start:performance.now(),sceneIndex:-1,stepStart:0,closed:false,position:{x:scene.player.x,y:scene.player.y},
   playerWasVisible:scene.player.visible,playerBadgeVisible:scene.badge?.visible};
 try{window.cancelTownAutopilot?.();}catch{}
 if(ctrl)ctrl.up=ctrl.down=ctrl.left=ctrl.right=ctrl.actionRequested=false;
 if(kb){kb.enabled=false;try{kb.resetKeys();}catch{}}
 try{cam.stopFollow()}catch{}
 document.body.classList.add('lq-mine-playing');ui.hidden=false;
 // Mark viewed only on completion or explicit skip; interrupted films play again safely.
 go(0);animationId=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 return true;
}
function go(n){
 if(!active||n>=nodes.length){finish(false);return;}
 active.sceneIndex=n;active.stepStart=performance.now();active.lastLine=-1;
 const shot=nodes[n],a=active;
 ui.querySelector('.mine-stage').textContent=`${n+1} / ${nodes.length}`;
 ui.querySelector('.mine-dialogue .who').textContent='';ui.querySelector('.mine-dialogue .en').textContent='';ui.querySelector('.mine-dialogue .vi').textContent='';
 const art=ui.querySelector('.mine-art');art.classList.toggle('open',!!shot.art);
 if(a.scene.area?.id===AREA){
  try{a.cam.pan((shot.location[0]+.5)*T,(shot.location[1]+.5)*T,reducedMotion()?0:2400,'Sine.easeInOut',true);
      a.cam.zoomTo(shot.zoom,reducedMotion()?0:2100,'Sine.easeInOut',true);}catch(err){console.warn('Mine camera:',err)}
 }
 updateLine(0);paint(shot.art,0);
}
function updateLine(progress){
 const a=active;if(!a)return;const shot=nodes[a.sceneIndex];const index=Math.max(0,Math.min(shot.lines.length-1,Math.floor(progress*shot.lines.length)));
 if(index===a.lastLine)return;a.lastLine=index;
 const [who,en,vi]=shot.lines[index];
 const obj=ui.querySelector('.mine-dialogue');obj.querySelector('.who').textContent=who;
 obj.querySelector('.en').textContent=en;obj.querySelector('.vi').textContent=vi;
}
function frame(now){
 if(!active)return;
 const a=active;
 if(!a.scene?.sys?.isActive?.()||a.scene.area?.id!==AREA||a.scene.inside||a.scene.switching){finish(true);return;}
 const shot=nodes[a.sceneIndex];const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-a.stepStart),progress=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,elapsed/shot.duration));
 updateLine(progress);
 let done=0;for(let i=0;i<a.sceneIndex;i++)done+=nodes[i].duration;
 ui.querySelector('.mine-progress span').style.width=((done+Math.min(shot.duration,elapsed))/total*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
 if(shot.art){if(!a.lastDraw||now-a.lastDraw>90){a.lastDraw=now;paint(shot.art,elapsed/1000)}}
 if(elapsed>=shot.duration){go(a.sceneIndex+1);if(!active)return;}
 animationId=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function next(){if(active)go(active.sceneIndex+1);}
function finish(skipped){
 if(!active)return;
 const a=active;active=null;cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
 stopMusic();if(ui){ui.hidden=true;ui.querySelector('.mine-art')?.classList.remove('open');}
 document.body.classList.remove('lq-mine-playing');
 const s=a.scene;
 if(s&&s.area?.id===AREA&&s.cameras?.main){
  try{s.cameras.main.stopFollow();s.cameras.main.zoomTo(a.zoom,250,'Sine.easeOut',true);s.cameras.main.pan(s.player.x,s.player.y,250,'Sine.easeOut',true);s.cameras.main.startFollow(s.player,true,.12,.12);}catch(e){console.warn('Mine camera restore:',e)}
 }
 if(a.keyboard)a.keyboard.enabled=a.keyboardWasOn;
 // Skipping counts as viewed, never forces a clue, NPC reward, or mission completion.
 if(s?.area?.id===AREA)write(KEY,skipped?'skipped':'seen');
 settingSound=false;if(ui){ui.querySelector('#lq-mine-audio').textContent='♪ Bật nhạc';ui.querySelector('#lq-mine-audio').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')}
}

const rc=(x,y,w,h,c)=>{ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(w),Math.round(h))};
const line=(x1,y1,x2,y2,c,w=1)=>{ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke()};

}

 // This is scenery only: no collision or changed navigation graph.

function near(s){
 if(!s||s.area?.id!==AREA||s.inside||s.switching||active||visible(modal)||!read(KEY))return null;
 if(s.chat?.isOpen||s.journal?.isOpen||s.settings?.isOpen||s.helper?.isOpen||s.quests?.isOpen)return null;
 const x=s.player?.x||0,y=s.player?.y||0;
 const dist=(tx,ty)=>Math.hypot(x-tx*T,y-ty*T);
 if(dist(24.5,60.55)<100)return 'lantern';
 if(dist(21.5,51.5)<112)return 'board';
 return null;
}

}
function closeChoice(){if(!modal)return;modal.hidden=true;if(modal._kb){modal._kb.enabled=modal._prev;modal._kb=null}}
function choose(c){if(!['share','care'].includes(c))return;write(LANTERN_KEY,c);

}
function tick(){
 const s=sc();const isMine=s?.area?.id===AREA&&!s.inside;
 document.body.classList.toggle('lq-mine-area',!!isMine);
 if(s!==lanternScene||!isMine){if(lantern)clearLantern();}
 if(!isMine){lastScene=s;return;}
 if(read(KEY)&&!lantern)installLantern(s);
 nearObject=near(s);
 const b=document.getElementById('lq-mine-lantern-action');
 if(b){b.hidden=!nearObject;b.textContent=nearObject==='lantern'?'✦ E · Chiếc đèn của Elias':'✉ E · Bảng tuyến đường cũ';}
 if(!active&&!read(KEY)&&ready(s)){
  // Only first arrival starts the film. Wait for map transition and game title to settle.
  if(lastScene!==s){lastScene=s;return;}
  play(false);
 }
 lastScene=s;
}
function init(){if(booted)return;booted=true;initUI();watcher=setInterval(tick,650);tick();}
window.LQMineIntro=Object.freeze({version:'50.0',isPlaying:(s)=>!!active&&(!s||active.scene===s),play:()=>play(false),replay:()=>play(true),skip:()=>finish(true),status:()=>({seen:read(KEY),choice:read(LANTERN_KEY),playing:!!active,beat:active?.sceneIndex??null}),inspect:inspectNearest});
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
