function playingFilm(sc){return document.body.classList.contains('lq-mine-playing')||window.LQMineIntro?.isPlaying?.(sc)||window.LQOrigins?.isPlaying?.(sc)||window.LQPast?.isFilming?.()||window.LQArtDistrict?.isFilming?.()||window.LQIntro?.isPlaying?.()||false}
function busy(sc){if(!sc?.player||sc.switching||sc.sleeping||sc.inside||playingFilm(sc))return true;
  if(sc.chat?.isOpen||sc.journal?.isOpen||sc.settings?.isOpen||sc.quests?.isOpen||sc.helper?.isOpen||sc.briefing?.isOpen||window.LQCareerWorlds?.isDialogOpen?.())return true;
  if(document.querySelector('#ll-panel:not([hidden]),#v10-panel:not([hidden]),#rpg-panel:not([hidden]),#l11-shell:not([hidden]),#lq-mine-choice:not([hidden])'))return true;
  return false;}
function niceTime(sc){const t=Number(sc?.store?.game?.minutes??720)%1440;return `${String(Math.floor(t/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.floor(t%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function phase(sc){const t=Number(sc?.store?.game?.minutes??720)%1440;return t<360||t>=1260?0:t<660?1:t<1020?2:3}
function toast(msg){const e=$('lq51-toast');if(!e)return;e.textContent=msg;e.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{e.hidden=true},3300)}
function anchor(sc,a){
 const tile=sc?.area?.spawn||{x:Math.floor((sc?.area?.w||30)/2),y:Math.floor((sc?.area?.h||30)/2)};
 if(sc){let cache=anchorCache.get(sc);if(!cache){cache=new Map();anchorCache.set(sc,cache)}
   const key=`${sc.area?.id}:${a.id}`;if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
   const x=a.at?.[0]??((tile.x||10)+(a.dx||0)),y=a.at?.[1]??((tile.y||10)+(a.dy||0));
   const point=safeTile(sc,x,y);cache.set(key,point);return point;
 }
 const x=a.at?.[0]??((tile.x||10)+(a.dx||0)),y=a.at?.[1]??((tile.y||10)+(a.dy||0));return safeTile(sc,x,y);
}
function safeTile(sc,tx,ty){if(!sc?.area)return {x:tx+.5,y:ty+.5};const ar=sc.area;
 const good=(x,y)=>x>=2&&y>=2&&x<ar.w-2&&y<ar.h-2&&!ar.isTileBlocked?.(x,y)&&!ar.warpAt?.(x,y);
 const bx=Math.max(2,Math.min(ar.w-3,Math.floor(tx))),by=Math.max(2,Math.min(ar.h-3,Math.floor(ty)));
 for(let r=0;r<12;r++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){
  if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))!==r)continue;
  const x=bx+dx,y=by+dy;if(good(x,y))return {x:x+.5,y:y+.5};
 }
 return {x:bx+.5,y:by+.5};}
function spots(sc){return ACTIVITIES.filter(a=>a.area===sc?.area?.id)}
function near(sc){if(busy(sc)||!dialog?.hidden)return null;let closest=null,dist=Infinity;
 for(const a of spots(sc)){const p=anchor(sc,a),d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-p.x*TILE,sc.player.y-p.y*TILE);
  if(d<91&&d<dist){dist=d;closest=a;}}
 return closest;}
function renderArt(stored){const palette=PALETTES[stored?.palette??0]||PALETTES[0],shape=patterns[stored?.pattern??0]||patterns[0];return `<div class="lq51-art" role="img" aria-label="Tranh pixel-art"><div class="lq51-pixels">${shape.map(v=>`<i style="background:${palette[v]}"></i>`).join('')}</div><span>${safe(stored?.name||'A NEW MEMORY')}</span></div>`}
function markScene(sc){if(!sc?.add)return;const id=sc.area?.id;if(!REGIONS[id])return;
 for(const a of spots(sc)){
  const p=anchor(sc,a),isDone=!!data.done[a.id],x=p.x*TILE,y=p.y*TILE;
  const g=sc.add.graphics();g.fillStyle(0x071d2d,.60).fillRoundedRect(-13,-9,26,24,4);g.lineStyle(2,isDone?0x8de6b9:0xf5d28a,.96).strokeRoundedRect(-13,-9,26,24,4);
  g.fillStyle(isDone?0x6ac4a2:0xf0c879).fillRect(-8,-4,16,13);g.fillStyle(0x233b4a).fillRect(-6,-2,12,9);
  const glyph=sc.add.text(0,1,isDone?'✓':a.icon,{fontFamily:'monospace',fontStyle:'bold',fontSize:'13px',color:isDone?'#a3f7c4':'#ffe2a4'}).setOrigin(.5);
  const plate=sc.add.container(x,y-15,[g,glyph]).setDepth(12.65);
  if(typeof plate.setAlpha==='function')plate.setAlpha(.96);
  if(!data.settings.motion){}else if(sc.tweens){const tw=sc.tweens.add({targets:plate,y:y-18,duration:1600,yoyo:true,repeat:-1,ease:'Sine.easeInOut'});plate.once('destroy',()=>tw?.remove?.());}
  sc.areaObjs?.push(plate);sceneObjects.push(plate);
  if(isDone&&a.id==='wish-garden'){
   const grass=sc.add.graphics({x,y:y+13});grass.fillStyle(0x337e51).fillRect(-16,1,32,6);grass.fillStyle(0x82d49a).fillRect(-7,-9,5,12).fillRect(4,-12,5,15);grass.fillStyle(0xe5b88b).fillRect(-10,-13,11,4).fillRect(3,-16,10,4);
   grass.setDepth(12.3);sc.areaObjs?.push(grass);sceneObjects.push(grass);
  }
  if(isDone&&a.id==='art-mural'){
   const art=sc.add.graphics({x:x+30,y:y-14});const palette=PALETTES[data.wall['art-mural']?.palette??0];const pixels=patterns[data.wall['art-mural']?.pattern??0];
   pixels.forEach((v,i)=>{art.fillStyle(parseInt(palette[v].slice(1),16)).fillRect((i%8)*3,Math.floor(i/8)*3,3,3)});art.setDepth(12.4);sc.areaObjs?.push(art);sceneObjects.push(art);
  }
 }
}

function recover(){const s=scene(),p=s?.player;if(!s?.area||!p){toast('Cần vào game trước khi kiểm tra vị trí.');return;}
 if(s.inside||s.switching||playingFilm(s)||s.chat?.isOpen){toast('Không thể khôi phục khi đang trong nhà, hội thoại hoặc cinematic.');return;}

 try{s.unstick?.();if(s.blocked(p.x,p.y)){
  let px=Math.floor(p.x/TILE),py=Math.floor(p.y/TILE),found=false;
  for(let r=1;r<Math.max(s.area.w,s.area.h)&&!found;r++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r&&!found;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r&&!found;dx++){
   if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))!==r)continue;const x=px+dx,y=py+dy;
   if(x<1||y<1||x>=s.area.w-1||y>=s.area.h-1||s.area.isTileBlocked(x,y)||s.area.warpAt?.(x,y))continue;

  else toast('Không tìm được vị trí an toàn. Hãy mở menu bản đồ để chuyển vùng.');
 }catch(e){console.warn('LQ51 recovery',e);toast('Không thể kiểm tra vị trí trong trạng thái hiện tại.');}

function safeTile(sc,tx,ty,max=18){
 for(let r=0;r<=max;r++)for(let y=-r;y<=r;y++)for(let x=-r;x<=r;x++){

  if(openTile(sc,px,py))return {tx:px,ty:py,x:(px+.5)*T,y:(py+.5)*T};
 }
 return null;
}
// Four-way shortest path on the same blocked() grid as player movement.

 if(!openTile(sc,ex,ey))return [];if(sx===ex&&sy===ey)return [{x:end.x,y:end.y}];
 const w=sc.area.w,ids=globalThis.LQNav1049.search(w,sc.area.h,sx,sy,ex,ey,(x,y)=>openTile(sc,x,y),limit,[1,0,-1,0,0,1,0,-1]);if(!ids)return [];return ids.slice(Math.max(1,ids.length-140)).map(k=>({x:(k%w+.5)*T,y:(Math.floor(k/w)+.5)*T}));
}

 // Avoid a marker on unreachable side of a river, building or wall.
 if(p&&route(sc,{x:(spawn.x+.5)*T,y:(spawn.y+.5)*T},p,2500).length===0){p=safeTile(sc,spawn.x+2+index,spawn.y+1,5)||p}
 return p;
}
function gfxProp(sc,p,kind,complete=false){const g=sc.add.graphics({x:p.x,y:p.y});const base=complete?0x8cdbb3:0xe7ba7d;
 g.fillStyle(0x071d2c,.65).fillRect(-16,6,32,6);g.lineStyle(1,0x12283c,.9);
 const box=(x,y,w,h,c)=>g.fillStyle(c).fillRect(x,y,w,h);
 if(kind==='garden'||kind==='tree'){box(-11,2,22,7,0x456e4a);for(let i=0;i<4+(complete?4:0);i++){const x=-10+i*3,y=-5-(i%3)*2;box(x, y,2,11,0x569c61);box(x-2,y,5,4,i%2?0xffd08a:0x91d9b0)}if(kind==='tree'){box(-3,-15,7,15,0x765944);box(-15,-28,28,13,0x43896b);box(-11,-33,20,9,0x76b786)}}
 else if(kind==='fire'){box(-12,2,24,5,0x725447);box(-6,-9,12,15,0xeaa858);box(-3,-15,6,10,0xffdf85)}
 else if(kind==='water'){box(-13,2,26,5,0x639e9b);box(-9,-3,18,6,0x7ecce3);box(-3,-16,6,13,0xa2d9e4)}
 else if(kind==='machine'||kind==='computer'){box(-15,-19,30,25,0x415d6c);box(-11,-15,22,15,0x68b4ba);box(-8,-12,16,4,base);box(-4,6,8,7,0x7898a4);box(10,-6,3,3,complete?0x90f0b7:0xe4b461)}
 else if(kind==='shop'){box(-16,-12,32,6,0xd78467);box(-12,-6,24,13,0xa78660);box(-7,-3,5,5,base);box(4,-3,5,5,0x8cc7ac)}
 else if(kind==='bell'){box(-13,-8,26,15,0x526775);box(-8,-26,16,20,0xdbb879);box(-3,-6,6,5,0x9b824e)}
 else if(kind==='paint'||kind==='frame'){box(-15,-18,30,24,0x97755a);box(-12,-15,24,18,0xebe3d0);box(-10,-13,9,8,0xe58d97);box(1,-13,9,8,0x74b5af);box(-3,-1,9,3,0xe4bf7c)}
 else if(kind==='station'){box(-16,-18,32,24,0x52647f);box(-12,-14,24,14,0x1f3349);box(-9,-10,18,3,0x91d6c7);box(-9,-4,13,2,base)}
 else {box(-14,-15,28,22,kind==='letter'?0x926b57:0x6b7f8c);box(-10,-12,20,14,0xd8c9a5);box(-8,-8,16,2,0x997e64);box(-8,-3,11,2,base)}
 g.setDepth(12.3);return g;
}
function applyProject(sc,area= sc.area.id){if(!state.projects[area]||active?.projectDrawn)return;
 const b=propPosition(sc,2);if(!b)return;const g=sc.add.graphics({x:b.x,y:b.y});
 g.fillStyle(0x275949,.9).fillRect(-19,5,38,10);g.fillStyle(0xf3d18e).fillRect(-14,-16,28,22);
 g.fillStyle(0x498977).fillRect(-11,-13,22,16);for(let j=0;j<4;j++){g.fillStyle(j%2?0xd4a762:0xb8e8c6).fillRect(-9+j*5,-10,4,10)}
 g.lineStyle(1,0xf6d69e).strokeRect(-14,-16,28,22);g.setDepth(12.05);active.objs.push(g);
 const label=sc.add.text(b.x,b.y-22,'✦ '+MAPS[area].project,{fontFamily:'monospace',fontSize:'10px',color:'#b6f9d2',backgroundColor:'#17362bcc',padding:{x:4,y:3}}).setOrigin(.5).setDepth(12.5);
 active.objs.push(label);active.projectDrawn=true;
}
function clearActive(){if(!active)return;for(const obj of [...active.objs,...active.eventObjs])try{obj?.destroy?.()}catch{};active=null;}
function addProp(sc,id,index){const meta=MAPS[sc.area.id],def=meta.props[index];const [pId,title,kind]=def,pos=propPosition(sc,index);if(!pos)return;
 const complete=!!state.actions[sc.area.id+':'+pId];const gr=gfxProp(sc,pos,kind,complete);
 const label=sc.add.text(pos.x,pos.y-37,(complete?'✓ ':'◆ ')+title,{fontFamily:'monospace',fontSize:'10px',color:complete?'#a7efc5':'#ffe5b5',backgroundColor:'#152b3acc',padding:{x:3,y:3}}).setOrigin(.5).setDepth(12.6);
 const hit=sc.add.rectangle(pos.x,pos.y-8,34,42,0xffffff,0).setDepth(12.65).setInteractive({useHandCursor:true});
 hit.on('pointerdown',()=>{if(Math.hypot(sc.player.x-pos.x,sc.player.y-pos.y)<110)openProp(sc,{id:pId,title,kind,pos});else notify('Hãy đến gần vật thể rồi nhấn R hoặc E.')});
 active.objs.push(gr,label,hit);active.props.push({id:pId,title,kind,pos,objects:[gr,label,hit],graphic:gr,label});
}
function eventKey(sc){const p=phase(sc);return `${sc.area.id}:${sc.store?.game?.day||1}:${p}`;}
function eventActive(sc){const m=Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes??720);return m>=8*60&&m<20*60;}
function drawEvent(sc){for(const o of active.eventObjs)try{o.destroy()}catch{}active.eventObjs=[];active.event=eventKey(sc);active.eventName='';
 if(!state.settings.ambient||!eventActive(sc))return;
 const p=propPosition(sc,3)||propPosition(sc,2);if(!p)return;
 const type=((Number(sc.store?.game?.day||1)+Object.keys(MAPS).indexOf(sc.area.id))%3);
 const name=type===0?'Lễ hội địa phương':type===1?'Cuộc gặp gỡ du khách':MAPS[sc.area.id].event;
 const g=sc.add.graphics({x:p.x,y:p.y});g.fillStyle(0x526d78).fillRect(-25,-6,50,17);g.fillStyle(type===0?0xe1a477:type===1?0x9ec5ad:0xa2a6d6).fillRect(-28,-18,56,10);
 for(let x=-23;x<25;x+=10){g.fillStyle(x%20?0xf2d79a:0x6da5ad).fillRect(x,-18,7,10)}g.setDepth(9.3);active.eventObjs.push(g);
 const label=sc.add.text(p.x,p.y-33,'♫ '+name,{fontFamily:'monospace',fontSize:'10px',color:'#ffdfa3',backgroundColor:'#18364acc',padding:{x:4,y:3}}).setOrigin(.5).setDepth(10.4);
 active.eventObjs.push(label);
 // Visitors use actual existing LifeQuest NPC sprites so their proportions/pixel grid stay identical.
 const defs=(sc.npcs||[]).filter(n=>sc.textures?.exists?.('ch_'+n.def.id+'_down_0')).slice(0,3);
 for(let i=0;i<Math.min(2,defs.length);i++){
  const n=defs[i],dest=safeTile(sc,p.tx+i*3-2,p.ty+3,4);if(!dest)continue;
  const sp=sc.add.image(dest.x,dest.y,'ch_'+n.def.id+'_down_0').setOrigin(.5,.82).setDepth(9.4);
  const tag=sc.add.text(dest.x,dest.y-31,'Khách '+(i+1),{fontFamily:'monospace',fontSize:'9px',color:'#f5dfb9',backgroundColor:'#243648bb'}).setOrigin(.5).setDepth(10);
  active.eventObjs.push(sp,tag);active.visitors.push({sprite:sp,label:tag,base:dest,walk:[],phase:i,source:n.def.id});
 }
 active.eventName=name;
}
function attach(sc){if(!goodScene(sc)||sc.inside)return;if(active?.sc===sc&&active.area===sc.area.id)return;
 // Repair only invalid arrivals. Do not touch any valid world position or locked gate.
 try{if(sc.player&&sc.area){let tx=Math.floor(sc.player.x/T),ty=Math.floor(sc.player.y/T);if(sc.blocked?.(sc.player.x,sc.player.y)||sc.area.warpAt?.(tx,ty)){const old={x:sc.player.x,y:sc.player.y};sc.unstick?.();if(sc.area.warpAt?.(Math.floor(sc.player.x/T),Math.floor(sc.player.y/T))||sc.blocked?.(sc.player.x,sc.player.y)){const p=safeTile(sc,tx,ty,7);if(p)sc.player.setPosition(p.x,p.y)}if(old.x!==sc.player.x||old.y!==sc.player.y){sc.store?.save?.();record('Đã sửa điểm đến an toàn tại '+sc.area.id)}}}}catch(e){console.warn('[V52] landing validation',e)}
 clearActive();active={sc,area:sc.area.id,objs:[],eventObjs:[],props:[],visitors:[],animals:[],event:'',lastTick:0,lastAnimal:0,eventName:'',projectDrawn:false};
 MAPS[sc.area.id].props.forEach((_,i)=>addProp(sc,sc.area.id,i));applyProject(sc);
 const types=MAPS[sc.area.id].animals;
 types.forEach((type,i)=>{const spawn=sc.area.spawn||{x:10,y:10};const p=safeTile(sc,spawn.x+10+i*4,spawn.y+7+(i%2)*5,15);if(!p)return;
  const gfx=sc.add.graphics({x:p.x,y:p.y}).setDepth(9.15);active.objs.push(gfx);
  const obj={type,gfx,x:p.x,y:p.y,base:p,goal:null,path:[],dir:1,energy:70+15*i,phase:0,behavior:'forage',targetAt:0,observed:0};active.animals.push(obj);
  const hit=sc.add.rectangle(p.x,p.y-8,33,34,0xffffff,0).setDepth(9.6).setInteractive({useHandCursor:true});hit.on('pointerdown',()=>{
    if(Math.hypot(sc.player.x-obj.x,sc.player.y-obj.y)>105)notify('Hãy đến gần con vật để quan sát.');else animalInteract(sc,obj);
  });obj.hit=hit;active.objs.push(hit);
 });
 drawEvent(sc);lastArea=sc.area.id;
}
function drawAnimal(a,dt){const spec=SPECIES[a.type],g=a.gfx;if(!g?.active)return;g.clear();const x=0,y=0;
 const b=spec.body,l=spec.light,c=spec.accent,step=(Math.floor(a.phase)%2);
 if(a.type==='bird'||a.type==='parrot'||a.type==='bat'){
  g.fillStyle(c).fillRect(-13,-8+(step?2:0),10,5);g.fillRect(3,-8+(step?2:0),10,5);
  g.fillStyle(b).fillRect(-7,-10,14,12);g.fillStyle(l).fillRect(-5,-8,8,5);g.fillStyle(0xffdd82).fillRect(6,-4,5,3);g.fillStyle(0x172c38).fillRect(2,-7,2,2);
 }else{
  g.fillStyle(b).fillRect(-11,-7,21,12);g.fillStyle(l).fillRect(-9,-6,9,5);g.fillStyle(c).fillRect(8,-4,6,4);g.fillRect(-9,-11,5,6);g.fillRect(1,-11,5,6);
  if(a.type==='spotted'){g.fillStyle(c).fillRect(-4,-5,3,4);g.fillRect(4,0,3,3)}
  g.fillStyle(c).fillRect(-8,5,5,4+(step?1:0));g.fillRect(4,5,5,4+(step?0:1));g.fillStyle(0x1a2831).fillRect(6,-3,2,2);
 }
 if(a.behavior==='sleep'){g.fillStyle(0xaee0ed).fillRect(10,-20,3,3);g.fillRect(14,-25,2,2)}
 g.x=Math.round(a.x);g.y=Math.round(a.y);
 if(a.hit){a.hit.x=a.x;a.hit.y=a.y-8}
}
function animateAnimals(sc,dt){if(!active||sc.inside||sc.switching)return;
 const rainy=weather()==='rain',night=phase(sc)==='night',now=performance.now();
 for(const a of active.animals){a.phase+=dt/320;
  if(now>a.targetAt){a.behavior=night&&a.type!=='bat'?'sleep':rainy?'shelter':Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y)<75?'curious':'forage';
   a.targetAt=now+3500+Math.random()*4500;const move=a.behavior==='sleep'?0:a.behavior==='curious'?2:a.behavior==='shelter'?3:5;
   const start={x:a.x,y:a.y};const dest=move?safeTile(sc,Math.floor(a.base.x/T)+(Math.random()-.5)*move*2,Math.floor(a.base.y/T)+(Math.random()-.5)*move*2,5):null;
   a.path=dest?route(sc,start,dest,700):[];
  }
  if(a.path.length){const t=a.path[0],dx=t.x-a.x,dy=t.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),step=Math.min(d,Math.max(0,dt)*.021);
   if(d<2)a.path.shift();else if(step>0){const x=a.x+dx/d*step,y=a.y+dy/d*step;if(!sc.blocked?.(x,y)){a.x=x;a.y=y}else a.path=[];}}
  drawAnimal(a,dt);
 }
}
function animateVisitors(sc,dt){if(!active?.visitors?.length||sc.inside)return;const now=performance.now();for(const v of active.visitors){
 if(!v.sprite.active)continue;if(!v.walk.length&&(v.next||0)<now){v.next=now+4600+Math.random()*2600;const dest=safeTile(sc,v.base.tx+(Math.random()-.5)*5,v.base.ty+(Math.random()-.5)*4,4);if(dest)v.walk=route(sc,{x:v.sprite.x,y:v.sprite.y},dest,500)}
 if(v.walk.length){const pt=v.walk[0],dx=pt.x-v.sprite.x,dy=pt.y-v.sprite.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),step=dt*.022;
 if(d<step+1){v.sprite.setPosition(pt.x,pt.y);v.walk.shift()}else if(d){const nx=v.sprite.x+dx/d*step,ny=v.sprite.y+dy/d*step;if(!sc.blocked?.(nx,ny))v.sprite.setPosition(nx,ny);else v.walk=[]}}
 const t=`ch_${v.source}_${v.walk.length?'down_1':'down_0'}`;if(sc.textures?.exists?.(t)&&v.sprite.texture.key!==t)v.sprite.setTexture(t);
 v.label.setPosition(v.sprite.x,v.sprite.y-30);
 }}
function reactNpcs(sc){if(!active||sc.inside)return;const ev=eventActive(sc)&&phase(sc)!=='night',rain=weather()==='rain';let talked=0;
 for(const n of sc.npcs||[]){if(n.inside||!n.sprite?.visible||n.slot?.kind==='sleep')continue;
  const relation=state.npcChoices[`${sc.area.id}:${n.def.id}`],friend=Number(relation?.trust||0);
  if(rain&&n.path?.length===0&&n.slot?.kind!=='work'){n.idleTimer=Math.max(n.idleTimer||0,10);continue}
  if(!ev||!friend||n.path?.length||talked>=2||!active.visitors.length)continue;
  const p=active.visitors[0].base;if(Math.hypot(n.sprite.x-p.x,n.sprite.y-p.y)>210)continue;
  if(performance.now()-(n.lq52GreetAt||0)<30000)continue;
  const dest=safeTile(sc,p.tx+1+talked,p.ty+3,2);if(!dest)continue;
  const path=route(sc,{x:n.sprite.x,y:n.sprite.y},dest,700);if(path.length&&path.length<13){n.path=path;n.lq52GreetAt=performance.now();talked++}
 }
}
function guardNpc(sc,n,old,dt){if(!goodScene(sc)||sc.inside||n.inside||!n.sprite?.visible||!n.path)return;
 const now=performance.now();if(sc.blocked?.(n.sprite.x,n.sprite.y)){
  if(!sc.blocked?.(old.x,old.y))n.sprite.setPosition(old.x,old.y);
  n.lq52Stuck=(n.lq52Stuck||0)+Math.max(0,dt||17);if(n.lq52Stuck>380){
   const target=n.path[n.path.length-1],dest=target&&safeTile(sc,Math.floor(target.x/T),Math.floor(target.y/T),2);
   n.path=dest?route(sc,{x:n.sprite.x,y:n.sprite.y},dest,2800):[];
   n.lq52Stuck=0;n.lq52Reroute=(n.lq52Reroute||0)+1;
  }
 }else{n.lq52Stuck=0;if(n.path.length>1&&now-(n.lq52Checked||0)>4000){n.lq52Checked=now;
   const next=n.path[0];if(next&&sc.blocked?.(next.x,next.y)){const target=n.path[n.path.length-1];n.path=route(sc,{x:n.sprite.x,y:n.sprite.y},target,2000)}}}
}
function update(sc,delta){if(!goodScene(sc)){if(active&&active.sc===sc)clearActive();return}if(sc.inside){if(active?.sc!==sc||active.area!==sc.area.id)clearActive();return}if(!active||active.sc!==sc||active.area!==sc.area.id)attach(sc);
 if(!active||sc.switching)return;const dt=Math.min(80,Math.max(0,delta||16));
 if(active.event!==eventKey(sc)){active.visitors=[];drawEvent(sc);if(eventActive(sc))notify('🎪 '+active.eventName+' đang diễn ra ở '+MAPS[sc.area.id].name)}
 if(!state.settings.lowMotion&&state.settings.ambient&&!busy(sc)){animateAnimals(sc,dt);animateVisitors(sc,dt)}
 else if(active.animals.length&&++frameNo%10===0)active.animals.forEach(a=>drawAnimal(a,dt));
 if(performance.now()-active.lastTick>12000){active.lastTick=performance.now();reactNpcs(sc)}
 if(frameNo++%8===0)updatePrompt(sc);
}
function closest(sc){if(!goodScene(sc)||busy(sc)||!dialog?.hidden)return null;
 if(sc.inside){const n=indoorNearest(sc);return n?{kind:'interior',item:n.item,dist:n.dist,title:n.title}:null;}
 let best=null,dist=Infinity;for(const p of active?.props||[]){const d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-p.pos.x,sc.player.y-p.pos.y);if(d<105&&d<dist){dist=d;best={kind:'prop',prop:p,dist:d,title:p.title}}}
 for(const a of active?.animals||[]){const d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-a.x,sc.player.y-a.y);if(d<65&&d<dist){dist=d;best={kind:'animal',animal:a,dist:d,title:SPECIES[a.type].name}}}
 return best;
}
function updatePrompt(sc){if(!prompt||!chip)return;const visible=goodScene(sc)&&!busy(sc);chip.hidden=!visible&&!sc?.inside;
 if(!visible){prompt.hidden=true;return}const p=closest(sc);
 prompt.hidden=!p;prompt.textContent=p?`R · ${p.title}`:'';
 chip.textContent=active&&eventActive(sc)?`🌍 V52 · ${active.eventName||'Living World'}`:`🌍 V52 · ${MAPS[sc.area.id].name}`;
}
function useNearest(sc){if(!sc||!dialog?.hidden)return false;const target=closest(sc);if(!target)return false;
 if(target.kind==='animal')animalInteract(sc,target.animal);
 if(target.kind==='prop')openProp(sc,target.prop);
 if(target.kind==='interior')interiorInteract(sc,target.item);
 return true;
}
function rememberNpc(sc,npc,decision){if(!npc?.def||!sc.area)return;
 const key=`${sc.area.id}:${npc.def.id}`,a=state.npcChoices[key]||{trust:0,choices:[],lastDay:0};
 if(a.lastDay===sc.store.game.day&&a.choices.includes(decision)){notify('Nhân vật nhớ lời bạn đã nói hôm nay.');return}
 if(!a.choices.includes(decision))a.choices.push(decision);a.trust=Math.min(6,a.trust+1);a.lastDay=sc.store.game.day;state.npcChoices[key]=a;record(`${npc.def.name||npc.def.id} nhớ lựa chọn: ${decision==='help'?'Giúp cộng đồng':'Hỏi về cuộc sống'}`);
 if(decision==='help'){npc.idleTimer=1;notify('♥ '+(npc.def.name||npc.def.id)+' tin tưởng bạn hơn.')}else notify('📜 Một câu chuyện mới đã được ghi vào ký ức NPC.');
 sound(440+a.trust*30);drawMenu();
}
function npcInteract(sc,npc){if(!npc?.def)return;selected={kind:'npc',id:npc.def.id};const key=`${sc.area.id}:${npc.def.id}`,recorded=state.npcChoices[key]||{trust:0,choices:[]};
 showDialog('♥ '+(npc.def.name||npc.def.id),`NPC đang ${npc.slot?.label||'sinh hoạt tại '+MAPS[sc.area.id].name}. Độ thân thiết V52: ${recorded.trust||0}/6. Họ ghi nhớ những lựa chọn của bạn.`,[
 {title:'I can help our community.',action:'npc:help'},
 {title:'Could you tell me about your day?',action:'npc:story'},
 {title:'Trở lại bản đồ',action:'close'}]);
}
function animalInteract(sc,a){if(!a)return;const id=`${sc.area.id}:${a.type}`,v=state.observations[id]||0;state.observations[id]=v+1;
 a.behavior='curious';a.targetAt=performance.now()+4500;a.path=[];
 if(!v)record('Quan sát '+SPECIES[a.type].name+' tại '+MAPS[sc.area.id].name);else store();sound(SPECIES[a.type].sound);
 selected={kind:'animal',id};showDialog('🐾 '+SPECIES[a.type].name,`Hành vi: ${a.behavior==='curious'?'tiến lại quan sát':a.behavior}. Đã quan sát ${v+1} lần. ${weather()==='rain'?'Trời mưa, động vật có thể tìm chỗ trú.':'Động vật tìm kiếm thức ăn và nghỉ ngơi theo thời gian trong game.'}`,[{title:'Tiếp tục quan sát',action:'animal:observe'},{title:'Trở lại',action:'close'}]);
}
function onAction(sc,prop){const key=`${sc.area.id}:${prop.id}`;if(!state.actions[key]){
  state.actions[key]={day:sc.store?.game?.day||1,when:new Date().toISOString()};record('Đã tương tác: '+prop.title+' ('+MAPS[sc.area.id].name+')');
 }else store();
 const ids=MAPS[sc.area.id].props.map(d=>sc.area.id+':'+d[0]);if(!state.projects[sc.area.id]&&ids.every(id=>state.actions[id])){
  state.projects[sc.area.id]={day:sc.store?.game?.day||1,when:new Date().toISOString()};record('Hoàn thiện công trình: '+MAPS[sc.area.id].project);
  sound(620);notify('✦ '+MAPS[sc.area.id].project+' đã xuất hiện trên bản đồ!');
 }
 if(active?.sc===sc){const old=new Set(active.props.flatMap(p=>p.objects||[]));for(const o of old)try{o.destroy()}catch{};active.objs=active.objs.filter(o=>!old.has(o));active.props=[];
 MAPS[sc.area.id].props.forEach((_,i)=>addProp(sc,sc.area.id,i));applyProject(sc);
 }
 store();
}
const descriptions={
 board:['Bảng cộng đồng cập nhật danh sách những người cần hỗ trợ.','A volunteer can help the town today.'],
 letter:['Bạn so sánh nội dung lá thư và tên người nhận, rồi lưu kết quả vào sổ.','I checked the name and the delivery route.'],
 station:['Bảng giờ tàu cho biết các chuyến hàng và điểm đến của thị trấn.','The train leaves at half past nine.'],
 machine:['Bạn khởi động máy, kiểm tra đèn tín hiệu và hoàn thành một lượt vận hành.','First I checked the machine. Then it started.'],
 garden:['Bạn chăm sóc đất và tưới cây. Khu vực sẽ phát triển sau khi hoàn thành dự án.','If I were you, I would protect these plants.'],

function indoorNearest(sc){const inside=sc?.inside;if(!inside?.spec?.items||!sc.player)return null;
 // The interior renderer uses a fixed room origin shared with its original code.
 const roomX=160,roomY=128; // replaced below using the actual original constants if supplied from DOM? derive from map sprite.
 const image=inside.objs?.find(o=>o.texture&&o.texture.key?.startsWith('int_v7_'));
 const X=image?.x??roomX,Y=image?.y??roomY,unit=T*inside.k;
 let best=null,dist=Infinity;for(const item of inside.spec.items){if(!item.k||['partition','rug','plant','wall','door','stairs','portal'].includes(item.k))continue;
  const x=X+(item.x+(item.w||1)/2)*unit,y=Y+(item.y+(item.h||1)/2)*unit,d=Math.hypot(sc.player.x-x,sc.player.y-y);
  if(d<unit*2.5&&d<dist){dist=d;best={item,dist:d,title:interiorTitle(item.k)};}}
 return best;
}

function finishInterior(){const sc=scene(),key=selected?.id,item=selected?.item;if(!key||!item||!sc?.inside)return false;

  if(words.length<5){notify('Hãy viết ít nhất 5 từ tiếng Anh để hoàn thành công việc.');return false;}}

 if(kind==='bed'){
  const m=Number(sc.store.game.minutes||720);if(m+30>=1440){sc.store.game.minutes=(m+30)%1440;sc.newDay?.()}else sc.store.game.minutes=m+30;
  try{sc.updateSchedules?.()}catch{};sc.store.save?.();result='Nghỉ 30 phút; NPC đổi ca theo đồng hồ';
 }else if(storage){if(it.count===1){state.inventory.books=(state.inventory.books||0)+1;result='Tìm được một trang tư liệu, đã thêm vào túi V52'}else result='Đã kiểm tra lại; trang tư liệu vẫn trong túi';}
 else if(machine){
  if(['orePile','orepile','minecart'].includes(kind)){if(it.count===1||it.day!==old.day){state.inventory.samples=(state.inventory.samples||0)+1;result='Thu thập được một mẫu khoáng vật thô'}else result='Đã kiểm tra lại mẫu ở khu vực này hôm nay'}
  else if((state.inventory.samples||0)>0){state.inventory.samples--;state.inventory.refined=(state.inventory.refined||0)+1;result='Thiết bị đã xử lý mẫu khoáng vật thành mẫu tinh luyện'}
  else result='Đã khởi động và hiệu chỉnh thiết bị; hãy tìm quặng thô để chế tác';
 }
 else if(food){if(it.day!==old.day||it.count===1){state.inventory.meals=(state.inventory.meals||0)+1;result='Đã chuẩn bị một phần ăn trong game'}else result='Góc bếp đã được chuẩn bị hôm nay';}
 else if(writing)result='Đã nộp bản ghi ngắn bằng tiếng Anh và cập nhật hồ sơ công việc';
 else result='Đã kiểm tra vật thể và lưu vào nhật ký';
 if(it.count===1)record('Nội thất: '+interiorTitle(kind)+' tại '+sc.inside.b.name+' — '+result);else store();
 try{const u=T*sc.inside.k,img=sc.inside.objs.find(o=>o.texture?.key?.startsWith('int_v7_'));if(img){const cx=img.x+(item.x+(item.w||1)/2)*u,cy=img.y+(item.y+(item.h||1)/2)*u;
   const n=sc.add.text(cx,cy-12,'✦',{fontFamily:'monospace',fontSize:'13px',color:'#a5f1cf'}).setDepth(5);sc.inside.objs.push(n);sc.tweens.add({targets:n,alpha:0,y:cy-34,duration:950,onComplete:()=>n.destroy()});

}

}
window.LQ52=Object.freeze({version:VERSION,attach,detach:sc=>{if(active?.sc===sc)clearActive()},update,guardNpc,tryInteract:useNearest,interiorInteract,route,openMenu,closeMenu,state:()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)),stats:()=>({areas:Object.keys(state.projects).length,interiors:Object.keys(state.interior).length,species:Object.keys(state.observations).length}),test:{safeTile,openTile,propPosition,phase,eventKey,project:area=>!!state.projects[area]},maps:MAPS});

<script id="lq-physics-checks">
/* V52.2 · precise polygon diagnostics, no sprites or assets changed. */
(function(){'use strict';
  window.LQPhysicsFix=Object.freeze({
    version:'52.2',
    check(x,y){const s=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();
      if(!s?.area||!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y))return null;
      return {area:s.area.id, worldX:x,worldY:y,
        tileX:Math.floor(x/32),tileY:Math.floor(y/32),
        solid:s.blocked(x,y), geometry:window.LQPrecisePhysics?.debug(s.area,x,y),
        obstacleTile:s.area.isTileBlocked(Math.floor(x/32),Math.floor(y/32))};
    },
    current(){const s=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();
      return s?.player?this.check(s.player.x,s.player.y):null;
    },
    mapStats(){const s=window.__lifequestGetScene?.();const a=s?.area;
      if(!a?.blocked)return null;
      const count=a.blocked.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.reduce((n,v)=>n+(v?1:0),0),0);
      return {area:a.id,buildings:a.buildings.length,obstacles:a.obstacles.length,solidTiles:count,
        tileCount:a.w*a.h};
    }
  });
})();
</script>

  const dist=(a,b,x,y)=>Math.hypot(a-x,b-y);

  function save(sc){try{sc.store?.save?.();return true;}catch(e){console.warn('[V66] Save not available',e);return false;}}
  function state(sc=scene()){
    if(!sc?.store?.game)return null;
    const g=sc.store.game;
    if(!g.v66||typeof g.v66!=='object'||g.v66.schema!==1) g.v66={schema:1,areas:{},objects:{},history:[],seen:{}};
    const d=g.v66;
    for (const k of ['areas','objects','seen']) if(!d[k]||typeof d[k]!=='object')d[k]={};
    if(!Array.isArray(d.history))d.history=[];
    return d;
  }
  function status(sc,key=area(sc)){
    const d=state(sc); if(!d)return null;
    if(!d.areas[key]) d.areas[key]={step:0,complete:false,visits:0};
    return d.areas[key];
  }
  const timeOf=sc=>{const g=sc?.store?.game||{},m=cap(Number(g.minutes??720),0,1439);
    return {minutes:m,day:Math.max(1,Number(g.day)||1), weather:String(g.weather||'clear').toLowerCase(),
      phase:m<390?'night':m<610?'morning':m<1000?'day':m<1150?'evening':'night'};
  };
  function record(sc,title){const d=state(sc);if(!d)return;
    d.history.unshift({area:area(sc),title:String(title).slice(0,110),day:timeOf(sc).day});d.history=d.history.slice(0,32);
    save(sc);

  function buildings(sc){return Array.isArray(sc?.area?.buildings)?sc.area.buildings:[];}
  function matchBuilding(sc,cfg){
    if(!cfg)return null;
    const bs=buildings(sc),key=cfg.building.toLowerCase();
    return bs.find(b=>String(b.name||'').toLowerCase()===key) ||
      bs.find(b=>String(b.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(key)) || null;
  }
  function safe(sc,x,y){return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(y)&&x>24&&y>24&&x<(sc.area.w-1)*32&&y<(sc.area.h-1)*32&&!sc.blocked?.(x,y);}
  function anchorFor(sc,cfg){
    const b=matchBuilding(sc,cfg);
    if(!b)return null;
    const x=(Number(b.door)+.5)*T, y=(Number(b.y)+Number(b.h))*T+23;
    // An interior's blocked() uses local room coordinates. Never feed it outdoor positions.
    if(sc.inside && String(sc.inside.b?.name||'').toLowerCase()===cfg.building.toLowerCase())return{x,y,b};
    if(safe(sc,x,y))return{x,y,b};
    for(const radius of [16,32,48,64,80,96]){
      for(const offset of [0,-16,16,-32,32,-48,48]){
        for(const back of [0,12,24]){
          const xx=x+offset,yy=y+radius+back;
          if(safe(sc,xx,yy))return{x:xx,y:yy,b};
        }
      }
    }
    return null; // Never suggest an unreachable access point.
  }
  function target(sc){const cfg=SCENES[area(sc)];return cfg?anchorFor(sc,cfg):null;}
  function nearTarget(sc){
    if(!gameReady(sc))return false;
    const cfg=SCENES[area(sc)], a=target(sc);
    if(!cfg||!a)return false;
    if(sc.inside)return String(sc.inside.b?.name||'').toLowerCase()===cfg.building.toLowerCase();
    return dist(sc.player.x,sc.player.y,a.x,a.y)<118;
  }
  function realItems(sc){
    if(!validRoom(sc))return [];
    const obj=sc.inside, pic=obj.objs?.[0], x=pic?.x,y=pic?.y,k=obj.k||1;
    if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y))return [];
    return obj.spec.items.filter(it=>it&&Number.isFinite(it.x)&&Number.isFinite(it.y)&&Number.isFinite(it.w)&&Number.isFinite(it.h))
      .map((it,i)=>({key:[area(sc),obj.b.name,obj.floor||0,it.k,it.x,it.y,i].join('::'),it,
        x:x+(it.x+it.w*.5)*T*k,y:y+(it.y+it.h*.5)*T*k, k}));
  }
  function nearestItem(sc){return realItems(sc).filter(p=>/table|counter|desk|bed|shelf|stove|forge|machine|screen|loom|herb|plant|clock|book|cabinet|chest|piano|organ|case|furnace|lantern|fireplace|display|workbench/i.test(String(p.it.k||''))).filter(p=>dist(sc.player.x,sc.player.y,p.x,p.y)<75*p.k).sort((a,b)=>dist(sc.player.x,sc.player.y,a.x,a.y)-dist(sc.player.x,sc.player.y,b.x,b.y))[0]||null;}
  function inspectFurniture(sc){
    const p=nearestItem(sc);if(!p)return false;
    const d=state(sc);if(!d)return false;
    const next=!d.objects[p.key];d.objects[p.key]=next;
    const type=String(p.it.k||'object'), label=next?'được sử dụng':'được đặt lại';
    record(sc,`Nội thất ${type}: ${label}`);ping(sc, next?660:420);
    toast(`Vật thể ${type} ${label}.`);
    redrawPanel();return true;
  }
  function attend(sc){
    if(!gameReady(sc)||!SCENES[area(sc)])return {ok:false,reason:'Khu vực này không có hoạt động V66.'};
    if(!nearTarget(sc))return {ok:false,reason:'Hãy đến gần công trình được đánh dấu hoặc vào đúng phòng.'};
    const s=status(sc),cfg=SCENES[area(sc)];
    if(s.complete)return {ok:false,reason:'Bạn đã hoàn thành hoạt động này. Cảnh quan vẫn ghi nhớ kết quả.'};
    s.step=cap(Number(s.step)||0,0,2)+1;
    if(s.step>=3){s.complete=true;s.completedDay=timeOf(sc).day;}
    record(sc,(s.complete?'Hoàn thành: ':'Hoạt động: ')+cfg.steps[s.step-1]);
    ping(sc,740);toast(s.complete?cfg.result:cfg.steps[s.step-1]);redrawPanel();
    return{ok:true,step:s.step,complete:s.complete};
  }
  function updateLocation(sc){
    const aid=area(sc),room=sc.inside?.b?.name||null;
    if(aid!==currentArea){
      currentArea=aid;lastWeather=timeOf(sc).weather;wetUntil=0;
      const bs=buildings(sc),cfg=SCENES[aid];
      const seed=hash(aid);
      windowTiles=[];puddles=[];
      for(let i=0;i<bs.length;i++){
        if(i%3===seed%3){let b=bs[i];if(Number(b.w)>=2&&Number(b.h)>=2)
          windowTiles.push({x:(b.x+.8+((i*7)%Math.max(1,Math.floor(b.w-1))))*T,y:(b.y+b.h*.47)*T,id:i});}
      }
      const a=cfg?anchorFor(sc,cfg):null;
      if(a){for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
        let x=a.x-128+(i*47)%260,y=a.y+48+((i*29)%84);
        if(safe(sc,x,y)&&dist(x,y,a.x,a.y)>34)puddles.push({x,y,sz:4+(i%3)*2});
      }}
    }
    if(room!==currentRoom){currentRoom=room;redrawPanel();}
  }
  function box(g,x,y,w,h,c,a=1){g.fillStyle(c,a);g.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.max(1,Math.round(w)),Math.max(1,Math.round(h)));}
  function ring(g,x,y,r,c,a=1,w=1){g.lineStyle(w,c,a);g.strokeCircle(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.max(1,r));}
  function line(g,x,y,x2,y2,c,a=1,w=1){g.lineStyle(w,c,a);g.lineBetween(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(x2),Math.round(y2));}
  function shimmer(g,x,y,v,col,t,alpha=1){

    if(v>=2)box(g,x+1,y+5,9,2,0x95dba6,alpha*.7);
  }

  function visible(sc,x,y,pad=180){
    const cam=sc.cameras?.main;if(!cam)return true;
    const view=cam.worldView;if(view&&Number.isFinite(view.x))return x>view.x-pad&&x<view.right+pad&&y>view.y-pad&&y<view.bottom+pad;
    return true;
  }
  function drawWindows(sc,g,t,clock){
    if(!prefs.windows)return;
    const night=clock.phase==='night'||clock.phase==='evening';
    const max=prefs.quiet?5:10;let drawn=0;
    for(const p of windowTiles){if(drawn>=max)break;if(!visible(sc,p.x,p.y))continue;
      const lit=night||((Math.floor(t/2300)+p.id)%4===0);
      box(g,p.x,p.y,8,9,0x1f3137,.72);box(g,p.x+2,p.y+2,4,5,lit?0xf9d6a0:0x7ca29c,lit?.65:.22);
      if(lit && !prefs.quiet && clock.phase==='night')box(g,p.x-2,p.y-2,11,12,0xe9bd7d,.06);
      drawn++;
    }
  }
  function drawWeather(sc,g,t,clock){
    if(!prefs.weather)return;
    const raining=/rain|storm|mưa|mua|wet/i.test(clock.weather);
    if(lastWeather && /rain|storm|mưa|mua|wet/i.test(lastWeather) && !raining) wetUntil=t+45000;
    lastWeather=clock.weather;
    if(raining)wetUntil=t+6000;
    if(t>wetUntil)return;
    const a=raining?.14:.12*cap((wetUntil-t)/45000,0,1);
    for(const p of puddles){if(!visible(sc,p.x,p.y))continue;
      g.fillStyle(0x9dcace,a);g.fillEllipse(p.x,p.y,p.sz*5,p.sz*2);
      if(!prefs.quiet && Math.floor(t/480)%3===0)ring(g,p.x,p.y,p.sz*1.8,0xd8eff3,a*1.5);
    }
  }
  function drawActorIntent(sc,g,t,a,stage){
    if(!Array.isArray(sc.npcs))return;
    let n=0;
    for(const npc of sc.npcs){if(n>=3)break;
      const s=npc?.sprite;if(!s?.visible||npc.inside||!visible(sc,s.x,s.y,65))continue;
      if(dist(s.x,s.y,a.x,a.y)>145)continue;
      const y=s.y-39+Math.sin(t*.004+n)*2;
      box(g,s.x-9,y-7,18,13,0x1b3540,.78);
      for(let j=0;j<3;j++)box(g,s.x-6+j*5,y-2,3,3,stage>=3?0x9ce2af:0xe1d7ae,.9);
      n++;
    }
  }
  function drawOutdoor(sc,t){
    if(!worldGraphics||!gameReady(sc))return;
    worldGraphics.clear();if(!prefs.enabled||sc.inside)return;
    const cfg=SCENES[area(sc)],a=cfg?anchorFor(sc,cfg):null,clock=timeOf(sc);
    if(a){
      const statusNow=status(sc), rawStep=statusNow?.step||0;
      // Daily scene choreography is visual; quest progress is stored separately.
      const step=statusNow?.complete?3:Math.max(rawStep,clock.phase==='morning'?1:clock.phase==='day'?2:0);
      const bx=(Number(a.b.door)+.5)*T,by=(Number(a.b.y)+Number(a.b.h)*.67)*T;
      if(visible(sc,bx,by)){
        drawSignature(worldGraphics,cfg,bx,by,step,t,clock,prefs.quiet);
        if(!prefs.quiet) drawActorIntent(sc,worldGraphics,t,a,step);
      }
      if(prefs.focus && !statusNow?.complete && visible(sc,a.x,a.y)){
        ring(worldGraphics,a.x,a.y,12+Math.sin(t*.003)*2,cfg.color,.45,2);
        box(worldGraphics,a.x-11,a.y-15,22,2,cfg.color,.65);
      }
    }
    drawWindows(sc,worldGraphics,t,clock);
    if(!prefs.quiet)drawWeather(sc,worldGraphics,t,clock);
  }
  function drawInterior(sc,t){
    indoorGraphics?.clear();
    if(!indoorGraphics||!prefs.enabled||!prefs.interior||!validRoom(sc))return;
    const clock=timeOf(sc),all=realItems(sc),d=state(sc),lim=prefs.quiet?3:5;
    const bx=sc.inside.objs[0].x, by=sc.inside.objs[0].y,k=sc.inside.k||1;
    // Light from actual wall band, never drawn into physical doorway.
    const tone=clock.phase==='evening'||clock.phase==='night'?0xf6d39a:0xe1e5cb;
    for(const i of [0,1]){
      const x=bx+sc.inside.spec.w*T*k*(.21+i*.58),y=by+22*k;
      box(indoorGraphics,x-7*k,y,14*k,3*k,tone,.3);
      if(!prefs.quiet&&prefs.particles)box(indoorGraphics,x-3*k,y+7*k,6*k,2*k,tone,.1);
    }
    let count=0;
    for(const obj of all){
      if(count>=lim)break;
      const kind=String(obj.it.k||'');
      if(!/table|counter|desk|bed|shelf|stove|forge|machine|screen|loom|herb|plant|clock|book|cabinet|chest|piano|organ|case|furnace|lantern|fireplace|display|workbench/i.test(kind))continue;
      if(!visible(sc,obj.x,obj.y,65))continue;
      const on=!!d.objects[obj.key],x=obj.x,y=obj.y;
      const c=on?0xbce8b2:0xe7c99b,alpha=on?.8:.3;
      box(indoorGraphics,x-8*k,y-6*k,16*k,2*k,c,alpha);
      if(on){box(indoorGraphics,x-5*k,y-11*k,10*k,3*k,c,.52);
        if(!prefs.quiet && prefs.particles){let dx=Math.sin(t*.002+count)*2*k;box(indoorGraphics,x+dx,y-15*k,2*k,2*k,c,.65);}}
      count++;
    }
  }
  function attach(sc){
    if(!gameReady(sc)||sc.__lq66Attached)return;
    current=sc;
    // One graphical layer per environment. No fake obstacles or replacement NPC sprites.
    worldGraphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(7.15);
    indoorGraphics=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(2.15);
    worldGraphics.__lq66=true;indoorGraphics.__lq66=true;
    const handleUpdate=(time,delta)=>{
      if(!gameReady(sc)||sc!==scene())return;
      const now=Number.isFinite(time)?time:performance.now();
      if(now-lastPulse< (prefs.quiet?190:85))return;
      const stamp=performance.now(); lastPulse=now;

  function ping(sc,frequency){
    if(!prefs.sound)return;
    try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return;
      audioCtx=audioCtx||new AC(); if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume();
      let o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),gain=audioCtx.createGain();
      o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=frequency;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.018,audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+.13);
      o.connect(gain);gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+.14);
    }catch(_){}
  }

function wallBase(ctx){

 for(let row=0;row<10;row++)for(let col=-1;col<15;col++){
  const x=col*42+(row%2?21:0),y=row*20;
  ctx.fillStyle=['#4b4b5b','#494453','#575160','#464552'][Math.abs(row*7+col*3)%4];ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,39,17);
  ctx.fillStyle='#68707e';ctx.fillRect(x+3,y+2,37,1);
 }
 ctx.fillStyle='#0e1a2c';ctx.globalAlpha=.23;ctx.fillRect(7,7,W-14,H-14);ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 // mural frame and guiding symbols from the older neighborhood story
 const colors=['#ffd447','#35c8d0','#ff4f87'];
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ctx.strokeStyle=colors[i];ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeRect(7+i*4,7+i*4,W-14-i*8,H-14-i*8);}
 ctx.font='bold 15px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#dacdbf';ctx.fillText('THE COMMUNITY WALL',30,33);
 ctx.fillStyle='#74c9c6';ctx.font='bold 11px monospace';ctx.fillText('EVERY MARK TELLS A STORY',29,H-21);
}
function drawingLayer(strokes){
 const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=H;
 const ctx=c.getContext('2d');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 for(const s of strokes){const pts=Array.isArray(s.points)?s.points:[];if(!pts.length)continue;
  const c=s.tool==='eraser'?'#000000':(/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(s.color)?s.color:'#ff4f87');
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=s.tool==='eraser'?'destination-out':'source-over';ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.fillStyle=c;
  const size=Math.max(2,Math.min(28,Number(s.size)||7));ctx.lineWidth=size*(s.tool==='marker'?1.4:1);
  ctx.lineCap=s.tool==='marker'?'square':'round';ctx.lineJoin='round';
  if(s.tool==='stamp'){
   let [x,y]=pts[0],r=size*2.8;ctx.beginPath();
   if(s.stamp==='eye'){ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*.54,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r*.26,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
   else if(s.stamp==='wave'){
    ctx.moveTo(x-r,y);for(let i=0;i<=24;i++){const xx=x-r+2*r*i/24;ctx.lineTo(xx,y+Math.sin(i/24*Math.PI*2)*r*.37)}ctx.stroke();
   } else {
    const n=s.stamp==='bolt'?4:5;for(let i=0;i<n*2;i++){const a=-Math.PI/2+i*Math.PI/n,rr=i%2?r*.42:r;const px=x+Math.cos(a)*rr,py=y+Math.sin(a)*rr;if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(px,py);else ctx.lineTo(px,py);}ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();}
  }else if(s.tool==='spray'){
   for(let pi=0;pi<pts.length;pi++){
    const [x,y]=pts[pi];for(let j=0;j<12;j++){const angle=(j*2.399+pi*1.17),rad=(j%7+1)*size*.35;
     ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x+Math.cos(angle)*rad),Math.round(y+Math.sin(angle)*rad),j%4===0?3:2,2);
    }
   }
  }else{ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...pts[0]);for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(...pts[i]);
   if(pts.length===1){ctx.fillRect(pts[0][0]-size/2,pts[0][1]-size/2,size,size);}else ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.restore();
 }
 return c;
}
function renderMural(canvas, strokes){const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;wallBase(ctx);ctx.drawImage(drawingLayer(strokes),0,0);}

function displayOnWorld(sc){
 if(!ext(sc))return;

 sc.textures.addCanvas(key,canvas);
 const img=sc.add.image(4*T+18,25*T+108,key).setOrigin(0,0).setDisplaySize(140,50).setDepth(1.2);
 const frame=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.21);
 frame.lineStyle(3,0xe9c986,.98).strokeRect(4*T+16,25*T+106,144,54);
 frame.fillStyle(0x213344,.90).fillRect(4*T+17,25*T+161,142,10);

 objects.push(img,frame,label);
 if(sc.textures.exists('lq71_eye'))sc.textures.remove('lq71_eye');
 // Image is loaded asynchronously in the first frames; the next scene refresh attaches it.
 if(imgEye.complete&&imgEye.naturalWidth){sc.textures.addImage('lq71_eye',imgEye);const eye=sc.add.image(4*T+18,4*T+109,'lq71_eye').setOrigin(0,0).setDisplaySize(68,68).setDepth(1.18);
  const border=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.19);border.lineStyle(3,0xd4b778,.85).strokeRect(4*T+16,4*T+107,72,72);objects.push(eye,border);
 }
 const glow=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(1.15);objects.push(glow);
 ambient=glow;

}

function navTarget(sc,to){
 if(!ext(sc)||!sc.area?.isTileBlocked)return false;
 const w=sc.area.w,h=sc.area.h,source=[Math.floor(sc.player.x/TILE),Math.floor(sc.player.y/TILE)],idx=(x,y)=>y*w+x;
 const prev=new Int32Array(w*h).fill(-1),a=[source],origin=idx(...source),target=idx(...to);prev[origin]=origin;
 for(let i=0;i<a.length&&prev[target]===-1;i++){
  const [x,y]=a[i];for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){
   const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=w||ny>=h||sc.area.isTileBlocked(nx,ny))continue;
   const k=idx(nx,ny);if(prev[k]!==-1)continue;prev[k]=idx(x,y);a.push([nx,ny]);
  }
 }
 if(prev[target]===-1){toast('Không tìm thấy đường đi tới địa điểm này.');return false}
 const points=[];for(let k=target,j=0;j<w*h;j++){points.push([k%w,Math.floor(k/w)]);if(k===origin)break;k=prev[k]}
 points.reverse();route={points,target:to,label:'Art District',built:Date.now()};toast('Đã chỉ đường trên bản đồ · '+(points.length-1)+' ô.');return true;
}

function initPainting(){
  const sc=current();if(!artUnlocked(sc)||!nearArt(sc,[9,32],4.25))return;draw=$('lq71-draw');if(!draw)return;
 const saved=(state(sc).strokes||[]).map(s=>({...s,points:(s.points||[]).map(p=>p.slice())}));
 let strokes=saved,tool='brush',color='#ff4f87',size=7,stamp='star',working=null,pointer=null;
 const redraw=()=>{renderMural(draw,working?[...strokes,working]:strokes);$('lq71-editor-status').textContent=strokes.length+' nét đã vẽ · Nhấn Lưu tác phẩm để áp dụng vào bản đồ.';};
 redraw();
 const getPoint=e=>{const r=draw.getBoundingClientRect();return [Math.max(0,Math.min(W,Math.round((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*W/3)*3)),Math.max(0,Math.min(H,Math.round((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H/3)*3))]};
 draw.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button!==0&&e.pointerType==='mouse')return;e.preventDefault();pointer=e.pointerId;draw.setPointerCapture(pointer);working={tool,color,size,stamp,points:[getPoint(e)]};redraw();});
 draw.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId!==pointer||!working||working.tool==='stamp')return;const p=getPoint(e),last=working.points[working.points.length-1];if(Math.hypot(p[0]-last[0],p[1]-last[1])>=3&&working.points.length<350){working.points.push(p);redraw();}});
 const done=e=>{if(e.pointerId!==pointer)return;e.preventDefault();if(working){strokes.push(working);if(strokes.length>150)strokes=strokes.slice(-150);working=null;redraw()}pointer=null;};
 draw.addEventListener('pointerup',done);draw.addEventListener('pointercancel',done);
 const pb=panel.querySelector('[data-action=save]');pb.onclick=()=>{if(!ext(sc)||!artUnlocked(sc)||!nearArt(sc,[9,32],4.25))return;if(persist(sc,strokes)){refreshWorld(sc);toast('Đã lưu tranh Community Wall vào tiến trình game.');$('lq71-editor-status').textContent='✓ Đã lưu! Tranh xuất hiện bên mặt tiền Mural Workshop.';}else toast('Chưa lưu được tranh. Hãy kiểm tra bộ nhớ trình duyệt.')};
 panel.querySelector('[data-action=undo]').onclick=()=>{strokes.pop();redraw()};
 panel.querySelector('[data-action=reset]').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Xóa toàn bộ nét trong bản nháp?')){strokes=[];redraw()}};
 panel.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{color=b.dataset.color;panel.querySelector('#lq71-color').value=color;});
 panel.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{tool=b.dataset.tool;panel.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',el===b));});
 panel.querySelector('[data-tool=brush]').classList.add('active');
 panel.querySelector('#lq71-color').oninput=e=>{color=e.target.value};
 panel.querySelector('#lq71-size').oninput=e=>{size=Number(e.target.value)};
 panel.querySelector('#lq71-stamp').onchange=e=>{stamp=e.target.value};
 painter={getStrokes:()=>strokes,redraw};
}

function ambience(sc,time){if(!ambient||!ext(sc)||!sc.cameras?.main||visible)return;
 ambient.clear();const v=sc.cameras.main.worldView;
 const reduce=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches;
 const hrs=Number(sc.store?.game?.minutes||720)%1440,night=hrs>=1070||hrs<340;
 const sites=[
  {x:9*T,y:33*T,k:'paint',c:0xff8dbb},
  {x:9*T,y:46*T,k:'music',c:0x6de9e3},
  {x:62*T,y:34*T,k:'photo',c:0xd7bcff},
  {x:83*T,y:32*T,k:'paint',c:0xffb879},
  {x:83*T,y:83*T,k:'dance',c:0xff87c9},
  {x:36*T,y:14*T,k:'gate',c:0xffcd8b}
 ];
 for(let i=0;i<sites.length;i++){
  const a=sites[i];if(a.x<v.x-150||a.x>v.right+150||a.y<v.y-150||a.y>v.bottom+150)continue;
  const phase=reduce?0:time*.002+i*1.4;let x=a.x+Math.sin(phase)*7,y=a.y-18-Math.cos(phase*.7)*6;
  if(a.k==='paint'){
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++){ambient.fillStyle([0xffd675,0xf58bb8,0x73ddcb][j],.45);ambient.fillRect(x+j*7,y-j*5,3,5)}
  }else if(a.k==='music'){
   ambient.fillStyle(a.c,.35).fillCircle(x,y,4);ambient.fillRect(x+3,y-15,2,15);ambient.fillRect(x+3,y-15,7,2);
  }else if(a.k==='photo'){
   if(reduce||Math.floor(time/900)%5===0){ambient.fillStyle(a.c,.33).fillCircle(x,y,10);ambient.fillStyle(0xffffff,.6).fillCircle(x,y,2)}
  }else if(a.k==='dance'){
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++){ambient.fillStyle(a.c,.24).fillRect(x+k*8,y+2-(k%2)*5,5,7)}
  }else if(night){
   for(let k=-3;k<=3;k++){ambient.fillStyle(k%2?0xffd18a:0x88e4d2,.08).fillCircle(a.x+k*19,a.y-68,10)}
  }
 }
 if(route?.points?.length){
  const player=sc.player,dx=route.target[0]*TILE+16-player.x,dy=route.target[1]*TILE+16-player.y;
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<56){route=null;toast('Đã tới gần điểm tham quan.');return}
  const pt=route.points;
  for(let i=0;i<pt.length;i+=2){const p=pt[i],x=(p[0]+.5)*TILE,y=(p[1]+.5)*TILE;
   if(x<v.x-20||x>v.right+20||y<v.y-20||y>v.bottom+20)continue;
   ambient.fillStyle(0x4be0dc,.55).fillCircle(x,y,4);ambient.fillStyle(0xffeec9,.38).fillCircle(x,y,1.5);
  }
 }
}
let lastTime=0;
function updateArtPrompt(sc){
 if(!root)return;const btn=$('lq71-open');if(!btn)return;
 const task=nextArtTask(sc),at=task?.at||[9,32],here=nearArt(sc,at);
 const visibleHint=here&&!visible&&!artFilmShowing();
 btn.hidden=!visibleHint;
 if(visibleHint)btn.textContent=task?'🎨 F5 · '+task.title.replace(/^\d+ · /,''):'🎨 F5 · Vẽ Community Wall';
}
function update(sc,time){
 if(!ext(sc)){if(linkedScene===sc&&objects.length)clearWorld();if(root){root.hidden=!active(sc);if(visible)close();updateArtPrompt(sc);}return}
 if(linkedScene!==sc||!objects.length){clearWorld();linkedScene=sc;displayOnWorld(sc);}
 if(root)root.hidden=false;
 if(time-lastTime>140){lastTime=time;ambience(sc,time);updateArtPrompt(sc)}
}
function attach(sc){if(sc.__lq71Attached)return;sc.__lq71Attached=true;
 sc.events.on('update',(time)=>{try{update(sc,time)}catch(e){if(!sc.__lq71Warn){console.warn('[V71 Art]',e);sc.__lq71Warn=true}}});
 sc.events.once('shutdown',()=>{clearWorld();sc.__lq71Attached=false});
}
function start(){mount();
 const refresh=()=>{const sc=current();if(sc?.events){attach(sc);if(active(sc)){root.hidden=false;updateArtPrompt(sc);if(ext(sc)&&linkedScene===sc&&imgEye.complete&&imgEye.naturalWidth&&!sc.textures.exists('lq71_eye'))refreshWorld(sc);}}
  else if(root)root.hidden=true;
 };
 setInterval(refresh,1000);imgEye.addEventListener('load',refresh,{once:true});refresh();
}

 ];
 function scene(){ try{return window.__lifequestGetScene?.()||null;}catch(_){return null;} }
 function active(sc){ return !!(sc&&sc.area&&sc.area.id===AREA&&sc.player&&sc.add&&sc.events); }
 function offscreen(sc,sp,pad=120){ const v=sc?.cameras?.main?.worldView; return !!(v&&(sp.x<v.x-pad||sp.y<v.y-pad||sp.x>v.right+pad||sp.y>v.bottom+pad)); }
 function uniqueTextures(sc){
  const keys=[]; const seen=new Set();
  for(const n of sc.npcs||[]){ const key=n?.sprite?.texture?.key; if(key&&key!=='__MISSING'&&!seen.has(key)){ seen.add(key); keys.push({key,scale:Math.abs(n.sprite.scaleX||1)}); } }
  return keys;
 }
 function drawProps(sc){

   const g=sc.add.graphics().setDepth(6.95); props.push(g);

    g.lineStyle(2,0xffd7a1,.45).strokeCircle(px+16,py+16,26);
    g.fillStyle(0x243447,.9).fillRoundedRect(px+4,py+6,18,22,4); g.fillStyle(0xffca84,.85).fillRect(px+10,py+2,6,6);
   }

 }
 function spawnCrowd(sc){
  const pool=uniqueTextures(sc); if(!pool.length) return;
  const taken=new Set();
  const valid=(x,y)=>{
    if(x<2||y<2||x>=sc.area.w-2||y>=sc.area.h-2||sc.area.isTileBlocked?.(x,y)||sc.area.warpAt?.(x,y)||taken.has(x+','+y))return false;
    // Keep the main central parade lane and building doors visually accessible.
    if(x>=34&&x<=37&&y>=10&&y<=52)return false;
    if(sc.area.buildings.some(b=>Math.abs(b.door-x)<=1 && Math.abs(b.y+b.h-y)<=1))return false;
    return true;
  };
  const nearest=(x,y)=>{
    if(valid(x,y))return [x,y];
    for(let r=1;r<=5;r++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){
      if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))!==r)continue;
      if(valid(x+dx,y+dy))return [x+dx,y+dy];
    }
    return null;
  };
  let idx=0;
  for(const site of SITES){
   for(const entry of site.crowd){
    const p=nearest(entry.p[0],entry.p[1]), role=entry.r;
    if(!p)continue;
    taken.add(p[0]+','+p[1]);
    const tex=pool[idx%pool.length]; idx++;
    const sp=sc.add.sprite((p[0]+.5)*TILE,(p[1]+.5)*TILE,tex.key).setDepth(7.35).setScale(tex.scale||1);
    sp.setVisible(true);
    crowd.push({sprite:sp,home:p,role,seed:idx,baseY:(p[1]+.5)*TILE,baseX:(p[0]+.5)*TILE,focus:site.at});
   }
  }
 }
 function clearAll(){ for(const a of crowd) try{a.sprite.destroy()}catch(_){} crowd=[]; for(const p of props) try{p.destroy()}catch(_){} props=[]; installed=null; }
 function install(sc){ clearAll(); installed=sc; drawProps(sc); spawnCrowd(sc); sc.events.once('shutdown',clearAll); }
 function animateActor(a,time){
   const sp=a.sprite; const t=time*0.001 + a.seed*0.37;
   let x=a.baseX, y=a.baseY, flip=false;
   if(a.role===ROLES.watch){ x+=Math.sin(t*.8)*2.2; y+=Math.cos(t*1.1)*1.4; flip=Math.sin(t) < 0; }
   else if(a.role===ROLES.paint){ x+=Math.sin(t*.4)*1.2; y+=Math.cos(t*.6)*.9; flip=true; }
   else if(a.role===ROLES.perform){ x+=Math.sin(t*1.7)*4.5; y+=Math.cos(t*1.5)*2.8; flip=Math.sin(t*1.7)<0; }
   else if(a.role===ROLES.dance){ x+=Math.sin(t*2.2)*7.5; y+=Math.cos(t*1.8)*4.2; flip=Math.sin(t*2.2)<0; }
   else { x+=Math.sin(t*.9)*5; y+=Math.cos(t*.7)*3; flip=Math.cos(t)<0; }
   sp.x=x; sp.y=y; sp.setFlipX(flip); sp.setVisible(!offscreen(installed,sp));
 }
 function update(time){
   const sc=scene();
   if(!active(sc)){ if(installed) clearAll(); return; }
   if(installed!==sc||!crowd.length) install(sc);
   if(sc.inside){ for(const a of crowd) a.sprite.setVisible(false); for(const p of props) p.setVisible(false); return; }
   for(const p of props) p.setVisible(true);
   if(time-lastTick<90) return; lastTick=time;
   for(const a of crowd) animateActor(a,time);
  }
 function boot(){ setInterval(()=>{ try{ update(performance.now()); }catch(e){ if(!window.__lq73Warn){ console.warn('[LQ V73 Crowd]',e); window.__lq73Warn=true; } } },110); }
 if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true}); else boot();
 window.LQArtV73={version:'74.0-crowd-art-district-fixed',diagnostics:()=>({count:crowd.length,sites:SITES.length,artists:crowd.filter(c=>c.role==='paint').length,dancers:crowd.filter(c=>c.role==='dance').length,watchers:crowd.filter(c=>c.role==='watch').length})};
})();

(() => {

const MOOD_ICON = {"neutral":"◆","happy":"✦","sad":"◒","confused":"?","amused":"✧","curious":"?","disagreeing":"◇","worried":"!","formal":"♜","calm":"◈","friendly":"✦","surprised":"!","angry":"!","shy":"◒","embarrassed":"◒","thinking":"…","doubtful":"?","relieved":"◈","excited":"✧","apologetic":"◒","encouraging":"✦","impressed":"✧","disappointed":"◒","proud":"♜","focused":"◆","urgent":"!","nostalgic":"◈","grateful":"✦","frustrated":"!","determined":"◆","suspicious":"?","playful":"✧","confident":"◆","contemptuous":"◇","tired":"…","inspired":"✧","patient":"◈","solemn":"♜","alert":"!","persuasive":"✦"};

function data(sc = getScene()) {
  if (!valid(sc)) return null;
  const g = sc.store.game;
  if (!g.v77 || typeof g.v77 !== 'object' || Array.isArray(g.v77)) g.v77 = { schema: 1 };
  const d = g.v77;
  d.schema = 1;
  if (!d.passport || typeof d.passport !== 'object') d.passport = {};
  if (!Array.isArray(d.favorites)) d.favorites = [];
  if (!d.names || typeof d.names !== 'object') d.names = {};
  if (!d.helped || typeof d.helped !== 'object') d.helped = {};
  if (!d.news || typeof d.news !== 'object') d.news = { lastReadAt: 0 };
  return d;
}
function persist(sc = getScene()) { try { sc?.store?.save?.(); } catch {} }
function level() { try { return services()?.cefr?.getLevel?.() || 'B1'; } catch { return 'B1'; } }
function speak(text) {
  const s = services()?.speech;
  if (s && typeof s.speak === 'function') { s.speak(String(text)); return; }
  try {
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(String(text));
    u.lang = 'en-US'; u.rate = 0.95;
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  } catch {}
}
function timeLabel(minutes) {
  const m = Math.max(0, Math.min(1439, Number(minutes) || 0));
  return String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0');
}
function affinityLabel(a) { return a < 0 ? 'Unfriendly' : a < 10 ? 'Stranger' : a < 30 ? 'Acquaintance' : a < 60 ? 'Friend' : 'Close friend'; }

/* ---------- names: learn NPC display names from the live scene ---------- */
function refreshNames(sc = getScene()) {
  const d = data(sc); if (!d) return;
  let changed = false;
  const add = (id, name) => { if (id && name && d.names[id] !== name) { d.names[id] = name; changed = true; } };
  try {
    for (const n of sc.npcs || []) add(n?.def?.id || n?.id, n?.def?.name || n?.name);
    const c = sc.chat?.npc; if (c) add(c.id, c.name);
  } catch {}
  if (changed) persist(sc);
}
const npcName = (d, id) => d?.names?.[id] || String(id || 'someone').replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());

/* ---------- helped: remember, per region, that the player fulfilled a resident's wish ----------
   The base game marks a resident's wish done in store.mem[id].goalDone, but it does not tie that
   to a region in the V60 world log. While the player is in a region we observe its residents and
   record the evidence under v77.helped[regionId], so the passport stamp survives leaving/reloading. */
function refreshHelped(sc = getScene()) {
  const d = data(sc); if (!d) return;
  const area = sc.area?.id; if (!area) return;
  if (d.helped[area]) return;
  let done = null;
  try {
    for (const n of sc.npcs || []) {
      const id = n?.def?.id || n?.id;
      if (id && sc.store.mem?.[id]?.goalDone) { done = id; break; }
    }
    const c = sc.chat?.npc;
    if (!done && c?.id && sc.store.mem?.[c.id]?.goalDone) done = c.id;
  } catch {}
  if (done) {
    d.helped[area] = { npc: done, day: sc.store.game.day || 1, at: Date.now() };
    persist(sc);
  }
}

const toastEl = document.createElement('div');
toastEl.id = 'lq77-toast';
document.body.appendChild(toastEl);
let toastTimer = 0;
function toast(msg) {
  toastEl.textContent = msg;
  toastEl.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.remove('show'), 4200);
}

const panels = {};
function makePanel(id, paper) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.id = id;
  el.className = 'lq77-panel' + (paper ? ' lq77-paper' : '');
  el.style.display = 'none';
  el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  panels[id] = el;
  return el;
}
function closePanels() { for (const el of Object.values(panels)) el.style.display = 'none'; }
function anyPanelOpen() { return Object.values(panels).some(el => el.style.display === 'block'); }
function baseOverlayOpen() {
  return ['chat', 'settings', 'briefing', 'helper', 'journal', 'quests'].some(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    return el && el.style.display === 'block';
  });
}
function openPanel(el) { closePanels(); el.style.display = 'block'; }
function closeButton(el, extra) {
  const b = document.createElement('button');
  b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'lq77-close'; b.textContent = '✕ Close';
  b.onclick = () => { el.style.display = 'none'; extra?.(); };
  el.appendChild(b);
  return b;
}
function openHelperWith(word) {
  const helper = document.getElementById('helper');
  const input = helper?.querySelector('input');
  const ask = document.getElementById('helper-ask');
  if (!helper || !input || !ask) { toast('Word helper is not ready yet.'); return; }
  closePanels();
  input.value = word;
  helper.style.display = 'block';
  ask.click();
}
function wordSpans(container, text) {
  const parts = String(text).split(/(\s+)/);
  for (const p of parts) {
    if (/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'-]{1,}$/.test(p)) {
      const s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'lq77-word'; s.textContent = p; s.title = 'Look up "' + p + '" in the Word helper';
      s.onclick = () => openHelperWith(p.replace(/^['-]+|['-]+$/g, ''));
      container.appendChild(s);
    } else container.appendChild(document.createTextNode(p));
  }
}
function moodChip(mood) {
  if (!mood || !MOODS.has(mood) || mood === 'neutral') return null;
  const chip = document.createElement('span');
  chip.className = 'lq77-mood lq77-mood-' + mood;
  chip.textContent = (MOOD_ICON[mood] || '') + ' ' + mood;
  return chip;
}
